In each case the villain escaped, always with increasingly rude remarks concerning my master. Daily Lord Jabba's matchless anger grows. It now falls to you to terminate this wily and well-armed offender.
Bib Fortuna, Lord Jabba's Majordomo
Lord Jabba sends his regards.
Insulter of Lord Jabba the Hutt
Another one. If this goes on, I'm gonna make that bloated worm eat his own tail.

A bounty is hereby issued on a confidence man accused of defrauding millions of credits from victims across the galaxy. Target is believed to be extremely intelligent, heavily armed, and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You've got a quick wit, but not quicker than this bounty hunter's trigger finger."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Thank you, bounty hunter. You don't know how many humiliated victims will celebrate this news."
Galactic Con Man
I thought you'd never catch up to me, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a notorious professional assassin, implicated in more than two dozen executions in the Core Worlds. Target is believed to be heavily armed, high-threat, and traveling in disguise. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You're one of the best, but we hired someone better."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That assassin was the best we ever hired. Next to you, that is. Perhaps we'll be in touch again."
Notorious Assassin
Great. Another bounty hunter. Back off while you can, friend.

A bounty is hereby issued on the murderer of an innocent fish-farming family on Mon Calamari. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "There is always a bigger fish."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The seas of Calamari are cleaner with the passing of this monster."
Vicious Murderer
I thought those Mon Cals would lead me to their Knowledge Bank. I didn't like killing them. I won't like killing you either.

A bounty is hereby issued on a freelance spymaster and architect of countless espionage and sabotage schemes. Target is believed heavily armed, high-threat, and aware of this bounty. Extreme caution is warranted. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Time to blow your cover."
Bounty Hunters' Guild

Client sends congratulations and this message: "Your target's plots killed dozens and brought down many powerful regimes. Three bounty hunters were killed before you succeeded. You're among the best at what you do."
Freelance Spymaster
You're quite skilled at pursuit. Too bad I have to kill you now.

A bounty is hereby issued on a mercenary general, wanted for atrocities in four sectors. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Mercenaries have no friends, only clients and enemies. Both of them want to see you dead."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The general's atrocities were legendary. You have rid the galaxy of a terrible scourge."
Mercenary General
I knew they'd send a hunter to do their dirty work. But you never met a mark like me!

A bounty is hereby issued on a rogue bounty hunter, accused of abetting the escape of a high-priced target and betraying an honest client. Target is heavily armed and expert in hunting techniques. Proceed with utmost caution. The client advises against speaking to the target before termination.
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Conscience is a detriment to a bounty hunter. We're glad you, at least, understand that."
Rogue Bounty Hunter
I know your work. You're good. So I'll give you one chance to forget that you found me.

A bounty is hereby issued on an elite slicer guilty of invading classified data systems in twelve sectors. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat, and is known to monitor shuttle and spaceport logs to elude pursuers. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "It's time to log you out."
Bounty Hunters' Guild

Client sends congratulations and this message: "Slicers think it's all fun and games, but this one compromised data that could endanger the lives of our operatives. You have demonstrated the seriousness of the crime. Thank you."
Elite Slicer
You can't have found me! It's inconceivable!

A bounty is hereby issued on a former intelligence agent for an outlying star system, who is now a consultant to enemies of the planetary government. Target is believed heavily armed, extremely dangerous, and capable of detecting pursuit. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Consider this your authorization for retirement."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Some professions demand a lifelong commitment. Don't you agree, bounty hunter?"
Corrupt Intelligence Agent
Finally caught up to me, eh? Too bad I'm your last mark, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a fugitive pirate captain accused of betraying a loyal crew. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You accused us of mutiny once. See what happens when we get really angry?"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That space scum marooned us on an asteroid. Killing was almost too merciful, but we wanted this to be over once and for all. Thanks for the good work."
Fugitive Pirate Captain
Think you're a match for me, hunter? Show me what you've got!

A bounty is hereby issued on a felon who destroyed several laboratories on Mrlsst in the Mennaalii system. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "This is the fate of those who oppose the quest for knowledge."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The quest for knowledge continues."
Vandal of Mrlsst Laboratories
Those labs were developing a cloaking device to sell to the highest bidder! I saw the proposals myself! But this set them back, let me tell you! Haha!

A bounty is hereby issued on a mercenary who led a notorious band of Gank killers on Nar Shaddaa, the Smugglers' Moon in the Y'Toub system. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Leyn Vanrel took over your gang. He sends his regards."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Nicely done. You may want to look me up when next you're on Nar Shaddaa. Lovely place, you'll like it."
Gank Assassin Leader
Why, that stinking --!

In House Benelex you are not simply one of the finest bounty hunters in the galaxy; you are, as it were, part of a family. Our benevolent leader, Corvastan Benelex, recently escaped a scurrilous assassination attempt at his home on Paquallis III. This is heavy-handed work by our longtime rival, House Tresario. Now House Benelex offers you the chance to dispose of the assassin, prove your ability, and earn both our family's gratitude and our generous bounty. Speak first to the target, saying: "Greetings from Corvastan Benelex."
Benelex Bounty Hunters' Guild
Splendid fighting, executed with a true warrior's grace. You will be welcome in the Benelex family when you are next on Paquallis III.
Hired Assassin
Oh ho! He still lives, does he? More than I can say for you.

The short history of House Neuvalis chronicles its steady rise to preeminence among bounty hunters. With the recent fracture in the Bounty Hunters' Guild, House Neuvalis carries on its true spirit. You too may take up the torch by hunting the culprit behind an assassination attempt on Beldorian the Hutt on the desert world of Nam Chorios. This assassin is armed and extremely dangerous. Beldorian desires that you first speak these words: "Ah bah pwoodah ngallah dowaalaa!"
Neuvalis Bounty Hunters' Guild
Your exemplary performance reflects the highest standards of the fading Guild, and of House Neuvalis as it carries forward the cause. Spread the news of our high aspirations!
Failed Assassin of Beldorian the Hutt
You speak Huttese poorly.

House Salaktori protects its high reputation as the galaxy's oldest and greatest hunting guild. Recent fractures in the outmoded galaxy-wide Bounty Hunters' Guild have encouraged rival houses to attack our members. By House policy, we avenge these offenses within no more than one standard year. One assassin has escaped vengeance, and the deadline approaches. We offer you this chance to earn our favor by killing this resilient quarry.
Salaktori Hunters' Guild
House Salaktori gratefully receives this favor. For your efforts in protecting our high reputation we award this bounty.
Assassin of House Salaktori Member
You don't even look like a Salaktori. They must be getting desperate now.

A bounty is hereby issued on the destroyer of an orbital mining facility near Ord Mantell in the Bright Jewel system. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You destroyed my livelihood; now I destroy your life."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Indiscriminate destruction gives bounty hunting a bad name."
Ord Mantell Saboteur
I'm a hunter too. My target was on that mining station, so I blew it up. Now I have to take you out too.

A bounty is hereby issued on a propagandist who spreads despicable lies about Imperial practices on the Core World Ralltiir. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Victory is ours. All will join us."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The propagandist's data has now been destroyed. All is well."
Ralltiir Anti-Imperial Progagandist
I've got holos showing the Empire's press gangs, puppet military tribunals, and savage atrocities. I won't let you stop me from spreading the truth.

A bounty is hereby issued on a known blackmailer from Coruscant. Target is believed heavily armed and high-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We found you again. Keep running, and we'll keep finding you."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Just an outworld hick who tried to score big in the big city. Never stood a chance."
Coruscant Blackmailer
Aah! How did you find me? I apologized a million times already! I'm no threat to anyone on the throneworld! You just never! Give! Up!

A bounty is hereby issued on the assassin who attempted murder on a family member of the Imperial governor of Garos IV. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client has not specified a message to be given to the target.
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "I ask your discretion regarding any information you may have learned about my daughter's activities."
Garos IV Would-Be Assassin
The governor's daughter works for the Rebels, and the Empire hired me to get her. I missed. I won't miss this time.

A bounty is hereby issued on the assassin of an executive of the Ororo Transportation shipping company. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We know who employed you. We will take care of them as we take care of you."
Bounty Hunters' Guild

Client sends congratulations and this message: "Xizor Transport Systems, our competitor, appears to have a longer reach than we suspected. We may have further assignments for you, pending investigation."
Assassin of Ororo Transport Exec
Hmph. If they think they can dispose of Xizor Transport by hiring some amoral bounty hunter, they're in for a surprise. You, too!

A bounty is hereby issued on a fugitive convicted of spreading sedition at the Military Academy on Chandrila. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Victory is ours. All have joined the Empire."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Sedition is a weed, which must be uprooted lest it spread uncontrolled."
Seditious Agent at Chandrila
The Empire's "military discipline" is blind obedience. Senator Mon Mothma was right! The Empire must be stopped!

A bounty is hereby issued on a pirate captain based on the notorious world of Carratos in the O'pahz system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Carratos has enough guns already."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That pirate has been running weapons in Chofin Settlement. We control that trade now."
Carratos Pirate Captain
Enough guns? No such thing.

A bounty is hereby issued on the spy who attempted to steal weapon schematics from the Imperial Military Academy on Carida in the Caridan system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Consider this a failing grade."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "We are now interrogating all students to determine internal security threats."
Imperial Academy Spy
I wasn't much interested in military service anyway.

A bounty is hereby issued on a smuggler who brought illegal weapons onto Bonadan in defiance of Corporate Sector Authority laws. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The protocol droid was a clever idea, but not clever enough."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Bonadan security now scans all droids for concealed explosives."
Bonadan Weapon Smuggler
That droid hated me putting that thermal detonator in his head. Heh.

A bounty is hereby issued on the murderer of a Tibanna gas prospector on the gas giant Bespin. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Baron Calrissian intensely dislikes claim jumpers."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "It looks like this was a net loss for everyone but you."
Murderer of Tibanna Gas Prospector
Huh! It probably cost Calrissian more to hire you than I made off that guy's claim.

A bounty is hereby issued on the thief of a cargo freighter of diamonds mined outside Trade City on Arkania in the Perave system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Bright and many-faceted are the minds of Arkania."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The people of Arkania, the Yaka, delight in uncovering thieves."
Arkanian Diamond Thief
Is that supposed to mean something? That freighter was full of ice. It all melted! Why did the Yaka put out a bounty on me?

A bounty is hereby issued on a treacherous Imperial supply officer. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You should know better than to fence Imperial goods in the open air, where any probot overhead can see you."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That incompetent ruined our entire operation. Hope you don't end up getting contracts on us too."
Imperial Supply Officer
Okay, I stole those weapons -- but I didn't do it alone! Let me go and I'll tell you who else -- argh, I'm reasoning with a bounty hunter! Yaaah!

A bounty is hereby issued on a crazed religious cultist. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "This is for the children you killed!"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "This terrorist religious cult is spreading. Popular music is the gateway they use for recruitment. You'll probably get more contracts like this."
Crazed Cult Terrorist
I'm not a cultist! I only sold a song collection called "Advanced Explosives Handbook" by a band called Deeply Religious. Music! Why won't you believe me! Arrrgh!

A bounty is hereby issued on a murderer who poisoned a noted Corporate States executive. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Those were not good mints."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Carmellian mints are now banned from this household."
Mint Poisoner
I swear that box of Carmellian mints wasn't poisoned. I warned that executive, if you eat too many mints, you get nausea. But nooo! Well, I'm not going gently!

A bounty is hereby issued on a felon who attempted to kidnap a wealthy Corellian. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You want that spice so bad? You're going where it went."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That's the last loose end from that deal."
Corellian Kidnapper
I just wanted him to tell me what he did with my goods. But I knew it would come down to him or me. And hunter, it won't be me!

A bounty is hereby issued on a manufacturer of dangerous illegal drugs. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Tweeny Fogg suggests you might have been more open to a fair bargain."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "This is just one more step in the plan. Expect more contracts shortly."
Death Stick Manufacturer
Fogg? I never heard of no -- wait, is he that two-bit crimelord? Wants to muscle in on me, huh? I'll show you --!

A bounty is hereby issued on a procurer and distributor of dangerous illegal drugs. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Tweeny Fogg offered good terms. You don't reject Tweeny Fogg."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Another step in the plan. Expect more contracts shortly."
Death Stick Distributor
"Tweeny Fogg"? What kind of name is -- oh, wait, I remember. That little squirt wants to move in on this territory? Hah! You're dead, creep!

A bounty is hereby issued on a purveyor of dangerous illegal drugs. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You could have joined with Tweeny Fogg. Too bad for you."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The plan continues. Expect more contracts shortly."
Death Stick Pusher
Who's Tweeny Fogg? You're killing me because I turned down someone I never heard of? I don't think so!

A bounty is hereby issued on a political operative employed by a repressive Outer Rim government for purposes of torture and mayhem. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Ando Maguro sent me."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "That monster didn't even remember me. Somehow I feel even worse. But you've made the galaxy safer today, believe me."
Outer Rim Government Operative
Who's Ando Maguro? Did he get hurt in a covert operation? He shouldn't have been socializing with the wrong crowd. And neither should you.

A bounty is hereby issued on a thief of Imperial secrets. This hunt is proceeding outside Imperial channels; discretion is essential. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Eisen Kerioth has dispensed with your informant."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Moff Kerioth thanks you for your service. Tell no one of anything your target may have said, or you will be next."
Thief of Government Secrets
What a jerk. Moff Kerioth's Twi'lek slave woman begged me to help her escape. I tried and failed. Now he's sent another jerk to kill me. Well....

A bounty is hereby issued on the organizer and leader of a covert species-ist hate society. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Did you think you could kill us all before we fought back?"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Please ignore the babbling of this obvious madman."
Leader of Secret Hate-Crime Society
Which one of those unnatural monstrosities sent you? Don't you know you're only furthering the insidious Galactic Chiss Conspiracy? I must stop you!

A bounty is hereby issued on the murderer of the captain of a Thyferran bacta tanker. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The son of Captain Norda sends you on your way."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "My father wasn't the best of all men, but he didn't deserve murder."
Murderer of Bacta Tanker Captain

The Empire loosed a plague on my homeworld. Captain Norda's tanker held enough bacta to heal thousands, but thousands died! Because Norda feared the Empire! I killed him and I'm glad -- like I'm glad to do THIS!

A bounty is hereby issued on an individual who aided the destruction of an Ubrikkian Luxury Sail Barge on Balmorra in the Nevoota system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests that no message be given to the target before termination, and that target's remarks not be recorded.
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends this message: "Discretion is essential. Tell no one of the target's words, or you will be next."
Sail Barge Destroyer
"Sail barge"? I led a strike team to destroy Governor Beltane's shiny new SD-10 battle droid plant! You want to kill me? I don't go easy.

A bounty is hereby issued on a renegade scientist who engaged in unlicensed weather modification on Drall in the Corellian system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The Boiling Sea is not filled by rainfall."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The Boiling Sea boils once more."
Weather Modification Scientist
I couldn't stand the heat, so I made it rain. The sea stopped boiling, and that hurt the tourist trade. Is one mistake worth killing me over?

A bounty is hereby issued on a renegade clan councillor from an outlying system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You have evaded your responsibility too long."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The ways of our people have lasted long and will endure still longer."
Renegade Clan Official
One of the five on our head clan council died. So we four survivors were all supposed to march into the desert and die. I won't die just because she did!

A bounty is hereby issued on the felon who committed an offense against the Trask merchant house on Kuat. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The magenta sash is reserved for Trask alone."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "This removes from the Trask sash the contaminating stain of dishonor."
Offender Against Kuat
Giving the people of Kuat those magenta sashes was the first symbolic step in encouraging rebellion. We'll overthrow the aristocracy, then the Empire!

A bounty is hereby issued on a notorious vandal who defaced a statue of the beloved Emperor. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The Emperor is not mocked."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Recount your exploit far and wide. Remember, the Emperor is never mocked."
Traitorous Vandal
I painted his stupid face blue, the color of dishonor in my culture. I'll keep doing it until freedom returns, and you won't stop me!

A bounty is hereby issued on the designer of a deadly bioweapon. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. WARNING: If any biological material is found on the target, destroy it immediately.
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "If you made contact with the target's bodily fluids, carry out decontamination procedures."
Bioweapon Scientist
Hhkk! Kff! I'm going to -- to -- ahhhkk! Hkk!

A bounty is hereby issued on the architect of a plan to overthrow a planetary government under the management of the Corporate Sector Authority. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "No more options for you."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Termination is always a nasty business."
CSA Would-Be Conqueror
You make it sound like I was conquering by force. I only tried to acquire a majority of stock. Executive politics shouldn't involve physical death!

A bounty is hereby issued on a gang enforcer wanted in a dozen Outer Rim sectors. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "How many innocent beings have suffered at your hands? This is for them!"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "We've got bacta clinics full of that maggot's victims. All of them thank you for ending the nightmare."
Gang Enforcer
You're good, bounty hunter, but not as good as me!

A bounty is hereby issued on a serial blackmailer whose crimes span fifty sectors. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Consider this your retirement party."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Thank you for eliminating that troublesome blackmailer. A number of quite influential galactic citizens have taken note of your good work."
Serial Blackmailer
You bounty hunters never learn, do you?

A bounty is hereby issued on an infamous starjacker who robbed the wrong space yacht. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We warned you never to set foot on an inhabited planet."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "A smart starjacker will avoid certain targets. This one was not very smart. You have earned the bounty."
Infamous Starjacker
You're good at tracking, but I'm good at fighting!

A bounty is hereby issued on a Black Sun trigger artist wanted in seven sectors. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Your Vigo can't protect you everywhere, but justice knows no bounds."
Bounty Hunters' Guild

Client sends congratulations and this message: "We suspect a double-cross by Black Sun. Otherwise a trusted enforcer would not have been traveling alone. Thank you for helping us take advantage of that opportunity."
Black Sun Trigger Artist
Sithspit! Where did you come from?

A bounty is hereby issued on a galactic desperado whose reputation is spreading like fire through the galaxy. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Some fine things have been laid upon your table, but you only want the ones that you can't get. Why didn't you come to your senses?"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Justice was getting closer every day. It takes a certain kind of fool to keep running."
Galactic Desperado
Let's finish this! I ain't getting' no younger!

A bounty is hereby issued on a space pirate wanted for stealing slaves in the Outer Rim. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You think you're quite a hero. As of now you're a martyr."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Interfering with lawful business is bad for the galactic economy. We're glad you concur with our goals, bounty hunter."
Slave Pirate
Freedom for slaves across the galaxy!

A bounty is hereby issued on the vandal who defaced the tomb of a great business executive from Sacorria, an Outlier system in the Corellian sector. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "When you toppled the grave marker of Silmas Monder, you should have started carving your own."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "This mentally disturbed individual believed that everyone on Sacorria was involved in some massive conspiracy. Very sad."
Vandal of Corellian Gravesite
I strafed Sacorria's moon, Sarcophagus. The whole moon is their graveyard. All those Sacorrians deserve much worse. So do you!

A bounty is hereby issued on a crystal thief who stole a shipload of Tasari shards. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You're very good at running away, but you can't outrun a price on your head."
Bounty Hunters' Guild

Client sends congratulations and this message: "Crystal thieves may have a glamorous reputation, but they're little more than ambitious burglars. That's one less to plague the galaxy. The bounty is yours."
Crystal Thief
Hold on! You're throwing away a fortune here! Don't be a fool!

A bounty is hereby issued on an assassin suspected of several political murders in the Ottega system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We do not abide assassination, especially when the targets might have revealed sensitive information before they died. In such cases, termination must be swift."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "You have avenged many good political leaders. By chance did the assassin give you any information before he died?"
Suspected Assassin
Those sithspawn double-crossed me! They'll double-cross you too, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a mercenary captain who is wanted for mass slaughter in four sectors. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We will never forget your atrocities at the Third Reconciliation. This is for the Shubs and Zuuls!"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Many Shubs and Zuuls have been avenged this day, I can tell you."
Mercenary Captain
I'll see you in hell, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on an informant who betrayed an employer's secrets to the Empire. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You took a vow of secrecy. Now you shall pay the price for your lack of vision."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Splendid work, bounty hunter. We trust the details of this incident will remain secret."
Dangerous Informant
Don't make me hurt you!

A bounty is hereby issued on a fugitive slicer, convicted of forging credentials for Imperial data systems. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The galaxy is not big enough to hide you forever."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Slicers shouldn't play around in the wrong sectors."
Fugitive Slicer
I thought I'd lost you, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a renowned saboteur accused in the slaughter of a dozen shipyard workers. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You used thermal detonators. Your own demise will be much more painful."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "A lot of families were shattered by that vermin's sabotage. You have earned their thanks as well as this bounty."
Renowned Saboteur
No bounty hunter is taking me down!

A bounty is hereby issued on an industrial spy, escaped from the custody of a private security force. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You're clever enough to slip away from us, but bounty hunters are cleverer still."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Spies are never as clever as they think."
Industrial Spy
That's the last mistake you'll ever make, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a dangerous prisoner who escaped a dungeon ship in Tragan Sector. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Escape is punishable by death."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Why would a prisoner turn a life sentence into a death sentence? Criminals are beyond comprehension."
Escaped Prisoner
Why can't I shake you?

A bounty is hereby issued on a rogue scientist accused of illegal genetic experiments across the Outer Rim. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Your despicable work ends now!"
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Rogue science. An indelicate business."
Rogue Scientist
You must not interfere with my important experiments!

A bounty is hereby issued on a fence of stolen goods, wanted for possession of contraband in 17 systems. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "A single scum like you allows dozens of thieves and robbers to make a living in the galaxy. Time to kill the weed at the root."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "With that space leech out of the way, many more criminals will go out of business. You've earned this bounty."
Interplanetary Fence
You don't know who you're playing with, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on a confidence artist who defrauded the queen of the Hunchuzuc Den on Selonia in the Corellian system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "The queen is not trifled with."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Dishonorable deception can have only one punishment."
Con Artist Fleeing Selonia
Hey, the Hunchuzuc queen wanted power over the planet. I just said I could get her some weapons. Like this one.

A bounty is hereby issued on a fugitive kidnapper wanted for ransoming a wealthy Naboo child. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "We don't want the ransom back. We'll take our revenge from your hide."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Our little daughter can sleep in peace now. Thank you."
Kidnapper-At-Large
Give me your best shot, bounty hunter!

A bounty is hereby issued on an industrial spy who stole schematics from the SoroSuub headquarters on Sullust. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "To attack SoroSuub is to attack all of Sullust."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "The wealth of Sullust depends on the well-being of the SoroSuub conglomerate. You may tell this to anyone as you see fit."
SoroSuub Thief
So I stole some plans. If you think you're gonna kill me over a schematic, think again.

A bounty is hereby issued on the sniper who fired on members of a marching band during intermission at the Planetary Shockball League quarter-finals in Coronet on Corellia. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Your lunatic conduct was an offense against good sportsmanship."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "After recent rehearsals the band sounds better than ever."
Crazed Sniper
I couldn't stand it! They started playing the "Imperial March" over and over, and I'm just! So! Sick of it!

A bounty is hereby issued on the assassin who shot a Zaltin Corporation executive on Thyferra in the Polith system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Death to Black Claw terrorists."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "For the sake of stability in the vital bacta trade, ignore everything the target may have said."
Assassin of Bacta Cartel Executive
I'm not with Black Claw. I was hired by Zaltin's competitor, Xucphra. Not that you'll live to tell anyone.

A bounty is hereby issued on a saboteur who destroyed a thoroughbred racing-blob stable at Fondine Blob Raceways on Umgul. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "Umglateen Protoplasm Stables has found you at last."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "All the blobs have now painstakingly separated themselves."
Racing-Blob Stable Saboteur
The guy who hired me never even paid for the job. Not my smoothest move. I'll bet this won't be either.

A bounty is hereby issued on an assassin who murdered an Ororo Transportation shipping executive in the Lybeya system. Target is believed moderately armed and medium-threat. The client requests this message be given to the target before termination: "You hopeless idiot."
Bounty Hunters' Guild
Client sends congratulations and this message: "Even more hopelessly idiotic than we'd expected."
Assassin of Ororo Transport Executive
That lousy huckster charged me triple at his cantina in the Vergesso Asteroids. I was drunk and got carried away. But right now I'm sober, so --

Concerned citizens are staging a public rally to denounce the Rebellion and support the Empire. Deliver this miniature holoprojector to their leader. It will display recordings of heroic Imperial soldiers, as well as tasteful images of the atrocities perpetrated by Rebel terrorists.
filename_of_object
Small projector
COMPNOR
Will you be attending this rally, citizen? It would look good on your record.
This will make our rally so much better. Bless the Empire!
Thank you, citizen. The rally will proceed shortly, unless sabotaged by Rebel terrorists.
Miniature Holoprojector

A group of children will be marching in a local parade honoring the Emperor. The citizens putting this together have requested proper Imperial attire and toy blasters for the children. Deliver this requisition order to the lead organizer. Any official can take this to the local Imperial depot to request these materials.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR
We admire the children's enthusiasm. If only all citizens were so enthusiastic, the galaxy would be a better place.
Our children will look so sharp. They will be a credit to the Empire.
Did you inform the organizers that firing the toy blasters can, in certain circumstances, blind or maim the target? This is a design flaw that will be corrected in later versions.
Toy Blaster Requisition

We've heard that the loyal local citizens are putting on a parade in honor of the Emperor. We're recording this event for HoloNet broadcast. Deliver this requisition order for five RMD-20 monitoring droids to this group's representatives. They can take it to their local Imperial depot to get the droids.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR
Let these children be an example to you, citizen. Strive to serve the Empire.
These droids will come in handy. Our children will be so pleased when this is recorded for all the Empire to see!
The assigned monitor droids are currently in use at local cantinas, but they should be available in time for the parade. Fine work, citizen!
Monitor Droid Requisition

Someone has been defacing Imperial statuary. The vandals don't appear on our monitoring devices. We suspect some form of holoshroud. Deliver this new neuro-sensor to our agent. It should detect holoshrouds. We will discover the vandals and put a stop to them.
filename_of_object
Scanner device
Imperial Security Bureau
To deface Imperial property is a serious crime. We'll make that clear to these criminals soon enough.
I'll catch these vandals one way or another. This device will be an immense help.
The scanner has not yet detected the distinctive holoshroud radiation signature, but it is only a matter of time. What else could explain this weird phenomenon?
Neuro-Sensor Scanner

Rebel spies stole a loyal citizen's speeder. Due to the owner's modifications to the speeder, we caught these spies within a few hours. As a public relations gesture, deliver this Corporate Sector Authority voucher, which gives a generous discount on the purchase of any new swoop.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
The Empire's influence with the Corporate Sector Authority can be a great benefit to loyal citizens.
Ten percent off. Well. It sure pays to serve the Empire, huh?
Well done. Spread the word of the Empire's generosity!
Swoop Discount Voucher

Our Board has selected a winner in the Patriotic Art Competition. The lucky citizen is to receive an all-expense-paid vacation to Coruscant. Return this award-winning painting, entitled "Lord Vader: Protector of the Empire's Youth," to the artist. The documents attached include prize redemption instructions.
filename_of_object
Painting
COMPNOR: Arts Division
I love the way all those children are gazing admiringly at the striking figure of Lord Vader. It's most inspiring.
I won? I won! I can't wait to tell the kids we're going to Coruscant. Thanks!
Plans have changed. A reliable informant tells us that the artist has been seen recently in the company of dubious individuals suspected of Rebel sympathies. The artist's prize has been cancelled.
Lord Vader: Protector of Empire's Youth

A model citizen divulged the names of several dangerous Rebel spies a few weeks ago. Two of those spies were the citizen's own parents. What greater demonstration of loyalty can exist? As we promised, we're delivering a hologram recording of the executions. Take it to this citizen with our thanks and compliments.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
This is the sort of strength we require in our citizens. Heed this example!
I don't want to watch this horrid recording! I made a big mistake! The Force preserve me! What have I done?
The citizen appears to have fallen from earlier ideals and is now being taken to a COMPNOR Re-education Center. Say nothing of this, or it will go badly for you.
Hologram of Execution

Interrogation of a Rebel spy has resulted in a list of suspected Rebels and sympathizers. We're very interested in finding these individuals without alarming them. Deliver this list of names and holographic images to our contact, who will discreetly disseminate the information to loyal citizens.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
Traitors can't hide forever. The Empire roots out such vermin wherever they nest.
I'll make sure this gets into the right hands. You can never be too careful these days.
Owing to the length of the list of suspects, some of those lower on the list were warned by the apprehension of the first few. However, our operations continue. We shall find them all.
List of Suspects

The New Order teaches that humans are superior to other species. A highly respected scientist is composing a definitive work to prove this. Help this effort by providing the scientist with the results of certain medical studies. These are not available on the HoloNet, of course. We don't want these delicate results to fall into the hands of enemies who would wilfully misinterpret them.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR Science Division
Don't believe any stories you hear about vivisection. They're sheer nonsense.
The medical results at last! Soon no one will doubt the physical and ethical superiority of humans.
The sensitive nature of these medical results requires your discretion. Tell no one of these findings until the populace is suitably prepared for their release.
Medical Files

One of our spies, who are everywhere, located a new Rebel terrorist cell several days ago but has not contacted us since. Deliver this datadisc and claim it confirms an order of fuel cells. If the recipient accepts the disc, our spy has been discovered. If the disc is refused, then our spy is still active but simply trying to avoid suspicion. Can you do this?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
We lose good lives to these Rebel scum all the time. It's part of the sacrifice every good citizen must make.
Fuel cells, huh? Sure, I'll take it. Do I need to sign anything?
We have located the spy's body and are now recruiting a replacement. The setback is purely temporary.
Confirm Status of Spy

This office has uncovered several Rebel sympathizers and is planning a purge. Rebel slicers are infesting the HoloNet, so we need these warrants hand-delivered. After all, we don't want to give those scum the chance to escape justice. Tell no one!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
The Empire is always looking for dedicated citizens willing to serve. The rewards are many.
Everything seems in order. Now we can move and purge those sympathizers.
This office will remember your service to the Empire. The memory of the ISB is long and infallible.
Arrest Warrants

A concerned parent believes local schoolchildren are being fed pro-Rebel propaganda. Deliver to this informant a small undetectable transmitter to hide on the child's clothing. We'll soon discover who at this school is poisoning the minds of the Empire's youth.
filename_of_object
Small sealed container
Imperial Security Bureau
How foolish of a schoolteacher to push traitorous propaganda on our children!
Thank you. I believe all our schoolteachers harbor pro-Rebel sentiments. I'll put an end to their crimes.
A purge and purification of schoolteachers will begin soon. Thank you for your help.
Undetectable Transmitter
A certain citizen may be supplying the Rebels. Deliver this cooker, saying that it's a prize in a sweepstakes. A transmitter built into the device should reveal the suspect's true loyalties.
crafting\station\food_tool.iff
Food Cooker
Imperial Security Bureau
When will citizens realize that every action has a consequence? Crime does not pay.
A new cooker? How wonderful. I just love baking for the neighborhood. Would you care for a cookie? They're fresh.
The Rebel sympathizer's seemingly innocuous front will soon crumble like those "cookies" that undoubtedly wind up in Rebel mouths.
Bugged Cooker

A citizen suspected of pro-Rebel sympathies is hosting a catered party in an effort to earn a promotion. Rebel-lovers do not deserve promotions. The party must fail. Deliver this bottle of Naboo wine; claim it's from the caterer. When the guests drink the wine, they'll become deathly ill. This will ruin that traitor's chances. Do your duty.
filename_of_object
Bottle of wine
COMPNOR
One should always know the source of a gift, don't you agree? Hahaha!
Naboo wine! How nice. To think we were considering never using this caterer's services again. Thank you!
The battle against the Rebellion must proceed on many fronts. COMPNOR is there to fight on the fields that the Army and Navy cannot reach.
Naboo Wine

A lunatic who claims to be the Emperor continues to send HoloNet messages demanding a military escort to the market. Our spies, who are everywhere, assure us that this idiot is harmless. However, this office believes the Empire should deal with lunatics more firmly. Deliver this order instructing the maniac to cease and desist.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR
The Empire's patience is not infinite. I hope this will convince that fool to cease such insane activities.
What? How dare my minions speak to me in such a manner! They shall all pay the price for their lack of vision!
The lunatic continues to pester this office, most recently with orders to construct a second Death Star. What foolishness!
Desist Order for a Lunatic

The Empire is looking for people of action, not words. One citizen, at great peril to life and limb, prevented an escaped Yuzzem prisoner from hijacking a local transport and possibly killing dozens of loyal citizens. Deliver to this hero a special ISB vibrodagger, a replica of the weapon carried by our agents.
filename_of_object
Replica Vibrodagger
Imperial Security Bureau
Perhaps someday you can earn a similar weapon, citizen. Be diligent.
This is a great honor. I shall carry it with pride. Hail the Empire!
The replica vibrodagger must not be worn in public, on pain of prosecution for impersonating an officer. Did you inform the recipient of this vital fact?
Replica Vibrodagger

A misguided merchant has been pricing goods outside the approved Imperial price ranges. Perhaps this individual has not received our latest pricing guide. Deliver this guide and inform the merchant that we expect prices to fall within the stipulated ranges very soon. A second warning about this matter would not benefit business.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR Commerce Division
Rules are made for a reason, and it's not for the purpose of breaking them. Obedience is expected.
I -- I was just trying to help out local businesses that can't afford these high Imperial taxes. No, wait, don't report I said that! I'll raise my prices!
Our spies report that the merchant's prices are returning to acceptable ranges. All is well.
COMPNOR Pricing Guide

One of our spies, who are everywhere, is conducting an important surveillance mission. We've ordered the agent to maintain transmission silence. You never know who's listening. These new orders must be delivered to the agent at once. Can the Empire count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
Our work is never done. Preserving the New Order should be everyone's concern.
New orders, eh? Thank you, citizen. The Empire does not forget its loyal servants.
Inform no one of the spy's identity, or it will go badly for you. That is all.
Spy's New Orders
We have a report that Rebels are meeting in a concealed chamber under an informant's home. Deliver a heat sensor so the homeowner can verify this suspicion.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Scanner device
Imperial Security Bureau
The ISB is always looking for bright, eager talent. What better way to serve the Empire?
Finally! I'll be able to prove that there's a Rebel Command Center underneath my very home! How do you work this thing?
We must investigate all such claims, no matter how seemingly outlandish. That is our job -- our duty -- our cause.
Heat Scanner
A citizen informs us that certain locals have been holding clandestine meetings, possibly to aid the Rebellion. Deliver this message to the loyal citizen. It includes a reward for diligence.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
We only wish all citizens were as loyal as the recipient of this datadisc -- and as loyal as you are, too, citizen!
I knew my rude neighbors were up to no good. They'll get what they deserve now. Bless the Empire!
Though Rebel sympathizers hide everywhere, assure all who will listen that the Empire has matters well in hand.
Loyalty Reward

An upstanding citizen believes an acquaintance is secretly attending meetings with Rebels. Deliver this tagger spy device to the informant. Once this citizen plants a transmitter on the suspected traitor, we can monitor his movements.
filename_of_object
Small gun or tracker device
Imperial Security Bureau
Traitors hide behind many facades. They may be close friends, even loved ones. In the end, all must face justice.
Great gadget. I could never afford this on my own. Now my father will regret stopping my allowance!
Rebel sympathizers are everywhere. Our informants' motives may be petty, but their vital service triumphs over all other moral considerations.
Spy Tagger Device

One loyal citizen has helped us arrest over a dozen Rebel sympathizers. We want to show our appreciation by presenting them with a plaque. It bears the COMPNOR pledge along with the citizen's name engraved on the front. Perhaps you can one day earn such a plaque, citizen. For now, please simply deliver the plaque.
filename_of_object
Plaque
COMPNOR
The Empire shows its appreciation in many ways. This plaque is but one small example.
My plaque! I'll hang it in a place of honor. I can't wait to show my friends. The few remaining loyal ones, that is.
With continuing service to COMPNOR and the Empire, you, too, citizen, may someday merit a plaque of your own.
COMPNOR Loyalty Plaque

A local school teacher wants to present a class of young students with COMPNOR badges. They reward students who memorize the COMPNOR creed. Could you deliver these badges? Children are the Empire's future, after all.
filename_of_object
Small sealed container
COMPNOR
Nothing inspires a person more than happy, loyal children. Wouldn't you agree, citizen?
The children will be delighted. Hail the Empire and COMPNOR.
Evidently no student successfully memorized the entire COMPNOR creed, so no badges were awarded at this time. This is acceptable; there are always more children.
COMPNOR School Badges

A citizen has organized Neighborhood Rebel Alert Watches. We are so impressed with this that we've decided to adopt a similar model all across this sector. Please deliver this holocam recording to this model citizen. It's a personal thanks from our Chairman. We want loyal citizens to know they are treasured.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
COMPNOR
A vigilant citizen is a happy citizen. Are you happy?
Oh goodness, a personal thanks for me? I was just doing my civic duty. Thank you.
The Neighborhood Rebel Watch Alert program will go worldwide shortly. Do you want to start your own Watch Alert program? If so, contact COMPNOR at the appropriate time.
COMPNOR Holocam Thank-You

We offered a reward to a loyal citizen for years of service, and the citizen asked for a replica ISB uniform. We've cleared it with our superiors and need you to deliver the uniform. I must admit, our uniforms are quite sharp.
filename_of_object
ISB Uniform
Imperial Security Bureau
The Empire knows that style and fashion are important. We're glad to see others agree.
I can't wait to try this on. My mate will be quite enthused to see me, I think. Thank you.
Of course the replica ISB uniform cannot be worn in public, on pain of prosecution for impersonating an officer. Did you inform the citizen of this vital fact?
Replica ISB Uniform

We've just received an order from General Veers himself at Imperial High Command to train more AT-AT pilots. Pick up and deliver a set of transfers to the garrison commander. These candidates are to go immediately to Imperial training facilities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I understand that General Veers is serving directly under Lord Vader. A prestigious assignment indeed.
Always wanted to pilot an AT-AT myself. I'll see to this at once.
You've done well, citizen. It is the Empire's hope that you will continue to serve faithfully.
Recruit AT-AT Pilots

We intend to strike Mon Calamari's floating cities in retaliation for their aid to the Rebellion. Pick up High Command's orders and deliver them to the garrison commander. All shore leave is revoked. All troopers must report to duty at once.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We waited too long to strike the Mon Calamari. This is long overdue.
Word will go out immediately. My men will report on time.
The Star Destroyer will depart soon. We will make the Mon Calamari pay for their crimes against the Empire.
Strike the Mon Calamari

Admiral Ozzel has just informed us that we need to deliver 500 additional probe droids to the Star Destroyer Accuser. Collect the requisition order and deliver it to our depot officer. He'll see to it that those probe droids are loaded aboard a transport.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Searching the Galaxy takes time and resources.
More probe droids? We can hardly keep them in stock. What, or who, are they looking for?
You've done well. The Empire is grateful for your assistance.
Probe Droids Search the Galaxy

A former Senator continues to aid the Rebellion. Despite the dissolution of the Senate, this politician's influence limits our access to his holdings. Collect and deliver a termination order to our Intelligence contact. This mission is to be accomplished "by any means necessary."
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These do-gooders will learn that privileged positions can't protect them from the Emperor's wrath.
Good. I've been waiting for a chance to take out this Senator. I think I'll throw in his annoying family as a bonus.
That was a delicate mission, handled discreetly and professionally. The Empire will not forget your efficiency.
Take Out a Senator

Insiders helped the Rebellion acquire secret Imperial plans resulting in the deaths of thousands of loyal soldiers. Pick up the dossiers on our prime suspects, and deliver them to an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. We order a deathmark on every suspect.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We do what we must to ensure the guilty will be brought to justice.
Business is good for our guild these days. The Battle of Yavin was the Empire's disgrace and our fortune.
That was handled well, citizen. The Empire will see to it that you are rewarded.
Avenge the Death Star

We've just captured several Rebels who were conducting sabotage missions in the Outer Rim. The Rebels' resistance to convential interrogation have made drastic action necessary. Collect and deliver a message, for the eyes of an Inquisitor only. We need his skills in interrogation.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I can't wait to watch the Inquisitor at work. They say the sight is a thing of beauty.
I leave at once. These Rebels will tell us everything.
Well done. Your dedication to the Empire is admirable.
Summon the Inquisitor

Intercepted Rebel transmissions are too vital to send via the HoloNet. Collect a copy of these transmissions and deliver them to our Intelligence contact. Deciphering these transmissions will lead us to the Rebel's new base. The Empire is counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Information is power, citizen. The Empire's information network is the best in the galaxy.
We'll get right on this. Those Rebels won't escape us.
Prompt delivery and a minimum of fuss. That's the sort of action the Empire prizes. Well done.
Intercepted Rebel Transmissions

We must insure the Corporate Sector Authority is not secretly aiding the Rebel Alliance in exchange for payoffs. We have obtained the security codes to confidential CSA files. Collect them and give them to our covert operative. If he discovers wrongdoing, he is to take appropriate action.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The CSA's loyalty will always be to money. The Empire should not be so lenient with them.
Now we'll see which Viceprexes are smart and which are not.
Performed with great professionalism, citizen. The Empire is glad to pay your fee.
Investigate the CSA

We've discovered a number of CSA Viceprexes who have been aiding Rebels in exchange for money. Collect and deliver termination orders to our operative as soon as possible. We'll make sure the CSA understands that the Empire does not treat such matters lightly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Money is a powerful motivator, but the threat of death is more powerful still.
What good is money if you're not around to spend it? Too bad these guys didn't learn that lesson.
Excellent work, citizen. The Empire will reward you.
Bump Off Greedy Businessmen

Intelligence suspects that a new breed of Jedi has appeared and is aiding the Rebels. Collect Intelligence's report and deliver it to the Inquisitors. If the Jedi have returned, we must hunt and destroy them once and for all.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If this rumor is true, it would explain the Battle of Yavin.
We will root out these Jedi. They will meet the same fate as their corrupt Old Republic predecessors.
As long as loyal citizens such as yourself continue to serve faithfully, the Empire will crush its enemies.
Inquisitors Must Hunt Jedi

We're providing our recruiters with a demo version of our TIE flight simulators, to help boost enlistment. Pick up and deliver the encrypted program. Tell the recruiter to limit the amount of time each visitor gets with the flight sim. We know those simulators can be addictive.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our TIE flight training programs are a big draw for Imperial citizens.
This will certainly boost enlistment. I love these flight sims.
Well done. The Empire has compensated you.
Help Imperial Recruitment

We suspect the Mon Calamari are building a vast fleet to support the Rebellion. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our operative so that they can organize surveillance missions in preparation for Imperial strikes on Mon Calamari floating cities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Aiding the Rebellion invokes genocide. All species must support the New Order.
This will be an excellent example of Imperial justice, second only to Alderaan.
The Empire is pleased with your performance, agent. The Mon Calamari will pay for the thousands of Imperial lives lost at Yavin with millions of their own.
Punish the Mon Calamari
A Rebel cell has been identified on a remote planet in the Outer Rim. Pick up the report and deliver it to our Imperial Naval contact. This cell must be wiped out immediately. Take no prisoners.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
This assignment requires an Imperial naval captain who is not squeamish.
I think one Star Destroyer with a full complement of stormtroopers ought to suffice.
Your service helps the Imperial war machine run smoothly. You deserve to be rewarded.
Destroy a Rebel Colony

We've been instructed to locate some sort of rare crystal on Mimban. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our local agent. He should contact Captain-Supervisor Grammel to secure his help.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We never question the Emperor's instructions, citizen. Never.
Mimban? Isn't that a small mining colony? I will follow these instructions to the letter.
We must pursue all leads that might result in the destruction of the Rebellion. Your efforts are noted, citizen.
Find the Mimban Crystal

A seller of antiques claims to possess rare Sith artifacts. The Emperor himself has commanded that this individual be arrested and these artifacts confiscated, if they exist. Collect and deliver the warrant to our operative.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I don't understand the fascination that old religion holds for Imperial citizens. Superstition, I suppose.
I was wondering when we'd get around to bringing in this dealer. It's as good as done.
Job well done, agent. The Emperor will be informed of your assistance.
Retrieve Sith Artifacts

An influential Imperial dignitary has been proven a traitor. He must be removed quietly, in order to avoid alerting his allies. Collect a Scarab assassin droid and deliver it to our agent. We've made sure the droid will be traced back to Rebel operatives.
Filename_of_object
Small assassin droid
A fitting end for such a vile traitor, wouldn't you agree?
You sure I won't be implicated in this? This guy's got a lot of friends on Coruscant.
Well done, agent. Your service to the Empire has been noted, and your future looks rosy indeed.
Scarab Assassin Droid

The Emperor wants to know how a Jedi Knight, especially one as dangerous as Obi-Wan Kenobi, could have hidden for so long. Our agent is to turn Tatooine inside out in an effort to answer this question. The Emperor's instructions are on an encrypted datadisc that you must collect and deliver.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I certainly hope there aren't any more Jedi secretly aiding the Rebellion.
I'm sure the Hutts helped hide this fugitive. Those creatures will do anything for money.
Trusted agents are hard to find. The Empire wants to insure your continued allegiance by demonstrating how lucrative it can be to serve the Emperor.
Investigate Tatooine

We've redesigned our scout trooper blaster pistol so that it can carry a larger energy cell and deliver a more powerful punch. Pick up the prototype and design specs, and deliver them to a garrison commander for field testing. This is an important military mission. Can we count on you?
Filename_of_object
Trooper pistol
This pistol is a true credit to the genius of the Imperial Army's weapon designers.
Amazing how the pistol retained its light weight even with the larger energy cell.
Good work, agent. We'll be keeping our eye on you. You show promise.
Help Test Prototype Pistol

We've finally identified all the surviving Rebel pilots from the Battle of Yavin, including a Corellian smuggler and his Wookiee companion. Pick up their dossiers and take them to the local garrison commander. All stormtroopers will keep a sharp eye out for these enemies of the state.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These terrorists are responsible for the deaths of thousands of loyal Imperial officers and troopers. We trust they will be arrested soon.
Our troopers will arrest this Rebel scum in no time.
Fine work. Continue serving the Empire and you will continue to be rewarded.
Find the Traitors of Yavin

Imperial Intelligence suggests that recent potential recruits are actually undercover agents for the Rebellion. Pick up the list of names and take it to the garrison commander so these suspects can be arrested for questioning.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our recruiters must be especially vigilant. Rebel spies constantly try to infiltrate through their offices.
We do get our fair share of spies. Fortunately, we always root them out.
Your service to the Empire is noted, citizen. We hope it will continue.
Potential Recruits Are Often Spies

A design flaw in older helmet comlinks allows certain transceivers to pick up a trooper's transmissions. A modification to the comlink chip should take care of the problem. Pick up the adjustment instructions and deliver them to the local garrison commander.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you are. The commander should also use this opportunity to do an inventory of his garrison.
You can never be too careful about who's listening in on what, eh?
Fortunately, these older helmets are found mostly on small outposts. You've been compensated for your efforts, citizen.
Fix Trooper Helmets

Recent sabotage by Rebel data slicers has confused local garrisons. Pick up and deliver some encrypted orders to the local commander. Inform him that he will receive orders in this manner until Imperial Intelligence can once again secure the HoloNet.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I've always preferred hand-delivered orders. Nothing beats the extra security.
Good. This should clarify things a bit. These Rebels are a definite thorn in our side.
Well done. I hope that this is just an example of what we can expect from you in the future.
Improved Imperial Security

We're receiving requests for additional conscripts from the Corporate Sector Authority. Our detention facilities are overflowing, so our solution is clear. Prisoners are to be transported immediately to the CSA's processing facilities. Pick up and deliver the instructions to the local warden.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Building and maintaining the Imperial war machine takes many strong backs. Rebel backs will do nicely.
I hope these quotas call for large numbers of prisoners, because we've got them to spare.
Efficient and prompt. Good. That is what the Empire expects from its loyal citizens.
Clear Out the Prisons

A recent list of suspects includes senatorial aides and family members. Local security forces have been reluctant to arrest them without word from Imperial High Command. Pick up the arrest warrants and take them to the garrison commander. They've been issued by the Ubiqtorate itself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The influence of many of the Old Republic's corrupt senators is difficult to dispel.
You understand our caution, don't you? This will clear things up.
Well handled, citizen. Those arrest warrants will be served immediately.
Ubiqtorate Arrest Warrants

We've fallen behind schedule due to prisoner riots. We need a boost to our labor force to keep up the Emperor's aggressive military buildup. Pick up the order for aid in worker recruitment and deliver it to the local government official.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Sometimes the Emperor asks the impossible. We need more workers!
I can think of a few layabouts who could be persuaded to serve the Engineer Corps. We'll get right on it.
You have done well. Continue to serve the Emperor faithfully.
Recruit Military Workers

Intelligence suspects that a new breed of Jedi has appeared and is aiding the Rebels. Collect Intelligence's report and deliver it to the Inquisitors. If the Jedi have returned, we must hunt and destroy them once and for all.

Imperial Intelligence

Jedi Intelligence for Inquisitors

mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
Aiding the Rebellion invokes genocide. All species must support the New Order.
Not since Alderaan has there been such an excellent example of Imperial justice.
The Empire is pleased with your performance, agent. The Mon Calamari will pay for the thousands of Imperial lives lost at Yavin with millions of their own.
Mon Calamari Attack Orders
A Rebel cell has been identified on a remote planet in the Outer Rim. Pick up the report and deliver it to our Imperial Naval contact. This cell must be wiped out immediately. Take no prisoners.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
This assignment requires an Imperial naval captain who is not squeamish.
I think one Star Destroyer with a full complement of stormtroopers ought to suffice for this mission.
Your service helps the Imperial war machine run smoothly. You deserve to be rewarded.
Outer Rim Rebel Cell Must Fall

Certain demonstrations in the Core Worlds protest the Imperial war machine. Deliver this airborne virus to our field agent, and instruct him to attend protests of this sort. The rest should be obvious. Tell the agent to take extreme precautions, as there is no cure for this engineered virus.
filename_of_object
Sealed container
Imperial Intelligence Operations
Make sure the seal on this container does not break!
This should discourage many would-be protestors.
You did not have contact with the virus yourself, did you? We would hate to lose a promising agent.
Engineered Airborne Virus

Our office has been instructed to collect data on the name "Skywalker." Of particular importance is the planet Tatooine. Send these instructions to our agent. He is not to contact us via the HoloNet; only hand-delivered communiques via courier are acceptable. Under no circumstances is Lord Vader to be informed of this mission.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
It is our understanding that the Emperor has taken a personal interest in this matter. Don't fail him.
Wasn't Skywalker a Jedi killed during the Clone Wars?
You have performed admirably. However, for security purposes it is vital that you now forget ever having been involved. Should news of this assignment leak out, it will go badly for you.
"Skywalker" Research Instructions

We've been instructed to locate some sort of rare crystal on Mimban. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our local agent. He should contact Captain-Supervisor Grammel to secure his help.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Deliver instructions to agent
Imperial Intelligence
We never question the Emperor's instructions. Never.
Mimban? Isn't that some insignificant mining colony? Well, orders are orders.
We must pursue all leads that might result in the destruction of the Rebellion. Your efforts are noted, citizen.
Mimban Crystal Instructions

The Kessel prison camp may have processed certain individuals believed intrumental in the destruction of the Death Star: a Corellian smuggler, his Wookiee companion, and a young pilot from somewhere in the Outer Rim Territories. This datadisc contains complete dossiers on all three, along with travel instructions to Kessel. Deliver the disc to our agent promptly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
According to the dossier, the young pilot may possess Jedi abilities. Advise our agent to use caution.
Kessel, huh? And a Jedi? This job just gets better and better.
The Empire appreciates your role in hunting the Rebels responsible for the Death Star's destruction.
Yavin 4 Traitor Dossiers

A seller of antiques claims to possess rare Sith artifacts. The Emperor himself has commanded that this individual be arrested and these artifacts confiscated, if they exist. Collect and deliver the warrant to our operative.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
I don't understand the fascination that old religion holds for Imperial citizens. Superstition, I suppose.
I was wondering when we'd get around to bringing in this dealer. It's as good as done.
Job well done, agent. The Emperor will be informed of your assistance.
Sith Artifact Dealer Warrant
We have issued new instructions to one of our informants. Deliver this holoprojector to him. Instruct him to read, in private, the personal message from the Ubiqtorate contained within.
filename_of_object
Small holoprojector
Imperial Intelligence
Loyal citizens can have only one master, and he is the Emperor. What? You don't understand? You will.
New instructions? Very well, I shall hurry home and read them.

That informant accepted bribes to ignore Rebel activity. This is unacceptable. When the agent activates the holoprojector, he will trigger a small thermal detonator. This will send an appropriate message to our other informants.
Informant's Holoprojector

An influential Imperial dignitary has been proven a traitor. He must be removed quietly, in order to avoid alerting his allies. Collect a Scarab assassin droid and deliver it to our agent. We've made sure the droid will be traced back to Rebel operatives.

Small assassin droid
Imperial Intelligence: Bureau of Operations
A fitting end for this dignitary, wouldn't you agree?
You sure I won't be implicated in this? This guy's got a lot of friends on Coruscant.
Well done, agent. Your service to the Empire has been noted, and your future looks rosy indeed.
Deliver assassin droid

An Internal Affairs agent is investigating a so-called "officer" of the ISB. We suspect this individual is actually a double agent helping the Rebels. Deliver this warrant to our agent. It will tell him how to proceed.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Security Bureau
When it comes to the security of the Empire, no one is above suspicion of traitorous activities.
If this is what I think it is, I can finally put a stop to this officer's activities. Forever.
Well done. That traitorous officer will soon learn the price for betraying the Empire.
ISB Double Agent Termination

A highly placed aide to the Emperor himself has been implicated in a treasonous scandal. We suspect the charge to be false, a Rebel stratagem. However, for the sake of prudence we are arresting the aide's family members, to discourage him from attempting flight. His daughter is visiting this world. Pick up and take the arrest warrant to the garrison commander. They've been issued by the Ubiqtorate itself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
The aide's daughter is here on a fact-finding mission for the Empire. At least, that is her claim. We shall see.
That aide's daughter is as good as arrested. Long live the Emperor!

No doubt the aide's reputation will be cleared soon. Were the charge of treason authentic, the Emperor would have easily rooted out a traitor so close to him. Our Emperor excels at detecting treachery.
Warrant for Imperial Aide's Daughter

The Emperor wants to know how a Jedi Knight, especially one as dangerous as Obi-Wan Kenobi, could have hidden for so long. Our agent is to turn Tatooine inside out in an effort to answer this question. The Emperor's instructions are on an encrypted datadisc that you must collect and deliver.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
I certainly hope there aren't any more Jedi secretly aiding the Rebellion.
