Turn Tatooine Inside Out

Lord Vader orders that any information regarding the name "Skywalker" is to be transmitted to him immediately. These orders appear to conflict with earlier instructions from the Emperor himself. A recent communique will make matters clear. Deliver it to our surveillance officer.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
I fear for any agent who gets caught between Lord Vader and the Emperor. We must resolve this situation.
I'll follow these instructions to the letter.
In all likelihood the term "Skywalker" means nothing important, so this situation may be resolved without undue tension.
The Emperor vs. Lord Vader?

Our spy inside crimelord Jabba the Hutt's palace has been discovered and fed to Lord Jabba's pet rancor. Deliver these reassignment orders to the agent we've selected to replace him. Inform the agent that speed is of the essence, regardless of the danger posed. When he has successfully infiltrated Jabba's palace, he is to contact us by courier only.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
If only all our agents were as efficient as you and the one chosen for this task.
Imperial Intelligence isn't very intelligent if it thinks an Imperial agent can survive that deathtrap.
It appears the agent is showing unusual reluctance to enter Jabba's palace. In fact, he has disappeared. We will investigate further.
Reassignment: Jabba's Palace

Recently we ordered an agent to infiltrate crimelord Jabba the Hutt's palace. The agent went AWOL. Deliver this termination order to one of our assassins and tell him to take care of this renegade agent as quickly and quietly as possible. We have reasons to believe he is seeking to join the Hutt syndicate.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence: Bureau of Operations
This agent could cause us great harm if he turns criminal.
It's better to die a loyal servant of the Empire than live as a traitor. I wish all agents realized that.
The Hutts recruit small numbers of Imperial renegades each year, hoping to line up new sources of contraband weaponry. We always find and destroy the traitors.
Terminate Renegade Agent

We intercepted part of a Rebel transmission that mentioned something called a "tauntaun." Records show that this is a species of animal, but here it appears to be a code term. We have reasons to believe it is an important link to locating a major Rebel cell. We've included all we know about it on an encrypted datadisc. Deliver it to our operative with instructions to gather more information.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Analysis Bureau
Every lead we get must be investigated, no matter how trivial it might appear.
Isn't "tauntaun" a code name Corellian smugglers use for high grade glitterstim spice? I'll look into that.
With luck, if our operative's suspicions are correct, we may uncover a Rebel drug-smuggling operation. Your part in this effort will not go unnoticed, agent.
"Tauntaun" Data Needed

Our  Internal Organization Bureau discovered one of our agents selling information to the Rebellion. The traitor fled to the Outer Rim. Deliver this open bounty to our contact within the Bounty Hunters' Guild.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
It is supreme folly to betray the Empire -- doubly so within the ranks of Imperial Intelligence!
I'll make sure this gets transmitted to our entire organization. You'll have your target soon enough.
With this open bounty on the traitor's head, we're confident that he'll soon be back in our hands. We intend to discover the full extent of his crime.
Imperial Intelligence Deathmark

Imperial Intelligence
These discs will prevent another Yavin 4 disaster. The Rebellion will soon be crushed.
The more of these safehouses we destroy, the less effective the Rebellion will be.
Excellent work. We trust you did not try to read the disc. Its self-destruction frequently damages the reading device as well.
Encoded Safehouse Instructions

We've discovered a number of CSA Viceprexes who have been aiding Rebels in exchange for money. Collect and deliver termination orders to our operative as soon as possible. We'll make sure the CSA understands that the Empire does not treat such matters lightly.

Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence Operations
Money is a powerful motivator, but the risk of death is more powerful still.
What is good is money if you're not around to spend it? Too bad these guys didn't learn that lesson.
Excellent work, citizen. The Empire will reward you.
Viceprex Termination Orders

We've just received an order from General Veers himself at Imperial High Command to train more AT-AT pilots. Pick up and deliver a set of transfers to the garrison commander. These candidates are to go immediately to Imperial training facilities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I understand that General Veers is serving directly under Lord Vader. A prestigious assignment indeed.
Always wanted to pilot an AT-AT myself. I'll see to this at once.
You've done well, citizen. It is the Empire's hope that you will continue to serve faithfully.
Recruit AT-AT Pilots

We intend to strike Mon Calamari's floating cities in retaliation for their aid to the Rebellion. Pick up and deliver High Command's orders to the garrison commander. All shore leave is revoked. All troopers must report to duty at once.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We waited too long to strike the Mon Calamari. This is long overdue.
Word will go out immediately. My men will report on time.
The Star Destroyer will depart soon. We will make the Mon Calamari pay for their crimes against the Empire.
Strike the Mon Calamari

Admiral Ozzel has just informed us that we need to deliver 500 additional probe droids to the Star Destroyer Accuser. Collect and deliver the requisition order to our depot officer. He'll see to it that those probe droids are loaded aboard a transport.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Searching the Galaxy takes time and resources.
More probe droids? We can hardly keep them in stock. What, or who, are they looking for?
You've done well. The Empire is grateful for your assistance.
Probe Droids Search the Galaxy

A former Senator continues to aid the Rebellion. Despite the dissolution of the Senate, this politician's influence limits our access to his holdings. Collect and deliver a termination order to our Intelligence contact. This mission is to be accomplished "by any means necessary."
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These do-gooders will learn that privileged positions can't protect them from the Emperor's wrath.
Good. I've been waiting for a chance to take out this Senator. I think I'll throw in his annoying family as a bonus.
That was a delicate mission, handled discreetly and professionally. The Empire will not forget your efficiency.
Take Out a Senator

Insiders helped the Rebellion acquire secret Imperial plans resulting in the deaths of thousands of loyal soldiers. Pick up the dossiers on our prime suspects, and deliver them to an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. We order a deathmark on every suspect.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We do what we must to ensure the guilty will be brought to justice.
Business is good for our guild these days. The Battle of Yavin was the Empire's disgrace and our fortune.
That was handled well, citizen. The Empire will see to it that you are rewarded.
Avenge the Death Star

We've just captured several Rebels who were conducting sabotage missions in the Outer Rim. The Rebels' resistance to convential interrogation have made drastic action necessary. Collect and deliver a message, for the eyes of an Inquisitor only. We need his skills in interrogation.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I can't wait to watch the Inquisitor at work. They say the sight is a thing of beauty.
I leave at once. These Rebels will tell us everything.
Well done. Your dedication to the Empire is admirable.
Summon the Inquisitor

Intercepted Rebel transmissions are too vital to send via the HoloNet. Collect a copy of these transmissions and deliver them to our Intelligence contact. Deciphering these transmissions will lead us to the Rebel's new base. The Empire is counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Information is power, citizen. The Empire's information network is the best in the galaxy.
We'll get right on this. Those Rebels won't escape us.
Prompt delivery and a minimum of fuss. That's the sort of action the Empire prizes. Well done.
Intercepted Rebel Transmissions

We must insure the Corporate Sector Authority is not secretly aiding the Rebel Alliance in exchange for payoffs. We have obtained the security codes to confidential CSA files. Collect them and give them to our covert operative. If he discovers wrongdoing, he is to take appropriate action.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The CSA's loyalty will always be to money. The Empire should not be so lenient with them.
Now we'll see which Viceprexes are smart and which are not.
Performed with great professionalism, citizen. The Empire is glad to pay your fee.
Investigate the CSA

We've discovered a number of CSA Viceprexes who have been aiding Rebels in exchange for money. Collect and deliver termination orders to our operative as soon as possible. We'll make sure the CSA understands that the Empire does not treat such matters lightly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Money is a powerful motivator, but the threat of death is more powerful still.
What good is money if you're not around to spend it? Too bad these guys didn't learn that lesson.
Excellent work, citizen. The Empire will reward you.
Bump Off Greedy Businessmen

Intelligence suspects that a new breed of Jedi has appeared and is aiding the Rebels. Collect Intelligence's report and deliver it to the Inquisitors. If the Jedi have returned, we must hunt and destroy them once and for all.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If this rumor is true, it would explain the Battle of Yavin.
We will root out these Jedi. They will meet the same fate as their corrupt Old Republic predecessors.
As long as loyal citizens such as yourself continue to serve faithfully, the Empire will crush its enemies.
Inquisitors Must Hunt Jedi

We're providing our recruiters with a demo version of our TIE flight simulators, to help boost enlistment. Pick up and deliver the encrypted program. Tell the recruiter to limit the amount of time each visitor gets with the flight sim. We know those simulators can be addictive.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our TIE flight training programs are a big draw for Imperial citizens.
This will certainly boost enlistment. I love these flight sims.
Well done. The Empire has compensated you.
Help Imperial Recruitment

We suspect the Mon Calamari are building a vast fleet to support the Rebellion. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our operative so that they can organize surveillance missions in preparation for Imperial strikes on Mon Calamari floating cities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Aiding the Rebellion invokes genocide. All species must support the New Order.
This will be an excellent example of Imperial justice, second only to Alderaan.
The Empire is pleased with your performance, agent. The Mon Calamari will pay for the thousands of Imperial lives lost at Yavin with millions of their own.
Punish the Mon Calamari
A Rebel cell has been identified on a remote planet in the Outer Rim. Pick up the report and deliver it to our Imperial Naval contact. This cell must be wiped out immediately. Take no prisoners.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
This assignment requires an Imperial naval captain who is not squeamish.
I think one Star Destroyer with a full complement of stormtroopers ought to suffice.
Your service helps the Imperial war machine run smoothly. You deserve to be rewarded.
Destroy a Rebel Colony

We've been instructed to locate some sort of rare crystal on Mimban. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our local agent. He should contact Captain-Supervisor Grammel to secure his help.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We never question the Emperor's instructions, citizen. Never.
Mimban? Isn't that a small mining colony? I will follow these instructions to the letter.
We must pursue all leads that might result in the destruction of the Rebellion. Your efforts are noted, citizen.
Find the Mimban Crystal

A seller of antiques claims to possess rare Sith artifacts. The Emperor himself has commanded that this individual be arrested and these artifacts confiscated, if they exist. Collect and deliver the warrant to our operative.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I don't understand the fascination that old religion holds for Imperial citizens. Superstition, I suppose.
I was wondering when we'd get around to bringing in this dealer. It's as good as done.
Job well done, agent. The Emperor will be informed of your assistance.
Retrieve Sith Artifacts

An influential Imperial dignitary has been proven a traitor. He must be removed quietly, in order to avoid alerting his allies. Collect a Scarab assassin droid and deliver it to our agent. We've made sure the droid will be traced back to Rebel operatives.
Filename_of_object
Small assassin droid
A fitting end for such a vile traitor, wouldn't you agree?
You sure I won't be implicated in this? This guy's got a lot of friends on Coruscant.
Well done, agent. Your service to the Empire has been noted, and your future looks rosy indeed.
Scarab Assassin Droid

The Emperor wants to know how a Jedi Knight, especially one as dangerous as Obi-Wan Kenobi, could have hidden for so long. Our agent is to turn Tatooine inside out in an effort to answer this question. The Emperor's instructions are on an encrypted datadisc that you must collect and deliver.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I certainly hope there aren't any more Jedi secretly aiding the Rebellion.
I'm sure the Hutts helped hide this fugitive. Those creatures will do anything for money.
Trusted agents are hard to find. The Empire wants to insure your continued allegiance by demonstrating how lucrative it can be to serve the Emperor.
Investigate Tatooine

We've redesigned our scout trooper blaster pistol so that it can carry a larger energy cell and deliver a more powerful punch. Pick up the prototype and design specs, and deliver them to a garrison commander for field testing. This is an important military mission. Can we count on you?
Filename_of_object
Trooper pistol
This pistol is a true credit to the genius of the Imperial Army's weapon designers.
Amazing how the pistol retained its light weight even with the larger energy cell.
Good work, agent. We'll be keeping our eye on you. You show promise.
Help Test Prototype Pistol

We've finally identified all the surviving Rebel pilots from the Battle of Yavin, including a Corellian smuggler and his Wookiee companion. Pick up their dossiers and take them to the local garrison commander. All stormtroopers will keep a sharp eye out for these enemies of the state.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These terrorists are responsible for the deaths of thousands of loyal Imperial officers and troopers. We trust they will be arrested soon.
Our troopers will arrest this Rebel scum in no time.
Fine work. Continue serving the Empire and you will continue to be rewarded.
Find the Traitors of Yavin

Imperial Intelligence suggests that recent potential recruits are actually undercover agents for the Rebellion. Pick up the list of names and take it to the garrison commander so these suspects can be arrested for questioning.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our recruiters must be especially vigilant. Rebel spies constantly try to infiltrate through their offices.
We do get our fair share of spies. Fortunately, we always root them out.
Your service to the Empire is noted, citizen. We hope it will continue.
Potential Recruits Are Often Spies

A design flaw in older helmet comlinks allows certain transceivers to pick up a trooper's transmissions. A modification to the comlink chip should take care of the problem. Fortunately, these older helmets are found mostly on small outposts. Pick up the adjustment instructions and deliver them to the local garrison commander.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you are. The commander should also use this opportunity to do an inventory of his garrison.
You can never be too careful about who's listening in on what, eh?
Well done, citizen. You've been compensated for your efforts.
Fix Trooper Helmets

Recent sabotage by Rebel data slicers has confused local garrisons. Pick up and deliver some encrypted orders to the local commander. Inform him that he will receive orders in this manner until Imperial Intelligence can once again secure the HoloNet.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I've always preferred hand-delivered orders. Nothing beats the extra security.
Good. This should clarify things a bit. These Rebels are a definite thorn in our side.
Well done. I hope that this is just an example of what we can expect from you in the future.
Improved Imperial Security

We're receiving requests for additional conscripts from the Corporate Sector Authority. Our detention facilities are overflowing, so our solution is clear. Prisoners are to be transported immediately to the CSA's processing facilities. Pick up and deliver the instructions to the local warden.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Building and maintaining the Imperial war machine takes many strong backs. Rebel backs will do nicely.
I hope these quotas call for large numbers of prisoners, because we've got them to spare.
Efficient and prompt. Good. That is what the Empire expects from its loyal citizens.
Clear Out the Prisons

A recent list of suspects includes senatorial aides and family members. Local security forces have been reluctant to arrest them without word from Imperial High Command. Pick up and take the arrest warrants to the garrison commander. They've been issued by the Ubiqtorate itself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The influence of many of the Old Republic's corrupt senators is difficult to dispel.
You understand our caution, don't you? This will clear things up.
Well handled, citizen. Those arrest warrants will be served immediately.
Ubiqtorate Arrest Warrants

We've fallen behind schedule due to prisoner riots.We need a boost to our labor force to keep up the Emperor's aggressive military buildup. Pick up and deliver an order to the local government official for aid in worker recruitment.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Sometimes the Emperor asks the impossible. We need more workers!
I can think of a few layabouts who could be persuaded to serve the Engineer Corps. We'll get right on it.
You have done well. Continue to serve the Emperor faithfully.
Recruit Military Workers

Imperial Intelligence suggests that recent potential recruits are actually undercover agents for the Rebellion. Pick up the list of names and take it to the garrison commander so these suspects can be arrested for questioning.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Our recruiters must be especially vigilant. Rebel spies constantly try to infiltrate through their offices.
We do get our fair share of spies. Fortunately, we always root them out.
Your service to the Empire is noted, citizen. We hope it will continue.
List of Suspected Rebels

We've just finished our latest promotional hologram. It shows Star Destroyers destroying Rebel bases in the Outer Rim and bringing order to several remote settlements. Deliver a recording to our public relations officer for distribution to all authorized local media.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy: Public Relations Division
I appear briefly in the background of the hologram. A proud moment for me.
I've been wanting to see this hologram for some time now. Glad we finally have it.
Make sure you see that PR hologram yourself, citizen. It's very inspirational.
Public Relations Hologram

A design flaw in older helmet comlinks allows certain transceivers to pick up a trooper's transmissions. A modification to the comlink chip should take care of the problem. Pick up the adjustment instructions and deliver them to the local garrison commander.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
The commander should use this as an opportunity to inventory his garrison.
You never can be too careful about who's listening in on what, eh?
Fortunately, these older helmets are found mostly on small outposts. You have been compensated for your efforts, citizen.
Trooper Helmet Fix

Some local merchants have not yet implemented a courtesy military discount. We want to encourage them to institute the standard 30% discount for all goods sold to military personnel. Pick up a friendly reminder hologram and deliver it to the local merchants' guild liaison so that he can play it at their next business meeting.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
These tiny oversights occur every now and again. It takes very little to correct them.
I'll play this at the beginning of the meeting. I'm sure there will be no further problems.
The hologram shows stormtroopers commandeering local shops suspected of selling goods to Rebels. Historically this has proven remarkably effective in reminding merchants of their civic duty.
Courtesy Military Discount

Recent sabotage by Rebel data slicers has confused local garrisons. Pick up a set of encrypted orders and deliver them to the local commander. Inform him that he will receive orders in this manner until Imperial Intelligence can once again secure the HoloNet.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Armed Forces
I've always preferred hand-delivered orders. Don't you agree?
Good. This should clarify things a bit. These Rebels are a definite thorn in our side.
Well done. I hope that this is just an example of what we can expect from you in the future.
Orders for Improved Security

For their exemplary duty in arresting Rebel sympathizers and informants, we'd like to reward our troops by having you pick up voucher cards and deliver them to the local garrison. They're good for up to 200 credits at all cooperative local restaurants and shops. Do not attempt to use these vouchers yourself, or it will go badly for you.
filename_of_object
Container of datadiscs
Imperial Army
The Empire takes care of its own.
The troops will definitely appreciate this.
Stormtroopers deserve some R&R every now and again, wouldn't you agree?
Stormtrooper Vouchers

We're receiving requests for additional conscripts from the Corporate Sector Authority. Our detention facilities are overflowing, so our solution is clear. Prisoners are to be transported immediately to the CSA's processing facilities. Pick up the instructions and deliver them to the local warden.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
Building and maintaining the Imperial war machine takes many strong backs. Rebel backs will do nicely.
I hope these quotas call for large numbers of prisoners, because we've got them to spare.
You have done well. We're putting those Rebel sympathizers to good use!
Prison Worker Quotas

Rebel raids on Imperial depots continue unabated. We've ordered tracking beacons planted in hundreds of blasters, energy cells, and medical scanners so that these supplies can be shipped to the likely target of the next Rebel attack. Pick up the transport order and deliver it to our liaison to the SoroSuub Corporation, which has produced this special equipment.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
The depot location is on this encrypted disc and should be shared with no one. This is a mission of the highest priority.
This shipment will leave on the next available transport. The Rebels will discover the hazards of stealing our equipment.
These trackers should be undetectable unless the entire device is dismantled and each part scanned individually -- more work than most Rebel cells will do. Good work!
Plant Tracking Beacons

A high-ranking representative of Sienar Fleet Systems may be visiting this system soon. We want this representative treated with the greatest respect and shown every courtesy by the local government. Deliver the request personally to our public relations officer, and have him inform local officials of the forthcoming visit.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy Public Relations
It pays to have the Empire's gratitude.
This representative will receive the best treatment. The Empire can count on me.
The Sienar Fleet representative was waylaid and captured by Rebels. The visit has been cancelled. That is all.
Sienar Fleet Rep Visit

Imperial Intelligence has identified possible sites for the Rebellion's next base of operations. One of these worlds is near our own. Deliver these orders to the garrison commander. He must retain the minimum number of troops necessary for planetary security and immediately reassign the rest to the Star Destroyer flagship Executor. It will enter standard orbit shortly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
The Executor is a ship to behold. You'd be proud to serve aboard that vessel.
So I'm just supposed to depopulate my entire garrison? Ahh, well. Long live the Empire.
The Executor has been diverted to handle an uprising in the Mid-Rim. The local garrison will remain at full strength until further notice.
Executor Reassignment Orders

Recruitment is up all across the Galaxy. The Empire's citizens are demonstrating their loyalty by signing up to serve their Emperor. Deliver the new recruitment documents to the local recruiter and tell him to follow the new manual.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
How can the Rebellion win, with so many loyal Imperial citizens around?
My heart swells with pride. Hail the Empire!
The Empire's greatest day is yet to come. And you have played your part, agent.
Recruitment Materials

A recent list of suspects includes senatorial aides and family members. Local security forces have been reluctant to arrest them without word from Imperial High Command. Pick up the arrest warrants and take them to the garrison commander. They've been issued by the Ubiqtorate itself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
The influence of many of the Old Republic's corrupt senators is difficult to dispel.
You understand our caution, don't you? This will clear things up.
Well handled, citizen. Those arrest warrants will be served immediately.
Senatorial Arrest Warrants

We've fallen behind schedule due to prisoner riots. We need a boost to our labor force to keep up the Emperor's aggressive military buildup. Pick up the order for aid in worker recruitment and deliver it to the local government official.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army: Corps of Engineers
Sometimes the Emperor asks the impossible of us. We need more workers!
I can think of a few layabouts who could be persuaded to serve the Engineer Corps. We'll get right on it.
You have done well. Continue to serve the Emperor faithfully.
Labor Force Increase

A Moff's daughter is traveling to our system on a research expedition. Seems she's a zoology student working on a field guide to the Empire's reptomammals. The Moff has requested an escort for his daughter, one which we will gladly provide. These are the specifications for the escort. Take them to the garrison commander and make sure the escort is ready in two days.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
I understand this young woman can be a bit -- fussy. I don't envy the commander this task.
I'll handpick the men and make sure they are acceptable to the Moff. I hope his daughter finds them acceptable too. If they disagree, it's hard to know who would win.
Speculation on the opinions of the Moff or his daughter is entirely out of line. Do not spread rumors, or it will go badly for you.
Moff's Daughter Needs Escort

Recently a garrison commander assigned an escort to a Moff's daughter while she conducted a zoological study. The escort proved inadequate. The young woman was wounded while investigating a narglatch den. Deliver this transfer order to the new garrison commander, and inform him that the former commander is to be shipped to Coruscant for court-martial.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
We should strive to make all Moffs happy.
I'll make very sure the former commander is on the next transport to Coruscant. I am grateful to the Empire for my recent promotion.
The Moff's daughter will live, fortunately. But the traumatic experience has caused her to abandon her plan to become a zoologist.
Court-Martial Order

We've just received an order from General Veers himself at Imperial High Command to train more AT-AT pilots. Pick up a set of transfers and deliver it to the garrison commander. These candidates are to go immediately to Imperial training facilities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
I understand that General Veers is serving directly under Lord Vader. A prestigious assignment indeed.
Always wanted to pilot an AT-AT myself. I'll see this at once.
You've done well, citizen. It is the Empire's wish that you continue to serve faithfully.
AT-AT Pilots Needed

We intend to strike Mon Calamari's floating cities in retaliation for their aid to the Rebellion. Pick up High Command's orders and deliver them to the garrison commander. All shore leave is revoked. All troopers must report to duty at once.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
We waited too long to strike the Mon Calamari. This is long overdue.
Word will go out immediately. My men will report on time.
The Star Destroyer will depart soon. We will make the Mon Calamari pay for their crimes against the Empire.
Deliver ship-out orders

Admiral Ozzel has just informed us that we need to deliver 500 additional probe droids to the Star Destroyer Accuser. Collect the requisition order and deliver it to our depot officer. He'll see to it that those probe droids are loaded aboard a transport.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Searching the Galaxy takes time and resources.
More probe droids? We can hardly keep them in stock.
You've done well. The Empire is grateful for your assistance.
Admiral Ozzel's Probe Droids

Imperial Intelligence intercepted a transmission that indicated Rebels might try to sabotage the shipyards at Fondor. Pick up the encrypted orders dispatched by Lord Vader and relay them to our waiting courier. Have him deliver the orders into the hands of Captain Needa of the Star Destroyer Avenger. Hurry.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Be prompt. My understanding is that Lord Vader is not a forgiving man.
Lord Vader sent these orders? I'll deliver them to Captain Needa right away! Personally!
Tell no one of the nature of your mission, or you will live, briefly, to regret it.
Lord Vader's Orders

Troublemakers in outlying systems are protesting the destruction of Alderaan and burning the Emperor in effigy. These demonstrations must be stopped, but only by local security forces. Stormtroopers are not to be used in these situations. These orders come directly from Imperial High Command. Pick them up and deliver them to our HoloNet officer, with instructions to transmit them immediately.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
Stormtroopers should never have been used for urban pacification.
I'll send out the transmission immediately. Will regular encryption suffice?
An incident with stormtroopers at one protest led to the deaths of many bystanders. This kind of regrettable accident only foments sympathies for the Rebellion.
No Stormtroopers at Protests

SoroSuub's latest blaster design, the Stormtrooper One, is ready for field testing. Every garrison is receiving fifty of the blasters. Deliver a message to the garrison commander. It gives instructions on how the weapons are to be dispersed among the troops. We expect full reports on the blaster's performance.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
We'll see if this is an improvement over BlasTech's E-11 blaster design.
I've been waiting to see how this blaster performs. The reports will be a pleasure.
The Stormtrooper One blaster will carry forward the Empire's efforts to restore order throughout the galaxy!
Stormtrooper One Blaster

The question we get asked more often than any other is, "How do I become a stormtrooper?" A new pamphlet explains how to enlist with the Imperial Army and join the galaxy's most elite soldiers. Deliver an electronic copy to our local recruiter so he can distribute it to all those eager young recruits.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
This renewed interest in the Imperial Army is heartening, isn't it?
This pamphlet will no doubt aid recruitment. I'll start distributing it to every likely candidate.
Nothing lures the fresh-faced young graduate into the Imperial Army like the prospect of stormtrooper armor!
How Do I Become a Stormtrooper?

Careful review of Imperial flight records has revealed irregular activity involving a particular shuttle. It appears that the craft has embarked on unscheduled flights to unknown destinations. Pick up the records of these findings and deliver them to our Internal Security officer for futher investigation.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
We're not sure how this could have happened. Shuttles don't just disappear.
This could be the result of a spy in our ranks. We'll investigate immediately.
The Rebellion has gained possession of many Imperial shuttles. In fact, this appears to be the preferred method of defection for low-ranking Imperial officers.
Imperial Shuttle Flight Anomalies

We've recently concluded an investigation of unscheduled Imperial shuttle flights. Our findings and recommendations are presented on an encrypted datadisc. Collect it and deliver it to the officer who requested the investigation. Inform him that we will take further action if requested.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence
Congratulate the officer in charge. One can never be too careful about Imperial security.
We'll study these findings and proceed from there.
All Intelligence findings and recommendations are, of course, classified. Tell no one.
Imperial Shuttle Investigation

Having reviewed Internal Security's findings concerning the most recent unscheduled Imperial shuttle flights, we've decided that no further action is necessary at this time. Please deliver this personal thanks to the IntSec officer in charge of the investigation. Assure him that the Moff named in his report will not forget his efficiency and discretion.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Where a Moff decides to travel is none of our concern.
Thank you. I must remember to send my warmest regards to the Moff's wife.
Thank you, agent. Of course the Moff will also remember your own discretion in this matter.
Discretion Regarding a Moff

Certain luxury starliners have been transporting goods to Rebel terrorist cells. Imperial High Command orders the Navy to approach and board all starliners. Should they find evidence of Rebel activity, they will arrest all aboard and impound the vessel. Deliver the orders to the garrison commander and instruct him to prepare stormtroopers.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Our ships will use whatever force necessary to bring in these traitors.
These wealthy citizens think they can get away with treason? We'll put a stop to them.
This initiative has the added benefit of improving Imperial revenue through auction of seized vessels. From the Rebellion's pockets into ours!
Luxury Starliner Seizure

We'll be conducting some military exercises on Tatooine and Alzoc III to better prepare our troops for combat in extreme weather conditions. Imperial Intelligence has reasons to believe the Rebels may be considering planets with such conditions for a future base. Deliver the transfer order to the local garrison commander so that he may assign squads to these exercises.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
There's a reason our troopers are the most feared in the Galaxy. They can fight everywhere.
I know just the troops for such an exercise. I will carry out the order promptly.
The latest intelligence indicates the Rebellion has not yet placed its new headquarters. It may be that our program is slightly premature. However, preparation for war is never wasted.
Send Stormtroopers to Extremes

Apparently the example on Dentaal was insufficient for some systems. Deliver a sample "vaccine" to our medical officer. Inform him that he should replicate it and and ship quantities to any system that continues to engage in acts of insurrection. One way or another, the Empire's authority will be recognized.
filename_of_object
Cannister
Imperial Intelligence: Bureau of Operations
Make sure the seal on this cannister is not broken.
I will be most careful with this -- "vaccine."
You did not become exposed to the vaccine yourself, correct? It will go badly for you if you did.
New Imperial "Vaccine"

A naval officer who defected to the Rebellion managed to escape our agents. Inquisitors are interrogating his family at a secret detention facility. If we leak its location to Rebel slicers, the officer will attempt a rescue. Pick up the encrypted datadisc with the facility's location. Deliver it to the garrison commander with instructions to let it fall -- plausibly -- into the Rebellion's hands.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Intelligence: Bureau of Operations
The secret location must be leaked in a convincing way, or the Rebels will suspect a trap.
I know the perfect agent for this operation. I'll see that it's done.

All is well. The commander gave the disk to a stormtrooper, then sent the trooper on patrol near a known Rebel stronghold. Of course the Rebels shot the trooper and plundered the body. This should convince them the information is trustworthy. The officer will soon be back in our hands.
Encoded Trap for Imperial Defector

Imperial High Command has ordered us to send a reconnaissance team to the Thila system. Deliver instructions to the local scout trooper commander, and see to it that he assembles a team as soon as possible. He is to report findings directly to Admiral Ozzel.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
What is it with the Rebels and jungle planets?
We just received our new Aratech speeder bikes. We'll test them out.
The reconnaissance of the Thila system will commence shortly. Good work, agent!
Reconnaissance of Thila System

Our officer evaluations have been completed. Deliver this list of names to the local garrison commander. These officers are assigned to exterminate Imperial Navy cruisers in drydock that have been infested with mynocks. We're sure this will help improve their evaluation scores in the future.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
The Empire always rewards hard work and strict discipline.
These officers will be delighted when they receive their reassignment orders. Heh, heh.
Vermin extermination duty has long been a powerful incentive in the Imperial Navy.
Vermin Extermination Duty

Imperial Intelligence employs the Bothan SpyNet. Reports indicate the Bothans may be dealing with Rebels as well. We are sending a Star Destroyer to Bothawui to discourage traitorous activities. Meanwhile, every garrison must cease using Bothan informants until Imperial Intelligence has cleared a list of acceptable spies. Deliver the order to the local garrison commander.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial High Command
A species that has intrigue and manipulation in its blood will always be a great risk to our security.
Right. I never trusted those blasted Bothans anyway.
The Empire trusts that if you see suspicious conduct by a Bothan, you will report it to Imperial Intelligence immediately.
Bothan Moratorium

Applications to the Imperial Academy have been updated to comply with a new screening process. Take the new applications to our local recruiter and inform him that old applications are to be destroyed. He should already have received the new recruitment materials.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Here are the applications. If I had a credit for every youngster who told me he wanted to be a TIE pilot --
Another new screening process? They must be getting too many defections to the Rebellion. At least that hasn't happened on my watch, yet.
Rebellion efforts to infiltrate spies into our ranks start at the Academy. Constant tuning of our admission process will locate spies before they can do an instant's harm.
New Academy Applications

Certain misguided Imperial officers are circulating a petition favoring the admittance of non-human species into the Imperial military. Deliver our order to the local garrison commander instructing his troops not to sign this petition. Any Imperial soldier whose name appears on this petition will be subject to discipline and possible court-martial.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial High Command
You don't approve of the petition, do you? Military service is obviously suited only for humans.
No one in my garrison will sign any such petition. You have my assurance of that.
The misguided officers who circulated the petition have been located and suitably disciplined. All is well.
Deliver warning

I have proof that a depot commander has been doctoring records to hide his misappropriation of certain supplies. Deliver my encrypted evidence to him, and inform him that I'll make sure it does not fall into the wrong hands -- in exchange for a percentage of his profit. I expect an answer within two days. I trust I can count on your discretion?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
An Intelligence Officer
It pays to have friends in high places.
Argh. I'll respond within the given time.
Remember, agent, I know more about you than you do about me. Discretion is essential.
Blackmail Notice

An officer recently tried to blackmail me, claiming I had stolen Imperial property. I need this response from Internal Security deliverd to him as soon as possible. I'm sure he's most eager to receive a response. You had best hurry.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
An Imperial Naval Officer
Tell this loyal servant of the Empire that if he doesn't appear promptly, an arrest warrant will be issued.
This is an order from Internal Security to appear on Coruscant. What's the meaning of this?
The officer in question is now en route to Coruscant. All is well.
Summons to Coruscant

Deliver this deathmark to the local liaison to the Bounty Hunters' Guild. The target has gravely insulted me, yet refuses to meet me in an honorable duel. One way or another, I'll have my satisfaction. This matter must be conducted with discretion. Can I rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
An Imperial Army Officer
I would have been the offended party's second in the duel. Some matters of honor must be settled outside normal channels.
A bounty hunter will handle this coward soon enough.
I expect that the Bounty Hunters' Guild will execute the deathmark with its customary efficiency. Thank you for your discretion in this matter.
Discreet Deathmark

I have been grievously insulted by a fellow officer and demand satisfaction. I need this formal challenge delivered to him immediately. It gives all the specifics of the duel. I expect to receive a prompt response.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
An Imperial Naval Officer
Tell this honorless anooba that my friend looks forward to bathing his vibrorapier in blood.
These Generationals and their ridiculous notions of honor. Tell this lunatic to go suck a mynock.
This insult must be avenged. I have no recourse but to go to the Bounty Hunters' Guild.
Challenge to a Duel

A squad of storm commandos will arrive soon to train the local troops. Pick up our encrypted orders and deliver them to the local garrison commander. He is to cooperate fully with the commander of the special squad. Any questions regarding this training should be directed to Imperial Intelligence.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial High Command
We expect the commando training to last several days.
Storm commandos? Hmm. The men should find this very educational.
The storm commandos were unexpectedly diverted to help combat an insurrection in the Outer Rim Territories. The training has been postponed.
Storm Commando Training

Imperial Intelligence has finally released hologram recordings of the Battle of Yavin, transmitted via the HoloNet just prior to the destruction of the Death Star. Deliver this encrypted copy of the holograms to the local garrison commander so he can play them for local troops.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
Up to now we've used these holos to help train TIE pilots and develop new fighter designs. Now the recordings should spur the troops to further action against suspected Rebels.
Thank you. Our men need to see the devastation inflicted by those Rebel scum.
Many men lost family members and friends aboard that space station, and we feel this hologram will help them find closure.
Hologram of Yavin Battle

Slave revolts on Balmorra have slowed down the production of armaments. Imperial High Command wants this situation corrected. Deliver transfer orders to the garrison commander. The specified force must make ready for immediate transport to Balmorra.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
We can't afford any threats to the steady flow of weapons coming from these important armament plants.
I'll see to it that these orders are carried out.
These slave revolts are annoyingly frequent. With sufficient force we can stop them once and for all.
Balmorra Troop Transfer

A Moff has been implicated in a plot to assassinate the Emperor. Deliver this arrest warrant to the garrison commander and instruct him to escort the Moff to Coruscant as quickly as possible. We don't want this situation demoralizing our troops, so be sure he keeps it quiet. Only a small arrest squad need know the situation, and they're to remain on Coruscant after they've delivered the Moff.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial High Command
Political ambition and the desire for power can destroy an otherwise loyal Imperial servant.
This Moff is influential. I can understand the need for silence.
Tell no one of the arrest of the Moff, or you will be subject to the same Imperial justice.
Moff Arrest Warrant

You must pick up a high-priority message and deliver it to an Imperial admiral's aide. This message carries the seal of the Moff. Speed and absolute discretion are required. Execute this task promptly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Office of the Moff
Be sure this gets into the right hands. The fate of the Empire may depend on it.
I'll personally make sure the admiral receives this.
Tell no one of this mission. The Moff's business is not for casual conversation.
The Moff's Highest Priority

An Imperial citizen should be all that he can be. And he can do it in the Imperial Army. Deliver the new promotional hologram to our recruiter. The appearance by Lord Vader himself is most inspirational.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
I saw this hologram. Lord Vader's speech shook me to the marrow.
I'll enter this data into our recruitment terminals immediately.
Imagine getting the chance to serve one day with such a distinguished champion of the Empire as Lord Vader. This will draw new recruits like a magnet.
Be All That You Can Be

An encoded message from an unknown source claims that a secret cell of Jedi Knights has been discovered on Dathomir. We understand that a Jedi played an important role in the destruction of the Death Star. We can't afford to ignore this message. Deliver these orders to the garrison commander. He must assign a squad of storm commandos to investigate this claim.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial High Command
We must prevent the return of the Jedi at all costs.
If they're on Dathomir, we'll find them. Personally, I think all those Jedi stories are just children's tales.
Our officers seem disgracefully ignorant regarding the dimension of the Jedi threat. We shall remedy this through diligent re-education. We trust that you do not share that ignorance, agent.
Jedi Knights on Dathomir?

One of our recruiters has had problems with local youth gangs. Deliver to him this requisition order for Dark Eye surveillance droids. Once we have the images of the offenders in action, we'll dispatch a squad of stormtroopers to handle the situation. It will be a good example for others as well.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
Those Dark Eye droids look so attractive -- when you get to see them, which isn't often.
This should wipe the smiles off those hoodlums' faces.
Youths are enthusiastic. Unfortunately they don't always channel that energy toward something productive.
Dark Eye Droid Requisition

A local garrison commander has requested additional supplies for the troops stationed there. We have approved part of the request. Deliver the adjusted inventory list to him, and inform him that he should be receiving the materials shortly. Any further requests must go through the regular channels.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
It's not an easy job running an efficient Imperial war machine.
Only part of my request was approved? I hope it was the important parts.
Making do with what is available -- that is the soldier's task. That, in fact, is why we hired you; this office's HoloNet is currently broken.
Adjusted Inventory Request

We're providing our recruiters with a demo version of our TIE flight simulators, to help boost enlistment. Deliver this encrypted program and make sure to tell the recruiter to limit the amount of time each visitor gets with the flight sim. We know how addictive these simulators can be.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Navy
Our TIE flight training programs are a big draw for Imperial citizens.
This will certainly boost enlistment. I myself love these flight sims.
The next generation of TIE flight programs will simulate the TIE pilot's entire tour of duty, including convalescence after injury. This should lure even more recruits.
TIE Flight Simulator

We've redesigned our scout trooper blaster pistol so that it can carry a larger energy cell and deliver a more powerful punch. Pick up the prototype and design specs, and deliver them to a garrison commander for field testing. This is an important military mission. Can we count on you?
filename_of_object
Prototype blaster pistol and datadisc
Imperial Army
This pistol is a true credit to the genius of the Imperial Army's weapons designers.
Amazing how the pistol retained its light weight even with the larger energy cell
Good work, agent. We'll be keeping our eye on you. You show promise.
Prototype Scout Pistol

We've finally identified all the surviving Rebel pilots from the Battle of Yavin, including a Corellian smuggler and his Wookiee companion. Pick up the dossiers and holographs of these individuals. Deliver them to the local garrison commander so that all stormtroopers can keep a sharp eye out for these criminals.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Army
These terrorists are responsible for the deaths of thousands of loyal Imperial officers and troopers.
Our troopers will arrest this Rebel scum in no time.
Fine work. Continue serving the Empire and you will continue to be rewarded.
Rebel Holos of Smuggler and Wookiee

We've just received an order from General Veers himself at Imperial High Command to train more AT-AT pilots. Pick up and deliver a set of transfers to the garrison commander. These candidates are to go immediately to Imperial training facilities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I understand that General Veers is serving directly under Lord Vader. A prestigious assignment indeed.
Always wanted to pilot an AT-AT myself. I'll see to this at once.
You've done well, citizen. It is the Empire's hope that you will continue to serve faithfully.
Recruit AT-AT Pilots

We intend to strike Mon Calamari's floating cities in retaliation for their aid to the Rebellion. Pick up and deliver High Command's orders to the garrison commander. All shore leave is revoked. All troopers must report to duty at once.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We waited too long to strike the Mon Calamari. This is long overdue.
Word will go out immediately. My men will report on time.
The Star Destroyer will depart soon. We will make the Mon Calamari pay for their crimes against the Empire.
Strike the Mon Calamari

Admiral Ozzel has just informed us that we need to deliver 500 additional probe droids to the Star Destroyer Accuser. Collect and deliver the requisition order to our depot officer. He'll see to it that those probe droids are loaded aboard a transport.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Searching the Galaxy takes time and resources.
More probe droids? We can hardly keep them in stock. What, or who, are they looking for?
You've done well. The Empire is grateful for your assistance.
Probe Droids Search the Galaxy

A former Senator continues to aid the Rebellion. Despite the dissolution of the Senate, this politician's influence limits our access to his holdings. Collect and deliver a termination order to our Intelligence contact. This mission is to be accomplished "by any means necessary."
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These do-gooders will learn that privileged positions can't protect them from the Emperor's wrath.
Good. I've been waiting for a chance to take out this Senator. I think I'll throw in his annoying family as a bonus.
That was a delicate mission, handled discreetly and professionally. The Empire will not forget your efficiency.
Take Out a Senator

Insiders helped the Rebellion acquire secret Imperial plans resulting in the deaths of thousands of loyal soldiers. Pick up the dossiers on our prime suspects, and deliver them to an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. We order a deathmark on every suspect.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We do what we must to ensure the guilty will be brought to justice.
Business is good for our guild these days. The Battle of Yavin was the Empire's disgrace and our fortune.
That was handled well, citizen. The Empire will see to it that you are rewarded.
Avenge the Death Star

We've just captured several Rebels who were conducting sabotage missions in the Outer Rim. The Rebels' resistance to convential interrogation have made drastic action necessary. Collect and deliver a message, for the eyes of an Inquisitor only. We need his skills in interrogation.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I can't wait to watch the Inquisitor at work. They say the sight is a thing of beauty.
I leave at once. These Rebels will tell us everything.
Well done. Your dedication to the Empire is admirable.
Summon the Inquisitor

Intercepted Rebel transmissions are too vital to send via the HoloNet. Collect a copy of these transmissions and deliver them to our Intelligence contact. Deciphering these transmissions will lead us to the Rebel's new base. The Empire is counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Information is power, citizen. The Empire's information network is the best in the galaxy.
We'll get right on this. Those Rebels won't escape us.
Prompt delivery and a minimum of fuss. That's the sort of action the Empire prizes. Well done.
Intercepted Rebel Transmissions

We must insure the Corporate Sector Authority is not secretly aiding the Rebel Alliance in exchange for payoffs. We have obtained the security codes to confidential CSA files. Collect them and give them to our covert operative. If he discovers wrongdoing, he is to take appropriate action.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The CSA's loyalty will always be to money. The Empire should not be so lenient with them.
Now we'll see which Viceprexes are smart and which are not.
Performed with great professionalism, citizen. The Empire is glad to pay your fee.
Investigate the CSA

We've discovered a number of CSA Viceprexes who have been aiding Rebels in exchange for money. Collect and deliver termination orders to our operative as soon as possible. We'll make sure the CSA understands that the Empire does not treat such matters lightly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Money is a powerful motivator, but the threat of death is more powerful still.
What good is money if you're not around to spend it? Too bad these guys didn't learn that lesson.
Excellent work, citizen. The Empire will reward you.
Bump Off Greedy Businessmen

Intelligence suspects that a new breed of Jedi has appeared and is aiding the Rebels. Collect Intelligence's report and deliver it to the Inquisitors. If the Jedi have returned, we must hunt and destroy them once and for all.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If this rumor is true, it would explain the Battle of Yavin.
We will root out these Jedi. They will meet the same fate as their corrupt Old Republic predecessors.
As long as loyal citizens such as yourself continue to serve faithfully, the Empire will crush its enemies.
Inquisitors Must Hunt Jedi

We're providing our recruiters with a demo version of our TIE flight simulators, to help boost enlistment. Pick up and deliver the encrypted program. Tell the recruiter to limit the amount of time each visitor gets with the flight sim. We know those simulators can be addictive.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our TIE flight training programs are a big draw for Imperial citizens.
This will certainly boost enlistment. I love these flight sims.
Well done. The Empire has compensated you.
Help Imperial Recruitment

We suspect the Mon Calamari are building a vast fleet to support the Rebellion. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our operative so that they can organize surveillance missions in preparation for Imperial strikes on Mon Calamari floating cities.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Aiding the Rebellion invokes genocide. All species must support the New Order.
This will be an excellent example of Imperial justice, second only to Alderaan.
The Empire is pleased with your performance, agent. The Mon Calamari will pay for the thousands of Imperial lives lost at Yavin with millions of their own.
Punish the Mon Calamari
A Rebel cell has been identified on a remote planet in the Outer Rim. Pick up the report and deliver it to our Imperial Naval contact. This cell must be wiped out immediately. Take no prisoners.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
This assignment requires an Imperial naval captain who is not squeamish.
I think one Star Destroyer with a full complement of stormtroopers ought to suffice.
Your service helps the Imperial war machine run smoothly. You deserve to be rewarded.
Destroy a Rebel Colony

We've been instructed to locate some sort of rare crystal on Mimban. Collect and deliver Intelligence's instructions to our local agent. He should contact Captain-Supervisor Grammel to secure his help.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We never question the Emperor's instructions, citizen. Never.
Mimban? Isn't that a small mining colony? I will follow these instructions to the letter.
We must pursue all leads that might result in the destruction of the Rebellion. Your efforts are noted, citizen.
Find the Mimban Crystal

A seller of antiques claims to possess rare Sith artifacts. The Emperor himself has commanded that this individual be arrested and these artifacts confiscated, if they exist. Collect and deliver the warrant to our operative.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I don't understand the fascination that old religion holds for Imperial citizens. Superstition, I suppose.
I was wondering when we'd get around to bringing in this dealer. It's as good as done.
Job well done, agent. The Emperor will be informed of your assistance.
Retrieve Sith Artifacts

An influential Imperial dignitary has been proven a traitor. He must be removed quietly, in order to avoid alerting his allies. Collect a Scarab assassin droid and deliver it to our agent. We've made sure the droid will be traced back to Rebel operatives.
Filename_of_object
Small assassin droid
A fitting end for such a vile traitor, wouldn't you agree?
You sure I won't be implicated in this? This guy's got a lot of friends on Coruscant.
Well done, agent. Your service to the Empire has been noted, and your future looks rosy indeed.
Scarab Assassin Droid

The Emperor wants to know how a Jedi Knight, especially one as dangerous as Obi-Wan Kenobi, could have hidden for so long. Our agent is to turn Tatooine inside out in an effort to answer this question. The Emperor's instructions are on an encrypted datadisc that you must collect and deliver.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I certainly hope there aren't any more Jedi secretly aiding the Rebellion.
I'm sure the Hutts helped hide this fugitive. Those creatures will do anything for money.
Trusted agents are hard to find. The Empire wants to insure your continued allegiance by demonstrating how lucrative it can be to serve the Emperor.
Investigate Tatooine

We've redesigned our scout trooper blaster pistol so that it can carry a larger energy cell and deliver a more powerful punch. Pick up the prototype and design specs, and deliver them to a garrison commander for field testing. This is an important military mission. Can we count on you?
Filename_of_object
Trooper pistol
This pistol is a true credit to the genius of the Imperial Army's weapon designers.
Amazing how the pistol retained its light weight even with the larger energy cell.
Good work, agent. We'll be keeping our eye on you. You show promise.
Help Test Prototype Pistol

We've finally identified all the surviving Rebel pilots from the Battle of Yavin, including a Corellian smuggler and his Wookiee companion. Pick up their dossiers and take them to the local garrison commander. All stormtroopers will keep a sharp eye out for these enemies of the state.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These terrorists are responsible for the deaths of thousands of loyal Imperial officers and troopers. We trust they will be arrested soon.
Our troopers will arrest this Rebel scum in no time.
Fine work. Continue serving the Empire and you will continue to be rewarded.
Find the Traitors of Yavin

Imperial Intelligence suggests that recent potential recruits are actually undercover agents for the Rebellion. Pick up the list of names and take it to the garrison commander so these suspects can be arrested for questioning.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our recruiters must be especially vigilant. Rebel spies constantly try to infiltrate through their offices.
We do get our fair share of spies. Fortunately, we always root them out.
Your service to the Empire is noted, citizen. We hope it will continue.
Potential Recruits Are Often Spies

A design flaw in older helmet comlinks allows certain transceivers to pick up a trooper's transmissions. A modification to the comlink chip should take care of the problem. Fortunately, these older helmets are found mostly on small outposts. Pick up the adjustment instructions and deliver them to the local garrison commander.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you are. The commander should also use this opportunity to do an inventory of his garrison.
You can never be too careful about who's listening in on what, eh?
Well done, citizen. You've been compensated for your efforts.
Fix Trooper Helmets

Recent sabotage by Rebel data slicers has confused local garrisons. Pick up and deliver some encrypted orders to the local commander. Inform him that he will receive orders in this manner until Imperial Intelligence can once again secure the HoloNet.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I've always preferred hand-delivered orders. Nothing beats the extra security.
Good. This should clarify things a bit. These Rebels are a definite thorn in our side.
Well done. I hope that this is just an example of what we can expect from you in the future.
Improved Imperial Security

We're receiving requests for additional conscripts from the Corporate Sector Authority. Our detention facilities are overflowing, so our solution is clear. Prisoners are to be transported immediately to the CSA's processing facilities. Pick up and deliver the instructions to the local warden.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Building and maintaining the Imperial war machine takes many strong backs. Rebel backs will do nicely.
I hope these quotas call for large numbers of prisoners, because we've got them to spare.
Efficient and prompt. Good. That is what the Empire expects from its loyal citizens.
Clear Out the Prisons

A recent list of suspects includes senatorial aides and family members. Local security forces have been reluctant to arrest them without word from Imperial High Command. Pick up and take the arrest warrants to the garrison commander. They've been issued by the Ubiqtorate itself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The influence of many of the Old Republic's corrupt senators is difficult to dispel.
You understand our caution, don't you? This will clear things up.
Well handled, citizen. Those arrest warrants will be served immediately.
Ubiqtorate Arrest Warrants

We've fallen behind schedule due to prisoner riots.We need a boost to our labor force to keep up the Emperor's aggressive military buildup. Pick up and deliver an order to the local government official for aid in worker recruitment.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Sometimes the Emperor asks the impossible. We need more workers!
I can think of a few layabouts who could be persuaded to serve the Engineer Corps. We'll get right on it.
You have done well. Continue to serve the Emperor faithfully.
Recruit Military Workers

My new solo recording of kloo-horn pieces, including an all-new rendition of the classic "Soaring Banthas at Sunset," is finished. But I need someone to hand-deliver it to my sound engineer. I don't trust HoloNet compression routines, you know, they're lossy algorithms that ruin the tone. I'm kind of distracted by a personal crisis, so I really need these tracks taken quick. Be a friend, huh? You'll love the guys at the mastering joint, they're smooth.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If you lose this disc, mister "artiste" is going to have a fit. I don't know why he doesn't just transmit the stupid thing. Like compression would make his stupid bleatings sound worse!
Hey, thanks. That is a good thing, delivering these gonzo sounds. A good thing. -- Uh, sorry, was I saying something? Never mind. Take care, okay? I'll go check out the vibes on this. Thanks.

Thanks, buddy. This recording is going to blow your mind, it's the best kloo-horn material ever, I swear. My girlfriend says I'm a genius, and she used to write for the music rags, so she should know.
Solo Kloo-Horn Recording!

My grandfather recently passed away. After my grandmother died, he always told us stories of his childhood sweetheart, "the one that got away." He would write letters to her, letters that were never sent. Now he's gone, and I think the right thing to do is have these letters delivered at long last. Can you take the archive to her family? I don't feel I can face this woman myself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Will you take these letters? I don't feel right walking up to this old lady's family and handing over these love letters -- I remember my grandmother too well.
Love letters for my grandmother, eh? Tell the truth, I am not sure I should deliver them -- well, okay. Who am I to stand in the way of an old romance?
I've received a touching note from the "other woman." She was very grateful. You can be proud.
Old Love Letters

My cousin was remembered in my late father's will. I don't trust this information over the normal communications channels -- it's not much of an inheritance, and if I go through the normal channels, it's bound to be taxed down to zero. I'm asking you to deliver the information regarding the inheritance, and I'm willing to pay a modest fee.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. The information about the inheritance is in this datadisc. Please make sure it ends up in my cousin's hands only!
Ah, what's this? An inheritance? Why, thank you so much! I had heard that my uncle passed away, but we were never close. This is quite unexpected!
I attach your fee, which pays for services rendered -- and for your reasonable discretion.
Inheritance Notification

I suggest you not look at these images; they are potentially incriminating, and knowledge of their contents could put your name on bounty hunters' lists throughout the galaxy. Just deliver them, no questions asked, discreetly and quickly. Trust me, I am revealing the horrible corruption at the highest levels of government. But I need your help to do it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Don't show these documents to anyone. Don't look at them yourself. And trust me, you're doing the right thing.
What, is this all? Nobody cares about the stupid old scandal. Oh well, I guess it was easy credits for you!
No reply? Well, I'll keep working to spread the truth!
Illegal Activity?

Ah, the delicate savory flavor of carefully filleted colo claw fish, with the lightest sauce of fermented blue milk, rockmite honey, and a secret mix of herbs and spices! The aroma as you ladle the broth from a masterfully crafted soup. The explosion of sensations on your tongue, enough to satisfy the greatest gourmands in the galaxy. This is my greatest work in the greatest art of all, the ephemeral art of cookery! And I need you to hand-deliver it to my rival, just so that I can know that he saw it personally, and will weep at the very idea of ever equalling my exquisite mastery!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Be sure to watch as that scoundrel rival cringes! Weeps! Despairs of ever mastering this dish!
Mmmm, this looks good. I wonder why this guy keeps sending me these great recipes. I wonder if he has the wrong person?
Soon I shall prepare yet another culinary masterpiece. My rival's ego will endure further unbearable torment! Oh, I am bad, I am bad, but I cannot resist.
Colo Claw in Honeyed Spice-Milk

My whole livelihood is tied up in this new blaster design -- I've spent years perfecting it, and I am positive it will cause a revolution. I don't trust this design to the HoloNet. There are too many clever slicers looking for industrial secrets. I need you to carry it to the industrialist whom I hope will agree to manufacture it. He says he will have a representative waiting.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here. Please don't lose it, and please be careful with it! My whole life is tied up in this blaster design.
Another wannabe blaster designer. If you've seen one, you've seen a million. Well, we'll look at it and see if it's any good. Thanks.
Thanks for delivering my blaster design. If it works, you can tell everyone you played a part in revolutionizing blaster technology.
Blaster Schematics

It may seem incredible, but we have become convinced that these ancient stone carvings found on numerous worlds, including even Corellia and Coruscant itself, are in fact of Jawa origin! Should our hypothesis prove true, it will reveal much about the galaxy long, long ago. We need someone to carefully hand-carry local specimens of stone tablets to a lab for analysis.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Archaeological Division
Be careful; these three-dimensional scans of the stone tablets are priceless. We've made backups, of course, but we need the lab to examine them quickly.
Amazing data. Have you heard that the trade routes of the Jawa form a perfect ten-pointed star on the sand? You can sharpen a vibroblade if you leave it at the center.

We believe that phonemic analysis of spoken Jawa language, when combined with an analysis of their typical migratory patterns across the sands of Tatooine, reveals a degenerate form of what was once a highly vibrant culture capable of spacefaring, advanced weaponry, and a high degree of cultural attainment. This is so exciting! A major breakthrough in archaeology.
Jawas Were Spacefarers!

I suggest you not look at these images; they are potentially incriminating, and knowledge of their contents could put your name on bounty hunters' lists throughout the galaxy. Just deliver them, no questions asked, discreetly and quickly. Trust me, I am revealing the horrible corruption at the highest levels of government. But I need your help to do it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Don't show these documents to anyone. Don't look at them yourself. And trust me, you're doing the right thing.
This is incredibly important. With this we can finally expose corruption and malfeasance among Imperial tax agencies. Thank you so much for delivering this!
This will shake the foundations of the Empire! And we will remember your role in our breakthrough.
Illegal Activity?

I don't think you should look at these passcodes. Are we clear? It might not be healthy. In fact, these might not be passcodes at all. Why don't you tell yourself they are something silly and harmless, like love letters or recipes or something, okay? Great, just so we understand each other. Be sure you hand them to the right person.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Don't look at these. Don't ask what building they're for. Don't ask who is hiring you. Don't ask who is receiving them. Just do as you're told and get paid.
We've been tracking your progress. We've identified you. We know everything important about you. Remember that.
We'll know if you looked at these codes. And we know where you live. So if you find yourself suddenly dead, you have only yourself to blame.
Secret Passcodes

This software is confidential and critical. Suffice it to say that it has significant military applications. We need you to hand carry it, at the client's insistence; they are extremely paranoid about it going over the HoloNet. Please deliver it to their representative at the agreed location.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the software. Please deliver it promptly. And don't bother trying to run it -- I promise you don't have the required hardware.
Thanks for delivering the software. How high is your security clearance? All right, never mind.
Thanks, we couldn't have done it without you. You fee has been deposited.
Hand-Carry Vital Software

This datadisc holds an important chemical formula that we believe can lead towards a cure to multiple dangerous diseases. It needs to be hand-delivered to medical personnel; we have multiple couriers going out, as well as electronic transmissions. We are taking all necessary precautions because it is completely vital that this reach its destination, do you understand? Thousands or even millions may die.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I advise you not to mention the outbreak to anyone; no sense in causing a riot. Deliver this quickly, for lives are at stake.
Ah, another copy of the antidote compounds. Fortunately, we received the electronic transmission early on, and were able to contain the outbreak. There's no danger now. But thank you anyway.
The unpredictable nature of this epidemic means there could be other outbreaks. We must be ready!
Into the Hot Zone

I have sold an impregnable warehouse, and I need to hand-deliver keycodes to the structure. I don't want them on the HoloNet, of course, or some slicer will get access to a valuable piece of real estate -- a triple-A secured facility suitable for biomedical materials, weapons grade research, that sort of thing. I want you to deliver them, by hand, to the purchaser.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the keycodes. Don't bother trying to get at them, they're encrypted. This facility is practically impregnable, I am sure the buyer will be pleased.
Thanks! I don't know why the seller was so concerned about hand-delivering the keycodes. I figure this building will make a great cantina. I don't plan to ever lock it!
Cantina! Gad!
Secure Warehouse Keycodes

I need you to deliver a letter. Here is an excerpt: "I hate you. I never want to see you again. Oooh, you make me so mad. Don't try to deny you've been seeing someone else! I saw you! I hope you get stepped on by an overweight bantha and die! I hope you break out with a terrible skin disease! I can't believe I ever thought I loved you! HATE HATE HATE!" Be sure to sneer as you deliver it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I shouldn't even bother to send this, but I can't resist.
But -- but -- I'm still in love -- this is all a misunderstanding -- oh no!
My sweetheart called. My stupid letter almost broke up a wonderful romance, and you let me do it! I HATE YOU! HATE HATE HATE!
I Hate Hate Hate You

I need you to deliver a party invitation. It's a private affair; all relevant information is on the datadisc. Just to be clear, you're not invited -- your sort wouldn't be welcome there, you really wouldn't fit in. No offense.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The party information is on this datadisc. Please be discreet.
Oooh, a party! Great, I can't wait to show off my new purple peko-peko boa!
Thank you so much. You may hear about the party in HoloNet society news coverage.
Private Party Invitation

We need to hand-deliver this important policy speech to a local government official -- there's some big event happening, and the speech needs to be presented then. For some reason, we can't get through via the regular HoloNet channels, so we're counting on you to deliver it!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Communications Office
This speech needs to be delivered in advance of the big event. I hope you make it.
Well, the event was cancelled, but thanks for the speech anyway!
The event is apparently getting rescheduled. We may need your help again. Thanks!
Important Policy Speech

We need you to deliver a summons. Our regular couriers are unavailable, and this case needs prompt investigation. Simply serve the summons, and don't engage the recipient in any significant conversation -- trust us, it won't go well.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Imperial Circuit Court
Here's the summons. Just hand it to the recipient and leave. Not much point in talking.
A summons? What? Hey now, why am I getting a summons?
The recipient has relayed acceptance of the summons, and promises to be indisputably and vocally present in court at the appointed time.
Serve a Circuit Summons

This is my manuscript of poetry. Here's a sample: "Like the sight of the peko-peko/Soaring free above the swamps/My love for you hovers, rises, delicate yet strong/And disappears only into the glory of sunsets." I need you to deliver the datadisc to my publisher.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
These poems are the expressions of my heart. Be careful with them, please!
"Like the sight of the peko-peko"? Oh brother.
I can't believe this rejection! Not only the rejection itself, never mind that, but the speed of it! Did you say something bad to the publisher?
Unspeakably Sensitive Poetry

Well, I finished off my latest batch of scribblings. I barely call them stories, really, hardly worthy of the name. Writers mostly scribble anyhow; aren't many who have anything worth saying. Anyway, for whatever reason, a publisher wants to see these. So go ahead, take them.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. If you lose them, I don't care. Just trifles, after all.
Great! This writer is fantastic. It's a real honor to publish these stories. I only hope that the political content is a little more -- subdued this time.
