Really, the whole foofaraw over these jottings baffles me. Ah well, life is a mystery.
Stories and Scribblings

'Have you ever seen the nocturnal Nexu? Noticed all the different kinds of banthas there are? Now children across the galaxy can learn about amazing animals on a hundred worlds, and in addition see delightful full-color holographs of each beast at work or play.' That's what the blurb says, at any rate. Well, I need someone to deliver this mess, and I guess you're it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I knocked off the writing duties on this hack job in -- well, I won't say how quickly, it embarrasses me. Have fun delivering it.
Great, we'll rush this to distribution right away.
Now the publisher can shill one more sentimental mess to gullible parents. Gaah, I need a drink.
Wildlife Research Manuscript

My magnum opus, a reference work cataloging the various minerals of the galaxy, is finally complete. Some may call it dry or dull, but it is a grand work of scholarship, and I have been careful to annotate every reference. Every mineral description is accompanied by a holograph of both the mineral itself and of its molecular structure. Now all I need is for you to hand-deliver it to the publisher.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I do hope that you find the time to read my manuscript along the way. I recommend the section on theodolites.
Excellent! I imagine that this one will become a bestseller in short order.
Thank you. The audience for mineralogical texts across the galaxy is vanishingly small in percentage terms, but in sheer numbers is quite enough to guarantee me a comfortable living.
Grand Work of Mineralogy

I feel guilty that it has taken this long for this legal document to be delivered. I know that we should not have kept an indentured servant so long, but over time, it felt like we were all one big happy family. But now, we've moved away, and well, it's time for justice to be done and for freedom to have its day.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I hope our servant gets joy from this.
What? Can it be? Freedom? Freedom! I am free! Free!
I feel much better. I wish our former servant well in whatever pursuit freedom brings.
Manumission Documents

My grandfather recently passed away. After my grandmother died, he always told us stories of his childhood sweetheart, "the one that got away." He would write letters to her, letters that were never sent. Now he's gone, and I think the right thing to do is have these letters delivered at long last. Can you take the archive to her family? I don't feel I can face this woman myself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Will you take these letters? I don't feel right walking up to this old lady's family and handing over these love letters -- I remember my grandmother too well.
Oh dear. Love letters for my grandmother -- she just passed away yesterday. You're too late.
That's terrible news. I feel so bad that I waited this long. Possibly if you had got there just a little sooner -- but no, it's not your fault.
Old Love Letters

Check this thing out! It's like a hologame, except you play it piggybacking on the Holonet, see? And you play with thousands of other people at the same time. So I have a copy of it here that's, you know, uh, kind of cracked? And I wanna slip it to my friend so we can play together.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
This game totally rocks. You have like hundreds of species to choose from, and you can be anything from a smuggler to a bounty hunter to a -- shh, don't tell the Empire -- a Jedi!
What, this game? Aw, c'mon. The lag time from here to the servers on Coruscant is terrible. Plus the controls are way too hard, especially the camera system.
Now I'm all down. Turns out the game server checks for cracked copies. It burned out my rig!
Wild New Hologame!

I suggest you not look at these images; they are potentially incriminating, and knowledge of their contents could put your name on bounty hunters' lists throughout the galaxy. Just deliver them, no questions asked, discreetly and quickly. Trust me, I am revealing the horrible corruption at the highest levels of government. But I need your help to do it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Don't show these documents to anyone. Don't look at them yourself. And trust me, you're doing the right thing.
Thank you for being a perfect patsy! Now we can arrest the person who sent you for high treason against the Empire. You're free to go.
FROM THE IMPERIAL SECURITY BUREAU: The holder of this account has been detained by the Empire for investigation of criminal activity. Do not attempt to contact the account holder. That is all.
Illegal Activity?

This refinement to the typical twinline turbo design of the swoop engine flux chamber permits over 700 rotations per second using class C or better material manufacturing processes. We need these experimental blueprints delivered to our agent secretly, so that our competitors get no warning.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the plans for the new engine. Please deliver them promptly, and keep them quiet!
I hope you were cautious and discreet as you travelled. Thank you for the delivery.

This refinement lets us shave almost three credits off typical SKU assembly cost for the mid-sized speeder and swoop engine. This could mean billions of additional credits in a typical revenue cycle. Thank you for your help!
New Engine Schematics

They're saying that they may have to arrest our friend because of a lack of identity papers. Well, we have the papers in question, obtained quite legally, I assure you. All we need is someone to give them to an arranged intermediary so that the harassment by authorities can stop!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the identity documents. Please make sure that they arrive promptly!
Perfect. Now we know exactly whom to arrest. Thanks for being so helpful, citizen -- and remember, the Empire is always watching.
FROM THE IMPERIAL SECURITY BUREAU: The holder of this account has been apprehended on criminal charges. Do not attempt to contact the account holder. Long live the Emperor!
Important Identity Documents

They're saying that they may have to arrest our friend because of a lack of identity papers. Well, we have the papers in question, obtained quite legally, I assure you. All we need is someone to give them to our friend so that the harassment by authorities can stop!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the identity documents. Please make sure that they arrive promptly!
How wonderful! With this, we can save our friend from imprisonment.
Our friend has made it offworld to a safe harbor, thanks to you.
Important Identity Documents

I feel guilty that it has taken this long for this legal document to be delivered. I know that we should not have kept an indentured servant so long, but over time, it felt like we were all one big happy family. But now, we've moved away, and well, it's time for justice to be done and for freedom to have its day.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I hope our servant gets joy from this.
Oh... well, that's ironic. She ran away yesterday. I guess she couldn't wait any longer for freedom.
Giving an indenture servant freedom is one thing, but condoning escape only weakens the whole system. I have reported the fugitive to Imperial authorities.
Manumission Documents

I can't tell you what this is about. I'd have you deliver the actual compound, but it would probably explode. Or melt through the world. Or both. Or neither. You know, it's very unstable. But the commercial applications! Stunning! In any case, we need you to deliver the formula, if you could.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, the datadisc with the formula. I feel sure this compound will prove to have tremendous military and medical applications.
Ah, thank you for delivering the formula! We shall test it immediately, and hope it doesn't blow up.
Evidently the experimental lab blew up. It is unclear whether my compound had anything to do with this. Well, no great breakthrough was ever won easily.
Chemical Melts Through Planets

We need a confidential courier to deliver these private business communiques. We hope you are up for the job -- normally we use only bonded and qualified couriers, but we're in a hurry. It is vital that these documents reach their intended destination quickly, as there are millions of credits at stake.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the communiques. They're encrypted, so don't bother trying to read the datadisc. The recipient will know how to decrypt them.
Thank you for the delivery.
Thank you. When you see the new model Howlrunner emerge from the Empire's production lines, you can say, "I helped with that."
Private Business Communiques

My employer sells antiques to interested buyers. One such collector has paid the proper fee to view my employer's wares. Could you pick up an encrypted catalog and deliver it? The collector will know how to retrieve the data.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Nothing is free, pal.  If you want to look, you gotta pay the fee too. Actually, you probably can't afford it. Deliver this quick, though, and you might be on your way to earning enough.
The catalog at last! I've waited a long time for this. The possibility of Sith artifacts! Can you imagine?
By the way, the contents of our catalog are confidential. Please respect our privacy.
Antiques Catalog

Fleek eels are a prized delicacy that must be kept alive until they're cooked or else the flavor is greatly diminished. I found a way to preserve the eels so that none of the flavor is lost. I need you to pick up a sample and deliver it promptly to a representative of the Corporate Sector Authority. Their food companies can make millions off my secret recipe!
filename_of_object
Small container
I knew all those years my friend spent studying preservatives would pay off. I hope he doesn't forget me when he's filthy rich. Please be careful with this delivery!
This sample will be tested, of course. If it fails to meet our taste standards, there will be no compensation. That is, in fact, what we are expecting.
Thanks, citizen! I can't wait for those CSA chefs to taste those preserved fleek eels and marvel at my genius!
Fleek Eels Soon to Be Preserved

Can you keep a secret? I'm a great Jedi Master who used to lead the Jedi Council in the days of the Old Republic. We're in hiding, waiting for the right moment to destroy the Empire. I need you to pick up a secret message from one of our contacts and deliver it to a fellow Jedi. This is of the greatest importance. Can you handle it?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The fate of the galaxy is in your hands. Know that the Force will be with you, always. Unless you fail. Then you're bantha fodder. Good luck.
Not this lunatic again! Who is it this time? Last week it was the Emperor. This is just a grocery list, for Corellia's sake! Poor sod needs professional help.
Thank you for serving the interests of the Jedi. Soon we shall come out of hiding and restore the Republic. Honest.
The Return of the Jedi?
I finally managed to sell my old JR-4 swoop. Got a good price for it, too. I need you to pick up the title and deliver it to the new owner. Thanks, buddy!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. You into speeders and swoops like me and my buddy? Check out the Flare-S swoop if you ever get a chance. Nice.
The title! Great! I've already started to modify the JR-4. It was in great condition.
Thanks for taking care of that for me, buddy. I can't wait to buy the new TaggeCo Air-2 swoop. Now that's a sweet ride!
Swoop Title

Someone wants to buy my vintage blaster collection, including my matching set of MB-450's. Luxan Personal Armaments is the best, and the Penetrator is the elite of hunting pistols. I have a datadisc -- holographs and detailed specs of everything in my collection -- to be delivered to the buyer. Can you pick it up from my friend?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
My buddy inherited this collection from an uncle. That old-timer was a blaster freak. Wish the old guy had had some lightsabers, you know?
Can't wait to see what's on this datadisc. I love blasters. Don't you? Nothing like the weight of a solid weapon in your hands, eh?
Thanks for the delivery. If you ever hear of anyone selling lightsabers, let me know.
Blaster Catalog

I once took an interest in genealogy and kept very good records. Now my colleagues think they can use me as a library whenever they wish. Please pick up a copy of my database and deliver it to these annoying scholars. Tell them they can look up the name "Skywalker" themselves. The nerve!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Please tell this scholar to stop harassing our family or else we shall refuse future requests. Fate of the Empire indeed!
I'm certain the name "Skywalker" is important. It may indeed be the key to solving all of the Empire's problems! Thank you for bringing this.
My thanks for the prompt delivery. Perhaps now I can get some peace.
Genealogical Studies

I'm a private investigator and I'm swamped with work. Could you pick up a datadisc of holographs and deliver it to a client? A little matter of a dark suspicion, one partner for another -- the usual stuff. This encrypted disc will settle the matter for good. Thanks.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I hope this alleviates my client's paranoia. Trust is a rare commodity these days.
Finally I'll know the truth! I'm sure this disc will verify my suspicions. Love hurts, you know.
Thanks for your help. Some days I hate my job, but it's a living. Speaking of which, your fee has been deposited.
Help a Private Investigator

You know they used to clone people, right? I'm convinced my friend has been cloned for nefarious purposes. I need you to pick up a datadisc containing holographs of the clone in action, taken by an investigator I hired. Then take the disc to my friend. This will prove I'm right.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the disc. I personally think my client's friend is just leading a very interesting double life. But I'm not being paid for my opinion, so --
Sure, I'll look at the images, but I just wish my friend would accept the truth. I have not been cloned!
Thanks for delivering those pictures. You should make sure you're not cloned, friend. Otherwise you never know what crimes you might be implicated in.
Mistaken identity?

My best friend is about to marry someone unworthy. I hired an investigator to follow the mate-to-be. The investigator has holographs that will prove my friend's "true love" has been unfaithful. I can't deliver these myself, or my friend would think I had doctored the images. Can you pick them up and deliver them?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the holographs. I gotta admit, some of them are rather amusing. But don't tell my employer I said that.
What is this? A disc of holographs? What's on them? Who sent them? Who are you?
Thanks for your help. I hope you didn't mention my name. I'm only trying to save my friend future heartache.
Incriminating Holographs

I'm a scout for a major music label and don't have time for amateurs. The vocals on these latest sample tracks sound like the death rattle of a Tatooine meewit. This so-called musician included credits to make sure this 'precious' recording was returned safely. Could you pick it up and get it out of my life? Don't try to listen to this mess.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
You gotta listen to a bunch of garbage before you find anyone with even a shred of talent. You don't play, by any chance?
They've returned my work? Why? Did they like it? Do I have a contract? What's wrong with these people? They're Tusken when it comes to music!
Thanks for dropping off that cacophonous mangle. I hope the artist goes into a more appropriate line of work, like custodial duty or food service. Your fee is taken care of.
Bad News for a Musician

I'm submitting my application to the Academy at long last. Won't my friends be jealous when they hear I've become a TIE pilot? But I can't trust something this important to the HoloNet. Could you pick up my application from my friend's home and hand-deliver it to a professional courier?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
My best friend's future is in your hands. Please be careful and see that it gets to its destination. Thanks!
Another star jockey wanna-be, eh? All right, I'll see that it's delivered to the Academy.
Thanks, buddy! You're the kind of friend someone wishes for. I deposited a little something into your account.
A New TIE Pilot

I feel guilty that it has taken this long to deliver a legal document. I know that we should not have kept an indentured servant so long, but over time, it felt like we were all one big happy family. Well, it's time for justice to be done and for freedom to have its day. Can you pick up this document from my family and deliver it?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the document. Please inform this individual that they'll be missed.
What... can it be? Freedom? Freedom! I am free! Free!
Thanks for getting that done. Next time I'll be a bit more conscientious about such things.
Free an Indentured Servant

My friends love keeping up with the latest fashions. An acquaintance is putting a whole bunch of facial tattoo patterns on a datadisc for us. Could you please pick up the disc and deliver it to my friend?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It's important to keep up with fashion, you know. A person's clothes and make-up say a lot. For example, your clothes speak volumes.
Wow! Thanks for the disc. I can't wait to try out these new make-up tips. We'll be the hit of all the dance clubs. If we ever got to go, that is.
Thanks for the delivery. Those tattoos are supposedly worn by the Nightsisters of Dathomir. Wouldn't that be a great name for a band? Maybe we'll start one.
Fashionable Facial Tattoos

A friend just got the specs for the newest Ommni Box that's about to hit the market. This thing can make even the crummiest band sound great. Just what we need! Could you pick up these specs and take them to my band buddy? Once the rest of the band sees this, I know they'll chip in with me to buy it. Thanks!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The specs are on this datadisc. Tell those wanna-be musicians that this Ommni Box can't perform miracles. Good luck.
Let's see if this toy is as good as my friend claims. If it is, we'll send you a copy of our first recording. How's that?
This Ommni Box is gonna pave the way for our rise to super-stardom. I just know it! You remember me, I'm gonna be famous.
Amateur Band Seeks Ommni Box

I've managed to find actual live recordings of krayt dragons. My friend is a naturalist and has been studying krayts for years. A book on the subject is in the works, I understand. Could you pick up the datadisc contains the recordings and drop it off with my friend? I'm sure they'd be most useful.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I've listened to these recordings. Truly amazing stuff. Who knew krayt dragons vocalized to this degree?
The krayt dragon recordings! This will be such a boon to my research. Thank you so much!
I would love to see the look on my friend's face when these recordings are played. Alas, if only I wasn't so busy I could pay my friend a visit. Thanks for your help.
Help conduct research

Why are power converters so hard to find? I've looked everywhere. Why does this always happen to me? It's not fair! I want some power converters! Is that too much to ask? Could you please pick up a purchase order and deliver it to a local supplier for me? I'd go myself, but I have to finish cleaning some droids.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. I hope this supplier can fill this order. That farm kid is getting annoying.
This whiny customer again? I should never have special-ordered those fuel cells. Now I'll never get any rest. Fine, I'll get right on it.
Life is so unfair. Did you ever have one of those days? Well that's my whole life. Why me? Oh, thanks for your help.
Get Some Power Converters

My friend wants to check out the newest recording by the popular band "Dance Lords of the Bith." If you don't find yourself moving to this music, you're probably dead. It's currently on loan to a neighbor. Could you pick up the recording and deliver it? Can't wait to hear this at the club.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
There you are. This music moves your spirit, you know? Feel the beat, zoomer!
The Dance Lords! Great! I heard this music is hot jets at the smoothest clubs on Coruscant. Can't wait to get smooth to its beat. Thanks!
Thanks for your help. We should all strive to give the gift of music.
Dance Lords of the Bith!

I was adopted as a child. After years of searching, I think I've finally found my real mother. Could you pick up some flowers and deliver them to her, along with an invitation to dinner? I can't deliver it myself, on the off chance that I'm wrong. Oh, I hope I'm not. Thank you so much for your help.
filename_of_object
Flowers
A bouquet of flowers as ordered. Is this for a sweetheart? Oh, you're doing this for someone else? How nice.
Nope, sorry, you got the wrong person. I've never been a mother and never hope to be. I may accept the dinner invitation anyway, though. And the flowers are nice.
Thanks so much for giving my mother that invitation. I'm going to make fleek eel soup. It'll be grand! Too bad you can't join us.
Reunite a Family

Four-cubes will break you spiritually as well as financially. I need someone to pick up a datadisc from my bookie and deliver it to a fellow player. The disc contains codes to access my credits. They're all encrypted, so don't even think about keeping it. Plus, you wouldn't want to add a Hutt to your list of enemies, would you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Some beings just don't know when to leave well enough alone. Why is it that gambling attracts so many folks with bad luck? Anyway, here's the disc.
Looks like this loser got some common sense. Good. I was about to start hiring bounty hunters.
Don't gamble, friend. Just don't. It leads to an early grave and heartache while you live. And worry not, I instructed my bookie to deposit your fee. Now I'm totally broke.
Pay Off a Hutt

I've finished the definitive work on training hunting twirrls. It should become quite a popular sport among the nobles and the rich on Coruscant. It is, after all, already a distinguished sport on Naboo for persons of higher breeding. Please pick up my manuscript and deliver it to my editor for proofreading.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Yes, here's the manuscript. Have you ever tried twirrl hunting? No, I guess you wouldn't have, would you? Carry on.
This author's previous works have always been of superior quality -- always well researched. I can't wait to peruse this one.
Thank you ever so much for taking care of that. I hope you'll find my compensation satisfactory. Must run now.
Popularize Twirrl Hunting

My partner has just received a new litter of tusk-cats. A friend of ours wants the pick of the litter. Please pick up a datadisc containing holographs of all the cubs from my partner and deliver it our friend. This will help our friend make a good choice. Thank you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Nothing like a strong tusk-cat at your side. These are some of the finest from the top kennels in Theed. I'm sure these holographs will demonstrate their quality.
That litter is in already? Splendid! My son has been looking forward to this moment. The cub is for him, you know.
Thanks for your help, friend. I hope our friend finds something worth purchasing.
Help pick a pet

I was investigating a missing person's case for a client to discover what had happened to their son. Apparently the young man was on Alderaan when it -- well, you know. His final letters are stored on a datadisc. I regret I can't deliver the datadisc in person, but I'm keeping a low profile. My investigation attracted some unwanted Imperial attention.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Please be sensitive when delivering this message. It will no doubt come as a great shock to the recipient.
What? This can't be! A plague upon the Empire! Those assassins don't deserve our loyalty! Oh, my son! My dear son!
Did anyone appear to be following you when you made the delivery? I'd keep a low profile, just in case. Your fee has been transmitted to your account.
Missing on Alderaan

I have finally found my father's murderer and have put a price on the killer's head. However, due to our past, I will give the wretch a fighting chance. I need you to pick up a copy of the hunt certificate and deliver it to the guilty party. That should give this murderer a chance to make all the proper arrangements. I've made mine.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Feel free to tell this individual that you're only the messenger, not the instrument of death itself.
A deathmark? But I've never killed anyone! I'm innocent! This is all a huge mistake!
I know this task was unpleasant, and I appreciate your professionalism in carrying it out.
A Deathmark

You must help me! My cousin has been falsely accused by some vengeful lunatic of murdering a loved one. I need you to pick up the evidence exonerating him -- a commercial transport manifest dated the day this maniac claims the murder took place. The passenger list proves my cousin was on that ship and couldn't have murdered anyone!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the disc! Please hurry! Our cousin's life is in your hands!
The deathmark has been ordered. This disc proves nothing; records can be falsified. Justice will be served at last.
Thank you for attending to this matter so quickly! I hope our efforts are enough to save my cousin's life!
Help Prove Innocence

My cousin was remembered in my late father's will. I don't trust this information over the HoloNet -- it's not much of an inheritance and is bound to be taxed into oblivion. I'm asking you to pick up a copy of the will and deliver it to my cousin's family. I'm willing to pay a modest fee.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. The information about the inheritance is in this datadisc. Please make sure it ends up in the right hands!
Ah, what's this? An inheritance? I had heard that my friend's uncle had passed away. I'll make sure he gets this when he gets home.
Thanks for your help. I think this inheritance will come as a surprise to my cousin.
About an Inheritance

I don't trust my new blaster design to the HoloNet; there are too many slicers out there on the lookout for industrial secrets. The best way to deliver something confidential is to carry it by hand. I need you to pick up an encrypted datadisc containing my design and carry it to the industrialist whom I hope will agree to manufacture it.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here. Please don't lose it, and please be careful with it! My friend's whole life is tied up in this blaster design.
Another wannabe blaster designer. If you've seen one, you've seen a million. Well, we'll look at it and see if it's any good. Thanks.
Thanks for delivering my blaster design. If it works, you can tell everyone you played a part in revolutionizing blaster technology.
Life Tied Up in a Blaster

This software is confidential and critical. Suffice it to say that it has significant military applications. We need you to hand carry it, at the client's insistence; they are extremely paranoid about it going over the HoloNet. Please deliver it to their representative at the agreed location.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the software. Please deliver it promptly. And don't bother trying to run it -- I promise you don't have the required hardware.
Thanks for delivering the software. How high is your security clearance? All right, never mind.
Thanks, buddy, we couldn't have done it without you. You fee has been deposited.
Deliver critical software

I need someone to pick up a summons and deliver it. My regular runners are not available, and this case needs to be investigated promptly. Simply serve the summons, and don't engage the recipient in any significant conversation -- trust me, it won't go well.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the summons. Just hand it to the recipient and leave. Not much point in talking.
A summons? What? Hey now, why am I getting a summons?
Thanks for your help. I hope you weren't given a hard time. Your fee has been taken care of.
Deliver a summons

The happy day has come at last! My only daughter is getting married. Could you pick up the very first holographic invitation from the data engineer and hand-deliver it to my oldest friend? That should make quite an impression.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the personalized invitation. This is quite the elaborate presentation, lots of animation and music. Family must be rich.
Well, it's about time! I knew that girl would get hitched sooner or later. Can't wait to tell the family. Wedding invitations on datadisc. Heh! How times change.
Thanks for delivering that invitation. My friend was most impressed. I'm not rich, but my daughter's first -- and, I hope, only -- wedding is worth a splurge.
Bring Nuptial News

I've finished my survey of the Core's asteroid fields and have charted every known space slug in those sectors. I need someone to pick up the survey datadisc from my lab and deliver it to a representative of the Imperial Science Department's Biology Division -- they need to double-check my stats before we transmit it to the Imperial Information Center.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
By delivering this datadisc you are furthering the cause of science. We're counting on you!
Ah, the survey results! I'll check these findings immediately. I hope my superiors keep me in mind when assigning scientists to study those space slugs.
Thanks for getting that to my colleague so quickly. I've deposited your fee for services rendered.
Space Slug Survey Map

My company has just finished logging the inventory of one of our client's holdings. It's all been stored on a datadisc that has everything itemized by sale price. The appraisals were done by the most careful and painstaking professionals in the field. Could you pick up the inventory and deliver it to our client?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our client is most eager to receive this datadisc. Please relay our apologies for tardiness, but we wanted to be thorough.
It's about time! I paid good money for these appraisals, and I expected them to be done long since. I'll adjust my final payment to the company accordingly.
Thank you for your prompt service. I understand that our client was a tad upset. We'll try to smooth things over. Your pay has been deposited.
Precise Inventories Take Time

A customer's daughter is getting married soon, and she needs a dress in a week. Could you pick up the datadisc containing the dress pattern from my customer? Please deliver it to my colleague's fabric shop so I can be sent the appropriate fabrics. I'm swamped with work and can't go myself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It will be a gown fit for a queen. Do please hurry with the delivery. Thank you.
This will be quite a dress. The pattern calls for some pretty exotic fabrics -- spidersilk saturated with glimmerdust, prismatic zwill, resublimated nanoweave. Hope this customer is rich.
Thank you so much for being prompt. If you ever need clothes, look me up -- once I'm not so swamped, that is.
Beautiful Bridal Gown

A friend's child has been sick, stricken with body sores. I know an old family remedy that never fails, regardless of the species afflicted. Could you pick up the datadisc with the recipe for this poultice and the accompanying herbs from a local pharmacist? Then please deliver the goods to my friend.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Apply this poultice three times a day. Remind the customer to make a fresh batch every day, and wrap the unused portion tightly before throwing it out.
My poor child, how she suffers. I'll give this remedy a try. Thank you so much for delivering it. I'll let my friend know if it worked.
My thanks for the prompt delivery. I hope my friend's child gets better once this remedy is used.
Cure for an Ailing Child

I won't be able to attend my nephew's birthday celebration this year.  But I made a special holocam recording of me singing his favorite nursery rhymes. Could you pick up the recording and make sure the family gets it in time for the party? Thank you so much.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Just finished editing the holo. It certainly is -- something. I hope the kid likes it.
Is this for the birthday boy? I'm helping put together his party. I'm sure he'll be pleased to get this. Thanks!
I hope my nephew appreciates all my hard work. He can be such a sweet boy if the mood strikes him. Thank you for your help.
Birthday Gift Is Really Something

A miner friend found some crystal deposits while out prospecting in the Outer Rim. He won't say where exactly he found them. Claims he's going to get rich or something. He wants me to have some crystal samples analyzed for him. Can you pick up the samples and deliver them to a mineralogist I know?
filename_of_object
Crystals
These might just be worthless rocks. I hope my friend can help me identify them. Oh, does the word 'Adegan' mean anything to you?
Crystals, eh? Sure, I'll have a look. Prospectors keep dreaming they'll find another source of Adegan crystals. They used to use those in lightsabers, you know.
Thanks for delivering those crystals. My friend is always having me check out all sorts of minerals. The mother lode is waiting, somewhere out there.
Mysterious Crystals
My mate is currently off on another so-called 'adventure.' Please deliver the news that we are no longer married. I've decided to get an annulment. This datadisc contains all the legal documents.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I knew this union would never work. I should have listened to my mother.
My mate is leaving me? Well, good riddance. I never really felt understood anyway.
Thanks for your help. I hope my former mate finds happiness, and I regret I was not able to provide it.
Deliver divorce decree

My boss' ship is currently stuck at a starport because this cheapskate doesn't want to pay the full price for a new hyperdrive motivator. I need someone to pick up a refurbished model and deliver it as soon as possible. Could you do this for me?
filename_of_object
Hyperdrive motivator (a mechanical part thingee)
That boss can be a bit grumpy. Could you say you got lost and that's why the delivery is late? Please?
It's about time! My ship has been stuck on this planet for weeks. I'm gonna fire my lazy employee when this is over. And you, you slowpoke, don't you know -- hey, where are you going?
I hope my boss didn't yell at you too much. I was instructed not to pay you, but I'm ignoring that and depositing your fee. Why should I worry about orders if I'm getting fired anyway?
Refurbished Hyperdrive Motivator

My instruments! I was so worried. I've had this set since graduating from the Academy. They're priceless to me. Many thanks.
Glad to hear you made it. I bet my friend was overjoyed, huh? Scientists get excited by the strangest things.
Precisely Calibrated Tools

Droid brain chip
Some folks can get pretty attached to their droids, eh? I personally am not one of those. They're just tools to me.
Thank the stars! You've saved our dearest droid! We'll install this chip right away. If our 3PO unit was here he'd thank you personally.
Sounds like they got the droid brain chip. Thanks for your help. I've transmitted some credits to compensate you for your time.
Droid Memory Chip

I ended up with a clutch of some amphibian's eggs from Myrkr. Told a friend of mine, who now wants to buy them. Can't figure out why. They're not very tasty. But hey, credits is credits. Could you pick up the eggs from my home and deliver them to my friend?
filename_of_object
Storage box of some sort
Feel free to take these. They taste horrible. Now if I could get my hands on some fleek eels, that'd be something.
Did my friend happen to tell you what type of eggs these are? Besides the fact that they're amphibians from Myrkr? Good. It's best you don't know. Well done.
Thanks for getting those eggs safely to my friend. I wish I could find some fleek eels.
Amphibian Eggs

My brother was supposed to lay our recently departed father's ashes to rest. He was so grief-stricken, however, that he forgot the ashes at a friend's home. Could you please pick them up and deliver them to my brother so that our father's spirit can finally rest in peace?
filename_of_object
Small box
Here are the ashes. Have you ever lost someone dear to you? It takes a long time for the pain to go away, doesn't it?
Hey, my glitterstim spice stash! You're pretty brave to risk getting arrested just to get this to me. My brother sent this? I don't have a brother. But I got a lot of good friends.
Thanks, buddy! You were great. I'm sure my brother will forget all the worries of the world now. Haha!
Inner Peace

My friends are getting married in a few days. They decided to elope and hold a small ceremony. Well wouldn't you know it, they went off and forgot the wedding bracelets. Had them hand-crafted too. Cost them a fortune. Could you see to it that they get them? The faster the better, my friend.
filename_of_object
Jewelry (Bracelets)
I get misty-eyed at the thought of true love. Not enough of it in the galaxy, that's for sure.
It just wouldn't have been the same without these. Thanks! We'll name our firstborn after you. What was your name again?
But they said they would name their firstborn after me! That's fickle for you. Oh well, I don't think I'd want anyone else saddled with the name my folks gave me!
Wedding Bracelets

My artist friend just went to deliver a family portrait to a patron. Guess what got left behind? That's right: the portrait. I swear to you, those artists have gas-giant clouds for brains. Could you take this portrait to my friend and save a career?
filename_of_object
Picture or portrait
If my friend spent more time with practical matters and less time worrying about 'art' -- oh well, I suppose it's good someone worries about art.
A thousand thanks, my friend! You've saved my career. If you ever want a portrait, let me know. I'll give you a healthy discount. Well, a decent discount. Well -- anyway, thanks.
Actually, my friend probably got more credits for that one portrait than I make all year. I wonder who's really the more practical one?
Portrait Saves Artistic Career

I'm a retired gourmet cook who used to co-own a restaurant with a dear friend. Every time I make my specialty, nerf liver pate, I must send some to my former partner or I'll never hear the end of it. Move fast! The pate won't keep forever, even in this special container.
filename_of_object
Container
No sneaking any tastes. Once the seal on that container is broken, the pate will only remain fresh for a day or so. I'm trusting you now.
I heard my old friend was making another batch of pate. Excellent! I shall sample this tonight! You have my gratitude -- though no, that doesn't extend to letting you have a taste.
Thank you for delivering that pate. I get requests for my pate recipe from all over this world. But I'll never tell!
Gourmet Nerf-Liver Pate

It's my friend's birthday, and I wish to give a very special gift. Could you please pick it up from the crafter and deliver it to my friend? Say it should be opened in a small, dark room. Don't mention my name, of course. This will be a big surprise, I assure you.
filename_of_object
Small box
I'm sure this item will be something the recipient will always remember. Careful now, don't shake it. And whatever you do, don't open it!
A birthday present? But my birthday isn't for another six months. Who sent this? Curious. I'll go home and have a look. Thanks.
Thanks for delivering the gift. You might want to disappear for a while. No special reason why, just some friendly advice. The credits I deposited into your account should help you get away.
A Big Surprise

This message is of the greatest importance. My friend has been searching the galaxy for a long-lost love. I've just received word that my friend's love was killed in a transport accident last year. I wish to save my friend further expense and heartache. Please deliver the notice as promptly as possible.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
My friend will be quite shaken by this news. Please be sensitive. The search has taken a long time. Thank you.
What? My love has been killed? No! Say it isn't so! How can I go on living? Please leave me now.
mission_success_mail
Tragic News

My partners needs this specialized memory chip for their droid. Seems they want the droid to perform some kind of fancy tricks, like dancing, I think. Anyway, if you could deliver it to them, I'd be most appreciative. Oh, and try to keep it quiet and out of sight, would you?
filename_of_object
Memory chip
My partners will be glad to get this chip. And let me warn you, they're big kidders. Don't believe any wild stories they might tell you.
The new slicer chips! Cruising! You the new slicer? Ever sliced into the HoloNet?
I told you my partners were big kidders. What a laugh, huh? Thanks.
Special Chips for Kidders

I am one of the few botanists who has a living t'ill plant in their possession. Those were flowers found on Alderaan, you know. It is my treasure. Every now and again, I consent to send a clipping to a colleague. Please see that this precious clipping is delivered safely.
filename_of_object
Plant of some sort
Life can be so fragile. And the more beautiful, the more fragile it seems. Please be careful out there.
Wonderful! I've waited a long time to see this plant bloom. I'll be sure to send my friend a wonderful gift as thanks.

I understand that very few Alderaan plants have been cultivated on other worlds. The botanical gardens on Coruscant had a wide selection -- but one rumor I heard said the garden officials, acting on orders from high up, burned all the plants. Typical.
Alderaan t'Ill Plant

I found a buyer who collects Wookiee bowcasters. Fortunately, I happen to have an antique. We finally agreed on terms that justify my parting with it. Deliver the bowcaster to the buyer. If it gets there quick, there may be more credits in it for you.
filename_of_object
Wookiee Bowcaster
Bowcasters can be dangerous weapons, even just to own. Wookiees don't like it when non-Wookiees use them.
This brings my total collection up to fifty. If this seller is to be believed, this particular weapon will be the jewel of my collection.
It turns out that after all the Imperial taxes on sales of antique collectibles, I don't have enough left to pay you the bonus I mentioned. But thanks anyway!
Wookiee Bowcaster
I just received a container of wild shaak ambergris that some customers wants to buy. They make perfumes, I believe. Could you deliver this container to them?
filename_of_object
Container
Never been much of a perfume wearer myself, but I suppose I'm the exception. Careful on your travels.
The ambergis of the wild shaak is far superior to the domesticated variety. The end result is much sweeter. My thanks.
If shaak ambergris smells so great, why do shaaks themselves smell terrible? I've never understood that. Anyway, thanks for delivering that stuff to my customers.
Deliver ambergris

Have you ever tried laa fish caviar? It's simply superb! Please deliver this container of the delicacy to my dear friend. It's a gift to thank the family for hosting us at their home last month. Don't you dare eat any!
filename_of_object
Small can
Please tell my friend that this is the caviar of the genuine wild laa fish. Just wait for the reaction.
Laa fish caviar! And from the wild! How thoughtful -- that's my favorite! So much better than that dismal oversalted bioengineered stuff. That tastes like old oil from repulsorlift casings.
Wild laa caviar costs more than I make in a year. Don't tell anyone, but I have an alternative supplier. You can't tell bioengineered laa fish from the wild variety, no matter what the snobs say.
Laa Fish Caviar

My friend's home is infested with vermin. I have the perfect solution -- tooke-trap plants from the Gungan swamps! These carnivorous plants are voracious and will have my desperate friend's home pest-free in no time. Please deliver these seedlings at once.
filename_of_object
Plants of some sort
I think more folks should use plants for pest control. Who needs harsh chemicals in their homes?
I hope these work, because I'm allergic to most pesticides. I'm at the end of my towline!
I should have mentioned that the tooke-trap plants grow rather large, and may eventually attack house pets and small children. I'll have to remember to tell my friend.
Gungan Tooke-Trap Plants

I've learned that Jabba the Hutt has placed a huge bounty on the head of my friend. Rumor has it that Boba Fett himself has taken an interest. My friend must go into hiding at once. This may well prove a perilous mission. Can you deliver the warning?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Careful on your travels. Remember that bounty hunters will be after my friend. If you see Boba Fett, run. Good luck!
Boba Fett? After me? Thanks for the warning. I gotta disappear and quick!
It looks like my friend is going offworld. Way offworld. You can tell that to any bounty hunters you happen to see. Thanks.
Jabba Hunts My Friend

A friend is trying to buy an ancient Sith artifact. An archeologist I know discovered something of its history and has included the findings on a datadisc. Please collect this disc and deliver it immediately. I hope I'm not too late to save my friend from a terrible fate.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
You must warn my friend not to fall asleep with this dreadful artifact in the room. It contains the spirit of an ancient and evil Sith Lord. Go quickly!
Nonsense! The artifact is perfectly safe. Soon the entire galaxy will understand all about the Sith. Begone and trouble me no more, puny mortal.
I hope you weren't too late to save my friend from a terrible fate. I must visit soon and see about destroying that artifact.
Warn of Sith Artifact

My friend's father has become deathly ill. For some reason, normal HoloNet messages aren't getting through -- maybe the Imperial Army imposed one of their blackouts. Please deliver the news, along with this datadisc with directions to the bacta facility holding the father. I hope my friend gets the news before it's too late.

Datadisc
We don't know how much time the father has left. Please hurry!
Oh no! This is terrible news! I must contact my father at once. Thank you!
My friend should make it to the bacta facility in time to have a last long conversation. Thank you.
News of an Illness

I finally found a buyer for my centuries-old Core World Arms pulse-blast rifle. Obviously such a valuable item must be hand-delivered. It's packed securely. This collector travels a lot to dangerous areas, so be on your guard.
filename_of_object
Antique blaster rifle
These adventurers, always planet-hopping! Hope you find this one.
Ah, my rifle! Lucky you found me. I was on the next transport out of here. This might come in handy where I'm going. My thanks.
I wish I knew how that buyer earns enough credits both to buy antique weapons and also to travel around the galaxy. Hmm, I wonder if one habit explains the other?
Antique Blaster Rifle

These nobles and their ridiculous vendettas. A rich client who had been staying with us left his customized dueling vibrorapier in our home. Now the client needs it to settle a matter of honor, or somesuch nonsense. Could you please deliver it quickly? No telling what sort of trouble you might encounter on your travels. This noble has a habit of making enemies.
filename_of_object
Vibrorapier
I certainly hope you don't think dueling is honorable. Whatever happened to "forgive and forget"?
Aha! Now at last my honor can be defended. No one accuses me of cheating. No one!
I hope my client survives the ordeal. I haven't been paid yet.
Dueling Vibrorapier

This cargo is delicate, and you must be especially careful with its transport and delivery. A client has purchased a couple of Neimoidian pylat bird eggs. I don't need to tell you that these are rare and expensive. This animal collector has been looking for these for some time. Get them there whole and you'll be well-rewarded.

My birds! Well, they're going to be. Ever heard their song? Enchanting. Thanks so much.
I am happy to spread the word of your careful and delicate egg handling. I hope you will consider more work of this kind in the future.
Pylat Bird Eggs

Our friend's sister has just given birth! The family would love for my friend to return home at once and see the newborns. Could you pick up a datadisc, which contains pictures of the new family, from my home and deliver it and the good news? Tell my friend to hurry home. Many thanks!

Datadisc
I'm sure our friend will want to race home once they see this datadisc. I know it's a long way to go but it's for a good cause.
This is wonderful news! Thank you! I'll book the next transport out of here. Those are some cute newborns!
Thanks for getting the word to my friend. I hope the pictures were appreciated.
Birth Announcement

Purge yourself of sentimentality if you want to run an efficient business. Profits come to those who act quickly and decisively.
Buy-Out News

Stuck at a Starport

Restore a Friend's Memory

Thanks for getting those eggs safely to my friend. I wish I could find some fleek eels.
Eggs -- Not for Eating

Here. Please don't lose it, and please be careful with it! My friend's whole life is tied up in this blaster design.
Another wannabe blaster designer. If you've seen one, you've seen a million. Well, we'll look at it and see if it's any good. Thanks.
Thanks for delivering my blaster design. If it works, you can tell everyone you played a part in revolutionizing blaster technology.
Life Tied Up in a Blaster

This software is confidential and critical. Suffice it to say that it has significant military applications. We need you to hand carry it, at the client's insistence; they are extremely paranoid about it going over the HoloNet. Please deliver it to their representative at the agreed location.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the software. Please deliver it promptly. And don't bother trying to run it -- I promise you don't have the required hardware.
Thanks for delivering the software. How high is your security clearance? All right, never mind.
Thanks, buddy, we couldn't have done it without you. You fee has been deposited.
Deliver critical software

I need someone to pick up and deliver a summons. My regular runners are not available, and this case needs to be investigated promptly. Simply serve the summons, and don't engage the recipient in any significant conversation -- trust me, it won't go well.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the summons. Just hand it to the recipient and leave. Not much point in talking.
A summons? What? Hey now, why am I getting a summons?
Thanks for your help. I hope you weren't given a hard time. Your fee has been taken care of.
Deliver a summons

The happy day has come at last! My only daughter is getting married. Could you pick up the very first holographic invitation from the data engineer and hand-deliver it to my oldest friend? That should impress my friend.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the personalized invitation. This is quite the elaborate presentation, lots of animation and music. Family must be rich.
Well, it's about time! I knew that girl would get hitched sooner or later. Can't wait to tell the family. Wedding invitations on datadisc. Heh! How times change.
Thanks for delivering that invitation. My friend was most impressed. I'm not rich, but my daughter's first -- and, I hope, only -- wedding is worth a splurge.
Bring Nuptial News

I've finished my survey of the Core's asteroid fields and have charted every known space slug in those sectors. I need someone to pick up the survey datadisc from my lab and deliver it to a representative of the Imperial Science Department's Biology Division -- they need to double-check my stats before we transmit it to the Imperial Information Center.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
By delivering this datadisc you are furthering the cause of science. We're counting on you!
Ah, the survey results! I'll check these findings immediately. I hope my superiors keep me in mind when assigning scientists to study those space slugs.
Thanks for getting that to my colleague so quickly. I've deposited your fee for services rendered.
Space Slug Survey Map

My company has just finished logging the inventory of one of our client's holdings. It's all been stored on a datadisc that has everything itemized by sale price. The appraisals were done by the most careful and painstaking professionals in the field. Could you pick up the inventory and deliver it to our client?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Our client is most eager to receive this datadisc. Please relay our apologies for tardiness, but we wanted to be thorough.
It's about time! I paid good money for these appraisals, and I expected them to be done long since. I'll adjust my final payment to the company accordingly.
Thank you for your prompt service. I understand that our client was a tad upset. We'll try to smooth things over. Your pay has been deposited.
Precise Inventories Take Time

A customer's daughter is getting married soon, and she needs a dress in a week. Could you pick up the datadisc containing the dress pattern from my customer? Please deliver it to my colleague's fabric shop so I can be sent the appropriate fabrics. I'm swamped with work and can't go myself.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It will be a gown fit for a queen. Do please hurry with the delivery. Thank you.
This will be quite a dress. The pattern calls for some pretty exotic fabrics -- spidersilk saturated with glimmerdust, prismatic zwill, resublimated nanoweave. Hope this customer is rich.
Thank you so much for being prompt. If you ever need clothes, look me up -- once I'm not so swamped, that is.
Beautiful Bridal Gown

A friend's child has been sick, stricken with body sores. I know an old family remedy that never fails, regardless of the species involved. Could you pick up the datadisc with the recipe for this poultice and the accompanying herbs from a local pharmacist? Then please deliver the goods to my friend.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Apply this poultice three times a day. Remind the customer to make a fresh batch every day, and wrap the unused portion tightly before throwing it out.
My poor child, how they suffer. I'll give this remedy a try. Thank you so much for delivering it. I'll let my friend know if it worked.
My thanks for the prompt delivery. I hope my friend's child gets better once this remedy is used.
Cure for an Ailing Child

I won't be able to attend my nephew's birthday celebration this year.  But I made a special holocam recording of me singing his favorite nursery rhymes. Could you pick up the recording and make sure the family gets it in time for the party? Thank you so much.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Just finished editing the holo. It certainly is -- something. I hope the kid likes it.
Is this for the birthday boy? I'm helping put together his party. I'm sure he'll be pleased to get this. Thanks!
I hope my nephew appreciates all my hard work. He can be such a sweet boy if the mood strikes him. Thank you for your help.
Birthday Gift Is Really Something

A miner friend found some crystal deposits while out prospecting in the Outer Rim. He won't say where exactly he found them. Claims he's going to get rich or something. He wants me to have some crystal samples analyzed for him. Can you pick up the samples and deliver them to a mineralogist I know?
filename_of_object
Crystals
These might just be worthless rocks. I hope my friend can help me identify them. Oh, does the word 'Adegan' mean anything to you?
Crystals, eh? Sure, I'll have a look. Prospectors keep dreaming they'll find another source of Adegan crystals. They used to use those in lightsabers, you know.
Thanks for delivering those crystals. My friend is always having me check out all sorts of minerals. The mother lode is waiting, somewhere out there.
Mysterious Crystals

One of our secret meeting places has been compromised. We need this warning delivered to our contact with instructions to find a new meeting place. We hope next time we'll have a more remote location than under some stranger's home. Can we count on you, citizen?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Always assume someone is listening to your conversations. That's a major rule of rebellion.
Thanks for the warning. I'll inform the others.
We must all be cautious of being caught by the Empire. Be careful.
Secret Meeting Place
We've gotten an ISB uniform and need it delivered to our agent in the field. This will allow us to undertake more covert missions. Can we count on your help, citizen?
filename_of_object
Uniform
Thank you for taking such a risky assignment. If you're found carrying this uniform, the consequences could be severe.
Thanks. Do you think this uniform will make me look fat? Just kidding.
We could use more agents like yourself. Keep up the good work.
Imperial Security Uniform

ISB is secretly distributing a list of names among their contacts. They intend to arrest and interrogate everyone on that list. We've obtained a copy of that list. Please deliver this copy to our HoloNet slicer so we can warn the targets.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
For every citizen that the Empire arrests, we save five more.
I'll get the word out right away, assuming ISB isn't blocking the HoloNet again.
Thanks for delivering that information. With luck the ISB won't get any of our people.
Interrogation List

We have proof that the Empire has been performing vivisections on alien species. This encrypted datadisc must be delivered to our HoloNet slicer so we can transmit these graphic images to some former senators. We'll win over the former Imperial bureaucracy yet. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I thought these practices were just a rumor. We must expose the Empire's cruelty to the entire galaxy.
I'll send the holos right away. Do you know what format they're in? Never mind, my wizardry is mighty.
How many more atrocities will the Empire commit before they're finally defeated? Not too many, if we all work together.
Alien Autopsies

Recently we'd discovered an Imperial spy in one of our local cells. Now we know that the Empire has learned of it. These encrypted instructions tell what to do with the spy. That cell is to disperse immediately. Deliver the disc to our contact as quickly as you can.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It's getting harder to spot these Imperial moles. We must keep on our guard.
We'll follow these instructions. Long live the Republic!
We're grateful you delivered that information when you did. Any later would have been too late.
Cell Dispersal

We believe we know the identity of the Vibrodagger Killer. So far the Empire has turned a blind eye to these gruesome murders, because all the victims have been Alliance sympathizers. We'll have to take matters into our own hands. Deliver this holograph and dossier of the murderer to our HoloNet slicer, so we can get this information out to our field agents.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We never take pride in taking a life, but sometimes it must be done.
I can't believe it. This fiend will finally be brought to justice.
Thanks to your assistance, we'll be able to put a stop to these murders by any means necessary.
By Any Means Necessary
Some alien refugees we've been harboring are in desperate need of medical supplies. Please deliver this supply request to one of our contacts so we can get the supplies shipped immediately.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The abominable treatment of nonhumans is only one reason why the Empire must fall.
We're getting awfully short on medical supplies. It may be time for another raid.
I'm sure those aliens are grateful for the help you've given them -- as are we!
Emergency Medical Supplies

One of our contacts fears for the lives of his family. He wants them transported to a safe haven. Could you deliver this encrypted letter of credit to the transport captain who's agreed to take the family to safety? The Alliance will make sure the captain gets paid in full.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Empire's tactic of attacking our families is all too common, I fear.
I've dealt with the Alliance before. They're as good as their word.
It's a tragedy how many people are forced to go on the run. Thank you for helping them.
A Safe Haven

One of our contacts may be a double agent. We must verify it. We need someone to deliver this encrypted message that bears a secret Imperial symbol. Refusal of the message means the contact recognized the symbol and is working for the Empire. Acceptance means the agent is clean. We'll finally settle this matter.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We were certain this contact was trustworthy. I hope this disc is accepted!
These are my new instructions? I'll read them at once. May the Force be with you.
That's a relief! I wish we could all trust each other implicitly, but we must be careful.
A Test of Loyalty

A new field agent requires a Pocket Scrambler to insure proper encryption of transmissions. Could you deliver this device so the agent can begin filing regular reports? These devices are expensive, so be careful.
filename_of_object
Small gadget
We can never be too careful with our transmissions.
Are there instructions for this thing? Thanks.
The device is in working order, and we've received the agent's first report. Good job.
Pocket Scrambler

My son and his family were vacationing on Alderaan when it was destroyed by the Empire. I want to pledge myself to the Rebellion and help topple the bloody regime that took my son's life. Can you deliver this message to a contact within the Rebellion? I don't know who to trust.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We must do everything we can to put a stop to those butchers.
I wish this citizen's story was unique, but it's not. We'll make contact soon.
Thank you for handling that matter with such delicacy. You'll go far.
New Recruit

One of our cells believes their conversations are being recorded. We need this Silence Bubble Generator delivered to their representative for use in their future meetings. Mention that the device only covers an area 2 meters in diameter, so they'll have to sit close together.
filename_of_object
1 kg gadget
This is an expensive gadget. Better safe than sorry, I suppose.
Two meters? Well, we'll all get to know each other a lot better, I guess. Thanks.
The cell was glad to receive the device. You can't be too careful these days.
A Bubble of Silence

One of our contacts is using the neighborhood children to spy on the Empire's agents. Whereas we approve of this tactic for simple surveillance, we understand that this individual is encouraging the children to sneak into Imperial garrisons and offices. We feel this is putting the children at too great a risk. Please deliver this encrypted message that gives them guidelines as to what the Alliance considers acceptable risks.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We must make sure we never sink to the Empire's level of callous tactics.
I hope I haven't displeased my friends. Of course I'll comply.
Thank you. We must not put our children at risk.
Spy Kids

We've had numerous requests, from parents especially, for holograms showing what the Alliance stands for and how we operate. They're trying to counter COMPNOR's propaganda. Could you deliver this encrypted hologram to our HoloNet slicers so we can make it available to anyone that wants to access it? We need to get the good word out there.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We must discredit COMPNOR's propaganda.
If I had a credit for every person that has requested this sort of holo, I'd be one rich slicer. -- Whoa, I almost said 'one slice richer.' Funny, huh?
It's important that people know what we stand for. Thanks for making the delivery.
Get the Good Word Out

One of our agents has managed to acquire a hologram of the destruction of Alderaan. It's heart-wrenching. Could you deliver a copy of it to our HoloNet slicer so we can make it available to every citizen in the Empire? The truth will be out there.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Billions have been murdered by the Empire. Everyone will know the truth.
I saw a very bad copy of this. Lots of artifacting and low signal-to-noise. Hope this one's better. I'll send it.
That was the single greatest atrocity ever committed. We must never forget.
Alderaan's Destruction

There are rumors that a Jedi played a part in the destruction of the Death Star. We want to spread that rumor and encourage the belief that the Jedi have returned. Could you deliver this message to our HoloNet slicer so we can transmit it to all our cells?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If the Jedi have returned, the Republic will be back soon too.
You bet I'll spread the word! The Force is with the Republic! The Jedi have returned! The Empire will fall! Hee-yaah!
Well done, friend. It seems appropriate to add this: May the Force be with you!
The Jedi Return

Smugglers help us by delivering much needed supplies past Imperial blockades. Could you deliver this encrypted disc to our HoloNet slicer? It lists approved "procurement specialists" -- those we've dealt with on multiple occasions. Tell our cells to choose from this list when deciding on a smuggler.  Good luck.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
If our cells must choose someone not on this list, tell them to check with Alliance Intelligence before making any commitments.
An official list of reliable smugglers? That's so weird. What's next, an Alliance Seal of Approval?
Very few smugglers can be trusted -- probably even fewer than we think. There may be no honor among thieves, but unfortunately we have to deal with them.
List of Smugglers

I was going to join the Academy, but I saw a hologram of the destruction of Alderaan. It doesn't matter how I got it. Now I know the truth. A Bothan pilot instructed me to seek a trusted courier to deliver my request to the Rebel Underground. Is that you, citizen?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Empire has no respect for life, citizen.
The more the Empire oppresses its people, the sooner it will fall. We'll be in touch.
Thanks for getting me in touch with the Alliance. I appreciate it.
Another Recruit

The Empire tricked me into divulging the names of suspected Rebel sympathizers. One was my own father. He was executed, and I was forced to watch the hologram. I want to join the Rebellion and stop this tyranny. Please deliver this message to the underground. I can be found at the local cantina between noon and closing time. I sit at the back, and I always drink alone.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I'll have to live with this mistake for the rest of my life, citizen. I can hardly bear it.
This citizen is being destroyed by grief. We'll see what we can do.
Thanks for your help. I'll do everything I can to stop the Empire. My poor father. His face haunts me.
A Heavy Heart

A group of dedicated youths is showing support for the Alliance by spraying mustaches on statues of the Emperor. We need you to deliver these special enamel cannisters to their contact. No solvent will remove this enamel, so COMPNOR goons need to burn it off with lasers. It amuses the citizens to see those idiots do this sort of work. Can you help out these kids?
filename_of_object
Small cannisters
Tell them to put colorful patterns on the stormtroopers' helmets, too!
These will come in handy. Thanks!
No doubt the damaged statues will be replaced in short order, but we're showing that defiance is possible.
Deface Imperial Statues

We've heard that COMPNOR is putting on parades to show support for the Emperor. We need these stinkbombs delivered to one of our contacts to pass out to volunteers. They'll make sure the parade does not go well. Can we count on you?
filename_of_object
A sealed container
A parade for the Emperor seems to invite this sort of foul smell.
We'll put these to good use.
I'm sure it will stink less than the latest Imperial opera.
Stinkbombs for a Parade

A teacher who's sympathetic to the cause of the Alliance has been mentioned in an Imperial Intelligence communique. Can you deliver this warning so we can get the teacher off-planet as quickly as possible? We want to make sure bravery is rewarded, not punished.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance looks after its supporters.
Thank you, but I choose to stay and continue to spread the idea of freedom.
A very courageous person -- who will come to a bad end if the Empire takes notice.
Dangerous Ground

A sweet old citizen who likes baking for the community is about to be arrested. COMPNOR claims she is providing food to Rebels. Take these instructions to one of our contacts so we can get this innocent civilian to safety. Thanks, citizen.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Empire will always shoot first and ask questions later.
I know this woman. She makes great cookies. I'll see to this personally.
Thank you. We're happy to help protect this sweet old lady from pointless harrassment.
Save a Kindly Old Baker

We've learned that one of our supporters is being given a bottle of poisoned Naboo wine to serve at a party. We need the support of the merchant this individual is courting, so we must not allow that wine to be served. One of our informants is helping to host the party. Can you deliver this bottle of actual Naboo wine, so our contact can switch the bottles out before serving it? Hurry, it may already be too late.
filename_of_object
Bottle of wine
It's just like COMPNOR to ruin a perfectly good bottle of wine.
Good. The party has already started. I'm off.
Good job. The switch was made, and nobody was the wiser.
Poisoned Wine

A harmless lunatic has attracted a great deal of unwelcome attention by claiming to be the Emperor. We know that ISB is planning on burning this fool's house to the ground. Please deliver this warning to the citizen. We don't know if the idea will get through, but it's the least we can do.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
An enemy of the Empire is a friend of the Alliance. Actually, is someone claiming to be the Emperor really an enemy of the Empire? Ah well, I don't need to think about that.
A warning about the Empire? Wait! You're a Rebel! Guards! Seize this traitor! Guards!
That poor lunatic is going to get killed. I wish there were more we could do.
Warn a Lunatic

Our slicers' efforts to send bogus orders to Imperial garrisons has been very effective. Too effective, in fact. The Imperials have now taken to hand-delivering their orders, which leaves our slicers vulnerable to Imperial Intelligence. We need someone to pick up a new set of encryption codes and deliver them to our local slicers. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the new codes. They should help protect our data slicers. They're weird, but they're good folks and we need them.
Really? I gotta stop? Aww, just when I was having such fun. Okay, I'll ask the gang to throttle back, and we'll work with these new codes.
That should keep Imperial Intelligence guessing for a bit longer. Those goons are certainly dedicated, I'll give them that. Thanks for your help.
Save the Data Slicers

The Empire plans on arresting many former Senators and their families. We need someone to pick up the list of possible targets and deliver them to one of our HoloNet slicers so we can warn these targets. The slicer is to provide a list of High Command contacts to anyone fleeing arrest. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the list. Remember, the more powerful politicians we get on our side, the better off we'll be.
When I send this warning, the Imperial Analysis Bureau will be riding my tail in about ten seconds flat. You guys needs to move fast to save those -- who is it? Senators? Whoever.
Your efforts will save many lives, citizen. The Alliance is grateful.
Save the Senators

The New Order's stance on alien species has given us an edge in recruiting these neglected citizens. Of special interest to High Command are the Duros. We need a courier to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to our agent specializing in Alien Species Affairs. The agent is to travel to Duro and continue negotiating with the leaders there.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the orders. Many other alien species would follow the Duros' example if they joined the Alliance.
I think the Duros are determined to remain neutral, but I'll continue negotiating with them.
The Alliance appreciates your efforts. With luck, disenfranchised species will boost our ranks and help us topple the Empire.
Help Rally the Aliens

One of our refueling stations in the Outer Rim has been compromised, and we believe that the Empire is using it as bait to capture Alliance transports. Pick up these encrypted orders and deliver them to our local cell leader. We must insure that every transport captain and pilot aiding the Alliance receives these orders.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, citizen. And cheer up. For every station that the Empire discovers, we have ten more they know nothing about.
We'll get this information out to our pilots at once. Thank you.
Good work, citizen. Our pilots are a precious resource, and we must do all we can to protect them.
Save the Pilots

We have proof that an Imperial prison official at Kessel has been supplying glitterstim to smugglers and Black Sun. We need someone to pick up the encrypted evidence and deliver it to one of our couriers. We intend to present our "terms" to the Imperial official. He'll either cooperate with us or we turn over our proof to Imperial Intelligence.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the data. Remember, we do what we must to insure the fall of the Empire. In this case, it'll be fun!
Good old-fashioned blackmail, eh? Hey, if it's effective --
Well done. Remember to keep this quiet. We don't want word getting around to Imperial Intelligence.
Blackmail a Kessel Official

We've received a request from Commander Skywalker. He'd like us to get our hands on an Imperial Inquisitor. We need someone to pick up his encrypted orders and deliver them to our local cell commander. All commanders are to coordinate with High Command to help achieve this top-priority mission. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The orders are on this datadisc. I imagine we can learn a great deal from an Inquisitor. Good luck.
With pleasure! I've been wanting to take down one of these mighty Inquisitors ever since I heard of them.
That was well done. With any luck, we'll be able to supply Commander Skywalker with an Inquisitor soon. I wonder what he has in mind?
Nab an Imperial Inquisitor

A shipment of Merr-Sonn IR-5 "Intimidator" blaster pistols has fallen into our hands. We need someone to pick up inventory discs and deliver them to our local cell commanders. They can request these weapons for upcoming missions, especially any dealing with smugglers and pirates -- those types are easily intimidated. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. And remind the commanders that these weapons not only look intimidating, they also pack quite a punch.
I've seen those blasters. Effective weapons indeed. I'll look through this inventory carefully.
Excellent, citizen. These weapons will help our undercover agents deal with those unpredictable smugglers.
Disperse Intimidators

A generous sympathizer has donated several new MD-series medical droids. Could you pick up the specs for these droids and deliver them to our local cell commander? All requests for these droid must go through Winter, who will process them directly. Make sure the commanders make a strong case, or they may not get one.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Make sure the commander gets this. These donations keep the Alliance strong.
My people sure could use one of those droids. I'll make a no-frills request at once. I hear Winter is fond of brevity.
Thanks for your help. The Alliance could use more reliable couriers like yourself.
Medical Droids for Everybody

We found some old Trade Federation droidekas. These might be useful on certain missions or as security droids on some of our bases. Could you pick up this encrypted message and deliver it to our contact at High Command? We need instructions on how to proceed. Winter will hold these units until she receives those instructions.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. Inform High Command that the droidekas seem to be in perfect condition. I don't believe they were ever activated.
Weren't those things awfully unreliable? I always heard that's why the Trade Federation stopped using them. Well, I'll pass this along.
We appreciate your help, citizen. Meanwhile, we're looking into the source of those perfectly preserved droidekas. Could be more where those came from.
A Blast From the Past

Procurement and Supply recently sent us a message asking for further instructions on the matter of some droidekas. I need you to pick up High Command's response and deliver it to our P&S contacts so they can forward it to Winter. Do this quickly and we'll reward you accordingly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you are. Any tool is only as effective as our ability to control and use it properly.
Thanks, citizen. We'll see what the bosses have to say, I suppose.
That was a prompt delivery, citizen. Your fee has been deposited.
Dealing With Obsolete Droids

A Senator aiding our cause has angered Imperial Intelligence. His family has been targeted for termination. Pick up an encrypted datadisc from one of our slicers. It contains instructions for the Senator and his family. Deliver this disc to a member of the Senator's staff immediately. We hope we're not too late to save this patriot's family.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, friend. I hope it's not too late to save the Senator's family.
The Senator thanks you and will follow these instructions immediately. Thank you.
Well done, citizen. We will not stand by and watch our patriots executed.
Rescue a Senatorial Family

A shipment of laser cutters must get to a secret facility in the Outer Rim. I need you to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to one of our transport pilots. The pilot must report to High Command before leaving the local system. The location of the laser cutters as well as the coordinates of the secret facility will be revealed at that time.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the orders. We realize it's difficult transporting all this equipment while maintaining secrecy.
Well, the Empire hasn't found us yet. So I guess all these hoops they make us jump through for secrecy's sake are worth it.
Good job, citizen. This mission was of the utmost secrecy. Your silence will save many lives.
Help Carve a New Rebel Base

We've learned that a Moff is spearheading an attempt to assassinate the Emperor. Pick up this encrypted message and deliver it to one of the Moff's agents. It informs the Moff that the Alliance will assist in whatever way it can and gives security codes if the Moff wishes to contact High Command. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
