Moffs can strike at the heart of the Imperial Machine. We should never waste an opportunity like this. Be careful delivering this disc.
I'll see to it that the Moff receives this.
Well done, citizen. If this Moff's plan succeeds, this war will be over and the galaxy will be free again.
Aid a Plot Against the Emperor

We believe that the Empire is preparing to strike Mon Calamari. Please pick up these intercepted transmissions and deliver them to our Mon Calamari contact who will have them sent to Admiral Ackbar immediately. If we act fast, we can save millions of Mon Calamari lives. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Mon Calamari are vital to the success of the Alliance. We must save them!
May the Force be with us! I'll leave at once!
We can only hope that we were fast enough. Thank you for your efforts, agent.
Save the Mon Calamari

Imperial Intelligence has instructed their agents to travel to the Circarpous system. We don't know if they've learned of our secret dealings with Circarpousian financiers. We need you to pick up a message and deliver it to one of Princess Leia's aides. We hope this doesn't jeopardize her plans to meet with the Circarpousians.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It seems that the Empire is always one step ahead of us. This must change.
The Princess will want to go anyway, but I'll warn her. She's stubborn, you know.
Excellent work, citizen. I hope the Princess takes this warning to heart. Sometimes she's too brave for her own good.
Warn the Princess

Our agents have discovered that four Imperial Star Destroyers will be in orbital dock at the same time. We intend to strike the dock and destroy the Imperial ships. Could you pick up an encrypted datadisc and deliver it to the strike team commander? It will reveal the location of the dock and list the Alliance pilots that will participate in the mission.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Deliver this fast. We'll destroy these capital ships faster than the Empire can build them.
If this strike succeeds, it would be a great victory for the Alliance.
Well done, citizen. Your service to the Alliance is being noted.
Four Star Destroyers at Once

One of our colonies has been discovered by Imperial Intelligence. Many of our leaders' families are on this colony. We need you to pick up an evacuation order and deliver it to one of our pilots familiar with the colony so we can begin the evacuation. We dare not communicate via the HoloNet for fear of escalating the Imperial attack. Please hurry!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Be quick with this delivery. Until the Empire is toppled, we must remain on the move.
We'll have those families off that colony in no time. Never fear.
Good work. Let's hope we acted in time to save all those people.
Help Evacuate a Colony

One of our strike teams is hitting an Imperial depot in the Outer Rim. We want Imperial Intelligence to suspect we're hitting a different target. We need a trusted agent to pick up falsified Alliance communiques and deliver them to our HoloNet slicer. We'll make sure Imperial agents intercept them. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the communiques. Remember you can rarely use the same trick twice against the Empire.
I'm on it. I love fooling those Imperial idiots. Don't you? Haha!
Good work. It's the efforts of agents like you that will insure the Empire's defeat.
Help Fool the Empire

Although a terrible tragedy, the destruction of Alderaan has boosted our ranks. We need someone to pick up a datadisc and deliver it to our processing officer. It contains thousands of enlistees, many of them skilled pilots. This new influx of talent may be what the Alliance needs to turn the tide of battle against the Empire. Will you help?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Princess said it best: "The more the Empire tightens its grip, the more star systems will slip through its fingers."
Thanks for the delivery. How typical of the Empire not to understand that fear can easily become hate. We shall triumph.
Those extra recruits are much needed. Thanks for your efforts. The Alliance will reward you.
Boost the Alliance's Ranks

We must constantly keep our cells supplied and their agents equipped. We need couriers to pick up supply requests and deliver them to our requisitions officer. These couriers will make sure our brave freedom fighters have what they need to fight the Empire. Will you assist in this important task?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
We're glad to see you. Supplies are running pretty seriously low around here. Please hurry!
Thanks. Fortunately some "procurement specialists" just made it past the blockades, or we might have been in supply trouble.
Keeping the Alliance running is an endless task. We appreciate your efforts.
Supply Requests

Our Incom engineers have provided us with the latest X-wing flight simulator. This will be a great training aid for our new pilots. We need you to pick up a copy of the simulator and deliver it to one of our training officers. Make sure they report bugs to High Command. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Ever wanted to fly an X-wing? I think every Alliance member does. Take care of this flight sim.
I hear these are modeled on the TIE flight sims. Our pilots will benefit greatly. Thanks.
All clear, citizen. Good work. The Alliance is grateful.
Help train better pilots

Some of our agents have attempted to enlist with the Empire to spy for the Alliance. We believe Imperial Intelligence has identified a large number of these agents. We need someone to pick up encrypted orders from High Command and deliver them to our local cell contact. They tell local agents how to avoid detection.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The orders are on this datadisc. One thing I will say for Imperial Intelligence -- they're very thorough.
I'll get these instructions out to our agents immediately.
Your efforts will likely save many good agents, friend. Well done!
Save Alliance Agents

Ever since the destruction of the Death Star, the number of enlistees has risen dramatically. We suspect that some of these individuals may be double agents working for the Empire. Can you pick up an encrypted roster of suspicious enlistees and deliver them to our High Command contact?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the roster. But remember all the times when Imperial double agents denounced the Empire and joined our cause.
Sometimes these double agents are hard to spot. We'll do our best. Thanks for the information.
Mission accomplished, for the moment. We must help the Alliance remain free of Imperial spies.
Stop the Infiltrating Spies

Our slicers intercepted a secret Imperial communique revealing that the Empire has dossiers of all the surviving Battle of Yavin pilots. They've put a high priority on having these individuals arrested. Mentioned in the communique were Commanders Solo and Skywalker. Someone must pick up this communique and deliver it to our High Command contact. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. There's some juicy stuff in that communique.
Thanks, citizen. We'll alert these heroes as soon as possible.
Our thanks, citizen. The security of the Heroes of Yavin is one of our top priorities.
Help Protect the Heroes of Yavin

We've discovered a flaw in the design of older stormtrooper helmet comlinks. We need a trusted agent to pick up our technical analysis and deliver it to a local cell contact. We can use this flaw to intercept squad communications. This information will mostly benefit our cells on remote outposts. Think you can handle this mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the analysis. We should act quickly, because we don't know how long this flaw will go unnoticed by the Empire.
This should come in handy. I always wondered what stormtroopers chatted about when they were just standing around.
Job well done, citizen. The Alliance is glad to have trusted agents like you.
Eavesdrop on Stormtroopers

We've been contacted by an Imperial agent who wishes to defect to our side. Apparently, he'd been instructed to infiltrate Jabba's Palace on Tatooine and realized that his life was considered expendable by the Empire. He could provide us with valuable information regarding Imperial activities and intelligence missions. Could you deliver this message to one of our pilots? Please hurry. The Alliance is counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
The agent is to be picked up at these coordinates immediately. He believes the Empire is closing in on him.
He would be helpful to our cause. I'll pick him up right away.
Good work. This agent will be of immense value to the Alliance.
Imperial Defection

Our agents have discovered that four Imperial Star Destroyers will be in space dock at the same time. We've decided to strike the dock and destroy the Imperial ships. Could you deliver this encrypted datadisc to the strike team commander? It will reveal the location of the dock and list the Alliance pilots that will participate in the mission.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
We'll destroy these ships faster than the Empire can build them.
If we succeed, this will be a great victory for the Alliance.
Your part of this job is finished. Now it's up to the strike team.
Vulnerable Destroyers

We've intercepted some Imperial communiques that might prove the Empire was behind the recent attacks on the Bounty Hunters' Guild. It would benefit us if the Guild learns of this. These communiques must be delivered to our contact within the Guild. We hope it will encourage them to accept fewer deathmarks against Alliance allies. These are shady figures, though. Are you up to the challenge?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Bounty Hunters may be ruthless, but they also follow a code. Let's take advantage of that.
I suspect Black Sun was behind the attacks. We'll see what these transmissions reveal.
We hope the bounty hunters will inerpret those transmissions the same way we did. Thanks.
Bounty Hunter Allies

Our top Incom engineer has just completed a design for a new starfighter code named the "A-wing." We need this design delivered to one of our contacts, who will hand-deliver it to our secret manufacturing plant. Can we count on you for this crucial mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
This starfighter may tip the scales for us in combat. It's supposed to be more than a match for the TIE fighter's speed.
These schematics are safe with me. I'll get them to their destination.
Let's hope these ships are everything they're supposed to be. We need to begin work on the prototype immediately.
New Starfighter Design

One of our colonies has been discovered by Imperial Intelligence. Many of our leaders' families are on this colony. This evacuation order must be hand-delivered to one of our pilots familiar with that colony. We dare not attempt to communicate via the HoloNet for fear of escalating the Imperial attack. You must hurry. The faith of the Alliance goes with you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Until the Empire falls, we must remain on the move.
We'll have those families off that colony in no time.
The evacuation was a complete success, thanks in part to you.
Evacuation Orders

General Rieekan wants some speeder modifications delivered to our Incom engineers. I believe he wants our speeders tested for peak performance under extreme weather conditions. This encrypted datadisc contains his orders and testing specifications. Can you deliver them to the engineer team immediately?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Extreme weather conditions! Working for the Alliance certainly builds character.
Modifications to a speeder, eh? We'll see what we can do.
These new modifications are classified. Please don't speak of them to anyone.
Speeder Modifications

We've received a very interesting proposition from someone claiming to be the leader of the Black Sun syndicate. This mysterious figure has offered the aid of their organization in exchange for any information we have about Darth Vader and the movements of his fleet. Can you deliver the details of this proposition to our intelligence officer, who will look into this offer more thoroughly?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
It would greatly benefit the Alliance if Darth Vader were removed from the picture -- though I'm not sure even Black Sun could take him.
We'll check with the Black Sun Vigos we've worked with and verify this claim.
You have proved a most trustworthy courier. Let's hope the mysterious Black Sun leader proves half as trustworthy.
Black Sun Offer

We've just received Winter's latest intelligence in preparation for our next procurement raid. We need her report delivered to the strike team commander, so we can prepare for a raid on an Imperial munitions depot. Of especial interest to General Rieekan are the portable laser cannons held there. I hope we can count on you. Good luck.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
If the Empire goes to all that trouble to build weapons, the least we can do is steal them.
I swear I'm beginning to really enjoy these raids.
We hope our strike team will as successful at their mission as you were at yours.
Weapon Depot Raid

Mon Mothma would like us to search for Jedi Knights who, like Obi-Wan Kenobi, survived the Clone Wars. These encrypted instructions tell our surveillance post officer to report any findings directly to Mon Mothma. This is a matter of great interest to High Command. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Commander Skywalker has told us all he knew concerning Obi-Wan Kenobi. But I doubt we'll find other Jedi. Kenobi was probably unique.
Finding more Jedi would certainly be something. You'd think if they were around, they'd have come out of hiding by now.
More Jedi would be most welcome in our struggle against the Empire. I hope we find some.
Jedi Wanted

As difficult as it is, we need to quarantine the Graveyard of Alderaan. Imperial agents lie in wait for ships performing a Returning ritual, board the ships, and arrest the passengers and crew. We all still grieve for the loss of that bright world and its billions, but this is simply too risky for the Alliance. We need these orders delivered to our sector commander. Can you do this?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
I'm very sorry to say that until further notice, no Alliance member is to travel to the remains of the Alderaan system.
I'll see to it that these orders are obeyed. The Empire has much to answer for.
When this conflict has ended, we'll have time to grieve properly. For now, the struggle continues.
Remembering Alderaan

We managed to infiltrate an officer into the top ranks of the ISB. He's helped us save hundreds of lives. But he's been discovered, and we must warn him to escape. Can you deliver these encrypted orders to one of our field agents? The agent is to get arrested so that they can warn our infiltrator. Please hurry!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence

As a top officer in the ISB, our covert infiltrator will review the record of the arrest personally. When he sees the name of the individual arrested, he'll recognize it as a code alerting him to flee.
So now I've got to get arrested, huh? All right, this officer has served the Alliance faithfully. I won't let him down. I guess I'll go assault a stormtrooper.
Our officer got the warning in time, thanks to you. Next, we have to free that field agent who slugged some stormtrooper. We may contact you again soon.
Agent in Peril

Through our spies in the Imperial Navy, we've managed to plant seeds of discord among Darth Vader's fleet commanders. Admiral Ozzel has taken the bait and believes Vader wishes to replace him with a junior officer. Rumor has it that the two rarely see eye-to-eye. We need instructions sent to our covert team's contact to continue spreading these rumors. Are you the one for this mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Fortunately for us, the Empire's full of ambitious politicians eager to stab each other in the back.
This mission has been a pleasure. We'll gladly keep it up.
The more Admiral Ozzel clashes with Vader, the better off we'll be. Vader probably will replace him -- not that we care.
Sow Discord

A fragment of an Imperial communique mentioned the "Ison Corridor." We need these encrypted instructions delivered to Covert Operations. They are to investigate why the Empire is interested in this remote region of space. All findings should be hand-delivered by courier to General Rieekan's command staff. This matter is of the highest importance. Good luck.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Imperial Intelligence should never be underestimated.
We'll get right on it.
Your reliability has been noticed by the Alliance. We're most impressed with you.
Surveillance Instructions

Surveillance reports have come in regarding the Empire's interest in the Ison Corridor. We've investigated the matter closely. Our findings are contained on this encrypted datadisc. It must be hand-delivered to one of General Rieekan's command staff. We think you're the agent for this important mission. Do you accept?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
I think the General will rest easier when he reviews our findings.
I'll get this to the General at once.
You have performed your task admirably. Payment has been deposited.
Secret Reports

An Alliance officer wishes to attempt a rescue of his family. We have learned their location and wish a strike team assembled to undertake this mission. Please deliver this encrypted datadisc, which contains the location of the detention facility, to the commander we've chosen to lead this strike team. This matter is of the highest priority. We hope you accept.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
If the officer loses his family, we don't know how he'll react. We hope he'll keep a cool head.
This sounds like a trap, but I suppose we have to try to rescue the officer's family.
We suspect this may be a trap, so we're insisting that the officer remain safely at our central command station. I hope we don't wind up losing more people than we rescue.
Rescue a Family

My employer has acquired a rare bottle of Alderaanian brandy -- General Rieekan's favorite drink. Could you deliver this bottle to one of the General's aides? Tell the aide that Borsk Fey'lya sends it to the general with his compliments.
filename_of_object
Bottle of brandy
Borsk Fey'lya
Borsk Fey'lya never forgets a friend, citizen.
The general will be most appreciative. Thank you.
It is Minister Fey'lya's hope that the gift to the general will serve as a bond between them and encourage closer ties in the future. Well done.
A Gift of Brandy

We need to buy Commander Solo some time. These bounty hunters are getting more daring in their attempts to capture him. Apparently Solo offended a powerful Hutt on Tatooine. We need this offer delivered to our contact in the Bounty Hunters' Guild to see if they'll help negotiate a settlement between Solo and that Hutt. These sorts of missions are never easy. Can you handle it?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
You'd think that after the Bounty Hunter Wars, the Guild would be eager to work with us.
I'll deliver the message, but I doubt Jabba will negotiate. He wants Solo pretty bad.
You've done your part. Now let's hope that Hutt is willing to listen to reason. The last thing we need is some bounty hunter jeopardizing the location of one of our bases.
Soothing a Hutt

A senator aiding our cause has angered Imperial Intelligence.  His family has been targeted for termination. Deliver this encrypted warning immediately to a member of the Senator's staff. We hope we're not too late to save this patriot's family. We're counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
We will not stand by and watch our patriots' families destroyed.
The Senator's family will go into hiding. Thank you.
The warning came just in time for them to get out. Well done.
Targeted for Termination

We need these new designs for climate control units delivered to one of our agents for transport to a hidden base in the Outer Rim. We dare not transmit these plans via the HoloNet for fear of Imperial Intelligence intercepting them. We must keep the location of our base a closely guarded secret. You've proven yourself to be a trustworthy agent. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
The Imperial fleet is scouring the stars for us. We must be extremely cautious.
I'll see these are delivered safely.
Our agent is on the way with those plans. Thank you!
A Secret Destination

We believe that the Empire is preparing to strike Mon Calamari. Deliver these intercepted transmissions to our Mon Calamari contact who will have them sent to Admiral Ackbar immediately. If we act fast, we can save millions of Mon Calamari lives. We're relying on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
The Mon Calamari are vital to the success of the Alliance. Help save them!
May the Force be with us. I'll leave at once.
Only a few couriers could be trusted with such an important mission. We're glad we chose you.
Intercepted Transmissions

The Empire has identified several Viceprexes in the Corporate Sector Authority who have been aiding the Alliance. They will no doubt attempt to remove these individuals one way or another. Can you send this warning to our contact within the CSA so they can warn the Viceprexes? These people are very important to our cause.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
The Alliance is in constant need of supplies and military hardware. The CSA can provide us with that.
We suspected those Imperial creeps were closing in on us. Thanks for the warning.
A complete success, thanks to you!
Keep Our Allies Safe

We've intercepted a transmission from Imperial Intelligence putting their Imperial Inquisitors on alert for Jedi. We need someone to deliver this alert to one of Commander Skywalker's scouts so he can be warned of the danger. We trust you to do this.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
Commander Skywalker is living proof that the Jedi's fire has not gone out of the universe.
I'll see that Commander Skywalker gets this as soon as possible.

We can't afford to lose such a great hero as Commander Skywalker. He inspires our troops and is a symbolic reminder of the Jedi of the Old Republic. He'll be on the alert for those Inquisitors now. Thanks for helping.
Jedi in Peril

We suspect that Imperial agents plan on attending demonstrations on the Core worlds protesting the Empire's use of the Death Star. These agents will try to release a deadly airborne virus during the protests. Our scientists have obtained a sample of the virus and have developed an effective retrovirus. This sample of this retrovirus must be delivered to our agent, who can distribute it to all our field medics for duplication. You must be quick. It may already be too late.
filename_of_object
Small medical container
Alliance Intelligence
The Empire will stop at nothing to destroy democracy. Those fiends!
I leave at once. I hope I'm not too late.
Thanks to your timely action, untold numbers of lives have been saved. You have our gratitude.
Killer Virus

Imperial Intelligence has instructed their agents to travel to the Circarpous system. We don't know if they have learned of our secret dealings with the Circarpousian financiers. This message must be delivered to one of Princess Leia's aides. This may jeopardize her plans to meet with the Circarpousians. Can we count on you, agent?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
It seems that the Empire is always one step ahead of us. This must change.
The Princess will want to go anyway, but I will warn her. She's a stubborn individual, you know.
At least the Princess will be prepared for possible Imperial interference.
Warn a Princess

Even though we managed to destroy the Empire's Dark Trooper facility, we have reason to believe that some of these mechanized stormtroopers survived. We even suspect that an improved model has been constructed. This message must be delivered to our one of our top HoloNet slicers, so we can put all our troops on alert. Will you help save the lives of Alliance fighters?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Included in this disc are technical specs for the original Dark Troopers, which might help our men fight these specialized stormtroopers.
A new Dark Trooper? The old ones were bad enough.
Mechanized efficiency is no match for a dedicated freedom fighter. Forewarned is forearmed, thanks in part to you.
Dark Trooper Specs

Our slicers' efforts to send bogus orders to Imperial garrisons has been very effective -- in fact, too effective. The Imperials have now taken to hand-delivering orders, which leaves our slicers vulnerable to Imperial Intelligence. We need someone to pick up new encryption codes and deliver them to our local slicers. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the new codes. They should help protect our data slicers. It's good to see our tactics are working, however.
Really? I gotta stop? Aww, just when I was having such fun. Okay, I'll tell our gang to cool their jets. We'll institute these new codes right away.
That should keep Imperial Intelligence guessing for a bit longer. Those goons are certainly dedicated, I'll give them that. Thanks for your help.
Save the Data Slicers

The Empire plans on arresting many former Senators and their families. We need someone to pick up the list of possible targets and deliver them to one of our HoloNet slicers so they can warn these individuals. The slicer is to provide a list of High Command contacts if anyone needs assistance fleeing their system. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the list. Remember, the more powerful politicians we get on our side, the better off we'll be.
This warning will no doubt be intercepted by the Imperial Analysis Bureau. You guys needs to move fast if you want to save those senators.
Your efforts will save many lives, citizen. The Alliance is grateful.
Save the Senators

The New Order's stance on alien species has given us an edge in recruiting these neglected citizens. Of special interest to High Command are the Duros. We need a courier to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to one of our agents specializing in Alien Species Affairs. They are to travel to Duro and continue negotiating with the Duros' leaders.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the orders. Many other alien species would follow the Duros' example if they were to join the Alliance.
I think the Duros are determined to remain neutral but I'll continue negotiating with them.
The Alliance appreciates your efforts. With luck, disenfranchised species will boost our ranks and help us topple the Empire.
Help Rally the Aliens

One of our refueling stations in the Outer Rim has been compromised, and we believe that the Empire is using it as bait to capture Alliance transports. An encrypted set of orders must be picked up and delivered to our local cell leader. We must insure that every transport captain and pilot aiding the Alliance receives these orders.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, citizen. And cheer up. For every station that the Empire discovers, we have ten more they know nothing about.
We'll get this information out to our pilots at once. Thank you.
Good work, citizen. Our pilots are a very precious resource and we must do all we can to protect them.
Save the Pilots

We have proof that an Imperial prison official at Kessel has been supplying glitterstim to smugglers and Black Sun. We need someone to pick up an encrypted message and deliver it to one of our couriers. We intend to present our "terms" to the Imperial official. He either cooperates with us, or we turn over our proof to Imperial Intelligence.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Remember, we do what we must to insure the fall of the Empire. In this case, it should be fun.
Good old-fashioned blackmail, eh? Hey, if it's effective --
Well done. Remember to keep this quiet. We don't want word of this getting around to Imperial Intelligence.
Blackmail the Empire

We've received a request from Commander Skywalker. He'd like us to get our hands on an Imperial Inquisitor. We need someone to pick up his encrypted orders and deliver them to our local cell commander. All commanders are to coordinate with High Command to help achieve this top priority mission. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The orders are on this datadisc. I imagine we can learn a great deal from an Inquisitor. Good luck.
With pleasure! I've been wanting to take down one of these mighty Inquisitors ever since I heard of them.
That was well done. With any luck, we'll be able to supply Commander Skywalker with an Inquisitor very soon. I wonder what he has in mind?
Nab an Imperial Inquisitor

A shipment of Merr-Sonn IR-5 "Intimidator" blaster pistols has fallen into our hands. We need someone to pick up inventory discs and deliver them to our local cell commanders. They can request these weapons for upcoming missions, especially any dealing with smugglers and pirates -- those types are easily intimidated. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. And remind the commanders that these weapons not only look intimidating, they also pack quite a punch.
I've seen those blasters. Effective weapons indeed. I'll look through this inventory carefully.
Excellent, citizen. These weapons will help our undercover agents deal with those unpredictable smugglers.
Disperse the Nasty Guns

A generous planetary governor has donated several new MD series medical droids. Could you pick up the specs for these droids and deliver them to our local cell commander? All requests for these droid must go through Winter, who will process them directly. Make sure the commanders make a strong case or they may not get one.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Make sure the commander gets this. These sorts of donations help keep the Alliance strong.
My people sure could use one of those droids. I'll make a no-frills request at once. I hear Winter is fond of brevity.
Thanks for your help. The Alliance could use more reliable couriers like yourself.
Medical Droids for Everybody

We found some old Trade Federation droidekas. These might be useful on certain missions or as security droids on some of our bases. Could you pick up this encrypted message and deliver it to our contact at High Command? We need instructions on how to proceed. Winter will hold these units until she receives those instructions.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go. Inform High Command that the droidekas seem to be in perfect condition. I don't believe they were ever activated.
Weren't those things awfully unreliable? I always heard that's why the Trade Federation stopped using them. Well, I'll pass this along.
We appreciate your help, citizen. The Alliance has compensated you for your efforts.
A Blast From the Past

Procurement and Supply recently sent us a message asking for further instructions on the matter of some droidekas. I need you to pick up High Command's response and deliver it to our P&S contacts so they can forward it to Winter. Do this quickly and we'll reward you accordingly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you are. Any tool is only as effective as our ability to control and use it properly.
Thanks, citizen. We'll see what the bosses have to say, I suppose.
That was a prompt delivery, citizen. Your fee has been deposited.
Dealing with Obsolete Droids

A Senator aiding our cause has angered Imperial Intelligence. His family has been targeted for termination. Pick up an encrypted datadisc from one of our slicers. It contains instructions for the Senator and his family. Deliver this disc to a member of the Senator's staff immediately. We hope we're not too late to save this patriot's family.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, friend. I hope it's not too late to save the Senator's family.
The Senator thanks you and will follow these instructions immediately. Thank you.
Well done, citizen. We will not stand by and watch our patriots executed.
Targeted for Termination

A shipment of laser cutters must get to a secret facility in the Outer Rim. I need you to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to one of our transport pilots. The pilot must report to High Command before leaving the local system. The location of the laser cutters as well as the coordinates of the secret facility will be revealed at that time.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the orders. We realize it's difficult transporting all this equipment while maintaining secrecy.
Well, the Empire hasn't found us yet. So I guess all these hoops they make us jump through for the sake of secrecy is worth it.
Good job, citizen. This mission was of the utmost secrecy. Your silence will save many lives.
Carve Out a New Rebel Base

We've learned that a Moff is spearheading an attempt to assassinate the Emperor. An encrypted message must be picked up and delivered to one of the Moff's agents. It informs the Moff that the Alliance will assist in whatever way possible, and it gives security codes to be used if the Moff wishes to contact High Command. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Moffs can strike at the heart of the Imperial Machine. We should never waste an opportunity like this. Be careful delivering this disc.
I'll see to it that the Moff receives this.
Well done, citizen. If this Moff's plan succeeds, this war will be over and the galaxy will be free again.
Aid a Plot Against the Emperor

We believe that the Empire is preparing to strike Mon Calamari. Please pick up these intercepted transmissions and deliver them to our Mon Calamari contact, who will send them immediately to Admiral Ackbar. If we act fast, we can save millions of Mon Calamari lives. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Mon Calamari are vital to the success of the Alliance. We must save them!
May the Force be with us! I'll leave at once!
We can only hope that we were fast enough. Thank you for your efforts, trusted agent.
Save the Mon Calamari

Imperial Intelligence has instructed their agents to travel to the Circarpous system. We don't know if they've learned of our secret dealings with the Circarpousian financiers. We need you to pick up a message and deliver it to one of Princess Leia's aides. We hope this does not jeopardize her plans to meet with the Circarpousians.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
It seems that the Empire is always one step ahead of us. This must change.
The Princess will want to go anyway, but I will warn her. She can be stubborn, you know.
Excellent work, citizen. I hope the Princess takes this warning to heart. Sometimes she's too brave for her own good.
Warn the Princess

Our agents have discovered that four Imperial Star Destroyers will be in space dock at the same time. We intend to strike the dock and destroy the Imperial ships. Could you pick up an encrypted datadisc and deliver it to the strike team commander? It will reveal the location of the dock and list the Alliance pilots that will participate in the mission.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Deliver this fast. We'll destroy these ships faster than the Empire can build them.
If this strike succeeds, it would be a great victory for the Alliance.
Well done, citizen. Your service to the Alliance is being noted.
Destroy Four Star Destroyers

One of our colonies has been discovered by Imperial Intelligence. Many of our leaders' families are on this colony. We need you to pick up an evacuation order and deliver it to one of our pilots familiar with the colony. We dare not communicate via the HoloNet for fear of escalating the Imperial attack. Please hurry!
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Be quick with this delivery. Until the Empire is toppled, we must remain on the move.
We'll have those families off that colony in no time. Never fear.
Good work. Let's hope we acted in time to save all those people.
Help Evacuate a Colony

One of our strike teams is hitting an Imperial depot in the Outer Rim. We want Imperial Intelligence to suspect we're hitting another target. We need a trusted agent to pick up falsified Alliance communiques and deliver them to our HoloNet slicer. We'll make sure Imperial agents intercept them. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the communiques. Remember, you can rarely use the same trick twice against the Empire.
I'm on it. I love fooling those Imperial idiots. Don't you? Haha!
Good work, comrade. It's the efforts of agents like you that will insure the Empire's defeat.
Help Fool the Empire

Although a terrible tragedy, the destruction of Alderaan has boosted our ranks. We need someone to pick up a datadisc and deliver it to our processing officer. It contains thousands of enlistees, many of them skilled pilots. This new influx of talent may be what the Alliance needs to turn the tide of battle against the Empire. Will you help?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Princess said it best: "The more the Empire tightens its grip, the more star systems will slip through its fingers."
Thanks for the delivery. How typical of the Empire to not understand that fear can become hate very easily.
Those extra recruits are much needed. Thanks for your efforts. The Alliance will reward you.
Help Boost the Alliance's Ranks

We must constantly keep our cells supplied and their agents equipped. We need couriers to pick up supply requests and deliver them to our requisitions officer. These couriers will make sure our brave freedom fighters have what they need to fight the Empire. Will you assist in this important task?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Keeping the Alliance running is an expensive task. We appreciate your efforts.
Thanks, citizen. Fortunately we've attracted some more financial backers recently or else we might be in trouble.
Your efforts will be rewarded, friend.
Deliver Supply Requests

Our Incom engineers have provided us with the latest X-wing flight simulator. This will be a great training aid for our new pilots. We need you to pick up this copy of the simulator and deliver it to one of our training officers. Make sure they report any bugs to High Command. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Ever wanted to fly an X-wing? I think every Alliance member does. Take care of this flight sim.
I hear these are modeled on the TIE flight sims. Our pilots will benefit greatly. Thanks.
All clear, citizen. Good work. The Alliance is grateful.
Help Train Better Pilots

Some of our agents have attempted to enlist with the Empire in order to spy for the Alliance. We believe Imperial Intelligence has identified a large number of these agents. We need someone to pick up encrypted orders from High Command and deliver them to our local cell contact. They instruct local agents how to avoid detection.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The orders are on this datadisc. One thing I will say for Imperial Intelligence -- they're very thorough.
I'll get these instructions out to our agents immediately.
Your efforts will likely save many good beings, agent. Well done!
Save Alliance Agents

Ever since the destruction of the Death Star, the number of Alliance enlistees has risen dramatically. We suspect that some of them may be double agents working for the Empire. Can you pick up an encrypted roster of suspicious enlistees and deliver them to our High Command contact? We must help the Alliance remain free of Imperial spies.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the roster. I should point out, though, that some Imperial double agents wind up denouncing the Empire and joining our cause.
Sometimes these double agents are hard to spot. We'll do our best. Thanks for the information.
Mission accomplished, agent. We're lucky to have you on our side.
Stop the Infiltrating Spies

Our slicers intercepted a secret Imperial communique revealing that the Empire has dossiers of all the surviving Battle of Yavin pilots. They've put a high priority on having these individuals arrested. Mentioned in the communique were Commanders Solo and Skywalker. Someone must pick up this communique and deliver it to our High Command contact. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here you go, buddy. There's some juicy stuff in that communique.
Thanks, citizen. We'll alert these heroes as soon as possible.
Our thanks, citizen. The security of the Heroes of Yavin is one of our top priorities.
Help Protect the Heroes of Yavin

We've discovered a flaw in the design of older stormtrooper helmet comlinks. We need a trusted agent to pick up our technical analysis and deliver it to a local cell contact. We can use this flaw to intercept squad communications. This information will mostly benefit our cells on remote outposts. Think you can handle this mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here's the analysis. We should act quickly since we don't know how long this flaw will go unnoticed by the Empire.
This should come in handy. I always wondered what stormtroopers chatted about when they were just standing around.
Job well done, citizen. The Alliance is glad to have trusted agents like you.
Listen in on Stormtroopers

Our engineers have discovered a flaw in the design of stormtrooper helmet comlinks. We need a trusted agent to send this technical analysis to our local cell contact and inform them that we can use this flaw to intercept squad communications. I believe this flaw is limited to the older style helmets. This information will therefore benefit our cells on remote outposts the most. Think you can handle this mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
We should act on this now, because we don't know how long this flaw will go unnoticed by the Empire.
Thanks. I always wondered what stormtroopers chatted about when they were just standing around.
Keep up the good work!
Technical Analysis

Some local merchants, as a protest, are not giving Imperial military personnel the standard 30 percent discount on the purchase of goods. We need this message delivered to the merchants' representative. It says that this will only draw unwanted attention to their region, and therefore to any possible Alliance cells located in their area. To help the Alliance, they should give the Imperials their discount. Is this something you could help us with?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
No use in stirring up a skettos' nest. We want to Empire to ease its grip, not tighten it.
As loathe as we are to do this, we do wish to help the Alliance. It will be done.
It's heartening that so many merchants want to help us. Thanks for your help too.
Keep a Low Profile

Our slicers' efforts to send bogus orders to Imperial garrisons has been very effective -- in fact, too effective. The Imperials have now taken to hand-delivering their orders, which leaves our slicers vulnerable to Imperial Intelligence. We need someone to pick up a new set of encryption codes and deliver them to our local slicers. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Here are the new codes. They should help protect our data slicers. They're weird, but they're good folks and we need them.
Really? I gotta stop? Aww, just when I was having such fun. Okay, I'll ask the gang to throttle back, and we'll work with these new codes.
That should keep Imperial Intelligence guessing for a bit longer. Those goons are certainly dedicated, I'll give them that. Thanks for your help.
Danger to Slicers

We understand that the Empire has just granted many garrisons extended leave for their troops. We need this message delivered to our local cell contact, so we can put all our informants on alert. We need to get our agents as close as possible to these off-duty soldiers. It's amazing how talkative some of these men become after a few drinks. Can you help us trap these Imperials?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Remind our contact that happy soldiers are chatty soldiers.
We'll put all of our best agents to work. Especially the attractive ones.
Thanks to you, we should gather a lot of useful information.
Loose Lips

We've worked out a deal with our contacts within the Corporate Sector Authority to help us secure the release of several Alliance agents. They are putting in a request to the Empire for more workers for hard labor. We believe the Empire will fill these positions with known Alliance members. We need this message sent to our contact in the CSA. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
The Viceprexes friendly to our cause are to contact High Command immediately upon receiving their new work crews. Some of your friends may be among the prisoners rescued.
I'll see that this order is filled immediately, citizen. Good day.
Your part in this is complete. Now, it's up to others.
Free Alliance Agents

This message must be delivered to the local Alliance Procurement officer immediately! One of the Imperial depots we raided has contaminated supplies. Many energy cells, weapons, and medical scanners that were seized have trackers inside them. All goods taken from Imperial Depot 22-TZK are to be jettisoned into space. Can you make sure this message is received?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Remember, materials from Imperial Depot 22-TZK are not to be distributed to supply stations -- they are to be jettisoned. Spread the word.
Argh, some of these supplies may already have gone out. I'll track them down!
It's a good thing you got that information out in time. That could have gone very badly for our people. Soon we'll have to subject every single seized shipment to deep and time-consuming scans.
Bugged Equipment

A top-ranking Sienar Fleet Systems engineer has defected to the Alliance. The Empire is eager to get its hands on this engineer. We need this encrypted message delivered to our local cell contact. It will let them know if the engineer will be arriving at their location and specifics of that arrival. The Alliance is depending on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
We can't afford to lose this engineer, because he helped design Vader's experimental TIE fighter -- a design being incorporated into an elite TIE model we have yet to see.
If that engineer shows up here, we'll keep him safe.
If we can get that Imperial engineer, that would be a blow to the Empire and a big help for us. The last thing we need is a faster, more maneuverable TIE fighter. Thanks for your help.
Imperial Defector

The Empire plans on arresting many former Senators and their families. We need someone to pick up the list of possible targets and deliver them to one of our HoloNet slicers so we can warn these targets. The slicer is to provide a list of High Command contacts to anyone fleeing arrest. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Here's the list. Remember, the more powerful politicians we get on our side, the better off we'll be.
When I send this warning, the Imperial Analysis Bureau will be riding my tail in about ten seconds flat. You guys needs to move fast to save those -- who is it? Senators? Whoever.
The Senators wish to express their thanks for your aid.
Senators Need Your Help

The New Order's stance on alien species has given us an edge in recruiting these neglected citizens. Of special interest to High Command are the Duros. We need a courier to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to our agent specializing in Alien Species Affairs. The agent is to travel to Duro and continue negotiating with the leaders there.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Here are the orders. Many alien species would follow the Duros' example if they joined the Alliance.
I think the Duros are determined to remain neutral, but I'll continue negotiating with them.
The Alliance appreciates your efforts. With luck, disenfranchised species will boost our ranks and help us topple the Empire.
Diplomatic Mission

One of our refueling stations in the Outer Rim has been compromised, and we believe that the Empire is using it as bait to capture Alliance transports. Pick up these encrypted orders and deliver them to our local cell leader. We must insure that every transport captain and pilot aiding the Alliance receives these orders.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Here you go. And cheer up. For every station that the Empire discovers, we have ten more they know nothing about.
We'll get this information out to our pilots at once.
Good work. Our pilots are a precious resource, and we must do all we can to protect them.
An Imperial Trap

We've learned that the Imperial Intelligence is using new datadiscs been implanted with small explosive devices. If you don't enter the proper codes to read the disc, the charge goes off, destroying the disc and the reader -- and possibly the agent reading the disc. We need you to deliver this warning to our HoloNet slicer. Their safety depends on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Every day the Empire develops new ways to hamper the cause of freedom. Don't worry, this disc won't explode.
I'd heard the Empire was developing something like this. Sounded too nutty to be true. Guess nothing's too nutty in this Civil War.
Good job. We relayed the information to all our covert operatives. Thanks to you, nobody will get hurt.
Warning to Covert Operatives

One of General Airen Cracken's "procurement specialists" believes the Alliance is trying to set him up. We need this encrypted message delivered to our slicer so we can transmit this smuggler's concerns to General Cracken. Can you lend us a hand?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Winter: Alliance Procurement and Supply

This particular smuggler-- er, I mean, specialist -- just captured a large shipment of medical supplies bound for Imperial outposts. He wants General Cracken to meet him personally to insure prompt payment.
These smugglers and pirates are all rogues. But then again, so am I.

The disc gave the rendezvous point specified by this nervous "procurement specialist." We've checked him out, and he seems to be on the level. General Cracken can probably smooth matters over so we don't lose our "specialist."
Stolen Medical Supplies

We have proof that an Imperial prison official at Kessel has been supplying glitterstim to smugglers and Black Sun. We need someone to pick up the encrypted evidence and deliver it to one of our couriers. We intend to present our "terms" to the Imperial official. He'll either cooperate with us or we turn over our proof to Imperial Intelligence.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Here's the data. Remember, we do what we must to insure the fall of the Empire. In this case, it'll be fun!
Good old-fashioned blackmail, eh? Hey, if it's effective --
Well done. Remember to keep this quiet. We don't want word getting around to Imperial Intelligence.
Blackmail Notification

We've received a request from Commander Skywalker. He'd like us to get our hands on an Imperial Inquisitor. We need someone to pick up his encrypted orders and deliver them to our local cell commander. All commanders are to coordinate with High Command to help achieve this top-priority mission. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
The orders are on this datadisc. I imagine we can learn a great deal from an Inquisitor. Good luck.
With pleasure! I've been wanting to take down one of these mighty Inquisitors ever since I heard of them.
Commander Skywalker sends his thanks to all. With any luck, we'll be able to supply him with an Inquisitor soon. I wonder what he has in mind?
Help Commander Skywalker

A shipment of Merr-Sonn IR-5 "Intimidator" blaster pistols has fallen into our hands. We need someone to pick up inventory discs and deliver them to our local cell commanders. They can request these weapons for upcoming missions, especially any dealing with smugglers and pirates -- those types are easily intimidated. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Here you go. And remind the commanders that these weapons not only look intimidating, they also pack quite a punch.
I've seen those blasters. Effective weapons indeed. I'll look through this inventory carefully.
Can you believe it? All the blasters have been claimed already. These weapons will help our undercover agents deal with those unpredictable smugglers. Thanks!
Blasters Available

A generous sympathizer has donated several new MD-series medical droids. Could you pick up the specs for these droids and deliver them to our local cell commander? All requests for these droid must go through Winter, who will process them directly. Make sure the commanders make a strong case, or they may not get one.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Make sure the commander gets this. These donations keep the Alliance strong.
My people sure could use one of those droids. I'll make a no-frills request at once. I hear Winter is fond of brevity.
It's a shame there were only five droids to be had. We could have used many more. But we're grateful, regardless -- and on that note, thanks for your help.
Only a Few Medical Droids Left

We found some old Trade Federation droidekas. These might be useful on certain missions or as security droids on some of our bases. Could you pick up this encrypted message and deliver it to our contact at High Command? We need instructions on how to proceed. Winter will hold these units until she receives those instructions.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Here you go. Inform High Command that the droidekas seem to be in perfect condition. I don't believe they were ever activated.
Weren't those things awfully unreliable? I always heard that's why the Trade Federation stopped using them. Well, I'll pass this along.
We appreciate your help, citizen. Meanwhile, we're looking into the source of those perfectly preserved droidekas. Could be more where those came from.
A Few Good Security Droids

Procurement and Supply recently sent us a message asking for further instructions on the matter of some droidekas. I need you to pick up High Command's response and deliver it to our P&S contacts so they can forward it to Winter. Do this quickly and we'll reward you accordingly.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Any tool is only as effective as our ability to control and use it properly.
We'll see what the bosses have to say, I suppose.
That was a prompt delivery, citizen. Your fee has been deposited. Your service to the Alliance is always appreciated.
Straight From the High Command

The Empire has begun targeting luxury starliners. They claim that several of them have been transporting goods to the Alliance. We need this warning delivered to our HoloNet data slicer so we can warn the starliner crews. We don't want innocent folks killed. Can you help save them?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
The Empire does not understand the meaning of the words "innocent lives," nor do they care how many are lost.
Hey, my mom loves taking cruises on those things. You bet I'll warn them.
Thanks to your timely intervention, we may be able to use the starliners again in the future.
Starliners Beware

We need to get a shipment of laser cutters to a secret facility in the Outer Rim. We need you to pick up encrypted orders and deliver them to one of our transport pilots. This is a most important mission. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply

Here are the orders. The pilot must report to High Command before leaving the local system. High Command will give the pilot the location of the laser cutters as well as the coordinates of the secret facility.
The Empire hasn't found us yet. So I guess it's worth it -- all these hoops they make us jump through for the sake of secrecy.
It's difficult transporting all this equipment while maintaining secrecy. We're glad to know we can count on you. Well done.
Tools for a Secret Base

We've learned that a Moff is spearheading an attempt to assassinate the Emperor. Pick up this encrypted message and deliver it to one of the Moff's agents. It informs the Moff that the Alliance will assist in whatever way it can and gives security codes if the Moff wishes to contact High Command. Can you help us?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Moffs can strike at the heart of the Imperial Machine. We should never waste an opportunity like this. Be careful delivering this disc.
I'll see to it that the Moff receives this.
Well done, citizen. If this Moff's plan succeeds, this war will be over and the galaxy will be free again.
Assasination Plot

One of our strike teams is hitting an Imperial depot in the Outer Rim. We want Imperial Intelligence to suspect we're hitting a different target. We need a trusted agent to deliver these falsified Alliance communiques to our HoloNet slicer so we can make sure Imperial agents will intercept them. This should throw those Internal Security creeps off the track. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
You can rarely use the same trick twice against the Empire.
I love fooling those Imperial idiots. Haha!
The mission was a complete success, thanks to you.
Falsified Communiques

We keep receiving supply request from Rogue Squadron. Deliver these requests to our High Command officer and ask for final approval or denial -- otherewise, Rogue Squadron will not stop contacting us. Tell Command to note that the requests are signed by Wedge Antilles and countersigned by Commander Skywalker. You've got this one, right?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
I'm not sure why there's a disconnect between Rogue Squadron and Starfighter Command. Sure, we like hearing from the Rogues, but too much chatter is a security risk.
More requests from Rogue Squadron? Those guys are great, but they sure do run through a lot of supplies -- sometimes more than we can spare.
I guess even heroes can get caught up in bureaucracy. Thanks for helping sort that out.
Rogue Squadron Requests

Winter has sent us several of Wedge Antilles' requests for supplies for his Rogue Squadron. Winter needs these approved by our department. Please deliver this datadisc of approved requests to one of Procurement's officers. If Rogue Squadron has any problems with our decision, Antilles can take it up with us. Can you handle that?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Starfighter Command
Wedge and Commander Skywalker are heroes of the Alliance, but they still have to follow proper channels.
I wish those guys would leave us out of their squabbles.
I'm sure the Rogues were pleased to get those requests approved. By the way, we're working on smoothing out the approval process. That should please Wedge!
Approved Requests

Miners that have joined the Alliance have shown us a great use for the common LIN Demolitionmech droids. We would like the specs for these droids sent to our local cell commanders on this encrypted datadisc. Careful this doesn't fall into the wrong hands. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Specially rigged demolitionmechs can place explosives. If you rig them with a holographic disguiser and a sensor jamming device, they can look like common R3 droids!
This will help us sabotage Imperial depots and shipyards. Excellent!
The information you delivered was of great value. A job well done.
Explosive Droid Specs

We'd like to redistribute some of our A-A5 speeder trucks that we've modified to operate as armored personnel carriers. Send the specs for these speeder trucks to the local cell commander and see if they could use one of these trucks. We're counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Our settlements on the Outer Rim would be the best destinations for these vehicles, but we understand that there may be a need for them in the Core Worlds as well.
I'll check with our supply specialist, but I think we could use one. Those A-A5s are sturdy machines.
Excellent work. We're very pleased with the quality of your work.
Modified Speeder Specs

A gang of young Skyhopper pilots contacted one of our commanders and offered help in striking Imperial outposts in their home system. Can you deliver this datadisc to Starfighter Command and see what they wish to do with these hotshots? Their dossiers, including their criminal records, are contained on the disc.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
It seems these toughs had no interest in the Academy and don't really like the idea of serving the Alliance as possible X-wing pilots. They just want to cause mayhem for the Empire.
Half of our pilots were trained on T-16's. We'll think of an offer they'll accept.
It takes all kinds, I suppose. Still, good pilots are a valuable resource. Anyone wanting to harass the Empire can't be all bad.
Pilot Dossiers

Starfighter Command is trying to recruit a gang of T-16 pilots. These young hotshots are quite skilled, apparently, but lack discipline and don't wish to answer to anyone save themselves. Starfighter Command has decided to offer them the deal on this encrypted datadisc. Can you deliver this offer to the cell commander who deals with these pilots?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Starfighter Command
I hope this is worth it. These guys have extensive criminal records, and not just crimes against the Empire. Apparently they used to terrorize local merchants and transports.
I can't wait to see what these guys have been offered. Thanks.
I have no idea what Starfighter Command offered those pilots. I'll just trust that Command knows what it's doing. However it works out, your work was exemplary.
Starfighter Command Offer

Some of our field agents are requesting Z-6 jetpacks for an upcoming mission. Their requisition order must be delivered to one of Procurement and Supply's officers. Tell them that this request comes from Alliance Special Forces and is signed by General Madine himself. That should speed things up. Think you can handle that?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Special Forces
We expect a prompt response.
Ever since that bounty hunter got famous, it seems everyone wants a jetpack.
You have the makings of a top courier. Keep up the good work.
Special Forces requisition order

Due to the rising number of Wookiee recruits, we've assembled a short Wookiee language guide on this datadisc. One of our Wookiee agents assisted with this guide, so all pronunciation is accurate. Make sure the local cell commanders get this guide.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
Wookiees are brave fighters but can be a bit short-tempered. I'm glad they're on our side.
I always wondered when they'd get around to making something like this.
We've had a few unfortunate Wookiee incidents due to miscommunication and wish to avoid those in the future. This guide should make for fewer one-armed freedom fighters. Thank you.
Wookiee Language Guide

One of our "procurement specialists" sold us a shipment of R3's. We will be assigning these astromech droids to our heavy cruisers and frigates, which will free up many R2 units for use by either our local cells or Starfighter Command. Please deliver this message to the cell commander, so the cell can place an order for these R2 units with Procurement and Supply.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
Personally, I prefer the old R2 units. They have more personality.
You never can have enough R2 units. But I expect that Starfighter Command requests will get top priority.
Reliable couriers are a rare breed. Keep up the good work.
R2 Droid Availability

A smuggler has dumped an entire kennel of neks at one of our refueling stations. He didn't have enough credits to repair his damaged vessel and didn't wish to barter any future smuggling missions, so he gave us all he had. I need to know what Procurement and Supply wants done with these creatures. They're fully trained, looks like, and quite vicious. Could you deliver this message to a Procurement officer? Like, pretty soon?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
I need to get rid of these neks fast. They're scaring our communications officer.
Uh -- neks? Hmm. Well. I guess we'll take this to General Cracken and see what he recommends. They don't make good pets, I suppose?
An unusual payment, but we'll find a use for those neks. Your payment is a little more traditional.
Strange Payment

Although a terrible tragedy, the destruction of Alderaan has boosted our ranks. Could you deliver this datadisc to our processing officer? It contains thousands of enlistees, many of them skilled pilots. This new influx of talent may be what the Alliance needs to turn the tide of battle against the Empire. We need your help.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
The Princess said it best: "The more the Empire tightens its grip, the more star systems will slip through its fingers."
How typical of the Empire to not understand that fear can become hate very easily. We shall triumph.
Your service to the Alliance is greatly appreciated.
Enlistment Rosters

One of our cell commanders was left with an entire kennel of neks -- long story -- and wanted to know if we could use them. Fortunately, we've contacted a nek handler who will trade the pack for medical supplies. We need to deliver this datadisc of instructions to the members of that commander's cell. Feel like helping out?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
The cell members should sedate the neks and put them on the first Alliance transport out of their system. We'll arrange to pick up the neks and deliver them to the handler.
Good. Our communications officer was about to quit; those neks were getting her deeply flustered. We'll get these shipped right away.
Everything can be bartered or sold for something. Words to live by. But medical supplies for neks? Now I think I've seen it all.
Healing Power of Neks

We've learned that some cell commanders are employing bounty hunters to track down double agents. We need this order delivered to the local cell commander: Any use of bounty hunters must have direct approval from High Command. If there are any questions, contact High Command. Can we get your help on this one?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Make sure the commander gets the message: Under no circumstances are bounty hunters to be used against former Alliance officers, even those suspected of working for the Empire.
I don't see why we should limit our arsenal of weapons against traitors. But all right, I hear you.
Thanks for your aid. That could have been a security nightmare. Bounty hunters will gladly sell any information they have to the Empire. The risk of using them is too great.
Orders About Bounty Hunters

Reports from our HoloNet slicers claim some sort of Imperial super-slicer on the HoloNet has intercepted many Alliance communiques. The slicer goes by the code name "Blackhole." Please deliver these instructions to our local data slicer. Any activity on the HoloNet suspected of being the work of Blackhole is to be reported to us immediately.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
We suspect that this Blackhole figure may be the head of Imperial Intelligence, or perhaps even the Emperor himself. We must discover this mysterious agent's identity.
I've heard about this Blackhole guy, or gal, or thing, or whatever it may be. I'm betting my jets burn smoother than his. But okay, okay, I'll keep an eye open.

We hope our slicers can negate Blackhole's ability to interfere with the Alliance. Truth to tell, High Command is basically forced to stand back and just let our slicers work. Most of us are out of our depth here.
Code Name Blackhole

Our contact on the Corporate Sector Authority's Direx Board informs us that Imperial Intelligence is reviewing every single expense report generated by the Viceprexes. We need to make sure the Viceprexes friendly to our cause are aware of this, and warn them to proceed with extreme caution. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
The help we receive from friendly Viceprexes is incredibly important to our cause. The Empire could track Alliance sympathizers using these reports.
We'll get word to our superiors immediately.
You've been a great help in protcting our CSA Viceprexes. As powerful as they are, it's ironic they need our protection!
Warning to Viceprexes

We need pilots with experience navigating asteroid belts. Please deliver this notice to the local cell commanders so they can have any such pilots they may know of report to Starfighter Command immediately. Can the Alliance count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Starfighter Command
Our missions take us to many treacherous and isolated areas of space. Every pilot must undertake rigorous training and will be incommunicado for several months.
We'll put the word out that we're searching for experienced pilots.
We're always on the lookout for skilled pilots. If you know any, send them our way.
Pilots Needed

Since our victory at Yavin 4, more smugglers have offered their services to the Alliance. We want these instructions delivered to the local Alliance cell. It lays out a standard procedure for evaluating potential "procurement specialists" and gives the proper report forms that every cell commander must have approved prior to using any smuggler. Are you the agent for this mission?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Intelligence
We should always be suspicious of any smuggler who approaches us with an offer of assistance. Security will always be an issue.
We needed a standard operating procedure for these guys. Good to see we have one now.
We'll be careful to weed out the completely untrustworthy smugglers. I hope that's not all of them! Thanks for your help.
Smuggler Security Check

Our contacts inside the University of Byblos have indicated that interest in the Alliance is at an all-time high. We have an opportunity to recruit some of the galaxy's most talented young physicians and scientists. This encrypted message must go to our local Alliance Intelligence agent. We need more covert agents on Byblos to aid with recruitment. Help us recruit the brightest minds in the galaxy.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
Our Science Division works tirelessly at devising ways to thwart Imperial technology. They are priceless.
We'll devise a strategy and make sure we get those gifted young minds.
The Alliance needs all the skilled help it can get. Yours included.
Byblos University Recruiting

Ever since we attracted the attention of Borsk Fey'lya, our access to Bothan spies has increased dramatically. They are the best in the galaxy at what they do. We need you to hand-deliver this encrypted communique to our Alliance Intelligence liaison so we can coordinate their activities with the Bothans that Minister Fey'lya has put at our disposal.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Bothans trade in information, and that is a precious commodity indeed.
We'll begin including the Bothan representatives into our future communications and meetings.
The Alliance is lucky to have a dependable courier such as yourself in its service.
More and Better Spies

There seems to be some division within the Alliance in regards to the Jedi. Many feel they were a boon to the Old Republic and were noble guardians of peace. Others believe they were responsible for the corruption that destroyed the Old Republic and led to the Clone Wars. Could you deliver these instructions from High Command to the local cell commander?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
Word from High Command is that any discourse about the Jedi should be confined to personal discussions. We must focus on toppling the Empire, not reopening old wounds.
I think we'll be talking about the Jedi plenty in years to come.
Personally, I wish there were a lot more Jedi. That's just between us.
Alliance Jedi Policy

Commander Skywalker has requested that any information regarding Adegan or Ilum crystals be sent directly to him. Could you deliver these instructions to the local cell commander to spread this information to the miners and smugglers working for us? Hope we can count on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
We believe Commander Skywalker has a keen interest in crystallography.
Never heard of these crystals. What are they good for? Lightsabers, you say! Who wants a sword when you could have a blaster?
Some of these crystals might belong to certain collectors or former Imperial senators. I hope Master Skywalker gets the information he needs.
Crystal Questions

We must constantly keep our cells supplied and their agents equipped. We need couriers to pick up supply requests and deliver them to our requisitions officer. These couriers will make sure our brave freedom fighters have what they need to fight the Empire. Will you assist in this important task?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance Procurement and Supply
We're glad to see you. Supplies are running pretty seriously low around here. Please hurry!
Thanks. Fortunately some "procurement specialists" just made it past the blockades, or we might have been in supply trouble.
Keeping the Alliance running is an endless task. We appreciate your efforts.
Crucial Supply Requests

Commander Solo has requested that we send directly to him any inquiries from bounty hunters regarding his whereabouts. Apparently there is some bad blood between him and Tatooine crimelord Jabba the Hutt. Could you make sure the local cell commanders get this information?  One of the Heroes of Yavin is counting on you.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
Despite Commander Solo's past, he will always be seen as a Hero of the Alliance.
Smugglers attract bounty hunters. Is this really a surprise?
We need to make sure those bounty hunters don't threaten our security. No doubt it's just some misunderstanding that can easily be worked out.
Bounty Hunter Alert

Our Incom engineers have provided us with the latest X-wing flight simulator. This will be a great training aid for our new pilots. We need you to deliver this copy of the simulator to one of our training officers. Make sure they report any bugs to High Command. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
Ever wanted to fly an X-wing? I think every Alliance member does.
I hear this is modeled on the TIE flight sims. Our pilots will benefit greatly.
Thank you for your assitance in this matter.
New Flight Simulation

We've learned that some local youths have been harassing an Imperial recruiter. We need someone to warn their leader that the Empire is sending a squad of stormtroopers to deal with them. Is that someone you? These youths should lay low for a while. Tell them we appreciate their show of support for the Alliance.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
We encourage everyone to show dissatisfaction with the Empire, but not to the point of craziness.
Thanks, friend. Me and my friends will disappear for a while.
You got word to them just in time. Well done.
Stormtrooper Warning

Some of our agents have attempted to enlist with the Empire in order to spy for the Alliance. We believe Imperial Intelligence has identified a large number of these agents. We must have these orders delivered to our local cell contact. They instruct local agents not to enlist. We'll find other uses for their skills. Can you help us save these freedom fighters?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Alliance High Command
One thing I will say for Imperial Intelligence -- they're very thorough.
I'll get the news out to our agents immediately.
That was a near thing. You helped a lot of people.
Alliance Agents at Risk

Every since the destruction of the Death Star, the number of beings wanting to enlist with the Alliance has risen dramatically. We suspect that some of these individuals may be double agents working for the Empire. This roster of enlistees must be delivered to our High Command contact so that our Intelligence department can do very thorough security clearances on all of them. Help keep the Alliance free of Imperial spies.
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
There have been instances of Imperial double agents denouncing the Empire and working solely for us.
Sometimes these double agents are hard to spot. We'll do our best.
You've been a tremendous help. Thank you.
Searching for Double Agents

Our slicers have intercepted a secret Imperial communique that tells us the Empire has sent dossiers of all the surviving Battle of Yavin pilots to their local garrisons. They've put a high priority on having these individuals arrested. Mentioned prominently in the communique were Commanders Solo and Skywalker as well as the Wookiee Chewbaca. We must have someone send this communique and a warning to our contact in High Command so that these heroes may be warned. Can we count on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
The Alliance to Restore the Republic
The security of the Heroes of Yavin is one of our top priorities.
Thanks. We'll put these heroes on alert.
We're glad you were able to get the word out in time. Well done.
Protect our Heroes

Our slicers' efforts to send bogus orders to Imperial garrisons has been very effective -- in fact, too effective. The Imperials have now taken to hand-delivering their orders, which leaves our slicers vulnerable to Imperial Intelligence. We need someone to pick up a new set of encryption codes and deliver them to our local slicers. Can we rely on you?
mission\mission_datadisk.iff
Datadisc
Here are the new codes. They should help protect our data slicers. They're weird, but they're good folks and we need them.
Really? I gotta stop? Aww, just when I was having such fun. Okay, I'll ask the gang to throttle back, and we'll work with these new codes.
That should keep Imperial Intelligence guessing for a bit longer. Those goons are certainly dedicated, I'll give them that. Thanks for your help.
Save the Data Slicers

The Empire plans on arresting many former Senators and their families. We need someone to pick up the list of possible targets and deliver them to one of our HoloNet slicers so we can warn these targets. The slicer is to provide a list of High Command contacts to anyone fleeing arrest. Can you help us?
