This is a piece of starship armor plating. This is your second layer of defense behind your shields. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a booster. It will allow your ship to temporarily accelerate and improve your top speed. By default, the 'B' key controls your booster. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a weapon capacitor. Every shot that a weapon fires will drain energy from the capacitor. When this is empty, your weapons will no longer be able to fire until it recharges. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a droid interface. This will allow you to equip a flight computer or astromech droid on your starship. These can be used to control your ships subsystems. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is an Engine. This component controls your ships flight performance, speed and handling. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a reactor. This component powers all of your other ship components. If your reactor fails any component that consumes power will shut down. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a shield generator. Shield generators generate a protective shell of energy around your ship. A single generator will protect both the front and rear of your ship. If your shield is damaged, the geneator will recharge the damage over time. If the generator itself is damaged, it will not regenerate. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

This is a ship weapon. It is is used to destroy enemy ships. The weapon is powered by both a capacitor and your ship's reactor. Every shot will drain energy from your capacitor. To equip ship components, go to a starship terminal and click "Manage". This will allow you to equip this item as well as compare attributes with your current components.

Some starships use astromechs to perform this function instead of flight computers. Once a flight computer has been initialized, programmed data chips can be transferred to its datapad. When a flight computer is associated with a starship, any programs in its datapad will be useable by the pilot once the ship is in space.

"Nebula Orchid" - Painting

An artistic approach to depict the delicacy of the rare Nebula Orchid. Painted by B'lina Ko'aka. Due to the limited number of these paintings created, it is the constant target of many thefts. The serial number for this particular painting is 103/3000.

"High Commander T'lnia" - Painting

A highly-praised painting of the High Commander T'lnia of the CorSec Security Force. The pictorialization was created to commemorate the passing of this great leader in the Battle of Yavin4. Only a few of these paintings had been created before the Empire labeled the design, and ideal, "illegal". The serial number for this artwork is 2/35.

"Lady T'lnia" - Painting

The second of the series "The T'lnia Family". Wife to the High Commander T'lnia, the Lady T'lnia fought by her lover's side in the Battle of Yavin4. Legend says the Lady T'lnia was a part of the Jedi Order, schooling young force-sensitive children how to harness their power to defeat the forces of evil. Again, the Empire deemed this particular painting "illegal" immediately after its first debut. The serial number for this painting is 5/40.

"Generic Advertisment" - Painting

A painting depicting a common space scene, with a station orbiting a planet. This painting is used as a generic "welcome" to all who visit. It can be found in cantinas, more commonly. There seems to be no serial number.

"Transport Ship" - Painting

Used for teaching engineers, this painting is often hung in the worker's stations, providing a detailed representation of a Transport Ship. No serial number is attached to this painting.

"Fighter Pilot" - Painting

"A dedication to all the proud fighter pilots in our galaxy" is inscribed on the frame of the painting. The serial number is 2163/10000.

"Red-Thread" rug - Rug

Made from dyed bantha hair, this rug is praised for its craftsmanship and is used to characterize many a home. We currently have twelve of these rugs in our cargo. They seem to be quite popular.

"Soft Fiber" rug - Rug

Incredibly soft to the touch, this rug comes in a rustic color. Only the more wealthy folk seem to be able to afford this rug as it is very rare and takes many years to complete. The rug has been hand-woven.

[Daily Log] 

Dr. Y'tinv
023.768
Area D-502
Aii'tkian Anthropology Guild

Today, we were given a new assignment from our professor, Dr. Kynas. It was a different assignment than we were used to. Because my team and I are fluent in the knowledge of molecular anthropology, we were assigned to examine a new strain of copper that we're now calling 'Conductive Borcarbitic Copper'. At this time, we're trying to discover its origin. One of the members of the O.S.S. Guild of Area D-502 found a particularly odd artifact with the molecules of this particular copper attached to it. It's truly fascinating. The O.S.S. Guild of Area D-502 (they actually like to be called just plain "Junk Dealers") found the artifact in the Wall of Dantooine, fused, or half melted, to an asteroid. There could be more of this Conductive Borcarbitic Copper out there, but the "Junk Dealers" only care about the artifacts. With an alliance, both of our establishments could receive what they hope to find from the Wall of Dantooine. We'll see how it goes. In the meantime, we'll continue to study the new strain of copper. So far it seems resistant to our Ion laser tests. See future correspondence about these particular tests.

[New Copper Strain Experiments]

Subject: Conductive Borcarbitic Copper
Test 1: Ion Cannon
Description: We were able to effectively extract more samples of the Conductive Borcarbitic Copper from the Wall of Dantooine asteroids. The asteroid field is rich with this new strain of copper. The samples were melted down to produce a ball of copper with which we were able to conduct several tests on. In fact, even the melting process of the samples was able to give us an idea of how powerful this new copper could be. It was able to resist high temperatures of heat. We think the copper could be used as a great component for creating shields for a starship. See following tests for more information on attributes.

Subject: Conductive Borcarbitic Copper
Test 2: Blaster
Description: On our second run, we extracted another sample from the asteroids of the Wall of Dantooine. Again, we melted the samples to produce a lump at which we could fire with a normal blaster. Odd occurrence, however, as the copper easily melted this time whereas before it took several hours to produce a lump on which we could conduct our tests. It seems Conductive Borcarbitic Copper has a large range in the resource quality spectrum. We're going to continue our experiments.

* Note: I've gathered notes from various scientists regarding our new copper. They were each given a sample on which to conduct their own private tests. Our tests were tried in a safe environment with heavy weapons and a large staff of our trusted scientists.

Attribute 1: Cold Resistance
Attribute 2: Toughness
Attribute 2: Heat Resistance

** Note: Of course, these are not all the attributes associated with the Conductive Borcarbitic Copper. There could be more. The attributes numbers, again, seem to range greatly from sample to sample. We'll continue our tests.

*** Note: Because our team is fluent in the molecular level of anthropology, we will continue to experiment with this new strain of copper until we get some scientists familiar with resources on our site.


Signed,

Dr. Kynas

104.923 - Dark Prophet and the Altar of Evil (-1636, 0, -4033)

Hm.. silly title for a place emitting an unnatural evil. I approached the momument quietly, having seen the glimmer of a dark figure in the distance. A lone man, silhouetted by the birth of night, stood quietly, staring at the altar for quite some time. Despite my continuing approach, he did not even bother to notice me. I wondered what his story was, but didn't dare to ask. The eerie existence of the lifeless statues, the ever-burning flame casting a dance of light and shadow across the stone surfaces, never thwarted the beauty of the rolling hills and the happy fluttering of blue butterflies. 089.244 - Lone Droideka (-630, 0, 3982)

One of the many remnants to the Clone Wars. A fierce warrior, the droideka rolled into battle, popping up and emitting energy shields which helped aide them against the Gungan advancements. I'm surprised the droid hasn't been taken and is still here among the nature and the flowers of Naboo. Many here hold history sacred and it is why I love this planet so dearly. I wonder what this particular droideka saw in its lifetime? Now, it lays here, apart of the world and among other articles of discarded 'trash'. Nothing, in my mind, is trash.. it's all a part of history.

101.561 - Ongoing Struggle (963, 261, -1346)

The Galactic Civil War.. now, that's history for you. Throughout the galaxy, you'll find many pockets of strife pertaining to this ongoing phenomenon. On Naboo, I was able to find this one. I was amazed to find it still crawling with inhabitants and my suprise was what nearly gave me away to the Alliance. Another site I won't be able to readily explore. I'll try again later, I suppose. However, from my vantage point I could see many skulls peppering the landscape. It seemed to have been a brutal battle from what I could see. It was a brief visit nonethless, but a point of interest I'll visit again.

My plan was to visit Rori next, but I think I'll stick to the main planets for now. I'll have to visit them at another date. My next destination is Corellia, home of the Alliance.

Ah.. my calling; to adventure. This log marks my first exploration, in a series of many, of the Tatooine planet. I'm here to find those little pieces of history we often forget and have left behind. Each moment of our lives leaves a footprint for others to follow, windows through which one can taste a piece of what we have experienced. Tatooine is rich with history and I'm here to uncover it. Dodging the common horrors of the planet, I hope to come out in one piece and with a little more information about the world around us. 

But who really am I? I am Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam, self-proclaimed Explorer Extraordinaire. Of course, I was not always an explorer. I've recently retired from the Royal Security Forces on Naboo, having served in many battles, wars and grusome memories I'd like to forget. I'm old in age and in spirit, although moreso the latter; I've lived my life and I've seen great things. I've seen my children thrive, peace achieved. I'm an old veteran of life. Finally, I can turn my eye to my passion and dedicate the rest of my existence to it. History.. those fine threads of the past we often severe, delicate tunnels to the fading memories just beyond our reach. Bah! Enough of my ramblings. Let's see what we find today. Destination.. Tatooine!

230.341 - Spy's Haven (5943, 180, -3828)

Equipped with expensive computers and gadgets, I found what I'd like to call "Spy's Haven" while exploring the deserts in the south eastern area, near Mos Eisley. While approaching, I could see the jawa closing in, barely able to keep their tricky little hands to themselves as the computers went about their business. Obviously, the site was "fresh". I assumed it had only been abandoned for one, maybe two days. Even with my advanced slicing skills, the computers refused to release their information. I'm going to assume that members of the Alliance were stationed here before run off by the local wild life. On to more interesting subjects..

456.076 - Mosor's Maze (-3043, 0, -5127)

I nearly smacked into Mosor's Maze while trying to escape the local wildlife on my speeder. The bowcats are indeed a fickle, dangerous creature. I was able to duck into the mouth of the maze and hide while the bowcats past me by. Luckily, this trusty maze had been here when I needed it. I remember playing here as a kid, getting lost for hours. To rekindle the memories (history in of itself!), I decided to test it out myself. Unlike my childhood, I was able to get out of the maze easily. Ah, the memories.. Rumor tells us the story behind such a design of the imagination, although not a happy story at best. It is said Mosor came home from war and found his wife with his best officer, Polen. Previously, Polen had to be dismissed due to an "accident". Enraged, Mosor had the maze built as a momument to his promise of revenge. It was on the night of its completion that Mosor drugged his wife and her lover on Vasarian Brandy, dragging them to the maze in the whispering darkness of the night. He sealed them in thereafter, leaving them to die in the heat of Tatooine merciless gaze. The walls of the maze have since been brought down, but no corpses were found. Are the rumors true? Or was it just a tale our mothers told us to keep us out of there? I guess we'll never know.

076.341 - Hero's Grave (-3675, 38, -1649)

The Hero's Grave. I received the location from a friend of mine who also retired to persue history. Clues left by the keepers of this site tell us it is a grave, belonging to some of the first settlers of Tatooine. Small graves surround a center stone which we believe may house the remains of the leader. Much is unknown about this place.. Unfortunately, any evidence left from history, save from the small carvings in the rocks, has been stolen long ago and only tall stones remain as a testiment to their glory and achievements.

For now, we leave Tatooine. I am headed to Naboo while my partner in history is traveling to Dathomir. I wish him well and safety.

Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam
Explorer Extraordinaire

A'Lerris Verata, the strong leader of the mining efforts in the Tatoo System, has informed me of her concerns regarding the awakened Zynt'aia Order. Due to my presence, and my assistance with the mining efforts, the Zynt'aia Pirates have begun to spring unwanted and stealthy attacks against the peaceful miners. It is my duty, as a directive from A'Lerris herself, to clear the Zynt'aia influence from the mining field. Unfortunately, it seems the Zynt'aia Order has stirred and moved in to claim the field, destroying freighters and miners alike with little to no thought at all. It is time to extinguish the influence and replenish the balance.

Corellia System: Escort the Imperial Freighters Duty

Travel to the Corellia system and escort the Imperial freighters through the system. An escort duty is a voluntary mission that you are able to quit at any time without repercussions. When you reach the Corellia system, you will get a navigation waypoint to the arrival location of an Imperial freighter that you will need to escort through the system. Travel to the waypoint and wait until the freighter hyperjumps into the system. Once it is in the area, it will begin to fly through the system. You need to follow the freighter until it reaches its destination. Keep a careful eye out for enemy attack since they will attempt to destroy this freighter. Once completed you will receive another waypoint to the arrival location of another freighter. This escort duty can be stopped at any time by simply aborting the mission or leaving the system.

Naboo System: Escort the Emperor's Freighters Duty

Travel to the Naboo system and escort the freighters through the system. An escort duty is a voluntary mission that you are able to quit at any time without repercussions. When you reach the Naboo system, you will get a navigation waypoint to the arrival location of a freighter that you will need to escort through the system. Travel to the waypoint and wait until the freighter hyperjumps into the system. Once it is in the area, it will begin to fly through the system. You need to follow the freighter until it reaches its destination. Keep a careful eye out for enemy attack since they will attempt to destroy this freighter. Once completed you will receive another waypoint to the arrival location of another freighter. This escort duty can be stopped at any time by simply aborting the mission or leaving the system.

Once completed you will receive another waypoint to the arrival location of another freighter. This escort duty can be stopped at any time by simply aborting the mission or leaving the system.

Travel to the Tatooine system and follow the patrol navigation waypoints. As you reach one navigation waypoint, you will get a new waypoint to the next location on the patrol route.
Travel to the Tatooine System

The first stop on the Patrol will take you past the Commerical Trade Run. This infamous trade route is used mainly be large corporate shipping companies picking up and dropping off goods on Tatooine. The Commerical Trade Run is rarely targetted by pirates since most freighters have their own escorts and getting on the bad side of some of the larger companies is almost as bad as angering Jabba.
Travel to First Nav Waypoint

The second stop on the Patrol crosses paths with the Public Ways. The Public Ways, as it name suggests, is used mainly by the general public. Immigrants of all sorts, as well as, privately owned transport vessels use the Public Ways to travel to and from Tatooine. It is not uncommon for pirates to attack privately owned freighters traveling along the Ways.
Travel to the Second Nav Waypoint

The third stop on the Patrol will take you along the Lower Trade Route. The Lower Trade Route is one of the most heavily hit regions in the Tatooine sector since it is primarily used by smaller trade companys who cannot afford to hire escorts for their freighters. The rich bounty and low risk make it a favorite target for pirates of all sorts.
Travel to the Third Nav Waypoint
The fourth stop on your Patrol route will bring you into empty space. No major vessel routes cross through this area, making a hot spot as a pirate staging area.
Travel to the Fourth Nav Waypoint

Alliance RZ-1 A-wing Starfighter 
By far the fastest starfighter used in the Galactic Civil War, the compact A-wing is the Rebel Alliance's response to the Empire's growing number of TIE fighters and TIE variants. Because of its speed, the A-wing excels at hit-and-run missions, long-range patrols and reconnaissance, and surgical strikes against large starships. A stock A-wing's speed is provided by two powerful Novaldex J-77 "Event Horizon" engines. A combination of adjustable thrust-vector controls built into each engine and thruster-control jets located between the engines supply the vehicle's famed maneuverability. Unfortunately, the A-wing's controls are notoriously sensitive and few pilots can handle the craft at top speed. The A-wing relies on its speed and agility in combat. Its armament is relatively weak, consisting of two wing-mounted blaster cannons. A-wings require constant maintenance, and the Alliance has found it extremely difficult to keep a squadron of A-wings operational for any length of time. Despite this, the A-wing is quickly becoming one of the galaxy's most prominent interceptor fighters.

TransGalMeg "Rihkxyrk" (rik-zerk) Attack Ship
Being a relatively sluggish ship hasn't made the "Rihkxyrk" a push-over. Quite the contrary. The defenses and weapon load of most "Rihkxyrk" assault fighters is frightening, and is their hallmark. It can be very demoralizing to line up an "Rihkxyrk" in your sights and salvo off missiles and cannon pulses only to see them sloughed off by heavy-duty shielding systems and thick, heavy armor. Most "Rihkxyrk" pilots are an unflappable group, developing a high level of confidence in themselves and their machines after wading through heavy fire and coming through undamaged.

TransGalMeg "Kihraxz" (ki-Rax) Assault Fighter
The "Kihraxz" Assault Fighter is able to quickly close with and surgically attack its target before they are aware. TransGalMeg's design emphasis for this ship was on speed, and as a result defenses are at a premium and weapons loadout is reduced. This might be seen as a dire limitation, but the maneuverability of the ship is such that it can normally avoid attacks that would not be able to withstand. Although a cheaper ship, a number of pilots continue to fly the "Kihraxz" even though they could afford something larger, simply because the ship's performance suits their personal combat style.

TransGalMeg "Ixiyen" (ix-Ehn) Fast Attack Craft

The "Ixiyen" is designed to be a dominant force in the average fighter-on-fighter confrontation. It is also armed and protected well enough to be able to harry much larger ships. Although not operated in large numbers by any governmental organizations, it isn't for lack of quality and performance. The "Ixiyen" is a deadly opponent and capable of holding its own against most of the front-line combat craft currently in existence.

KSE Firespray

The Firespray-class patrol and attack ship has been recently re-introduced to the market by Kuat Systems Engineering. Although the original design was generated a number of years earlier, the prototype vessels built at that time were all lost in the hangar where they were being stored during an unfortunate prison escape incident. A sole ship survived the catastrophe and the design has since attained some notoriety owing to the escapades of its pilot. Rather than building to contract, KSE had generated the Firespray design as a project to shop around and had fronted all the cash for the prototypes, confident that once people had seen their performance purchase orders would come rolling in. Instead, the loss of the prototypes put the company in financial dire straights with nothing concrete to show for the Firespray project, and no way to generate interest in the product through demonstrations. Having already drained accounts originally stocked by a huge initial financial outlay, KSE mothballed the project and everything that had been built so far, including reams of technical data and all of the specialized tools used to build the prototype vessels. KSE then went on to enhance their existing offerings and go on to carve an even larger niche for themselves in the market for post-sale ship upgrade kits.

MandalorMotors M3-A interceptor
This lightly-armored interceptor was the first of a custom starfighter series commissioned by the Hutt crime organization (although no hard evidence remains to support this).  Rumors also indicate that MandalorMotors has reaped significant financial benefits from playing both sides of the Galactic Civil War. Even in the face of tremendous personal risk, the executives of MandalorMotors have opted to provide custom products to both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, while supporting a gray-market of parts and accessories to private space pilots and the discerning smuggler. The M3-A "Scyk" is a very accurate, nimble fighter that functions especially well for base defense and capital ship escort duties. It's limited loadout makes it a reasonable choice for short-range strikes en masse, but it's obvious lack of armor make it unattractive for assaults on heavily armored targets.

MandalorMotors G1-M4-C starfighter
As Outer Rim merchants forged relationships with high-end starship armor and shield system suppliers, the Hutt crime organization had to change their tactics. To continue unfettered piracy of the remote regions, (and to maintain profit margins) the Hutts commissioned a second ship from MandalorMotors; a more capable, more heavily armored starship with significantly increased firepower over the "Scyk," but without sacrificing too much of the maneuverability upon which Hutt pilots had grown to rely. The result is the G1-M4-C "Dunelizard" starfighter: a lean, muscular space craft with impressive agility, and a generous weapons loadout.

MandalorMotors M22-T heavy assault starfighter
The Hutt crime faction's space piracy operations have met with a considerable amount of success of late. This is due in no small part to the Empire splitting its attention between piracy suppression and the growing Alliance threat. Sensing an opportunity and spurred on by his pirate fleet's recent accomplishments, Jabba has seen fit to commit more of his resources to the development of larger and more powerful craft. Thus, Jabba commissioned the development of the M22-T Krayt, a turreted heavy fighter designed with the goal of creating a more powerful craft that will hopefully allow fewer pilots to do the work of many. The way Jabba sees it, if he has fewer people flying for him, he doesn't have to split the proceeds from his piracy operation with as many people.
	The M22-T Krayt is built in the same format seen in most in heavy star fighters, with flight crew being limited to workstations accessed from outside the craft. All other interior space is service-access only and can not be accessed during flight. Increases in chassis space have all been allocated to combat equipment such as the turret and its support systems. Regardless of whether the new design serves Jabba's needs, most independent operators are considering the possibility of operating a 2-person ship, something that prior to the M22-T had only been the purview of the military.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE/ln Space Superiority Starfighter 
From the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, the Emperor has stressed that the conflict will be a war of attrition. Nowhere is that philosophy more evident than in the design and tactics of the staple starfighter of the Imperial Navy, the TIE fighter. TIE fighters are meant to overwhelm enemy forces in huge numbers and have therefore been designed for speed and affordability rather than resilience. The TIE fighter is built around twin ion engine technology and is among the fastest and most maneuverable craft in the galaxy. The TIE fighter can outrun most Alliance vehicles. And while the TIE fighter's standard laser cannons are not very powerful on their own, when dozens of TIE fighters attack simultaneously, they can demolish anything in their path.

The TIE/ln is the direct result of the continual evolution of the TIE fighter design. Revisions in the design brought on by analysis of engagements in which the TIE fighter participated have directed the implementation of little changes to the design which have reached their current level of development in the TIE/ln. This improved TIE can carry a slightly heavier load of weaponry and avionics. The only externally visible difference between the TIE/ln and the TIE is that the newer revision is a slightly darker color.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE Space Superiority Starfighter 
From the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, the Emperor has stressed that the conflict will be a war of attrition. Nowhere is that philosophy more evident than in the design and tactics of the staple starfighter of the Imperial Navy, the TIE fighter. TIE fighters are meant to overwhelm enemy forces in huge numbers and have therefore been designed for speed and affordability rather than resilience. The TIE fighter is built around twin ion engine technology and is among the fastest and most maneuverable craft in the galaxy. The TIE fighter can outrun most Alliance vehicles. And while the TIE fighter's standard laser cannons are not very powerful on their own, when dozens of TIE fighters attack simultaneously, they can demolish anything in their path.

The TIE Light Duty is a slighty less powerful version of the TIE fighter. It is used to allow new pilots to get used to the unique nature of flight combat operations in space, without using up more expensive higher-end vessels. TIE Light Duty's are either high-mileage units that are pulled off the line and rebuilt, or are new hulls fitted out with salvaged and refurbished parts. In addition to using lesser-rated parts in the construction of the TIE Light Duty, limiters are placed on the power generation and other systems in an effort to both keep the trainee pilot out of trouble, and prevent over-stressing the weaker equipment.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE Advanced x1 Prototype 
The TIE Advanced is the prototype TIE fighter flown by Darth Vader at the Battle of Yavin. An experimental craft combining TIE fighter technology with more conventional starfighter components, like a hyperdrive and deflector shield generators, the TIE Advanced eventually became the template for the incredibly efficient TIE interceptor. As in all TIE starfighters, the prototype's propulsion system revolves around twin ion engines, although its solar ionization reactor is much more powerful than those on standard TIE fighters. Despite the improved power supply, Vader's TIE proved only slightly faster than the previous TIE models due to inefficient shield generators, which consumed a great deal of power, and the increased mass created by the addition of heavy armor plating. With Darth Vader at the controls, the TIE Advanced is a devastating starfighter. While piloting the prototype, Vader very nearly thwarted the Rebel Alliance's attempt to destroy the Death Star. Only the last-minute arrival of Han Solo and the Millennium Falcon prevented the Sith Lord from firing on Luke Skywalker's X-wing. After being clipped by the Falcon's quad laser cannons, the prototype spun into space. Vader eventually regained of control of the craft and fled to the nearest Imperial facility. The prototype has been repaired and remains one of Vader's most prized possessions.

SANTHE/SIENAR Technologies TIE Aggressor
The TIE Aggressor is a heavy fighter-bomber multi-role craft that was developed prior to the destruction of the first Death Star and as a direct response to a perceived growth in the amount of heavy shipping aligned with the Rebel Alliance. Its most obvious design feature is an anti-fighter defensive turret mounted on the aft dorsal surface of the fuselage, and a heavier than normal forward-firing laser cannon battery. 
The TIE Aggressor is neither fighter nor bomber, but rather something in between. It's a favorite with the more free-spirited pilots of the Imperial fighter cadre who enjoy longer missions away from base where they can be apart from the larger formations normally associated with an Imperial raid on Rebellion re-supply shipping.

The TIE Aggressor can accomodate a second person in the gunner position.  You must launch while grouped with a friend to take advantage of this feature.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE Bomber 
Of all the TIE fighter variants produced by Sienar Fleet Systems for the Galactic Empire, the TIE bomber is one of the most effective. The heavy assault ship, designed for strategic strikes against surface and deep space targets, is one of the most heavily-armed starships in the Imperial fleet. TIE bombers utilize the distinctive bent wings found on the TIE Advanced prototype. These solar array panels frame a rounded TIE cockpit and a large ordnance pod that can be configured to carry a wide array of destructive weapons. While not nearly as fast or agile as the original TIE fighter, TIE bombers are much more destructive. A single TIE bomber's payload can include a volatile combination of torpedoes, missiles, and other explosives. TIE bombers are deployed against space stations, orbital docking platforms, and orbital facilities, but they are especially effective against capital ships. After standard TIE fighters weaken the target's defenses, the bombers swoop in to disable vital areas such as the shield generators and engines.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE/Ln Space Superiority Starfighter 
From the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, the Emperor has stressed that the conflict will be a war of attrition. Nowhere is that philosophy more evident than in the design and tactics of the staple starfighter of the Imperial Navy, the TIE fighter. TIE fighters are meant to overwhelm enemy forces in huge numbers and have therefore been designed for speed and affordability rather than resilience. The TIE fighter is built around twin ion engine technology and is among the fastest and most maneuverable craft in the galaxy. The TIE fighter can outrun most Alliance vehicles. And while the TIE fighter's standard laser cannons are not very powerful on their own, when dozens of TIE fighters attack simultaneously, they can demolish anything in their path.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE Interceptor 
The TIE interceptor is a direct response to the Rebel Alliance's development of faster and more dangerous starfighters. Hoping to develop a vehicle that could compete with the A-wing in both speed and maneuverability, Sienar Fleet Systems has invested huge sums into improving upon the standard TIE fighter's existing twin ion engines. The resulting ion stream projectors allow TIE interceptors to execute tight turns and rolls not possible in most other starfighters. This complex engine system makes the TIE interceptor one of the fastest starfighter in the Imperial fleet, and it outperforms nearly every starfighter in the galaxy during dogfights. The TIE interceptor's bent wings, an element lifted directly from the TIE Advanced prototype, give the starfighter a smaller profile and increased power.

Sienar Fleet Systems TIE Oppressor Strike Starfighter
A recent development, the TIE Oppressor is being deployed in limited numbers among selected units of the Imperial starfighter cadre elite. It is an attempt to build a variant of the standard TIE hull that can carry heavy weapon payloads with sufficient armor and shielding to allow the ship to operate in the vanguard of an Imperial assault force. It also has enough solar array surface to assist in generation of the energy needed to power it all. All of the offensive and defensive equipment packed into the Oppressor comes at the cost of space for engine installations. Although most Imperial fighters are designed to have superior maneuverability, this is a trait in which the TIE Oppressor is rated by most of its pilots as merely average. This lack of dizzying maneuverability is a result of the Oppressor mounting the same basic engine arrangement as seen on earlier TIE starfighter types, but with its thrust being sapped by much heavier and more solid spaceframe. In return for the deficits in combat maneuvering capability, the Oppressor carries one of the most potent offensive and defensive packages fielded in any Imperial starfighter spaceframe. 

Only the most veteran Imperial TIE pilots are being allowed to participate in the Oppressor flight test program as only these personnel are deemed to have the tactical know-how to properly employ the ship as well as the loyalty to be trusted with such as expensive flight article. Although currently serving in the fleet as part of a 'Limited Fielding Test Initiative' and considered a minor trial program by the Imperial Navy, the actual numbers of fighters being fielded would make most Alliance officers wince.

X-Wing 
Incom Corporation T-65 X-Wing Space Superiority Fighter 
The X-wing is among the most advanced single-pilot starfighter ever produced. The starfighter receives its name from its double-layered wings, which separate into an "X" formation during combat to increase the craft's field of fire. Each wing is armed with a high-powered laser cannon and accurate proton torpedo launchers. Although the X-wing is designed for just one pilot and no passengers, the X-wing jockey is never truly alone thanks to the astromech socket located behind the cockpit. One of the X-wing's greatest assets is its durability: the fighter's reinforced titanium alloy hull, deflector shield projectors, and transparisteel canopy ensure that it can withstand several hits without suffering serious damage. The X-wing's history is nearly as important as its capabilities. Designed by Incom Corporation in the early days of the Empire, the X-wing schematics found their way into Rebel hands when several Incom engineers defected to the Alliance. The Rebels began producing the X-wings in modest numbers and the vehicle has quickly become one the most important weapons in the Alliance arsenal.

Gallofree YKL-37R Nova Courier
The Nova Courier follows the pattern well-established by Corellian Engineering Corporation's 'YT' series of transports. Although the larger freighters such as the Medium Transport are built to ply the shipping lanes which are patrolled and relatively free of obstructions, and make their profits on the idea of efficiency of scale, the smaller transports profit off of the special services they offer. They are smaller, more maneuverable vessels equipped for carrying smaller cargos through safe and hazardous space, and they possess a nominal ability to defend themselves. Intended to be crewed by just a handful, almost all systems are made to be accessible and maintainable by a small crew with light tools. In the hands of Rebellion pilots, the Nova Couriers have developed a reputation for being adept at ducking into asteroid belts to avoid pursuers, fighting off individual TIE patrol ships, and generally becoming masters of smuggling weapons, information, and personnel past Imperial blockades.

YT-1300 
Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 Transport 
A stock light freighter, the YT-1300 is an adaptable, all-purpose, cargo transport built on a modular design. Off the assembly line, a YT-1300 is a fairly standard vessel, with rudimentary engine, communications, and life-support systems. However, the vessel's appeal is the fact that it can be upgraded with great ease. In fact, Corellian Engineering Corporation has earned a small fortune selling conversion kits. The most popular modification is an enhanced hyperdrive package, although many pilots also outfit the craft with military-grade weapons, long-range sensor suites, and powerful deflector shields. Han Solo's Millennium Falcon is the most infamous (and most heavily-modified) YT-1300 in existence.

Koensayr BTL-S3 Y-Wing Attack Starfighter 
Prior to the advent of the X-wing, the Y-wing served as the Rebel Alliance's primary attack starfighter. The snub fighter, characterized by its triangular cockpit and two long engine pylons was considered outdated by the time of the Battle of Yavin, but its durability and heavy-firepower has ensured it a place in Alliance fleet. While the Alliance relies on the Y-wing for everything from escort duty to reconnaissance, the starfighter was originally designed for close-quarters combat with space stations and large starships. Light bombing runs and surgical strikes are also part of the Y-wing's mission profile. The starfighter's modular weapons emplacements allow it to be upgraded easily, yet another reason for its continued success. While the Rebel Alliance maintains the largest fleet of active Y-wings, the starfighters are also in heavy use by criminal organizations, mercenary groups, pirates, and privateers.

The Y-Wing can accomodate a second person in the gunner position.  You must launch while grouped with a friend to take advantage of this feature.

Incom/Subpro Z-95-AF4 Headhunter 
One of the oldest starfighters still in use, the Headhunter predates the Battle of Yavin by several decades and has experienced several revivals since its first appearance. The starfighter's longevity is based on its legendary resilience and it still remains an attractive option to mercenaries and security personnel throughout the galaxy. The starfighter is identified by a pair of fixed wings equipped equipped with rear-mounted maneuvering jets. Easy to modify, the Headhunter can support a wide range of laser cannons and missile-launcher, placing it on par with the Y-wing in terms of sheer destructive capability. The Rebel Alliance has even been known to convert Headhunters for short-range bombing runs. The Rebels also use Headhunters for training missions because the vehicle's controls are nearly identical to those of the X-wing and Y-wing.

%TU looted %TT from %TO.
You loot %TU from %TT.
Ah, it is one of your kind. Your species are prone to violent actions more so than mine, thus you may want to be part of this, yes? It will help your people and mine, rest assured. Shall I continue?

A group of extremists calling themselves the Afarathu have made a pact with the Tribunals. Many of us know that this will soon make the Afarathu cocky, and soon they will begin raiding everyone with their stolen weapons. They need to be shown that might leads to violence. You will show them, yes? Good.
Yes, as are many of our people, as well. Our politics are far more heated than yours are, with the Empire controlling all. A good day to you, pacifist.

Your people have a history according to your historians, if I know correctly. Some of my sisters only understand communication through violence.  Therefore, you would be an excellent moderator. Shall I continue?
Good luck!
So be it. Farewell.
Did you find the Afarathu Cult lair?
I'm listening. Go on.
No thanks. I'm a pacifist.
What do you mean 'prone to violent actions'?
I changed my mind. I'm not going.
Not yet. I am on my way.
This system of caves house an extremist group of Selonians who are known to raid all manner of people.
Afarathu Cave

Hey you! Have you heard the new song playing in the cantina? "The Empire's Slave" is a band of musicians who have been singing about bringing down all kinds of government. Do you want to know where they might be playing next?

They were saying that anyone who wants to help destroy all governments should show up at the Patriots' base of operations. Watch out, though, because they probably might think you work for either the Empire or the Rebellion.
Yeah, you're probably one of those Imperials, or worse yet, one of those Rebels. You're just like those guys they were talking about. Well, you can go off and be a slave to themﾅ I know I'm not!

There's a group of guys who call themselves the Patriots, right? They're a bunch of Drall like me who want to smash every government to the ground, and they formed a band to spread the message! They are sooo wizard!
Good luck!
So be it. Farewell.
Did you find the Drall Patriots' hideout?
Sure, tell me.
Nope, not interested.
Who is "The Empire's Slave"?
No. I've decided not to go there.
Not yet. I am on my way there now.
A group calling themselves the Drall Patriots use these caves to stage attacks on people.
Drall Patriots' Hideout
Hey there, kid. You look like you have an eye for detail. Have you ever thought of being a "Professional Eye-Witness"? If so, I have some advice for you. Interested?

I knew you were that kind of guy. Look... the Empire has set up shop a little ways up the road. Let's just say they know of me and won't let me within 1000m of the place. You though can get a good look around there, then one day when I run a story on it, I'll look you up, got it? Here's where you can find it.
What's wrong, kid? Are you scared of the truth? Or perhaps you just can't handle it?

Well, as you can tell by looking at me, I'm a journalist. I write for all of the major News HoloStations throughout the galaxy, and am well known for my surprise exposes. Matter of fact, right now I'm planning one and you can be part of it! Interested?
Good luck to you!
Well, okay. Maybe some other time.
Did you locate the Imperial Stronghold?
Absolutely! Count me in!!!
Ummm.. No thanks... I'm leaving now.
Hold on. What are you talking about?
No. I've decided to stay away from it for the time being.
I'm on my way there right now.
The Empire has gone to great lengths to construct this outpost, but no one knows what it's for. Perhaps you might be the one to find out.
Imperial Stronghold

Everyone here in town thinks I've gone crazy, but I know what I heard! You! You can go out there and prove that I haven't gone nuts! You need to go out into the wilderness and stop these cultists from bringing back Lord Nyax's ghost!

I knew someone would finally believe me! Here's where I saw them. If you have friends, bring them with you too! Someone has to stop these guys in case they actually know how to bring someone back from the dead!
You're just like everyone else here! I swear it's not just a story to tell kids! These guys are serious! Someone has to stop them before they summon up his ghost!

What? You've never heard of Lord Nyax? He was the worst thing ever seen on Corelliaﾅ dressed all in black, choking people with his mind, you name it!Most people think he's just a story you tell to kids who are misbehaving, but I'm telling you, he's real!! Or at least these guys think he is!
I sure hope you can verify my story so people stop thinking that I'm crazy.
Perhaps that is for the best.
Did you find the followers of Lord Nyax?
Umm... sure, I'll help you.
No thanks. You sound like you're one card short of a full Sabbac deck.
Who is Lord Nyax?
I've decided not to search for them.
Not yet. I am still looking.
This is the temple where a group of cultists are trying to bring Lord Nyax back from the dead.
Lord Nyax Cult
I can't believe it!! Aarrrgh! If he weren't my friend, I'd go do it myself. Huh? Oh, sorry... didn't see you there. Hey! Are you interested in unofficially helping the remaining "good" CorSec agents?
Here's where you can find the island all those thugs are using as a "base". If you find you have the time, go show them what happens to traitors!
Well, at least you're better than those rogues are. Thanks for your honesty.

My former partner, and best friend at that, apparently has gone "rogue". He joined up with a group of former agents that have decided to go into business for themselves. Not only that, he stole quite a number of weapons from the armory before he left. GRRrrrr!
Good luck, then.
That might be wise. But even so - the very idea of wholesome justice dies today... along with your courage.
Did you find the Rogue Corsec encampment?
Sure, I'll help.
Sorry... I don't do anything unofficial.
Why are you so angry?
I've decided not to look for it.
Not yet. I'm still looking.
An island where former members of CorSec have set up a base of operations for their thievery.
Rogue Island

Want to hear a crazy story? This guy last night in the cantina was telling us where there's this group of people running around moving things with their minds. He says there was this cave filled with crystals where all of them live. Crazy, huh? He even told us where it was, too. Interested in going out there to see if this is real or not?
It's your time, not mine. Okay, this is where he said the place was. I'll warn you that if you find nothing there, it's your own fault for believing this guy. Good luck.
That's what I'm saying! I'm not running out there to find out if he's telling the truth or not. Then again, what if he was?

Okay, here's the full story. He says he's a medic, right? He gets this call from some weird guy who says his brother needs help. The guy goes running out to these caves with the weirdo, finds the brother, then heals him up. While he's doing that, he says everyone around there were doing crazy things like moving stuff and jumping real high. Go figure. Interested in knowing where?
Then good luck to you.
Hmmm. Well, okay.
Did you find the force crystal hunters' encampment?
Sure, I have nothing better to do.
No thanks. It sounds like some tall tale.
How did he say he found out about the place?
I've decided to skip it.
I am still looking for the crystal hunters.
According to the story, this cave is filled with people who can do strange things with their mind
Mysterious Crystal Cave

Would you mind helping a starving artisan? Just the other day, I was accosted by some of those primitive Dantari. I thought I was dead, but at the last moment, all they took were a couple of my sculptures. Mind you, I'm happy to be alive, but I would have preferred to have kept my art, as well. Would you help see if the art is still there?

Thank you so much! I saw them run off to their cave well, when I dared to open my eyes, that is. I'm pretty certain they smashed it once they realized it couldn't be eaten, but if you happen to find it there, I'd greatly appreciate it if you brought it back.
Well a good day to you, too! Hmph!

I don't know, to tell you the truth. When they came upon me, I thought it was curtains for me. They started to grunt at me, holding out some spears and pointing to my artwork. All they kept saying was Janta.  Looking back, I think they were trying to trade with me, but I don't know how to communicate with them. Could you help me?
Good luck, then.
Fine.
Did you find them?
Sure, I'll help you.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Why didn't they kill you?
I've decided to quit looking.
I am still looking for them.
A group of Dantari make this system of caves their home.
Janta Stronghold

If you are looking for opportunities to help the Empire, then you are speaking with the right person. We are doing preliminary reconnaissance on the native Dantari. Since the Empire has just begun to take control of this planet, any information on the surrounding Dantari will help. Are you interested in helping the Empire?

Very good. Here are the coordinates of an area we suspect the Dantari to have a heavy concentration of their people. All we need you to do is observe the area. When we need the information, we will come to you and ask you for your detailed report.
Helping the Empire should be the most important thing on your list of things to do.

The Dantari are a threat to our stormtroopers. At this time, we are devoting all of our efforts to wipe out the remaining Rebel sympathy on this planet. Once the Rebels have been completely stopped, we can then focus our attentions on subjugating the indigenous species, the Dantari.
Good luck!
Okay. Fine.
Did you find them?
Yes, I wish to help the Empire.
Sorry, I have more important things to do.
Why are you concerned with the Dantari?
I decided to quit looking.
Not yet. I am still looking.
According to the Imperial Officer, this area is home to aggressive Dantari
Dantari Stronghold

How are you doing today? The name's Daiv Dekven, Scout. Look, you might be able to help me out, actually. I'm nursing some wounds right now, but I was checking up on a cave to see if it's already being used by some Dantari. Do you think you might be able to help me, since I can't do it myself?

Thanks a lot, friend. Let me mark down on your datapad where I saw this cave. All I need to know is if some Dantari are using it. I've heard a tribe named the Mokk Dantari are using it, but I need to make sure. I'll run off to the hospital shortly once you leave. Thanks again!
Hey, I understand. If I hadn't spent so much time running around this planet, the Dantari would still scare me too!

Heck, I'm not one for lying. I'm a Rebel. Judging by the look in your eye, I'd say you are too, eh? Yeah,  I'm a good judge of character. Anyway, as you were asking - I'm looking for a new place to hide out in case the long arm of the Empire comes down on us. That's why I'm checking out these caves to make sure Dantari aren't already there.
Good luck, then.
Suit yourself.
Did you find the Mokk?
Sure, I'll help.
Sorry, I'm a bit busy.
What are you doing on Dantooine?
I've decided to leave them alone.
Not yet. I am still looking for them.
According to Daiv, this cave system may or may not hold a tribe of Dantari called the Mokk.
Mokk Caves

You... come closer. I don't have too much longer. I will give you something in exchange for your promise to tell others. I am the last survivor of a crashed cruise liner, the Star Tours Tzarina. If you promise to tell others of our fate, I will tell you where the wreckage is. Perhaps you can find something salvageable there. Agreed?

Thank you, friend. Tell the Star Tours company that they need to fix their droids, they're crazy! I will mark where we crashed on your datapad. Watch out, before I got out of there, I saw a number of scavengers approaching the area looking for food. I need to sleep now, good luck.
I see. Very well, then I think I need to sleep now. I'm very cold.

I was one of many who were lucky enough to be some of the first passengers on Star Tours newest luxury yacht. Everything was fine until the droid captain changed course towards Yavin to show us something "neat". The ship was hit by a strange T.I.E. Fighter that was tumbling out of control. Our hyperdrive initiated and drove us straight into this planet. You must let others know...
Good luck, then.
Oh, I see. Farewell, then.
Did you find the crashed starship?
I promise I will tell others of your fate.
I am not interested, sorry.
What happened to the ship?
I've decided to do something else.
Not yet. I am still looking.
The remains of the Tzarina, the largest ship in the Star Tours fleet.
Crashed Civilian Transport Ship

Slave, I will have words with you. You seem to have been given more freedom than most of your ilk, therefore I charge you with a task that other slaves may are not able to complete. It has come to my attention that there is a cave filled with many inbred rancors. These creatures must be destroyed before they spread their line. Are you ready for your task?

I will mark the location of the cave on your datapad so that you can attend to this immediately. You are charged with entering the cave and destroying as many of these abominations as possible before you find your own life extinguished. Go now.
I will find who your owner is and bring upon a wrathful vengeance for your insolence. Your owner has not trained you adequately, slave. This will be rectified immediately.

A fellow sister had found that even though she desired to be trained to tame rancors, she had not the skill within her. Though she was directed to undertake different tasks, she rebelled and went into exile. It seems she has decided to continue with her training on her own, resulting in a perversion of the noble line of rancor. You will eradicate these mutants.
Good luck, then.
Then fare well... if you can.
Did you find the mutant rancor cave?
Yes, mistress.
No, mistress, I cannot do this.
How could something like this happen?
I have other plans, mistress.
Not yet. I am still looking.
A cave filled with horribly inbred rancors. Destroy all you see so that they can no longer breed.
Mutant Rancor Cave

You were able to escape from the sisters, too? What? You're from the stars!? Then maybe you might be able to help! The Nightsisters chose the strongest of their slaves and force them to work the mines! I managed to escape and search for help, for we cannot save ourselves! Will you please help us gain our freedom?

Oh, thank you! Here is where the mines are. Were trapped down deep inside the mines, and the Nightsisters oversee everything we do. If you're going to help us, you will need to bring help of your own. I look forward to seeing my friends againﾅ thank you so much.
I guess I understand. The Nightsisters are something no one should have to face in a battle. I will be off to try to find someone who is able to help.

They were the first people I sought out. The Empire told me that they would prefer to leave well enough alone, and that they didn't care about a few escaped slaves. Blast the Empire! They are no better than the Nightsisters! Will you help us, please?
Good luck.
No problem. I hope to see you around.
Did you find it?
Yes, I'll definitely help!
I cannot help you.
Why don't you ask the Empire for help?
I've decided to pass on this expedition.
Not yet. I am still looking.
A series of resource mines that are being worked by slaves of the Nightsisters.
Forced-Labor Mine
Your mind is too occupied at the moment, come back another time when you are not so distracted.
What do you want maggot?! Can't you see I'm busy?!

Hmm, so you are looking to prove yourself worthy of your life eh? Well there is a little something you could assist me with I suppose. A few nights ago an initiate of mine was out collecting some herbs. She should have been back the same day but we haven't seen her since. This isn't the first time that we've lost sisters out in that area. Can you go out there and see what you can find out maggot?!
Excellent. The area where this herb grows is around here. Get out there and find out what happened!
Your probably afraid maggot! Well I guess I couldn't expect anything less from one of your kind.
Dathomir is a dangerous place and we've heard rumors about...well you don't need to know about that. Just go find her already!
You better maggot!
You failed me maggot! What good are you?! Get out of my sight!
What do you want maggot?! Can't you see I'm busy?!
Knew I shouldn't have put any trust in one of your kind!
As I thought. We've heard rumors about this foul clan before. Knowing the location of their cave will prove most useful. You have served me well maggot!
What are you doing here maggot?! You're supposed to be out there checking what happened to my initiate!
Yes witch, I will see what I can find out. Where is this area?
If she didn't return, I may not either. Doesn't sound like something I would want to get involved in.
Do you have any idea what it could be out there?
I've decided that it's probably not a good idea for me to head in to that area.
I'm sorry witch; I will get right back out there and see what I can find.
This is where a cave of outcast Nightsisters is rumored to live.
Nightsister cave
You should finish your current tasks before bothering me, now get out!
I don't have time for you, get out of here!
There's an abomination of a clan that holds fortress in a cave near the Great Canyon. We need someone to scout out this place for a weakness in their defenses. These heretics must be eradicated!
Excellent. They are located in this area, find out as many details as you can and hurry back.
Fine! Find the help you need and come back when you have it.
They are an abomination! They don't even befriend the Rancor and are a disgrace to our entire sisterhood!
Hurry! I didn't say you could slack on this important task did I?!
You're just as useless as I thought!
I don't have time for you, get out of here!
Apologies won't help me! Get out of here and don't come back until you're of any use to me!
I suppose this could help, we will get right to planning what we have to do next.
You return empty handed?!
I will try my best.
It sounds like I would need more assistance with me than I have right now. I will have to say no for now.
But they are also nightsisters?
I can't do it right now, very sorry.
I have not managed to do your mission yet but I will get right on it.
This is where a cave of outcast Nightsisters is rumored to live.
Nightsister Cave
You already have plenty of things to worry about, come back when your less occupied.
I have lots of things to do, but nothing for you right now.

Lets see, yes, you could probably assist me. I've heard of a clan of the dangerous Nightsisters that has developed a strange symbiosis with some other creatures than the Rancor. I'd appreciate it if you could find out what's going on out there.
Good, I know they have their base of operations somewhere in this area. Let me know what you find out.
Thought you were more skilled than you are I guess.
Well if we can find a common variable in the way they tame their rancors and these creatures, we may be one step closer to...well but that's classified information.
Good, the sooner I get this information the better. Get to it soldier!
Bah, thought I could count on you doing this! Get out of here; I have no use for imbeciles.
I have lots of things to do, but nothing for you right now.
Didn't take you for the spineless type. Well I'm sure someone more courageous can assist me then.
Spiders eh? Hmm interesting, we may have to put together a strike force and see if we can capture some species.
Already back?
Sounds interesting, I will see what I can find out.
Nightsisters, from what I've heard about them, I should stay as far away from where ever they are as possible. No thanks.
Why would this be interesting information?
I've decided that it's probably not a good idea for me to head in to that area.
Sorry no, haven't had time yet. Will get right on it.
This is where a cave of outcast Nightsisters is rumored to live.
Nightsister cave

You are a slave that has been granted greater freedoms, are you not? Then you are needed to help your mistresses defeat the Singing Mountain clan and their Clan Mother, Augwynne. You need to journey to the field of battle where your Nightsisters will claim victory over those worthless excuses for witches and take up arms against them.

That is a good slave. Here is where the battle wages. Go forth and rip their hearts from their chests! You are commanded to fight until your life is quenched, at which time another will take your place. Now go!
YOU HAVE BEEN GIVEN A COMMAND! This was not a request. When your mistress has heard of this flagrant disobedience, you will wish you had died upon the fields immediately.

You shall be able to find more than ample supplies and weapons on the bodies of those who have come before you. Do not dare to disturb the dead bodies of your Mistresses, or even of the pathetic Singing Mountatin sisters, for you are beneath such an honor. Now, you are directed to leave at once.
Do so.
Hm. Unwise.
Did you find it?
Yes, my mistress, I shall.
I cannot do so, mistress.
What will I be armed with?
I've decided to pass on this.
I am still looking, mistress.
Here is where you will find a battle being waged between the Nightsisters and Singing Mountain Clan
Battle of Witches

You there! Do you want to know where you can find some of those blasted little buggers called Ewoks? I know the perfect place where you can find some and show them what a blaster does. So do you want to know or not?
Let me see your datapad! Okay, I've marked it down where you can find them and wipe out those little rats. I'd do it myself, but my shuttle is leaving soon. Good luck, and kill one for me!
Well you should! Those nasty little things will eat anything you have the moment you turn your back on them! Hpmh!

WHY AM I SO ANGRY?! I'm angry because I came all the way to this planet to study those little rodents only to have them ruin my droid! I sent a droid to record everything the Jinda were doing in their rituals, the tribe I was studying. Then they went ahead and ATE IT!!! I spent my life savings on that thing, and I can't afford another!
Good luck, then.
AAAH! Fine!
Did you find them?

I've got a friend in CorSec named Shaedra Valouri. She's helping me track a few leads that will break this case. Go and pick up what she has for me. She's meeting you outside of town in case corrupt officers try and stop her.

I've made arrangements for you to meet Captain Varley under the guise of selling back that evidence against him. If you can take down his cronies and bring him here, I'll make sure he spills his guts. With him out of the holo, we can shut down this smuggling operation once and for all.

We're gonna end this operation once and for all. Captain Varley spilled the location of Black Sun's little spice den. How about you go and fill it so full of holes that even the Force won't hold it together.

Graft, murder, revenge -- all the things this city was founded on. I need you to go pick up some evidence. Are you with me or not?
They think that they're untouchable because they work for CorSec. You just get that captain here and I'll make him sing. Don't you worry about that. What do you say?
If death is gonna come for us, we can still look it in the eye and make it buy us a drink first. So are you in or not?
I've told you all I can. Are you going?

You've been a great help to our cause, but I think our operations here on Corellia will pause momentarily. No sense in forcing the Empire to squeeze this system any more than it is. Check back with me from time to time.
This is not the CorSec report. That's what I need.
I'm a busy man. Talk to Irenez and she can schedule an appointment with me. Oh, and if you're not sympathetic to the Rebellion, you're wasting my time.

If Irenez thinks you're ready, that's good enough for me. The name's Iblis but everyone around here calls me the Commander. When dealing with the Empire you have to be efficient and precise. No room in my organization for flashy heroes. Those types get their comrades killed. You do the job you're assigned and nothing else. Understand? Good. Your first assignment is escort duty. One of our contacts in the Corellian Shipbuilder's Union is about to be arrested by ISB goons. Get him back here safely and get rid of anyone who tries to stop you. Can you handle that?

Your second assignment is a retrieval mission. An ISB agent has managed to acquire a classified internal CorSec report that identifies several Rebel sympathizers within at least half a dozen major Corellian corporations. That report must not fall into Imperial Intelligence's hands. I need you to intercept the ISB agent and bring me this report. Can you do that?

Back just in time. We've identified the leak inside of CorSec. A certain Captain Egan Garrud. I need him silenced. Our contacts tell us that he's been tipped off, so he knows we'll be sending someone. Garrud is one tough gundark, so you might wish to call in some help from trusted comrades. Think you can tackle him?

Turns out that Captain Garrud wasn't working alone. My people have identified a Bothan informant named Fadulk Di'keer that's been playing both sides of the fence. This guy's worked as an assistant to quite a few Corellian bigwigs, including the late Diktat himself. Turns out the Imperials have also identified him so he's on the lam. Find him before the Imperials do and bring him back here. Understand that we need him very much alive if we're to discover what kind of information he's sold to the Empire concerning our activities. Can you do it?

Looks like the pro-Imperial corporations have taken matters into their own hands and have hired a bounty hunter to bring me in. They've spared no expense, apparently, since they've hired a particularly dangerous lady by the name of Kalia Kulmina. She's a Zabrak and she's as deadly as she is beautiful. Think you could stop her from making me into a statistic?

Given your track record, soldier, I could think of no one better qualified to tackle this mission. We've just discovered that an Imperial Special Forces Unit is being formed whose sole mission is to take out my command center. I need these Imperial agents eliminated before they can complete their training and launch their attack. If you think you needed help with past missions, then you're definitely going to need an elite team to pull this one off. You have to hit them hard and fast. Can I count on you one last time?

Good. Man's name is Hlaano Dunlix. He'll know to expect you. He's currently in hiding so be prepared for a bit of a journey. It's more important that you get Dunlix here alive than it is to leave no Imperial witnesses. If things get hot, get out of there fast.

The agent's name is Drillen Foyle and he'll likely have requested a small stormtrooper escort. Once you get the report, break off the engagement if there is still resistance. Getting the report back to us is what's important. You can kill stormtroopers on your own time. And in fact I encourage you to do so.
He's a crack shot so don't let him keep you at a distance or he's likely to pick you and your friends off like nafen flies. Best of luck.
Great. Remember that the Empire wants this guy pretty badly too, so be expecting a fight. After all, the Empire's way of solving a problem is to throw more stormtroopers at it. Best of luck.

I'll give you the same advice I gave you on an earlier mission: if you have tough friends, bring them along. Kalia will be very difficult to bring down. But you know, if there's anyone that can do it, I think it's you. Best of luck.
Best of luck to you, soldier. I know I've made the right choice by picking you. I just hope the Force is with all of us today.
Looks like I'll have to have a little chat with Irenez. Dismissed.
I can't imagine why you'd be wasting my time. Dismissed.
I actually understand your hesitation to tackle this mission. All right, I'll find someone else.
You should have more confidence in your abilities, soldier. Fine, I'll find someone else.
A respect someone that knows their limits. No hard feelings.
I've asked too much of you already, soldier. May Fortune bless your future endeavors. Farewell.

He's been covering up shipments of starfighters that have been diverted to Rebel bases in the Outer Rim. Someone ratted him out and now the Imperials want to interrogate him. We can't let that happen.
I think a fairly high-ranking CorSec official sold us out. We'll have to identify this dangerous leak and deal with it soon.
Let me put it this way - I'd bring friends along and I'm a great shot. Garrud is fast on his feet, deadly accurate with a blaster, and he fights to win. He is not going to go easy.
No, he's a records keeper and definitely no soldier. He should come along quietly although he may call on the Imperials for help if they show up.

She's worked for Imperial Intelligence quite a bit and rumor has it that she specialized in hunting rogue Jedi that had escaped the Purge. They're all gone and she's still alive, so that should tell you something.
Not much, but they may have some Dark Troopers working with them. You'll need to be well prepared for anything.
Was something unclear, soldier?
I've got nothing more to tell you about this mission. Do you wish me to find someone else to give it to?
If you wish to reconsider, I understand.
I can find someone else to do this if you'd like to reconsider.
If you'd like to back out, now is the time.
I understand if you'd like to back out. It won't change my high opinion of you.
Did the Commander send you? I'm Dunlix.
No one should have known I was out here. Open fire, men!
Keep your distance, pal, or I'll drop you where you stand!
Uh oh, looks like trouble! Don't shoot!
Pitiful fool, throw your life away if you want. But you will not stop me.
Much obliged, friend. I know I wouldn't have made it without your help. I agree with the Commander - go treat yourself to some Corellian Double-Brandy.
I appreciate your efforts to keep me alive, despite the fact that you were escorting me back here. Although I'd rather be in the hands of the Rebels than Imperial Intelligence any day.
Those are not exactly the results I was hoping for, citizen. I'll have to bring in some specialists now. Maybe you should take some time off.

We may have to call in a "specialist" to take Garrud out. I appreciate your attempt, though.
This is unfortunate. If we don't know which of our covert agents have been compromised we can't take steps to protect them.
We'll see how close this lady gets before I can take her out. Assuming I get lucky, that is. I appreciate the attempt, soldier.
I'll have to organize a second attack. We've lost the element of surprise but with any luck they won't be able to reinforce their position before we can strike again. Thanks for your help.

Do you recall that Rodian who tried to interfere with our last bit of business? Not long after you left that slicer, Ara Niorri, the Rodian's partner killed her. Ara was a gifted woman, and I don't like it when my friends get murdered. Will you do something about it for me?
I've been keeping my eye on the Lady Hutt after our recent run-ins. I hear tell me she's expecting an important delivery from Naboo soon. Will you intercept it for me?

I can't believe the lengths people in this business will go to. The Lady Hutt has purchased a genetically engineered virus that heightens aggression. There are some things I'm just not willing to be involved in, and engineered viruses are right up there. Will you deliver this virus sample to the Biological Control Bureau for me?
I thought you might be interested. You'll be looking for Ara Miorri. She's a little on the eccentric side, doing all her business outside of town -- although I hear that's becoming more common.
Good, I didn't think you'd let this slide. The Rodian's name is Vralla. I'd be careful of her -- you foiled her partner, so she may be looking for you.

I knew I could count on you. The ship just landed in a remote location, and the delivery is being made by hand. Find the courier and take the package. I don't like doing business this way, but the Lady Hutt must learn who she's dealing with.

Good. I've arranged for a quiet dropoff with one of the BCB couriers. Just meet him, give him the package, and there'll be no questions asked. I hope they can get a retrovirus started in case anyone tries something foolish.
Afraid you might get yourself in trouble? Probably good thinking. Good luck to you.
I guess she didn't impress you very much. I'll handle it myself.
All right. Best to stay out of these power struggles if you don't have a vested interest.
I can't fault your good sense. Good luck to you.

A disk that a friend of mine has put together to help me with my shipping interests. I need someone to get it for me, as I seem to have picked up a tail. Don't ask who's tailing me -- I don't know. Will you make the pickup?

That's what I'm trying to figure out. Probably another Hutt somewhere on Corellia. She likes to keep her own hands clean nowadays, but she sends others to do the dirtiest possible work. Will you avenge Ara?

Technically I'm only going against one Hutt, but actually the answer is yes. You can't get far in this business without taking some risks. Besides, I know a few things they don't. Trust me on this. So will you do it?
Shouldn't affect anyone you know. I wouldn't be surprised if they try to change that.
You haven't lost interest in the job already, have you?
I've told you what I know. You haven't changed your mind, have you?
I've told you all I can. Will you get that package now?
Don't you want to make that delivery for me?

Well, if it isn't the little wretch who foiled my partner. Milady Hutt will be most pleased if I kill you.
You just made the last mistake of your life.
Are you looking for me?
Got a little hairy, I take it? That sometimes happens in our line of work.
I asked too much of you. Thank you for trying.
You weren't able to get the package? A minor setback. They happen.
No luck? I'll try to send over another sample.
She'll contact me when she's ready to make the drop. See me in a little while.
One of my informants will send the Rodian's location shortly. See me again in a few minutes.
Once the courier leaves with the package, my informant will contact me. See me soon and I should be ready.

Imperial Intelligence has provided me with the name of the mastermind behind this Corellian industrial spy ring. Admiral Ozzel would like me to take care of this, which of course means I'm turning to you. Can you remove this threat to Imperial security?

Once you have learned to truly hate them, perhaps I can teach you worse things. We shall see what you are capable of. Your task is to kill Tibik, the leader of this Ewok tribe. It shall be as though a great gong sounds their doom. Then my extermination can begin in earnest.

Hate? You haven't the wit to truly grasp how I feel about the Ewoks. Hate does not even begin to describe what I feel towards those furry abominations. As to my reasons -- They are not your concern. Now will you aid my extermination plan or not?

Destroy any who defend the ship. Do what you will with them, only bring us the power. I have only to reach out and...

He's convoking a secret conference here with many local nobles who are quietly sympathetic to the Alliance. It is crucial that Bal'far arrives here safely. Will you escort him?

We are assembling a conclave of Naboo aristocrats who sympathize with the Resistance. One noble has sent her servant to pick up directions and clearance codes. We have arranged a wilderness rendezvous, away from prying Imperial eyes, and would like you to deliver the datadisc to the servant. Will you go?

Our secret conference with sympathetic Naboo nobles is about to begin. Captain Dallows in Theed has sent one of his security officers to Dee'ja Peak as a guard for the meeting, but the officer ran into an Imperial patrol on the way. Our reports indicate he may have been wounded. Please escort the officer here safely.

Trouble. Stormtroopers have arrested Lim Paddu, the local noble whose invitation you delivered a while back. For the moment, they don't know who she is -- they think she's just a suspicious traveller. But once they take her back to the nearest city, High Inquisitor Mal Sikander will identify her and have her executed. Will you rescue Lim and bring her to the conference safely?

We have a crisis. One of the conference participants brought a servant, a man named Melloc Fitzal. It turns out Fitzal was a covert agent for Imperial Security. We screened all transmission devices before the conference, but Fitzal got out undetected and has met an escort of storm commandos in the wilderness. If he gets back to the city alive, the entire Resistance on Naboo will be finished. Assemble a strike team and stop him!
Good. When you find her, Gizda Ramani will speak the recognition code "Sensor Beacon." I caution you that Imperial Security is on her trail. May you both return safely.
