I'm not well-suited for this kind of thing.
What's so important about this message?
If she can use the Force, why can't she protect herself?
Why didn't she come in for training sooner?
I can't do this anymore.
No, I don't want Vader coming after me. I'm leaving this one alone.
I've come back to tell you I've changed my mind.  I'm not interested in this anymore.
Not yet.
Ummm... sorry.  I -um- had to use the 'fresher.  I'm leaving right now to get her.
Um, she was here just a moment ago.  Let me go see if I can find where she went.
Hello there. It's good to see busy folks taking time out from the whirl at Cheapside Cantina. Glad to have you.
Who are you!?!
Oh, nevermind.  I thought you were a friend of Binna.  Well, be careful out there!
Huh?  I thought you were one of them droids.  Ah, nevermind.
Well, you have yourself a good day, you hear?  And don't get caught when the wind starts to blow.
Ha hooey!  You not the one.  Ho yahaa!  I don't have things to say to you now.  Habba hodie!
I don't have time to chat anymore.
You're pretty handy to have around. Come and visit me from time to time, maybe I can find you more work later.

Stormtroopers attacked a Rebel base near here. Their fire went astray, as usual. They almost killed an innocent civilian family. I sent these folks to stay with a fellow I know, but they're still very shaken. There's not much I can do, but I do have a toy for the kids. Can you deliver it?

Some sleemo took a pot-shot at my favorite old guy, Gen Horosi. He's a Clone Wars veteran, incredibly ancient but still sharp. I got some friends to help him get home, but he needs healing. I scraped together some credits and got a stimpack. Can you deliver it?

Friend of mine, Peele Noonal, just had her first child and -- oh, thanks, I'll pass along your kind words -- and her nurse wrapped the baby in Peele's shirt. Ever had a baby? Trust me, it does the shirt no good. I want you to take this shirt of mine to Peele as a maternity gift.

I got this datadisk from a friend on Corellia. May say something about  my husband. He went missing years back. A friend who looked for him sent this report, but the data got corrupted. Can you take it to a data slicer friend of mine?
Real kind of you. Here's the toy, such as it is. You got the coordinates? Good.
Thanks. You might not find Gen at home. Sometimes wanders out of town and has to be led back. Feisty old guy, but a good heart. Oh, don't mention the Emperor, okay? It just gets him riled.
Great. Come on back and I'll give you a drink on the house.
Thanks. Fella named Dinnis the Blade. Nice enough guy, a little wild. Don't stand too close to him, he doesn't believe in using water.
That's all right. I'll find someone who has the time. Thanks anyway.
That's okay. You just sit back and get comfortable now.
Not a problem. We'll take care of this somehow. Sit down, relax.
No problem, friend. Have a drink, kick back, relax.

Well, I guess "toy" doesn't really -- It's a little fuel drum I cleaned up. Tried to decorate it with little drawings -- aww, it's just to beat on, makes noise. It's about all we can manage in Cheapside. What do you say to the delivery job?
Aw, nobody was gunning for him specifically. It was just some wild-eyed glitterstim druggie on a jaunt, blasting things and giggling. Happens too much around Cheapside. Can you help Gen?
The shirt is warm? Oh yeah, I guess that's because I just took it off. Will you deliver it to Peele?

He was piloting a cargo freighter on the Corellia Route. Ran into pirates and had to make a wild jump through hyperspace. It's been years, but I never gave up hope. I've stayed in this dive ever since, just on the chance he'd make it back here. If I left, he'd never find me.
It's really appreciated.  Make sure that you get to see the children's faces when you give it to them.  I want to hear all about it.
Oh, that's not a problem.  He doesn't put on airs about it.  Just greet him like you would any other person.
That's mighty considerate of you.  I trust you'll get it to her safely.
I've been waiting all these years, I don't think a little more will hurt.  Let me know when he's found something.
Are you Binna's friend?
You there!  You aren't one of them Confederation guys, are you?  The war is over, so put down your weapons.  Eh?  What was that?
How are you doing today?  It's looking like we might be in for a bit of a sandstorm, don't you think?
Wee hoo!  Are you the one that Binna say is coming to me?  Hoo yehaa!
That's all right. I'll find someone who has the time. Thanks anyway.
That's okay. You just sit back and get comfortable now.
Not a problem. We'll take care of this somehow. Sit down, relax.
No problem, friend. Have a drink, kick back, calm down and relax.
Mighty nice of you. Those kids have already been through stuff -- well, it's a tough life in Bestine, sometimes. Here, take a little something as a reward.
That was real nice of you. Gen'll be okay. He's been through more than any squadron of stormtroopers. Here, I made this for you. Tasty.
Thanks. Here, friend, have a drink on the house. Don't drink it too fast, or your eyes will cross.

That -- that's -- oh. All right, time for an old lady to sit down. He's really -- Okay. I'm all right now. Thank you. Here, take this, it's tasty. I think I want to be alone now. Alone with my dreams.
Unfortunately, the family got called away when one child had to go into the bacta tanks. Thank you anyway. I'll take the toy to the children.

I don' need no stimpack! I ain't hardly hit. Can't take me out that easy -- easy -- hol' on, lemme get my breath back -- wuzzat? Stimpack? Whyn't you say so, junior? Give it over. What? What? Sorry, don' hear so good nowadays.
Is this for me? From Binna? She's the nicest lady in the galaxy. Excuse me, I just put the baby to bed and I reeeally need some sleep.
Hoo yeh! Gimme the dat, I know what it's at. I do my magic, and -- Yee-eah! Seems Binna's old man is alive. Some kind of distant signal from Wild Space. Bad engine and low fuel, but he's flying home!
Didn't expect to see you back so soon.  Were you able to deliver the toy to the kids?
You're back quick.  Did you forget something?
So, how did she like the shirt?
So... is he still alive?
I'll do that for the little kids, yes.
For a Clone Wars veteran, I'll do anything!  Sure!
Sounds simple enough.  Sure, I'll do it.
Absolutely.  This is the least I can do for you.
Sorry, I'm unavailable right now.
Sorry, but I'm not interested in helping you with this.
I'm a bit busy right now.  I'm sorry, but I can't do that for you.
Sorry, I can't so this.  I think you should do it yourself, Binna.
What is the toy?
Why did someone shoot at Gen Horosi?
Why is this shirt warm?
What happened to your husband?
I've been told that my friends need urgent help.  I can no longer deliver this toy.  Here.
I just found out my mother is in the Hospital.  I need to go to her.  Could you have someone else deliver the stimpack?
I don't think I'm suited to giving shirts to new mothers.  I'm sorry, but I can't do this anymore.
This is too emotional for me.  I can't handle it anymore.  Get someone else to do this.
Sorry, I had something come up.  I'm off to deliver it right now.
I'm not too sure how to speak to a Clone Wars vet.  I don't want to treat him with less respect than he deserves.
Oh, I haven't given it to her yet.  There was a sandstorm and I didn't want it to get dirty.
I'm not sure yet.  Your slicer friend is -uh-  still working on it.
Hey, friend! I was hoping to talk to you, but I see you're busy. You can check back later if you want some excitement.
I don't know about you, but I could go for a nice, long snooze.
Well, I don't.
Not you, of course.  I was just making an example.
It's been a pleasure, friend. Maybe I can find more work for you later.
I'm sorry. I'd love to chat with you, but you seem a bit too, um...Imperial?  Or maybe not. It's hard for me to tell, but you're definitely not the kind of person who could help me with my troubles.

I'm back home after touring with my band, the Dewback Ramblers. You know us? -- Well, never mind. Our slitherhorn player just arrived on Tatooine, but he got suckered by the old "free transport to Bestine" con game. He's stranded in the desert and needs an escort. Can you help?

The Ommni Box player in our band is kind of a prankster. He travelled here to Tatooine using the wrong travel papers. I guess he never should have given his name as "Lord Vader." Anyway, the authorities are after him, so I need  you to bring him here safely. Okay?

Our mandoviol player is -- well, he's a wonderful guy, really, but he has kind of an attitude about Imperials. When he arrived here, some Imperial Security Bureau agents questioned him. And he sort of, well, bit one. Now he's on the run out in the desert. Can you bring him here?
Great! If you save him from being swallowed by some gorg, he'll probably play you a command performance!
That's great. Look for Mellaw Doowon, an Ithorian, one of those hammerheads. Quite a joker, Mellaw is. Good luck!
I knew I could count on you. Remember, look for a small Chadra Fan named Baze Joz. And please don't bring the ISB with him!
Oh. Well, all right. Hope someone can help my friend.
Oh. Well, okay. I guess someone else will get this exciting assignment.
Oh no! I thought I could count on you. And it was likely to be pretty exciting, too.
His name's Mixon Guncher. If you've heard of him, none of that stuff about his weird behavior is true. Well, not much. He does wear a lot of perfume. Anyway, will you help?
His name's Mellaw Doowon. Once, right before a gig, he filled my kloo horn with foaming cleanser. The suds, the suds! He's a real kidder. Can you bring him here, please?
He's Baze Joz, only the smoothest mandoviol player in the Outer Rim! I've known Baze a long time, and no matter what anyone tells you, all those rumors are completely false. Will you escort him here?
Okay, that's fine.  Let me know when you've brought him back.
Okay.  Let's hope he hasn't run afoul of those armored goons.
He should be smooth with you as long as he knows I sent you.  Just let him know that, okay?
Oh, the trip has tired me out. I do feel faint
Hmph! You wanna talk about humans who can't take a joke --!
Ik-ik! I'm about ready to kill somebody!
He was killed? Oh no! This is terrible. What will happen to the band? I guess we have to cancel this gig.
Oh. Well, all right. Hope someone can help my friend.
Oh. Well, okay. I guess someone else will get this exciting assignment.
Oh no! I thought I could count on you. And it was likely to be pretty exciting, too.
Is this Mixon? What has he done to his face now? Never mind. Please take this payment for your time. Hope the trip was exciting!
Thanks, friend! After this, I expect Mellaw will restrain his natural good humor around stormtroopers. Other Dewback Ramblers are on the way, so I'll offer you more excitement soon!

Thanks, friend! I hope this is the last excitement the Dewback Ramblers see for a while. I can't pay you in credits this time, or our gig won't even cover the costs. I do have this old organ that none of us use anymore though. It's yours if you can haul it out of here.
Smooth. We must locomote, friend -- I believe the wild things here like my perfume.
I was just about to turn myself in and claim I'm the Emperor in disguise. That probably wouldn't have worked, I guess. Let's vamoose!
Well, not you, not if Blerx sent you. I'll just watch you do the killing.  Take it away, maestro!
Have you left yet to pick him up?
Were you able to find him?
Did you have any problems with him?
Yes, I can help.
Sure, I'll go rescue the guy.
As long as he doesn't bite me too, sure.
Sorry, I've got other things I need to do.
That's his own fault.  Sorry, I don't tangle with Imperials.
No, this guy sounds dangerous.
Who is this slitherhorn player?
Who is this musician?
Who is the musician this time?
I just found out that I'm needed elsewhere.  You'll need to ask someone else.
I can't find him, and I'm tired of looking.  I can't help out anymore.
You know, this guy scares me.  I'm not going to be able to help after all.
Not yet.  I was getting some desert survival gear.  I'll be leaving soon.
Nope.  I'm still looking, though.
Not yet, I haven't.  I'll find out soon enough.
I'm sorry, friend. It seems you still have unfinished work. Seek me out when your job is completed.
Sorry, but I'm waiting for a friend.
Huh?  Oh, sorry about that.  I'm... um... practicing a role for an audition.
What?  You're not dead?  Hmm... I'll have to work on that a little more.
Maybe I can find you some more work later. Take care of yourself.
I said grenades, friend.  I don't know what this is, but it's sure not a case of grenades.
I recently came into possession of a datadisc that would be of great interest to the Alliance. Care to handle the delivery for me?

I recently met an exceptional young lady. She may have certain -- gifts, if you take my meaning. I understand an Imperial stormtrooper is bringing her in for questioning. Would you mind escorting her here before the Imperials pick her up?
I recently hired someone to acquire some grenades. He accepted payment and got the grenades but has been reluctant to actually deliver them. I was wondering if you'd go get them from him?
I thought you might be interested. You have that on-the-go look about you. Bring this disc to Teng Winstel -- he's one of my contacts in the Alliance. May the Force be with you, my friend.
That's what I hoped you'd say.

Ah, I thought you might enjoy a bit of shadier work. I suppose it takes a rogue to spot one. Karn Wilder is your quarry. He's not terribly trustworthy, but I never thought him so stupid as to cross me.
No problem. I'll find someone else. Good luck to you.
Not your style, eh? Don't worry about it, I'm sure somebody will be willing to help her.
I guess it was a bit much to ask of you. Forget I mentioned it.
I beat Han Solo's Kessel Run speed record! Granted, I wasn't hauling any cargo at the time, but it still counts. Now, about that job offer --
I mean that she may have some ability to use the Force. She's already had some run-ins with the Empire, so I need a decision, if you please.

Well, yes. Technically that's still true. It wasn't me doing the smuggling, was it? I still occasionally help procure scarce items for the Alliance. I do have bills to pay, after all. Now, your decision?
He doesn't have all day.  Could you please hurry?
Okay, but you may not have much time left.  Please hurry.
Hmph.  You could've just said you hadn't got around to it yet.  Let me know when you have, okay?
Are you the one with this 'important' package I'm supposed to wait for?
Okay... I'm reaching out with my mind...
You're not getting anything from me. Die!
No problem. I'll find someone else. Good luck to you.
Not your style, eh? Don't worry about it, I'm sure somebody will be willing to help her.
I guess it was a bit much to ask of you. Forget I mentioned it.
Well done, my friend. Thank you for your help. Feel free to see me again if you need more work.
You've been a big help. We can't let the Empire continue its wretched work. By all means, contact me again if you need more work.
A stellar job, if I may say so. I'd say you have an impressive future ahead of you -- a much better place for the future than behind you, no?
I wonder what BoShek's found now? He does infiltrate himself into the most unusual situations. Thanks.
I'm not sure why people think I have a connection with the Force. Ever since that idea got around, my life has been lots more interesting.
So, did Teng get the package yet?
Were you able to save her in time?
So, were you able to get the grenades from him?
Sure, I've got nothing else to do.  Tell me what you need.
Sure.  I'll make sure she gets here before the Imperials get her.
Sure, I'll get them from him.
No thanks.  I don't want to get conned by some 'reformed smuggler'.
Sorry, but that's not my type of work.
No, I'm not mixing myself up with explosives.  Sorry.
Why would I have heard of you?
What do you mean, "gifts"?
Why grenades? Didn't you say you weren't a smuggler any more?
I'm sorry, but I didn't know this had to do with the Rebellion.  I can't do this for you anymore.
You know, I don't want to get involved with this 'Force' stuff.  Sorry, but I'm no longer interested.
I'm actually a bit afraid of grenades.  What if he throws one at me?  I can't do this after all.
Not yet.  I'm about to meet up with him soon.
Not yet.  I was making sure there was a safe way out of there first.
Ummm... he hid them, and... ummm... I just found out where.  I'm going to get them right now.
I'm a very demanding patron. Come back when you've less on your plate.
Who are you?  Are you some kind of promoter?  If not, get out of my face.  I've got... things to do, I guess.
Oh, thank you!  I'll do what they say next time!
Not bad at all. I'll consider using you again in the future.
You'd help a girl like me? Isn't that sweet. Turns out, I do need something delivered to a business associate. Well, a future business associate, I hope. Think you can handle a simple delivery?

I like your enthusiasm. But the task I have in mind is slightly more perilous. A dear friend of mine has fallen in with the wrong crowd and is in desperate need of rescuing. This might be a bit too dangerous for the average mercenary. You sure you want in?

I confess I've gotten used to you coming to my "rescue." However, I just have one last little thing for you to do and then I'll let someone else enjoy your talents. I need a particular warehouse taken out. And when I say that, I mean burned to the ground. I know that sounds simply awful. Think you can do it anyway?

I knew this would be no problem for a tough-looking mercenary like you. Take this encrypted datadisc to Lam Bregaani, a Sullustan swoop jockey whose career I've been following closely these last few months. If he asks, tell him that everything has been taken care of.

I knew you were made of sterner stuff. My friend's name is Idee Zipbits. He's a Chadra-Fan swoop jockey. Not terribly brave, but pretty good in a race. If you bring him back here, I'd show an appropriate amount of gratitude.
I knew you'd come through for me! Now just to give you a heads-up, there might be some undesirable elements loitering around the warehouse. They're most likely cutthroats so just blast them.
It's not nice to feign interest in my affairs then refuse to help. Nobody likes a tease.
I understand, although I am a bit disappointed. I thought there was something extraordinary about you.
Now you've gone and made me all pouty. I hope you enjoy toying with my emotions. Soon a girl won't know whom to trust.
A proposition. Of the business variety, of course. But one so compelling that I think my future partner will not be able to refuse it. Still interested?
I'm afraid that Lady Valarian has taken an unhealthy interest in my friend's affairs. That Whiphid is not someone you want to cross. Is it?
Just some speeder parts and gadgets. Perhaps an old swoop racer or two. It's an eyesore, really. I'm sure no one will be sad to see it go.
Well, don't be a tease, friend. He's waiting for you as we speak.
I am hoping you will be able to do so in a much quicker fashion.  You wouldn't want to upset me, would you?
That's why I've chosen you.  You strike me as someone who is a consumate professional.
This better not be some kind of trick.  It's not like I have anything better to do, but still.
Help!  Help!
It's not nice to feign interest in my affairs then refuse to help. Nobody likes a tease.
I understand, although I am a bit disappointed. I thought there was something extraordinary about you.
Now you've gone and made me all pouty. I hope you enjoy toying with my emotions. Soon a girl won't know whom to trust.

I'm much obliged, citizen. Hope you didn't have too much trouble on the way. Oh, and Lam has a very vivid imagination. Kindly disregard anything he might have said. One too many crashes can addle a swoop jockey's mind.
You've brought Idee back all in one piece. I knew I could count on you! Now allow a girl to show her appreciation. Take this and enjoy yourself.
I gotta hand it to you, friend, you're one tough sand panther. Thanks for all your help. I think my business venture will go quite smoothly now. Take care.
If these bank codes are valid, then I'll be sure to "crash" on the second lap of the race. Make sure your boss has my transport off this rock ready to go.
Help! I'll do whatever the Tonnika sisters want! Just save me from these killers!
Did Lam have anything... positive... to say?
Have you been able to convince Idee to come with you?
Have you demolished the place yet?
Sure, I can do it.
Count me in!
I'll see to it that there is only smoke and debris when I'm done.
No thanks.
In that case, no thank you.
Not thanks.  Arson isn't my style.
What would I be delivering?
Who has your friend fallen in with?
What's in the warehouse?
Sorry, but something came up.  I can't do this for you anymore.
I've changed my mind.  I don't want to do this after all.
Count me out.  I'm not too keen on the idea of arson.
I don't know.  I haven't talked to him yet.
Not yet, but he'll understand in time.
No, I'm still making the explosives.  This takes time.
Welcome to Mos Taike, friend.  I hope you enjoy our settlement while your here.  When you're not busy, why don't you stop by.  I could use someone like you.
I don't know who you are or what you want, but I'm not the guy you're looking for.
Hey.  Who're you?  Do I know you?  No, I don't.  And let's keep it that way, okay?
Are you my Imperial contact?  Hmmm... no, you're not the person I'm here to meet.  Sorry, I have nothing to say to you.
You aren't the repair engineer I'm waiting for.  If you see him, you tell him I'm waiting, and the longer I wait, the more sense I'll beat into him.
You have a talent for this. Maybe I'll have more work for you in the future.
This isn't what the Aqualish stole.  I'm only interested in that.
No, she has a special medicine she needs for her breathing.  Sadly, only the one that Sithrin has will help the girl.
No, this isn't the datadisk.  I'm only interested in seeing that Farandan is dead and his datadisk is in safe hands.
Hmmmm... no, I don't think this is something Thanamiroc would have had on him.  Bring back something that would identify him.

Well, hey! I guess you're new to Mos Taike. Welcome - or maybe sympathies, given that this is a backwater town on the galaxy's backwater-iest world. But even here, one person can make a difference. In fact, I'm looking for someone to go after a local crook. Can you handle a fight?

Hey, hello again! Kli Sithrin is in town, that big Zabrak gangster in -- Anchorhead, I think. He stole a medpack right out of a little girl's hand. Doesn't that make your blood burn? If you take this guy out of circulation, I'll cheer you on. Bring me the medpack, and I'll give it back to the little girl. Okay?

Look at you, you're back! Seems like every time I see you, I have trouble to report. Jespral Farandan, a big figure in an offworld terrorist ring, is hiding out near here. Best hideout in the galaxy, really. But he's planning a new attack, and he has information crucial to our defenses, so it would be great if you could stop him, okay?

Hey, you're riding to my rescue yet again, friend. Word comes down from Mos Eisley that a known murderer and master of disguise, Trone Thanamiroc, is on another homicidal killing spree. He hijacked a vehicle and is rampaging around. Someone has to stop him, but I'm stuck here. Can you handle a tough target?
That's great! Remember, this Aqualish - one of those tusk-faced guys - stole a shield generator. He may be using it for defense, so let fly with everything you've got. Bring back the generator, okay?
Hey, that's really friendly. Look for a tough Zabrak with orange skin and slashing tattoos on his face. Even his horns have got horns, they say, so watch out. Bring the medpack back here.

That's great. This Farandan - I should warn you, he's wearing a Rebel Alliance uniform. But trust me, he's not a Rebel. Hey, I'm not trying to start a political discussion here; he's just not, that's all. If you find a datadisk on him, you'll bring that back here, right?

Good! The Mos Eisley office planted a homing beacon on his vehicle, so you should be able to find him. Be sure to bring back proof of his defeat, like his helmet or something. For once I can promise you a terrific reward!
Okay, I just wanted to ask. Enjoy your stay in our little place.
Well, you know how to use your time better than I do. See you around, friend.
Not a problem, friend. You can find plenty of useful things to do around here without my help.
I was afraid you were going to say that. This troublemaker has been terrorizing folks across Tatooine. But okay, friend, we'll take him out somehow.
His name's Thark. He's a rude, obnoxious Aqualish - not to be redundant - and he's a menace to free people in this town.
I couldn't tell you. Maybe he just wanted to show off. These Anchorhead gangsters like to mark their territory, just like a womp rat.

If you start believing crooks, you'll never get justice. If you're uncomfortable taking down the folks who make this galaxy unsafe - and I guarantee that's who you're fighting - then say "No." So, friend, what's your answer?

Hey, Thanamiroc can look like anything. Farmers, Sand People, Imperial soldiers, Rebels, baby banthas, you name it. Just kidding about the banthas. Whatever he looks like, he's always trouble. What do you say?
Well, try to get it back from him soon.  He's probably looking to sell it to make some quick credits, so we might not have much time.
Well, try to get it done fast.  Her mother let me know her breathing is getting more and more shallow as time passes.  She needs that medicine real bad like.
Well, let's hope you're able to find him before he enacts his latest dastardly plot.
Well, you'll want to do it soon, or you'll wind up tracking him down by his trail of dead bodies he'll leave in his wake.
Don't attack, you stupid lout, I'm an Imperial informant! I confiscated this generator from an insipid thief before it reached the Rebels. I - argh, never mind, I'd rather kill you!

That's close enough. What brings you here? A stolen medpack? I stole no medpack. If you must know, I'm meeting here with an ISB official. Hold on, I told you an Imperial secret. Now I suppose I'll have to kill you. Mangler - attack!
So. I must say, those Rebel scum found me out remarkably quickly. I'm about to make my first report to the ISB. In it I shall recount your death.
Finally you're here. Get this thing running, imbecile, or I'll have you beaten senseless. Wait - you're no repair engineer! A trap!
I feel bad for sending you out to get hurt like that.  Better luck next time, eh?
That poor little girl.  What's she going to do without that medpack?
Man I knew that guy was trouble.  Sorry you couldn't handle it.  Maybe I should have gone myself?
Wow.  I really thought you could handle that.  Guess I was wrong, huh?
Well, I guess so.  Let's hope he doesn't sell that generator to some Jawas in the meantime, though.
Sure, I understand.  I do hope that little girl doesn't get any sicker in the meantime, though.  That sure would be a shame, wouldn't you agree?
Well, I don't want you to get yourself killed.  I'll try to find someone else to stop him before it's too late for us all.
Well, I'm sorry to hear you can't handle this one.  Then again, I don't blame you; this guy is vicious.  I'll look into hiring a Bounty Hunter.  I just hope I have enough credits to afford the best.

Excellent, friend! I'm glad you see we all have to work together for our safety and freedom. I'd like to reward you with money, but I'm just a junior officer. Here, my sister made this casserole. It's delicious!

Thanks, that was fine work. Did Sithrin say anything? Well, when you corner these gangsters, they'll try everything. Did you like my sister's casserole? Try her soup. Takes a while to make, but mmm, worth it!

That's another favor I owe you, friend. I wouldn't put any stock in anything that fellow said; you know these crooks, after all. I wonder if you'd like some fresh flatbread my sister just brought? Have to eat it quick, or it goes all greasy.

Thanamiroc was passing himself off as a bounty hunter, eh? That's an ironic twist - wonder if he could have collected a bounty on himself. Ha! Hey, thanks again. Here's the best reward you'll find in Mos Taike: my sister's specialty! Don't show it around, or everyone will want a slice.
So, have you managed to round up that Aqualish and recover the generator yet?
So, do you have the medpack yet?
So, have you managed to put a stop to him and gather that datadisc?
Have you put an end to Thanamiroc's reign of terror?
Sure I can handle a fight!  Point me at him!
I can't stand by and watch a little girl have her medicine stolen.  I'll get it back for her!
I'll gladly help you stop this terrorist!
I can handle this guy.  Point me at him!
No, I'm not one for fighting.
A gangster?  No, I'm not getting involved with that kind of trouble.
No, I think this is better handled by you.  I'd just wind up getting killed.
No, he sounds too dangerous for me.
Who is this local crook?
Why did Kli Sithrin steal the medpack?
Is this one really a gangster? The others didn't talk like crooks.
"Master of disguise"? What's he dressed like?
I'm not able to handle this guy right now.  Could I track him down later?
Bren, I'm not able to get to Kli Sithrin just yet.  Would you mind if I recovered it later?
I don't think I'll be able to stop him, or get that datapad.  You might want to send someone else to do it.
I'm sorry, but this guy is too dangerous for me.  I think you need to send someone else to do it.
Not yet, but I'm working on it.
Not yet, but I'm going to get that medpack back for her.  I promise!
No, not yet, but when I do, I'll make sure to get it to you right away!
Not yet, but when I do, I'll be sure to bring back proof that he'll no longer hurt anyone else.
When I hire someone, I expect his or her full attention. Come back when you're ready to talk business.
Get out of here, slug!
Gordul says get out of here!  Gordul doesn't know you!
Nevermind.  I thought you were working for Farious.
Oh, sorry.  I thought you were someone else.  Nevermind.
I don't have anything for ya right now. Maybe later.

Eventually they all come 'round here looking for work, so I don't see why you should be any different. Yeah, I got something for you to do, but it'll require a strong stomach and nerves of durasteel. This ain't for the squeamish. You still interested?

Eager for more work, huh? Ambitious little scoundrel, ain't ya? Okay, I got something else for ya. One of my enforcers has decided he doesn't need me anymore and has gone into business for himself. I need you to show him that without me he has no future. And yeah, that means blast the slug into space dust.

Of course I have something for you to do! Here's the deal: I bought some, uh, merchandise from a dumb thug named Ripper. I paid fair market price, but now he's tryin' to twist my arm for more credits. I need you to make this problem go away. Ripper's a known gangster and responsible for many deaths, so you can consider this a public service.

You gotta stop a maniac from trying to bump off the Imperial Prefect! This killer is under the delusion that I've hired him! You gotta stop this madman before he gets us all killed! The Empire's revenge will be swift and brutal if they think I..we had anything to do with this!

Let's see what you're made of, pal. A Rodian thief that goes by the name Greenfinger is trying to skip town without paying his debts to me. That ain't acceptable. I need you to track this loser down and make an example of him. You can keep whatever he's carrying as a tip. Just make sure his passing is violent and painful.

That's what I was hoping you'd say. You're shaping up to be my kind of enforcer. Now go out there and teach that Aqualish he shouldn't mess with Farious Gletch! Use caution, he may have some friends with him.
Now that's the enforcer I've come to know and love! Just remember, this worm is dangerous. Don't take any chances. Blast him as soon as you see him!

I knew you'd come through for me! You're a lifesaver, pal! The lunatic goes by the name of "Professor Whisper." Yeah, yeah, I know - but what do you expect from an insane assassin? Anyway, he's a Bith and he's deadly. Did I mention he was insane? Stop him before he brings down the wrath of the Empire on my head!
I figured you for one of those squeamish types. I ain't got use for beings like you. Beat it!
What's wrong? You're not afraid of a near-sighted Aqualish, are you? And here I thought you had guts and the ambition to rise quickly in my organization. Why do I keep trying?
Are you really backing out on me now? What a punk!
No? Did you just say no? You can't say no! You gotta help me! Who else can I turn to? Please!
I need you to make a deadbeat disappear. Permanently. You still interested?
The brute's an Aqualish named Gordul Koga. He's one mean gundark so start blasting as soon as you see him. You'll do it, right?
He's one of Jabba's murderous swoopers. And I don't need to tell you how dangerous those slugs are, do I? Will you take this slime out of the gene pool or not?

Maybe because he's insane? And maybe I mentioned in passing, as a harmless comment to someone in the street, that this place would be better off without the Prefect. But how was I supposed to know this Bith would overhear my conversation and take me seriously? I blame this mixup on their overly-acute hearing and an inability to take a joke!
What am I paying you for!  Get it taken care of!
I don't have all day!  Get it done, or don't do it at all!
What are you waiting for!?  Kill him already!
Well, hurry it up already!  I'm not paying you to waste my time!
Gletch sent you, didn't he? I've dealt with your kind before. Just try and take me, slug!
Think you can take me? Gordul will crush you!
Gletch thinks he can cheat me? No one takes my glitterstim without paying for it! Die!
I'm a professional. If Gletch wanted the contract terminated, he should have contacted me. Now both of you will have to die.
I figured you for one of those squeamish types. I ain't got use for beings like you. Beat it!
What's wrong? You're not afraid of a near-sighted Aqualish, are you? And here I thought you had guts and the ambition to rise quickly in my organization. Why do I keep trying?
Are you really backing out on me now? What a punk!
No? Did you just say no? You can't say no! You gotta help me! Who else can I turn to? Please!
Now that was well handled, friend. Perhaps I misjudged you. I think you and I will get along just fine. Hehehe, yeah, just fine.
You're growing on me, buddy, you know that? You just keep removing these obstacles for me and your future will be prosperous.

Ha, ha! I would love to have seen the look on old Ripper's face when you introduced him to some blaster bolts! Oh, and if he claimed I never paid him, he lied. Do I look like the kinda guy that would try and cheat someone? On second thought, don't answer that.

Phew, you're a lifesaver. Well, for me at least ,hehe. I don't have anything else I need done right now. In fact, think I need a vacation to let things calm down some. Look me up when I get back and we'll get back to business.
Have you done away with that Rodian yet?
Have you sent the 'message' to Gordul yet?
Have you taken care of the gangster?
Has the 'Professor' been put out of business?
Yeah, that's my kind of job.  I'll do it.
Sure, I'll do it.
I'll take him out of the picture for you.
I'll take care of it. Count on me.
Nah, that doesn't sound like something I want to do.
No, that's not my style.
No, I'm not interested in doing this for you.
No, this is your mess, not mine.  Get someone else to clean it up.
What do I have to do?
What does this enforcer look like?
Tell me more about Ripper.
Why is this assassin under the impression that you hired him?
I'm not able to do this for you any longer.  Sorry.
I no longer have the time to take care of this 'problem' for you.
I've changed my mind.  I'm not going to do this for you anymore.
I've thought about what I said earlier, and realize I meant to say 'No' to doing this for you.
No, not yet.
No, not yet!  I'm still working on it.
Not yet.  I'm still getting around to it.
No, he hasn't been taken care of yet.
Ahh, you're a busy one. I see, I know. Smooth your moves and relax, friend. Hark to the sounds. Check on back here when you're free.
If you don't know who I'm talking about, get away from me.  I don't have time for you.
Did it look like I was talking to you?  Look, get some people, then have them get in touch with mine.  Okay?
*Snork snork* *grunt*
Perhaps one day fate will provide me with more work for you. Until that day my friend, farewell.
My night-time heart has cried, leaving with the day these discs of teardrops -- love letters to my sweetheart. Carry them to her. Carry my plea for affection and understanding.
A tendril of light reached down from the stars and touched my brow. In inspired fever I composed this song of love. Send it, carry it to the one who will most appreciate its feeling.

Seems I have a new fan. A storm-drenched spirit, drying and shriveling in these desert suns. He looks to me for guidance, but no. For this young spirit, I am too weak. I disappoint him. For that shriveling fan, this note of apology and hope, hand-delivered to him by you.
Dilta waits, she waits alone, out in that empty waste beneath a burning sky. Head out on those lonely old sands, my friend, my friend's friend.
Out in the wide, wild desert, friend -- that is your destination. Free of prying eyes, understand me? Go. My song must fly to the right heart.
Go, my friend. Head out to that windblown sand, where my fan waits in a desolation of the spirit. Hurry, now.
Our roads diverge now, my friend, but chance may bring us back together once again.
We each must follow our own road, friend. Someday, perhaps, our paths may cross again. Farewell.
Not a problem, friend. Head down your road, I'll head down mine, and maybe we'll meet again.
Ahhh, Dilta. A sweet sultry voice, a cool finger on the brow, a single star's gleam in a night-black eye -- that is Dilta. You'll like her. Go ahead, take my little job.
Be smooth, my friend, and do not pry into affairs of the heart. Only this: Seek one called Bex, whose true feeling for this work you will see. Please, take this tiny task.

Just one more wounded spirit, like you and me. Lonesome, troubled folk fall into my music, get uplifted, get shaken. Like my music to them, that's my fans to me -- they lift me up, they shake me down. My little task awaits your choice.
My heart will fly long until it is held by that sweet Dilta.
The crystalline moons will weep when the harmony is heard.
He's waiting with his soul on his wing.
Are you one of that loser's friends?  You look like one.
If I find out that Bith suckered me, I'll...
*Snort*
Our roads diverge now, my friend, but chance may bring us back together once again.
We each must follow our own road, friend. Someday, perhaps, our paths may cross again. Farewell.
Not a problem, friend. Head down your road, I'll head down mine, and maybe we'll meet again.

Ahh, that Dilta -- she is the spirited one. But I am smooth. I calm the troubled wind. My lament will melt her icy heart. And you, my friend -- to you, as to Dilta, I owe more than this sad token may express.
My friend, Bex Lobber carries a weight in his heart, and in his fist. Perhaps my little love-ditty will relieve both. I only wish I could pay you more, friend. And Bex too.
Life, life. I'm going down that lonely road, smooth mover. I feel a pressing need to move on. Take this little something and move on, too.
This better be the credits from that deadbeat Figrin. Tell him this: Any guy who plays sabacc that bad needs better cash flow.
I better have an exclusive distribution deal on this song, or I'll jam that welsher's big musician head into a really small hat.
Hnnnrrgh!
My protestations of deep emotion made it into her dear hands, I hope?
The melodic tones have reached the heart and ears of the chosen, I hope?
I'm hearing hearts shattering in the wind.  Is this the sound of my fan's faith?
Sounds like you need help.  I'll do it.
I shall be your emmisary of love, Figrin!
Sure, I'll give it to him.
That sounds too personal.  No, I'd feel wierd doing it.
You're too wierd.  No, I won't do this for you.
I'm tired of talking to you.  No, do it yourself.
Who is this "sweetheart"?
Who is receiving this love song?
Who is the fan who looks to you for guidance?
I don't like playing a go between.  You'll have to do it yourself, afterall.
I don't know what this is about, and I don't want to do it anymore.
Okay, I'm done with you.  You are just way too mellow for me.  Do it yourself.
Sorry, not yet.  I'll make sure she gets them soon, though.
Not yet.  I'll get it to the... um... wherever I'm taking it.  So, be calm - or something like that.
I don't know what you just said.  If you mean 'Did he get the letter', then - No, not yet.
How ya doin'? See me about a job when you get tired of your current employer.
Sorry, I was talking to myself.
Thanks for your concern, but I can handle this.
I don't have any more work for ya right now. Try me later.
No, this won't work.  I need a coupling.
This is not a converter coil, friend.  I need a coil so that I can get home again.
I just finished a repair, and I need someone to make the delivery for me. Whaddya say?
I cobble together lots of parts for moisture farmers. Some Tusken Raider is running around blasting any vaporators he comes across. You willing to find him and stop him from wrecking anything else?

My girlfriend, Camie, called. Her speeder hit an eopie in the desert. I need someone to bring her a new converter coil so she can get it running again. The speeder, not the eopie. Would ya mind bringing it to her quick?
Nice to see a little initiative for a change. A fellow named Vezz Kommani has been waiting on this power coupling. Take it to him out in the desert, away from prying Imperial eyes.
I know the folks 'round here would appreciate it. They've been a bit jumpy lately worrying about it.
I sure appreciate it. I don't want her out there any longer than she has to be, so take this part and get moving.
Afraid of a little hard work, are ya? Too bad. Tosche Station's got no place for lollygaggers.
I didn't figure ya for the shy type. Shove off.
Kind of a heartless womp rat, aren't ya? Get out of here!

Well, have you heard of Luke Skywalker?  Heck, yeah! We grew up together. I always knew he'd be something special. What a speeder pilot. Maybe that's where you heard of me... no, it couldn't have been that, could it?  But look, you interested in this job?
How should I know? Them Tuskens all hate our technology. I'd worry less about why, more about how ya might stop him.
Of course I have a girlfriend! What's so hard to believe about that? Now, you want to help her or not?
Good to hear!
Sounds good!  Let me know when he's been stopped.
Great!  Get it to her fast.  I don't want her to get a sunburn.
Where in the heck is that part?
Phew, I thought I was going to be that dewback's dinner for sure. Thanks!
Hey, can you come back later?  I gotta deal with something before we can continue...
Hey, can you come back later?  I gotta deal with something before we can continue...
Hey, can you come back later?  I gotta deal with something before we can continue...
Afraid of a little hard work, are ya? Too bad. Tosche Station's got no place for lollygaggers.
I didn't figure ya for the shy type. Shove off.
Kind of a heartless womp rat, aren't ya? Get out of here!
Ya done good. See me again if ya need more work.
Way to work. That'll be a load off everybody's mind. Now try to hang on to a few of these credits this time, hear?

Camie called -- she got home just fine. Thank you so much! If she had been eaten by that dewback, I don't know what I would have done. I don't have anything else I need help with right now, but check back later. Maybe something will come up.
Finally! Now to get this installed so I can get off this desert rock. Thanks!
Fixer sent you with the parts I need to fix my speeder? Thanks a million!
So, did you get it to him?
Has that crazed Tusken been stopped yet?
So... did she get the part?
Sure.
No problem.  I hate Tuskens with a seething passion.
Sure, I'll get it to your *ahem* girlfriend.
No thanks.
I usually leave well enough alone.  Let the Tusken do what he wants.
Okay, now you're making up stories.  I don't believe you have a girlfriend, so I'm not going to help.
Don't I know you?
Why is the Tusken destroying vaporators?
Do you really have a girlfriend?
Sorry, but I've changed my mind.
I can't do this anymore.  Sorry.
You're sending me on a wild cu pa chase, aren't you?  I'm not doing this.
Not yet.  I'm still getting it done, though.
No, but I'm now equipped to take care of him.
No, I haven't found her yet.  I'm going to try right now, though.
The Tusken Raiders has been spotted at this location.
Tusken Raiders
You! Can you help --? Oh. Never mind. I see you're busy. Maybe you could check back later, assuming I'm still stuck on this rock.
I'd hire you again but I hope to be off of this miserable desert hole really soon. Check back with me if you have time, you never know when something might foul up my plan to get out of here.

A couple of stormtroopers are headed this way. I really severely don't need to see them. If you dispose of them, I'm that much closer to getting out of this backwater. Except, excuse me, there's no water! Back-dump! Back-pit! Help me!
The hunt is intensifying. But if you destroy this one mounted trooper, you'll make it look like I'm somewhere other than here. That might divert the search. Interested?

I can't shake the rest of the patrol. This is the toughest bunch yet -- probably three or four troopers plus the leader. If you take them out, you'll clear the way for my mad dash to Mos Espa. What do you say?
Great. Get to the troopers and shoot them before they can report on my whereabouts. Watch out for sandtraps. I hate all this sand.
Okay, good, good. The trooper has a dewback, and the mount may make trouble too. Endless excitement in this dismal sandtrap.
I won't forget what you're doing for me. You're risking a lot to bail me out of a tough, tough spot. Good luck!
Yeah, I wouldn't look forward to facing stormtroopers either. Thanks anyway.
I absolutely don't blame you. Not my idea of a fun time. I expect I'll just hang back here until they find me or I slowly strangle on dust.
Yeah, I hear that. I feel silly just offering this deathtrap mission. But if I don't get off this barren Sarlacc-pit, I'm gonna dissolve in my own bile.
I'd just finished running a cargo of medical supplies through the Imperial blockade. On my way back up, they caught me. I barely survived the crash. Now I'm stuck on this dessicated rockball. Help!

Stressed! Yeah, you might say that. I woke up this morning and a rock-mite was eating my boots! Just one more attraction here on Tatooine, sun-drenched center for life-threatening recreation. Now, about that trooper --?

The Alliance is arranging a hot new X-wing and a clear docking bay with my name on it, just as soon as I can get there. But there's this matter of the patrol to deal with first. And your choice is --?
Thank you very much, my newly found friend.
I appreciate you helping me.  I didn't think I'd find anybody who cares on this back - ah - backwards planet!
Oh.  Okay, well, I still thank you!  Just say the word!
A hostile! Open fire!
Halt!
There's the target! Fire!
Yeah, I wouldn't look forward to facing stormtroopers either. Thanks anyway.
I absolutely don't blame you. Not my idea of a fun time. I expect I'll just hang back here until they find me or I slowly strangle on dust.
Yeah, I hear that. I feel silly just offering this deathtrap mission. But if I don't get off this barren Sarlacc-pit, I'm gonna dissolve in my own bile.
All right, all right, my life is just that much less terrible. I appreciate your help. If you want more work, I've still got trouble, so check back.
Good news. Okay, it's possible I may actually pull through this. If you've got more time and want more money, check back with me.

I don't believe it! I'm in the clear! You've saved me, my friend! Now I have to get to Mos Espa and jump off this despicable sand-blown crime-ridden Hutt-run krayt-loving hive of scum and villainy. Thanks!
Are there any more of the stormtroopers around?
Was the Mounted Stormtrooper taken care of?
You were able to deal with them already?  Are you a Jedi?
Calm down.  I'll help you.
Sure, I'll lend a hand.
I'll hold them off for you!
I don't want to tangle with Stormtroopers.
Stormtroopers are one thing.  A mounted one is another.  Sorry, I can't help.
Now you're being ridiculous!  I'm not dealing with a whole squad!
How did you crash here?
How are you doing? You look a little stressed.
How are you getting offworld?
I'm sorry, but I've changed my mind.  I can't do this anymore.
Sorry, I've ahad a change of heart.  I don't want to get involved with this guy.
You know what?  I can't help you with this.  This is way to risky!
I believe there are a few left.  I'll take care of the remaining ones shortly.
Not yet.  He's approaching as we speak, so I can take care of him.
Ummm... no, I'm not.  And... um... they're not all taken care of yet.  I'll let you know when to run.
How are you doing there, friend?  I hope you've taken a liking to Mos Taike.  When you've got some time, I might have need of your services.  Let me know when you're free, okay?
Oh, I'm sorry.  I though you were from Mos Taike.  I guess I'll have to find it myself, then.
Sorry, I'm waiting for a bodyguard to keep the Tuskens off my back.  He or she should be here soon.
You don't look like you need Jabba's protection.  Just keep walking and mind your own business.
I'm sorry, I though you were my husband.  Have a good day, and watch out for Tuskens.  I've just taken down four of them myself in the past hour.
Check back with me sometime. I may have more for you to do.

How are you doing there, friend?  My name is Gramm Rile, and I'm what you'd call the mayor around here.  You know, you stopped by just in time.  I'm having a surveyor come here to town to take a look around the place, but judging how late he is, I'd reckon he's lost.  Could you run out there and find him for me?

Nice to see you, friend!  Just to let you know, the surveyor said he agrees with me, and he's going to put in a good report for us.  Hopefully we'll get that garrison out here now.  In the meantime, I'm wondering if you can do me a bit of another favor?  I need you to escort a farmer across the desert so that I can talk with him.  Can you do that?

Blast that Talmont!  Blast all them Imperials, I tell you!!!  Prefect Talmont has decided "it's not a worthwhile expenditure of Imperial resources" and he won't build a garrison out here!  Without their help we're doomed!  Unless.  Well, it won't hurt to talk to him, I guess.  Could you go send a message for me then bring back the response?

I'm not having any part of dealing with that overgrown slug!  I can't believe he'd ask so much for his "help".  That's it, I'm relocating everyone into this town now for the time being.  If those Tuskens want a fight, they'll get one.  Oh, NO!  My wife is out there! Look, you have to bring her back here, understand?

Oh, I sure do appreciate this, friend.  If word got back to Prefect Talmont in Bestine that I'd gone ahead and let his surveyor get killed, well... well, I don't really know what could happen.  When you find him, bring him back here safe and sound, you hear?
Oh, this is good news.  With all the Tusken activity lately, it's got the farmer spooked.  I told him I knew just the person to keep him safe while walking out here.  I'll be waiting, friend.

Okay, look.  I need you to run out to this location and speak to one of Jabba's business associates.  He'll accompany you back here to make sure it's not a trap, so you get him here without a hair harmed on him, okay?  I'll wait here until you bring him back.

Okay, look, I'm entrusting you to bring her back here safely.  She's got the spirit of a bocatt, but that won't help anyone when facing down those Sand People.  You go out to my house and escort her back here safely, you hear?  In the meantime, I'll see to it that everyone else around Mos Taike gets to town safely.
Well, I can't blame you, with all of the reports of Tusken Raiders as of late.  I'll see if I can find someone else to do, but if you change your mind, you be sure to let me know, okay?
I sure do hope you reconsider, friend.  He's not going to come out here unless he has a bodyguard, and I sure do need to speak with him.  If you have a change of heart, I'll be here waiting.

Yeah, if I were in your shoes, I'd say the same. *sigh* Unfortunately, I'm the mayor out here and I've got to look at all of my options.  I wish I had the luxury to walk away as you do.  If you change your mind, let me know okay?  Try to do it before we get attacked by Tuskens again if you could, too...

What?  But I thought... I can't believe you'd leave a person out there to the Tuskens!  I'd do it myself, but I have to make sure everyone else gets the alert.  Look, you think about what you just said, then you think about those Tuskens, you got that?  Then, you come back to me when you realize you want to help.

Well, you see, this is how it is. *sigh* Mos Taike is under threat of attack by Tuskens all the time, and it's beginning to get out of hand.  I've petitioned both Tour Aryon and Prefect Talmont to have an Imperial garrison built here to help defend the town.  They've finally agreed to send a surveyor out here to assess the situation.

Well, not too many people know this yet, so keep it to yourself, okay?  Our main supplier of water lost a couple of caravans recently, and wants to recover her losses by making us pay for it.  I know a farmer out there who's willing to sell us water for the standard price, but he won't travel out here alone.  That's why I need you.

Well, if we can't get protection from the Imperials, we have to look elsewhere.  Jabba has offered his protection in the past, but hasn't given a price for it.  Maybe I can convince him that we don't have much to pay with, but we need his help.  I sure do hope he understands our plight and actually has a heart somewhere in there.

That two-faced, undermining, extortionist was happy to offer his help.  His price was to have Mos Taike send him seven people every year to be his slaves!  I won't have any of that!  If it means we die fighting the Tuskens, so be it, but I won't send anyone to Jabba to be a SLAVE!  I won't have that, I tell you!  Better to die free, then to live a slave!
That's good to hear.  I'll bet anything he's just walking around in cricles, which doens't bode well for a survey for our place.  Well, if you find him, bring him my way, okay?
Well, that's good to hear.  I don't want to see either of you hurt, so take your time.
Well, I don't want to bring down Jabba's wrath on us.  I thank you for you being prudent and all.  Try not to make him wait too long though, if you could.  It would be mighty apppreciated.
I'm glad to see you made it out alive.  Those Raiders can be deadly!  Let's just hope it's not too late for my wife.  You go get her while I direct everyone else in here safely, okay?
Are you here to rescue me?
Are you the one that Rile sent?
What a dangerous place, wouldn't you say.  A lot of bad things can happen out in the desert, if one isn't careful.
Gramm, is that you?  What's going on?
Well, I thank you for giving it your best.  I'll see about having Bren round up a group of people to go find him.  Even though you didn't find him, I do appreciate you looking.
Well, then I guess I'll have to send Bren out there.  I do appreciate you offering to help, either way.
*sigh* Well, I can't blame you.  Were I not so desperate, I wouldn't have asked you to do it.  I guess I'll go out there myself.  I thank you for considering it, though.

Well, if you've been injured, you can't act as an adequate bodyguard.  I'll send someone out there to bring her back.  In the meantime, get yourself to a medic.  Your wounds must be internal, 'cause I don't see any on the outside.

I'm glad to see you were able to find him.  He's a bit shaken up, with all things considered, but once he calms down a bit, I can show him around.  Hopefully this incident will convince him to send a report back to Talmont that'll get a garrison built out here.  Thanks again, friend.

My farmer friend says that he'll keep his rates low, seeing how safe it was to get out here, and all.  Without you, everyone here in Mos Taike would've had to sell themselves into slavery just to afford water.  Hmph... Jabba would've sure loved that.  We're in the clear now, so on behalf of Mos Taike, I give you our thanks!

Well, I thank you, friend. I'm now going to have a sit down with this guy and see if I can convince him to help without him asking too much.  *sigh*  If we weren't so desperate, I'd never consider this.  But you gotta understand, I have to do what I can to keep my people safe.  Surely you see that.

Oh, good, you got her here safely!  You've been a great help, friend.  Just in time, too.  According to Lorne, our security chief, he's spotted another Tusken raid on it's way.  I've been able to get everyone here safely, so we can all join together and bring down these Tuskens.  Once again, thank you friend, you've been a great help!

Oh, thank goodness someone's come to rescue me!  I was down to the last of my food and water!  I've been lost out here in the wasteland for close to 2 hours now!  Please, could you show me the way to Mos Taike?

Well, Rile did say he'd send me a body guard, and you sure do fit the bill.  I'm Merg Thando.  Pleased to meet you.  Now, if we could, let's make our way to Mos Taike before any Sand People catch our scent.
You must be the one who's looking for Jabba's help, hm?  Now, lead me to this backwater settlement, and don't make any false moves, got it?  If I get hurt, Jabba won't be too happy, understand?

Oh!  Gramm is calling everyone into town?  Now I understand why I was attacked by a dozen or so Tuskens about an hour back.  They were tough ones, too!  Took me about 10 minutes before I could take down all of them.  I appreciate your help.  Now, let's go before more return.
Have you managed to find the surveyor yet?
So, have you brought back my farmer friend?
So, where's Jabba's guy?
Is Chastina here in the town now?
Sure!  I'll go find him for you.
Point me at him and I'll get him here safe!
Sounds simple enough.  I'll do it.
By all means!  I'll get out there immediately!
Sorry, but I'm afraid I'd get lost as well.  I can't do that.
No, I've got other plans right now.
I don't think I like where this is going.  No, I won't do it.
No, I don't have time to escort some lady across the sands.  Do it yourself.
Why are you having a surveyor inspect the town?
Who do you want me to pick up?
What kind of message are we talking about here?
Why didn't you take Jabba's help?
I've searched and searched, but I can't find him.  You might need to send out a team for him, because I can't do it anymore.
I won't be able to safely bring him here, sorry.
I've thought about it, and I don't want to be part of any dealings with Jabba.  I can't do this anymore.
I can't escort her back here, Gramm.  I've been... um... injured.  Yeah, I've been injured and can't save her.  Can you send someone else?
No, I haven't been able to find him.  When I do, I'll be sure to bring him back right away!
Not yet.   I thought I saw some Sand People, and was waiting till they passed.  Once they're gone, I'll escort him here.
I haven't been able to make it out there yet.  Once I can safely do it, I'll be sure to bring him back.
No, I.. um... was attacked by Sand People.  Now that they've been dispatched, I can rescue her safely.
I could really use your help. Finish your current task and then see me again.
Sorry, I thought you were a Rebel.  Nevermind.
Have a good journey!  Make sure to watch out for those Krayts while you're at it.
What?  You're no Rebel fool.  Oh.  Ummm... Nevermind what I just said, okay?
That meant for you to get away from me.  Shoo!
There's a little too much Imperial scrutiny to do anything else right now. See me later.

There's a new Imperial Security Bureau initiative called Project Lasercutter. We're trying to fight it. We don't have a lot of time. An ISB agent is on the way to arrest one of our "procurement specialists" right now. Can you stop him?
We've received word that ISB is sending a Lasercutter team to arrest one of our most reliable smugglers. Will you escort her here safely?
We now know how ISB has been finding our smugglers recruits. They've planted a spy in the Alliance recruiting operation. Will you dispatch this turncoat for us?

Turns out it's not the ISB behind Project Lasercutter, but rather the Inquisitorius. Kill the Inquisitor leading the project. With him gone, Lasercutter will be set back months, if not permanently. This will be incredibly difficult, but I'm hoping you'll try. What do you think?
I'm glad to hear it. Intercept and stop the ISB agent before he finds him.
Wonderful. Go and meet our smuggler friend, Jaxa Lian, and bring her back safely. Hurry, so the ISB doesn't find her first.
The informant will be meeting ISB agents out in the desert. Eliminate all of them, but don't get reckless.
You're a good soldier. I wish you all the best. Find this Inquisitor and take him out. He'll be well protected, so get some insurance first, and reserve a spot in the bacta tanks for later.
You'd better go. I have things to do.
If that was a joke, I'm not laughing. No? Stop wasting my time, this is important work.
I can't believe you're backing out now. Goodbye.
I understand. This mission should not be undertaken lightly.
In brief, the Empire is hunting smugglers friendly to the Alliance. This will do nothing good for our supply lines. Will you help us?
I don't know yet, but you can be sure I'm looking in to it. Can we count on your assistance?
His name? Let me check -- Lidek Baws. Recruited on Naboo. Huh! That should have been a giveaway right there. Will you stop him?

I'm not surprised you haven't heard of them -- they're top secret. Inquisitors are skilled agents who work directly for the Emperor. They supposedly have skill with "the Force," not that I believe that. In any case, they're deadly. Will you take the mission?
You'll need to pick up the pace.  I don't know how much time you have left.
You'll need to pick up the pace.  I don't know how much time you have left.
I guess you know what you're doing.  Let's just hope he doesn't find out from someone else first.
Well, once you have that taken care of, go take him down.
Rebel fool!

Dispose of this annoyance.

understand. This mission should not be undertaken lightly.

Well done. Now I just need to track down our information leak.

I'm afraid I'm a very demanding individual and therefore working for me would require your full attention. Do come back when you can offer me that. You won't be sorry you did.
Until that time has come, your life will be filled with false euphoria.

I'm a former initiate of the B'omarr Order that decided not to attempt "enlightenment." My former brothers, however, have different ideas. They've sent one of their bodyguards to either force me back "into the fold" or dispose of me. You look like you may be able to help someone in desperate need.

It seems the B'omarr have hired a bounty hunter to bring me back into their serene embrace. I must have really impressed the abbot during my stay at the monastery. In any case, this bounty hunter will no doubt claim my life if you don't stop them. Will you help?

All right, I admit it! I did steal a sacred scroll from the B'omarr Order! They could care less that I didn't want to achieve "enlightenment" - in fact, the abbot claimed I was a hopeless "sensualist" and had me expelled! Will you please return this scroll to the abbot so I can have peace?

Splendid! I knew you'd appreciate my predicament - you seem a being who knows how to enjoy the finer things in life. The bodyguard is a Gamorrean named Drognuz. He may not understand any other language than violence.

Excellent! The bounty hunter goes by the name of Rath Kanaz. I can tell you now that bounty hunters a very deceptive and cunning individuals. They may hurl some wild and baseless accusations to justify their actions. Don't listen to a word they say - it's all noncense.

Stalwart and true is how I'll describe you from now on! The abbot and his retinue have agreed to meet at these coordinates. Just hand them the scroll and leave. Whatever you do, don't accept an invitation to their monastery. They might try to "enlighten" you once you're there.
Did I mention that I am a most generous being when it comes to rewarding those that save my life? You wouldn't want to miss out, would you? Please change your mind.
But I thought we were good friends? I fear I'm at a loss for words. I'm not accustomed to this sort of treatment from a trusted companion. What is the galaxy coming to?
You can't back out on me now! After all, it was you who left those B'omarr thugs rotting in the desert! I won't get a moment's peace if you refuse to help me. Please reconsider!

It involves surgically removing my brain from my body and placing it in a vat of nutrients. I like my brain where it is, thank you, and have decided that a vat of nutrients is not the finest accommodation the galaxy has to offer.

Oh, he may go on about a stolen precious object or something equally as ridiculous. The B'omarr Order has no doubt deceived the poor soul. Those monks will stop at nothing to convince their hirelings of the justice of their cause. Pay it no mind, friend.

I think it describes the complicated procedures involved in "enlightenment" - which is essentially how to remove and transport a living brain. All I know is that they thought it valuable, so therefore I assumed I could get a good price for it on the black market.
Hurry already!
Well, I guess I'll have to go into hiding until you are able to handle the situation.
Please hurry before they send someone else to kill me!
Grunt!
All the B'omarr want is that sacred scroll. You're in my way and must be removed.
May you come to know the serenity of emptiness, sensualist.
You've failed me.  Come back later if you're feeling more competent.

Well handled, friend. I just hope that's the last I'll hear of those bizarre monks. I'm not sure why they're so interested in harming me when they're supposed to be pacifists. I suppose I have to give up some of my hard earned credits as thanks.

I told you the bounty hunter would make wild claims. I assure you I don't know a thing about any "sacred scroll." I'm glad you're much smarter than the average mercenary, friend. As much as it saddens me to part with these credits, you have earned them.

I shall never forget you my friend. You have brought serenity to my life and have made it possible for me to get back to the important task of living it. I'm running a bit low on credits but I do have this map as a thanks for your help. Supposedly it leads to a treasure but I haven't mustered the courage to go there yet. Be careful if you do.
The scroll.  You have begun your travel down the path of enlightenment, sensualist.  We will watch from afar, but no longer through direct intervention.

Go speak to my assistant, Junelle Astor. She can arrange an appointment for you.

So, I see Junelle has cleared you. Good. I need some surveillance equipment delivered to one of my agents. He's currently investigating a group of Gungans suspected of aiding the Rebellion. Can you do this?

I'm happy to see you're so eager to serve me. Good help is hard to find. Take for example one of my agents, a Gungan loyal to the Empire who has been discovered spying on his traitorous fellows. He's managed to elude his pursuers thus far but fears he will eventually be tracked down. Could you see to it that he makes it back here safely?

This next assignment will require some amount of discretion. Mal Sikander is convinced that our beautiful Queen has sympathies for the Rebellion. This notion is completely ridiculous. One of Sikander's agents has managed to acquire some of Her Majesty's private correspondence. This is unacceptable. Find this traitor, punish him, and retrieve Her Majesty's personal property.

Ah good, a trusted agent. I do hope you've come ready to perform more duties for me. I've managed to discover how Sikander's agent got his filthy hands on the Queen's property. A so-called wandering troubadour helped the High Inquisitor spy on Her Majesty after gaining our good Queen's confidence. I need this criminal apprehended and brought back to me. Can you take care of this?

Just the agent I was hoping to see today. Ready to serve our beloved Queen again? You already know that Her Majesty's kind heart can create situations that are problematic. You must handle another such situation. Our noble Queen had been aiding some Gungan refugees that have now been implicated in treasonous activities. You must travel to the Gungans' camp and silence their leader, Yip Kanoos.

I wouldn't want to rely on just any agent for this next mission. You have proven yourself trustworthy and capable. One of Captain Dallows' lieutenants has been under investigation by Sikander's agents and was observed traveling to the Gungan swamps on unknown errands. My spies tell me that this officer is suspected of being involved with the Naboo Resistance. It is in everyone's best interest if this officer were to disappear without a trace. Can I rely on you?

Good. You should depart immediately. I wish the Gungans would realize how badly their actions reflect on the Naboo and our beloved Queen. If they'd only embrace the Empire, life would be easier for all of us.
Do hurry. Loyal Gungans are hard to come by.
I can see you are a being of breeding and discriminating tastes. Be sure to make an example of this traitor. Away with you.
Excellent. The performer's name is Ryd Rozen. He's a coward and will not resist arrest. Be on the lookout, however, for Sikander's agents.
Good. If Kanoos has bodyguards, dispose of them as well. We must protect the Queen's reputation at all costs.
Excellent. The officer is Lieutenant Leana Kilnar. It's my understanding that she's currently on some mission in the wilds. This is most fortunate, wouldn't you agree?
Are you sure Junelle cleared you? Why go through all that trouble if you had no desire to help?
Remember when I said that good help was hard to find? I think you see what I meant now.
Is it because you feel you can't be discreet? Well, perhaps this is for the best.
I hope you're not refusing for fear of Mal Sikander. I assure you I can shield you from the High Inquisitor's wrath.
I find you refusal to serve Her Majesty both baffling and deeply insulting. I shall have to think on this.
You aren't suddenly becoming squeamish, are you? Developing a conscience at this stage is both overdramatic and inconvenient.
The agent is Eevas Drupper. I'll let him know you're on your way.
The clever Gungan, named Boona Deeks, hid inside the rotting carcass of a bolle bol for a couple of days. So be warned, he might be a touch on the odorous side.
Our beloved Queen is above reproach. That is obvious for anyone to see. A form as graceful and delicate as hers could not harbor such foul treachery. Will you serve her?

Her Majesty is a kind-hearted patron of the arts. No doubt she felt a great swell of pity after hearing this artist perform and likely took him under her wing. Certain unscrupulous individuals take advantage of such kindness.
The brute can tarnish Her Majesty's sterling reputation by making it seem as if she were aiding and abetting Rebel sympathizers. Will you do it?

That's most unfortunate. That Gungan knew the names and locations of several terrorist cells. That information is lost. Ah well.
Her Majesty's private correspondence should not be passed around like some sort of cheap court gossip. I am most disappointed by your failure to acquire that disc.
This musician could have provided us with many answers. Your failure to bring him back vexes me.
Kanoos should not have been allowed to live. Now many more Gungans shall have to die to insure Her Majesty is shielded from false allegations.
Removing Lt. Kilnar would have quieted things down considerably here at the palace and left Sikander frustrated. Your failure means more work for me.
It seems my agent's location has been compromised and he must elude a pursuit. Check back with me later for his new coordinates.
As it turns out, this Gungan agent thinks it's too dangerous for anyone to approach his position at the moment. Check back with me later for an update.
The traitorous thief has gone into hiding. My spies will find him, worry not.
There's been a complication. My spies have lost track of this scoundrel. Check back with me later. He won't escape us for long.
My spies have just informed me that Yip Kanoos has gone into hiding. We'll find him soon. Check back later for the villain's coordinates.
One moment. It seems that Lt. Kilnar is harder to track down than I had anticipated. Check back with me later for her coordinates.
How very disappointing. Come back when you can actually finish what you begin.

Sadelli refuses to leave Tatooine without Soolami, her younger sister.  The poor thing is still in the clutches of the despicable slavers. Sadelli thinks she's being taken to Jabba the Hut as a gift. I knew you'd accept! I'm sure that if you hurry, you can catch Soolami before she's taken to Jabba. Sadelli assures me that the overconfident Woff rarely hires more than one or two thugs to escort his slaves. Please save Soolami!
