No thanks.  That's just not my style.
What?  More?  No, I've already helped enough.
Okay, you're talking about arson here.  I'll have none of that!
What unsavory individuals would I be crossing?
Who are these slavers?
Who's travelling with him?
I don't want to get mixed up in all of this.  Sorry, I can't do this anymore.
I don't want to get mixed up in all of this.  Sorry, I can't do this anymore.
I've changed my mind.  If I do this, I will be as bad as these criminals.  I cannot do this anymore.
No, I'm still working on a way to save her.
No, I'm still working on a way to save her.
No, their terror still reigns.  I shall overthrow their rule soon enough by burning down their hideout, though.
Once you've finished your current job, see me about some more interesting work.
No you're not.  Get out of here before I break yer face, got it?
I'm waiting for a few more things to come together. No doubt I'll find more work for you later.
What's this?  You playing me for a fool?  Give me the stuff!

I plan to become a new force in Tatooine's -- shall we say -- less regulated businesses. First I need to make a few contacts. Then there's only one obstacle to success: Jabba the Hutt. So what do you say? Up for a little risk?
I have high hopes that this partnership will make us both a lot of credits. I need you to get a list of security agents in Jabba's employ, so I can make them a better offer.
I have it on good authority that an assassin will try to kill Lady Valarian. If you find and stop him, I feel certain she would be more favorably disposed toward my deal.
I always enjoy the company of another high-stakes player. First off, I want you to take this business offer to Lady Valarian. She has as little use for Jabba as I do.
You can almost taste those credits, eh? Get to work.

Excellent. We're but a few steps away from our final goal. The assassin was last seen at these locations. Find him before he reaches his target. If he denies working for Jabba, don't be fooled, he's an assassin after all.
I wouldn't have thought you were the shy type. I'll try not to overestimate you again.
Getting cold feet, are we? I suppose I'll just have to get rich without you.
If that's your decision, then I'm afraid our partnership is dissolved.
That Hutt is the messiest businessman I've ever seen, as well as having atrocious table manners. Not to worry, I have it all planned out. Quite a simple affair, really. Your decision?

Through the simplest of means. Take the list from Sil Onda'tek, one of Jabba's trusted thugs, and bring it to me. Sil may not want to part with it, of course, but I'm sure you can persuade him. Your decision?
Jabba, of course. Whoever else would stoop to such a dastardly scheme? How fortuitous that his nefarious deed lets me look out for my future ally. Will you help?
Good.  Let's see that it's done, alright?
I'm not paying you to sit around a chat!  Get to work!
Get on with it then!  It's not like the assassin is just going to wait for you out in the desert!
Heyyy... you the one I'm here to meet, huh?
You picked the wrong side, chump.
You're from Ungasan? That slimeball set me up! You're gonna pay for his mistake!
I wouldn't have thought you were the shy type. I'll try not to overestimate you again.
Getting cold feet, are we? I suppose I'll just have to get rich without you.
If that's your decision, then I'm afraid our partnership is dissolved.
We seem to be laying a foundation for trust. It's important to know whom you can count on. Don't you agree?
Good work. We're one step closer to our goal. Lay low for a bit, and then check back with me.
Excellent. You should seek up Lady Valarian at the Lucky Despot in Mos Eisley. She might have some things she needs help with while I finish things up around here.
I'll make sure this gets where it's supposed to.
Did her messenger get the info?
So, do you have the list yet?
Has the assassin been taken care of?
I like the sound of this.  Yes.
I'll get them for you.
I'll help to get the Lady into our grasp!
No thanks.  I'm not tangling with Jabba.
No thanks.  I think I'm being followed by Jabba's goons.
Whoa!  First Jabba and now Valarian?  You must be on glitterstim.  No!
Why is Jabba an obstacle?
How am I supposed to get this list?
Who sent this assassin?
I've changed my mind.  I'm not getting involved in this.
No, and I won't either!  I QUIT!
I'm no longer doing this.  You get off your posterior and do it yourself.
Not yet.  I'm still working on it.
Not yet.
Not yet.  I'm still working on it.
Hi there. I'm looking for help, so swing back when you're not so busy.
What?  You don't like the blistering heat, the parched air, and the burning suns?  Are you crazy?  This is a paradise!
Never mind.  You're not the kind of person I thought you were.
I don't have anything else for you to do right now. If something comes up later, I'll let you know.
What's this?  I'm not a junk dealer, okay?

I've been trying to help Tatooine's slaves get better treatment. This offends a slaver named Drik Bandrik. He framed me for stealing a droid from some Jawas. Turns out these Jawas are violent. They're after me for revenge. Can you stop them?  If you do I'll give you some souvenirs I have...

Bandrik has planted evidence with Jabba the Hutt that frames me for trying to lead a slave revolt at Jabba's palace a few years ago. The revolt failed, but Jabba's still angry. He's sent a Rodian henchman to get me. Can you stop the assassin?

That slaver Drik Bandrik has framed me again -- this time for killing a moisture farmer. I was nowhere near the murder, and I can prove it. But this local vigilante leader, on Drik's payroll, is leading a mob to lynch me. Please stop them so I can clear my name!

Remember that Bandrik accused me of killing a moisture farmer? Turns out the farmer's not dead. Bandrik paid her to leave town long enough for the lynch mob to do its happy work. I found the farmer. Will you bring her here to me?

With the help of my friend Krin, I've assembled evidence that will clear me of all Drik Bandrik's fake charges. I thought of sending it to the police -- but I have a much more clever idea. Will you deliver this disk to my slicer friend, Thermal Det?
That's great, friend. These Jawas follow a leader called Wittin. They're not like other Jawas -- they're mean. Be careful. And thanks!
Thanks! The Rodian's named Deeng. He's notorious around here as a thug who would kill his own mother. I think he did, actually. Be careful.

Thank you! There's six or eight of them, I think -- local moisture farmers led by a big thug named Sont Toipo. If you stop Toipo, the rest will probably run off. I hope. Try not to hurt them, they're just farmers.
That's good. I'll wait here for you. But don't be surprised if Drik sends his thugs to kill you both. He's got a lot riding on this now.

Great. Thermal's waiting in the desert, away from Drik's prying spies. If you bring him this datadisc, he'll send it where it will do the most good. Don't worry about Thermal -- he looks weird, but he's a fine fellow.
Come on, it's just a bunch of Jawas! Oh well, I hope you'll return to help me if you find time.
It's one Rodian! But okay, I understand. I sure hope I can find someone to get this assassin before it's too late.
Oh, oh, oh. I don' t know what I'll do now. This is bad!
Well, I hope Krin can find her way here alone. She's getting on in years, and the desert is pretty tough.
Oh, bad! I can practically taste my freedom. I'll have to find someone else to make this delivery. Thanks anyway.

Years ago I had a friend -- a slave, like I was -- who later left Tatooine and became a great Jedi Knight. He died in the Clone Wars. I own some nice mementos from his podracing days. He won the Boonta Eve Classic! Interested in helping me?

Once I made a speech about slave treatment in the Mos Espa slave market. Drik found a holo of my speech and had a data slicer copy it into the slave quarters at Jabba's palace. Looks like I'm inciting his slaves. But I've never even been to Jabba's palace! Can you help me?

While I was supposedly killing this farmer, I was in fact rotting in an Imperial jail cell -- arrested for "political agitation," meaning slave rights. They let me go because I was harmless. But I have the arrest record. If you believe me, will you help me clear my name?
The supposed "victim" is a woman named Krin Vel. She's been my friend forever. She helped buy me my freedom. I'd never kill her. Will you bring her here safely?

I don't want to give it away -- but police and the Empire have no reason to arrest Drik Bandrik. There's someone else who does, and Thermal Det can send this evidence straight to that someone. Interested?
Thank you, friend.  Let me know when you've killed them all.
I appreciate your kindness.  I would also appreciate if you would be a little more prompt with this too.  It's only my life and all.
Ummm... I appreciate your zeal, but all I'm asking is that the mob is prevented from killing me.  But, you're the professional here, I guess.
Okay.... when are you planning on bringing her back?
Okay, thanks!
Utinni! Nik-nik! Niwaa taa doo!
Jabba sent me to kill a troublemaker. I'll charge him extra for you!
I don't care whether Kitster's guilty. Drik says he's a troublemaker, and Drik knows best. Get him, guys!
Oh, I missed my beloved Tatooine!
Heya!  You wanna see something cool on the Holonet?
Come on, it's just a bunch of Jawas! Oh well, I hope you'll return to help me if you find time.
It's one Rodian! But okay, I understand. I sure hope I can find someone to get this assassin before it's too late.
Oh, oh, oh. I don' t know what I'll do now. This is bad!
Well, I hope Krin can find her way here alone. She's getting on in years, and the desert is pretty tough.
Oh, bad! I can practically taste my freedom. I'll have to find someone else to make this delivery. Thanks anyway.

That's great news, friend. Drik Bandrik has been busy framing me for other crimes, though, so check back. Meanwhile, here's a souvenir helmet worn by my friend when he won the Grand Arena podraces. Thanks!
That's a relief. But I need to get Drik Bandrik off my tail before this gets any worse. Worse than Jabba! I can't even think of that. Thanks!

You've saved me again, friend! I have a souvenir for you, a droid brain rebuilt by my old friend. He was a real genius mechanic -- once he rebuilt an entire protocol droid. Wonder what he did with that droid?
Thank you! Krin and I will see to it that Drik Bandrik goes to prison for this -- or worse. Hmm, I may need your services again though.

Great job! Thermal sent proof of Drik Bandrik's fraud straight to Jabba the Hutt. Jabba won't like it that Drik played him like a dejarik piece. I expect Drik will find it healthy to visit another world soon. Thanks for all your invaluable help, I'm in your debt.
Smooth! You got the data? Thanks. This weather out here was about to repave my exterior. I gotta get this onto the 'Net, thanks.
I had no idea Drik Bandrik was arranging a frame. As soon as I found out, I rushed back here. Please take me to Kitster!
Have you destroyed all of those little violent creatures?
Is the bounty hunter dead?
Have you killed the leader of the mob?
Is Krin alright?  Where is she?
So, was Thermal able to get this rolling?
I'll take care of those little thieves!
Don't worry, Kitster, I'll save you.
I'll stop them with whatever force is necessary!  Never fear, friend.
Sure, sounds easy enough.
Oh, I like clever plans!  Sure, I'll do it.
No.  Jawas are just misunderstood people.
Look, you've got to earn your living somehow.  I can't help you with this.
I'm not going to try to stop some mob.  Sorry.
No thanks.  If I can't kill something, I'm not interested.
I didn't hear anything about killing in there.  No, I'm not interested.
What kind of souvenirs?
What is the evidence that frames you for the failed slave revolt?
What's the proof you didn't kill the moisture farmer?
Who is the farmer?
What's your clever idea?
I've changed my mind. I'm actually a bit scared of those little guys.  Sorry.
I've come back to tell you that I'm not doing this for you anymore.
I'm sorry.  I just remembered that I'm not a murderer.  You'll have to take care of that yourself.
I've changed my mind.  I don't want to help you anymore.
I haven't killed anything for a while.  I'm dropping this job so I can blow up things.
No, they're too wily.  I'm still tracking them all down.
Not yet.  I just stopped by to say hello.  I'm off to kill him now.
No, the mob leader still breathes.  I will be changing that very soon.
I haven't found her yet.
I don't know.  Once I give it to him, I'll let you know.
A band of Wittin's Jawa Enforcers hunting Kitster Banai.
Jawa Enforcers
You have other commitments right now. Come back and see me when you're not so busy.
What?  No, that's not the proper response.
Huh?  That's not how you're supposed to respond to that.  Oh, that means you're not... Um... bye.
I seem to have everything under control for right now. Come see me again later.
Please leave. You can't assist me.
My name is Kormund Thrylle. If you're in need of work, friend, there is something you could help me with. I have an urgent message I need delivered, but I can't do it myself. Can you help?
I have a soldier of the Alliance coming to collect some Imperial documents of utmost importance. He needs help finding me. Maybe you'd be interested in helping me again?

I had a feeling I could count on you. I've learned to trust my instincts over the years, and something told me you'd be reliable. Bring this message to Reen Loruk. He needs to be informed of my mission status.
Got a taste for espionage now, have you? Excellent. I need you to go find Rodius Tharn. He's a male Rodian. Bring him back here to pick up the information that I lifted from the Imperials.
I'm sorry. I thought you wanted to help the Alliance.  My mistake.
I guess you've done your part, and now it's someone else's turn. Thanks anyway.
Imperial Security is searching for me. I have important information for the Alliance, and I need you to deliver a message to my contact, to let him know my mission was successful.
Imperials are looking all over for me. But once I get this datadisc handed off to the Alliance, I can get arrested twice an hour without risking any information.
I knew you were the right type of person for this job.
Thank you for your persistence.  This means a lot to me.
Phew, I thought that droid was going to get away and get reinforcements.
They were trying to arrest me on some made up charges! Thank you for your help!
Sorry if you think that's harsh but Kormund knew the risks when he went to work for us.  I can't babysit every agent we have in the field.  I'm just glad to know he's alive.
I understand.  If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
I guess you've done your part, and now it's someone else's turn. Thanks anyway.
You've done both the Alliance and myself a great service.
You handle yourself pretty well -- you should consider a career in intelligence. Thanks for everything.
Thanks again for taking care of that probe droid. A message from Kormund? That's good news. We thought he'd been compromised by now.
You here to lead me to where Kormund is hiding out? Good, let's go.
Were you able to get into contact with Reen yet?
Where is Rodius?
Sure, I'll do it.
If this will help you, I'll do it. Yes.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
No, I'm not sure I like what I'm getting myself into.
Why can't you deliver it yourself?
Why can't you just go to him?
Were you just going to give up on him?
I'm not sure I want to get entangled in this.  Sorry, I can't do it.
Some Imperials told me that they would hurt me if I help you.  I can't help you anymore.
No, there were Imperials following me.  I think the coast is clear now.  I'm off.
He wasn't there.  I'm going out to look for him again.
My tasks require the utmost attention and care. You seem far too busy to give me that at the moment.
Oh, you're not a womprat.  Sorry.
I don't have my syllabus, sorry.  I can't teach you anything right now.
I said, get away!  You smell like Bantha-fodder.
When you get a chance, stop by and see how much Jabba will give you for your head.
But, I don't want to do business with you, therefore get out of my face.
Now is not the time to renew our association. Perhaps a bit later.
Yes...What?  Speak with Ind and Kavas.  I don't deal with just anyone that walks in here.

Looking for work? Hmm, I'm not sure that my sort of assignments would be appealing to you. I'm in need of much more than a simple courier. I need someone who can make problems disappear. Do you think you can do that?

I think another assignment is in order. This time the trouble involves a Rodian spice dealer named Soobu Javeedo, who's foolishly decided to peddle his wares in my territory without so much as a "by your leave." Can you teach him some proper etiquette?

Remember that last little task I gave you? As it turns out, Soobu's swooper friends were part of a bigger gang. Ever heard of the Desert Banshees? Well, now they've heard of you. In fact, they want to meet you. And this is convenient since I was going to hire you to take care of them. What do you say?

I think you've got what it takes to tackle this assignment. I've finally discovered who's been organizing these swoop gangs against me, and I need this slug removed. This time, however, we strike directly at Jabba's organization. Are you certain you wish to side with me?

As expected, Jabba was somewhat offended by the demise of his crony. Word has it that he's hired a professional assassin to take out Arrud's killer, and we all know who that was, don't we? Given that you're one of my favorite beings in the galaxy, I thought I'd give you a chance to tie up loose ends.

Jabba has sent a hit squad to get rid of yours truly. I suppose it was only a matter of time. The Hutt may be disgusting, but he's not stupid. He knows the true genius behind these recent strikes. And worse, Governor Aryon is turning a blind eye to this assault on my person. You'll help your sweet Valarian out of this mess, won't you?

Perhaps I misjudged you. Very well, here's my current problem: Una Gitori, a former agent of mine, has decided to expand his horizons by selling information to my rival Jabba. In addition to breaking my heart, Una jeopardizes many of my current business deals. It would be wonderful if you could silence him.
You're quickly becoming "my kind of people." Very good. The task is simple. Find Soobu and make him disappear. He'll have swooper cronies with him, so watch your back. Those thugs can be a bit rough.

I figured you'd be the type to hunt trouble down before it hunts you. A deadly Zabrak named Kilth Saanu leads the Banshees. If you take her out, chances are the rest of the Banshees will scatter. If not, then just blast all of them.

Very well. Your task is to remove Arrud Barsoomu, Jabba's right-hand enforcer in Mos Eisley. This Twi'lek is a most unpleasant individual - perfectly suited to serving a vile beast like Jabba. Tales of Arrud's fascination with torture would sicken you.

Now that's the vicious little rancor I've come to know and admire. The assassin is a Chadra-Fan named Duska Murgo. She's awfully fond of IG assassin droids so I'd keep an eye out for those as well. Please hurry back to me.

There is no one in the Outer Rim as reliable as you, my little mastmot. The walking cadavers are a group of Weequay, led by a brutish thug named Siron Vurn'ke. Forget whatever you may have heard about Weequay - they're not as formidable as some would claim, especially not for a vicious killer like you.
My instincts are seldom wrong. Well, in any case, please enjoy yourself. Anyone with a taste for leisure and the credits to back it up is welcome here.
Don't tell me you've suddenly become squeamish. I was hoping you'd be a tad more resilient than that. Oh well, can't have everything.
Suit yourself but these girls will probably come looking for you eventually.  Don't say I didn't warn you.
I don't hold this against you. In certain circumstances, it is perhaps best to maintain neutrality. Anyone who says otherwise is selling something.
Suit yourself. I will find someone to take care of this hired killer, of course. I just fear I may not do it in time to save your life. That thought breaks my heart.

I was hoping to avoid having to name names in an effort to appease the Governor, but if that is the only alternative left to me... I'm sorry I won't able to protect you from the Imperials. I hope you can forgive me.
I don't know. Would you like to? But now that you mention it, yes. You probably will have to do that. Still interested?

I'll give you three guesses and the first two don't count. That's right. It's the fat slug himself - Jabba.  I hope that doesn't worry you overmuch. Tales of Jabba's influence are greatly exaggerated.
They aren't members of Jabba's regular gangs. I believe the Hutt is "evaluating" the Banshees to see if they are worthy of joining his organization. Perhaps you can help that evaluation along?
I'm afraid I can't tell you that until you choose a side. I would hate to have to silence you after we've become such good friends.
You? Most certainly not. If it were anyone else, I would advise a hasty exit to a heavily fortified stronghold. But you, my little mastmot? You have nothing to worry about.
Aryon's never had much affection for me. She sees me as a troublemaker, someone who risks drawing unwanted Imperial attention. Nothing would please her more than to have me silenced.
Let's see that it happens.
Make sure he pays attention.
And this is why I am paying you.  Carry on.
Serves him right.  I always prefer a simple blaster to the head.  He likes to hear them scream.  A taste of his own medicine, wouldn't you say?
That attitude of yours might slip you up.  I'd hate to see one of my best have such an inglorious death.  Stop by once you have dealt with the matter.
I trust in your abilities, my ice tiger.  I know you will make sure that your patron will come to no harm.  Let me know when the threat has passed.
Selling information is what I do! Die, womp rat!
Typical of Valarian to send an amateur. Prepare to be educated, fool!
You're bantha-fodder! Aieeeeeeeeeee!
You are Valarian's "killer?" Jabba will be pleased to have your head!
This is not personal, oafish one - this is strictly business.
Heh, Wee-Quay!  Kill the interloper!
I see my instincts were wrong. Well, in any case, please enjoy yourself. Anyone with a taste for leisure and the credits to back it up is welcome here.
Don't tell me you've suddenly become squeamish. I was hoping you'd be a tad more resilient than that. Oh well, can't have everything.
Suit yourself, but these girls will probably come looking for you eventually.  Don't say I didn't warn you.
I don't hold this against you. In certain circumstances, it is perhaps best to maintain neutrality. Anyone who says otherwise is selling something.
Suit yourself. I will find someone to take care of this hired killer, of course. I just fear I may not do it in time to save your life. That thought breaks my heart.

I was hoping to avoid having to name names in an effort to appease the Governor, but if that is the only alternative left to me... I'm sorry I won't able to protect you from the Imperials. I hope you can forgive me.
My spies report that you handled that well. Perhaps there's a career in this for you? Enjoy the fruits of your labors. And have a drink with your friends, compliments of the house.

You took on old Soobu and two of Jabba's swoopers and lived? You have definitely become "my kind of people." Please accept this small token of my appreciation. I do hope our business relationship continues to flourish.
Don't cry for me, Desert Banshees. Well done, my ferocious rancor. If I had twenty more like you, I wouldn't have to worry about that fat Hutt at all. Enjoy your reward.
For better or for worse, we're now linked, my vicious little rancor. So enjoy your reward and the pleasures of the Lucky Despot. After all, you're practically family now.

You've returned to me, my little ice tiger! I knew you could take care of that pesky diminutive assassin. Did she have those nasty IG droids with her? Poor little mastmot. Come and have a drink. You could definitely use one.

That was perfection itself, my mastmot. Take this dagger. It's not a weapon, but the badge by which my "employees" recognize my most revered dragons. Now, in order to maintain proper decorum, you and I should limit our contact, at least until I can assuage the Governor's fears. Farewell, my ice tiger.
Does Una still breathe?
Has Soobu learned his lesson yet?
Have you taken care of the Banshees yet?
Has the scum been eliminated?
So, have you taken care of your little problem yet?
Is the deed done?  Am I still in danger for my life?
I've done work like that before, yes.
I'll be happy to.
Two mynocks with one stone, is what I say.  Point me at them.
Yes, my Lady, you are a much better bet than that bloated slug!  I'll help you take on Jabba.
No one comes after me!  I'll kill that assassin before she even knows I'm there.
I would gladly do anything to save your life.  Fear not, my Lady, you will be safe.
I'm not sure I'm cut out for something like that.  No.
No, I'm not one for teaching.
No, I'm not good around crowds.
Whoa!  I'm not crossing Jabba!
What? An assassin after me? Umm... I can't do it myself, Lady.
I'm sorry, but I don't have what it takes to save you.
Would I have to kill anyone?
Who does Soobu work for?
Do the Desert Banshees also work for Jabba?
Who do you want me to take out?
Should I be worried about this assassin?
Why is Governor Aryon turning a blind eye?
Yes, he does.  I don't think I have what it takes.  Sorry.
I'm sorry, my Lady, but I am too sca -er- busy to do this.  Send someone else to do it.
No, I don't want to kill anymore.  I'm tired of all this killing!
On second thought, I think I'm going to step out of this.  I don't want to cross Jabba.
I don't think I'm going to be able to handle this.  I'm going to have to hide instead.  Sorry.
I am sorry, my Lady, but I will be unable to protect you any longer.  I hope you understand.
Only for now.  This will be corrected soon.
He will be learning it very shortly.
No, they haven't shown their faces.  When they do, though....
Not yet, but soon.  Very soon.  And it will hurt.
Not yet.  I'm not worried though.  I'll take care of it in due time.
I have set up a trap for them.  You needn't worry, my Lady.  Soon, they will not bother you any further.

Welcome to the museum.  We are looking for help.  When you have full time to yourself, come see me.  Hem!
Ootini!  Din kandanii.
What?  You're not working for the curator?  My mistake.
..not the person I thought you were.  Sorry about that.  If you see the fence, let him know I'm waiting, okay?
Whew!  I thought you were about to try to take this back.  Well, be careful out here in the wastes.  Good journeys.
The museum is running smoothly again. If I need more help later I'll gladly hire you again.
No, no.  This is not the artifact!
The display piece that was stolen did not look like this.
This is not the scanner.  The one that was part of the museum was quite old.
Thank you, but this is not the piece from the display.

Well, well, a visitor. Hem! Welcome to my humble museum. I am the curator. If you are here regarding the recent theft of a valuable artifact, I am -- hem! -- the one -- hem! Excuse me. -- You may talk to me. Will you pursue the thief and return the artifact?

Ah, welcome back. Hem! You helped my little museum greatly in what I now call the Tusken Robe Incident. Might you now handle a similar -- hem! -- regrettable theft? The purloined object is a part of the armor worn by chief miner Melnea Arnthout, one of Tatooine's -- hem! -- original settlers. Will you go after it?

Ah, you are ready for more work? I hoped you would inquire. Hem! Now some thief has stolen a mineral scanner that dates back to the original settlement of Tatooine. It defies understanding why anyone would steal it; it lacks -- hem! -- notable historic or economic value. Can you return it safely?

It defies belief, my friend, but -- hem! -- my museum is once again the victim of theft. I have no idea who would steal this artifact -- but the Hutts have many enemies, hem! So it is not inconceivable -- but I am maundering. Will you retrieve the artifact?
Excellent. The stolen Tusken Raider robe has a hidden homing beacon, as is standard museum procedure. In all likelihood you will find the thief at the designated coordinates. Thank you, thank you!
Good. The armor, like the robe you returned earlier, has a tracking beacon that should lead you right to the thief. I speed you on your way!
I trust the tracking beacon hidden within the scanner will lead you to the culprit, as always. Please return the item intact.

Splendid. You will recall, of course, that all museum artifacts have tracking beacons. It is fortunate the thieves never think to disable these! Please locate the thief and return the artifact by any means.
I apologize for my mistake. Please enjoy your visit to my little sanctuary. Hem!
Not available just now? I understand. Please enjoy your visit to my little sanctuary. Hem!
Very well, I wish you good luck in your other endeavors. Enjoy the museum.
Understandable. I wish you well in your travels around our world.

The artifact in question is a robe supposedly worn by the Tusken Raider who led the original assault on Fort Tusken centuries ago. The robe's provenance is questionable, but I know no better candidate. I would -- hem! -- very much like it back.
It is the endless dust of this desert. Over the decades I must have inhaled enough to fill a -- hem! -- a binary load lifter. Now, the mission?

It is purely a function of budget, I assure -- hem! I must requisition yet more funds for greater anti-theft protection. It is a terrible indictment of Imperial funding priorities, no? Hem! Now as to the mission?

When the Hutts first arrived on Tatooine, long ago, they held a mass slaughter and subsequent feast. The artifact is, as best we can tell, a chunk of dried meat left over from that initial feast. Will you retrieve it?
I will be waiting.  Thank you for your assistance.
Well, I hope you will be able to find it.  That was a priceless relic!
This is good news.  All these thefts lately are looking very bad for the museum.
Well, I hope you are able to soon.  The display location looks quite empty without it sitting there.
Utinni! Nik maikka dinnika Dinhint!
Hmm. Has that lickspittle of a curator changed his mind? I shall not cancel our arrangement. Rather, I shall cancel you.
You are the fence? Late! Dinhint did say right about how much valuable is this hunk of junk, yes? Wait! You are not --!
I know you! Hanging around the museum, right? Tell Dinhilt this is no gemstone. You won't believe this, but -- Hey, what are you do--?
I apologize for my mistake in asking you. Please enjoy your visit to my little sanctuary. Hem!
Not available just now? I understand. Please enjoy your visit to my little sanctuary. Hem!
Very well, I wish you good luck in your other endeavors. Enjoy the museum.
Understandable. I wish you well in your travels around our world.
Fine work! The robe appears relatively harmed after its ordeal. These senseless thefts grow ever more frequent. I hope the Empire will grant my petition for an increased theft-control budget.
The armor appears to be in acceptable condition. Thank you again for your exemplary service. I anticipate a budget increase to handle these thefts soon.
This is yet another reason I am in your debt. Perhaps you will spread the word among Imperial authorities that this museum requires a greater budget to prevent theft.

Thank you indeed! I daresay the museum's collection would not be perceptibly harmed by the absence of this meat. But as a matter of principle, we must not tolerate artifact theft -- a point I hope the Imperial budget committee remembers when they allocate funds.
Hem!  Have you found the robe?
Have you been successful in retreiving the armor?
Has the tracking beacon been helpful in finding the scanner?
Wonderful!  You have the artifact in your possession, do you not?
I will track down this thief for you.
Sure, I'll go get it for you.
I'll return it safely for you.
I've recovered all the rest you've sold -er- lost, no reason to stop now.  Sure, I'll get it back.
No, this sounds like something for the police.
You seem to be missing a lot of pieces here.  Maybe you should call the police, rather than asking me.  Sorry.
No, I'm not doing another one of these repossession jobs for you.
I've realized what's going on here, and I don't want any part of it anymore.
What is this valuable artifact?
Why are you coughing? Are you all right?
Why are you seeing so many thefts at your museum?
What kind of artifact is it?
I'm unabe to find the thief.  I'm sorry, but I've given up on this.
I've had something come up.  Can I look for it later?
I will not be able to help with this right now.  Perhaps later?
I've been thinking long and hard, and realize I don't want to be involved in this any longer.
No, I haven't found the thief yet.  Once I do, I'll bring back the robe for you.
I haven't managed to wrest the armor from the thief yet.
Yes, it has.  I now know the location and am about to recover it.
No, not yet.  I still haven't been able to track down that dastardly bandit.

Welcome to Mos Taike!  I'm Lorne Prestar, Chief of Security for this town.  You look like an able enough person.  If you're in need of a job, I might have work for you.  Just stop by and let me know, okay?
Yeah, that's what I thought.  Walking away like a coward!  Coward!  You're not even worth my time!
It's pretty quiet around here right now. It never lasts though. Come see me later.

Welcome to Mos Taike!  I'm Lorne Prestar, Chief of Security for this town.  You look like an able enough person.   I'm getting reports that there's a wild worrt that's beginning to harass some of the locals.  Do you think you can lend a hand in taking care of this for me?

Hey, I was looking for you!  I need your help again, kid.  Since you did such a good job last time, I need you to take out another critter for me.  Leave it to the specialists, I always say.  It looks like there's a mutant mound mite out there that's causing even bigger trouble this time.  Do you think you can take care of this one for me?

I've got another job for you if you're interested.  It seems we have a troublemaker that thinks it's fun to rough up other people.  I'm not having that.  Go find the guy and let him know how much we don't like troublemakers around here, okay?

Soldier, I need your help!  Are you listening?  We have a desperate situation here, and we're going to have to pull together to get out of this alive!  You understand!?  Listen.  We've got a Tusken War Party advancing on our location, and I need to send you to take up an open front!  Are you prepared, rookie?
That's the spirit!  Go out there and show that worrt who's the master around here.  Well, in a manner of speaking, heh.
That's what I wanted to hear, kiddo!  You get out there and make short work of the mite that's causing these problems.  Put it out of it's misery... the things' probably mad with hunger, I'll bet.

Good.  Go find the guy and explain to him that he's not wanted around here.  If he's belligerent, you're allowed to use force to get your point home.  If he doesn't listen to even that... well, just make sure he doesn't bother anyone else again, if you can read between the lines.

Affirmative to that.  I have the other troops - er - guards set out on all fronts.  You need to defend our weak front.  Get out there and you show them Tuskens all you've got, you hear me?  And, kid, don't get yourself killed, got it?

Well, I can understand that.  I can't expect just anyone to have the courage to do it.  Well, try not to get your hands too dirty around here.  I don't want to see you break a nail, or claw, or whatever...
Hmm... maybe a I had you wrong, kid.  I thought you had guts of plasteel, but I guess not.  Well, I'll just have to do it myself... like a real man.
Hmm... I understand.  This is more a job for someone who wants to do real work.  Thanks for your previous help, though.

Look!  You must do this!  If you don't, we will lose this war - er - this battle!  It's all or none!  Got that?  I've seen too many kids like you just freeze when you need to pull the trigger.  Don't let your fear freeze you, kid!  Please tell me you'll pull your weight out here!

Well, about a few weeks back a tourist tells me he saw a worrt lurking too close to town.  Well, I thought nothing of it, until a hear from a few tourists that they were attacked by what I'm assuming to be the same critter.  I can't have that going on in my town, but I don't have time to take care of it myself.  So, can you do this for me?

Gramm tells me that a Sand Dragon 'Fresher sales rep was attacked by a beast the other day on his way here.  Now, either we have a problem with the local critters, or we got the wrong beast the last time around.  Either way, I'm not going to have innocent casualties turning up on my watch!  Can you take care of this for me?

I have several witnesses that say the guy was seen smacking around Igma Korto's friend the other day.  Now, her friend works for the Corellian Times, and I don't want them thinking I run a slipshod starship out here in Mos Taike.  That's why this thug needs to be taught a lesson in manners.

This is no time for questions, kid!  Scouts show Tuskens are converging on Mos Taike even as we speak!  We act now or we lose everyone like we did back in the jungles of Naboo 20 years back!  So many people died that day under my command, and I'm not having it again!  Kid, get out there and don't get yourself killed!
That's what I want to hear!  Good hunting!
Well, it shouldn't be too much of a problem for someone like you.  Get out there and show it what you've got!
Well, remember, there's no need to go killing anyone.  At the same time, you've gotta defend yourself if the situation calls for it.  Let me know how it turns out.
That, kid, is what I call guts of steel!  Get out there and win this one for the Prestar!
<a worrt looks anxious>
<a mound mite looks angry>
Hey!  What're you looking at, huh?  You looking at me?  You got a problem, huh?  I'll give you a problem!
Grr...
That worrt must have been tougher than he looked.  Or maybe you're not as tough as you look?
Man, I thought surely you'd take that mound mite down no problem.  I must be getting old.  My eyesight must be going.  I thought you looked tough.
Guess I should have sent Bren, or at least someone who could handle themselves in a fight.  Oh well.
Hm..tuskens are tough enough sure, but I thought you had the skills.  Well, maybe not...
Still a little wet behind the ears, huh?  Well, you just let me know when you've seen a little more of this world then, okay?
Well, the first thing you learn out there is to listen to your fear.  The next is to control it.  Once you have it strapped up, you come back and let me know you'll do it, okay?
Hey, I understand.  You're still green, kid, and this is no kinda job for you.  If you find that you're made of stronger stuff, you just let me know, got it?

Well, kid, it's because they're not!  Pull yourself together, kid!  You've got to come to!  Without you, we'll lose this fight.  Once you've got your head on straight, you come back and I'll give you further orders.

You've got gusto, kid!  I like that!  Now that the worrt is going to be something's dinner tonight, hopefully I won't have to hear any more whining from the tourists.  Bah.  They scare too easy.  That'll get you killed, I tell you.  Well, kid, I thank you for getting this done.  I'll look you up if anything comes up.
You got rid of the beast, right?  Good to hear, good to hear.  Go stop by the cantina and get your self a stiff drink.  You deserve it, kiddo!

I'm going to assume he listened and you drove him out of town, okay?  What goes in the desert STAYS in the desert, you know what I mean?  Good.  Sheesh!  First the critters, now ruffians.  What next?  Well, you've helped out a lot, kid.  Stop by after you've finished another tour of - *sigh* - I mean, seen the world a little more, got it?

Kid, you did me proud!  You came back in one piece.  We lost a few guys, but we saved the town...  Finally, I'll be able to sleep at night without waking up screaming from all those memories.  Kid, I owe you.  I owe you.
So, have you dispatched that worrt yet?
So, how goes your mite hunt?
So, have you had a little talking to with this hoodlum yet?
You've already taken care of those Raiders?  You're better than I thought, kid!  You deserve a medal!
I'd be happy to help.  Yes, I'll do it!
It sounds easy enough.  Sure, I'll do it!
I'll teach him some manners, don't worry.
Tuskens?  Where?  Yes, I'll definitely help!
No thanks.  That sounds like something you'd be better able to handle.
I did the first one as a favor.  I'm not pest control, Lorne.  No.
Sorry, but I'm not some goon.  I'm not roughing any one up.
Lorne, I don't see any Tuskens anywhere.  Are you sure you haven't been out in the suns too long?  I'm afraid I can't help with this.
What's all the commotion?
I thought I already took care of the problem.  What happened?
What did the guy do?
What's going on here, Lorne?
I don't think I can kill this worrt, Lorne.  It might eat me.
To tell you the truth, I'm a bit scared of those things.  I can't do this job for you.
I've been called elsewhere and can't take care of this right now.  Sorry, Lorne.
Sir, I can't do it!  It's too much for me!  I've never seen that many!  They're everywhere!!!!  It's like... it's like... it's like they're not human!
No, I haven't found it.  Once I do, though, you can be assured it won't harrass any other people.
It's going good.  I'm just about to find where it's feeding area is, then get rid of it.
Not yet.  I guess he knows he's in trouble and is scared to face me.  Once I spot him, though, we'll have our little talk.
Ummm... yeah, I took them out, but... ummm... there are more of them.  I've come back for a little breather.

You think you can just wander in here and chat with the Chief of Police? Unless you have services to offer, get out of here or I'll have you arrested.
Whoa.  Um... I wasn't really serious about that.  Sorry.  Please don't hurt me.
Spread this message to all you know and you will find peace within yourself.
Oh, I didn't see you there.  Um... Citizen, return to your home.  There's nothing to see here.
Oh, you're not going to kill me?  That's a relief!
That's all the work I have for now. Check back another time.
I only have use for loyal soldiers of the Empire, please leave.
A gangster working for the Hutts has assaulted an officer, stolen Imperial secrets, and is racing to sell them to the Rebellion. Will you stop him?
Another troublemaking alien is agitating for equal rights. I don't think so! Bring him here for discipline.
Stormtrooper TD-334 was caught in a radiation accident and is now displaying unorthodox behavior. Apprehend him without committing undue harm.

A filthy spy is heading to Bestine.  Supposedly reporting on a certain matter to Prefect Talmont. Arrest the spy before something happens to our "little Moff." If the spy happens to accidentally die en route, rest assured there's no one more deserving.
Good. Arrest Wend Dinard and bring him here. We need to know what secrets he compromised. Move!
This one has no record of violent behavior, but he travels with fanatical supporters. Who knows what they're capable of? Be careful, but bring him back.
Good. We've kept this matter confidential. It's possible other troopers may misunderstand the situation. Don't betray secrecy. Just try to escape without undue combat, and bring TD-334 here.
The spy is a blasted smuggler named Noda Lovan. Kill -- I mean, make the arrest and you'll be doing the galaxy a favor. Go!
Get out! And don't bother me again!
Are you one of those agitators too? Get out!
You're wasting my time. Get out.
Get out. And don't tell anyone about this, or it will go badly for you.
His name's Wend Dinard. Human, but works for aliens -- makes me sick. Dinard travels in the company of known thugs, so be ready with your weapons. What's your decision?
Some kind of freak. Name's Dowwop, or something equally stupid. He wants the Empire to create alien-only police patrols for alien settlements. Will you arrest this nitwit?
The trooper was guarding a reactor repair facility when Rebels blew it up. TD-334 was the only survivor. What's your decision?
Charge? How should I --? Well, say the spy's stolen Imperial secrets. That's not far from the truth. Your decision?
Don't let him get the best of you!  Get out there and catch your man!
Then what are you doing here?  Get out there and get him!
Have you been affected by the radiation, too?  The next time I see you, you had best have that Stormtrooper in your custody.
Well, what are you waiting for?!  Get out there before I have *you* arrested!
Bah! Those guys called themselves bodyguards!
Sigh, all this violence.
I think purple highlights would give these helmets a bold statement.  No... not purple... LAVENDER!
I'll bet that thug Harburik sent you. He's killed enough folks already, why not me too?
Dead? What were you thinking? I can't question a corpse! Sigh, it's so hard to find good help now a days.
Get out! And don't bother me again!
Are you one of those agitators too? Get out!
You're wasting my time. Get out.
Get out. And don't tell anyone about this, or it will go badly for you.
About time. Here's your reward. That's all for now.
You can be proud of your role in asserting the galaxy's natural order. Now I'll have a long chat with this idiot. You can go now.
I think there was no good way this could have turned out. Take your reward, and we'll pretend this never happened.
You got the spy all the way here, huh? No fatal accidents presented themselves? Well, here's your reward. Get out, and don't come back.
Okay okay, I know when I'm out of options. I'll come along quietly.
I apologize for my friends, they are a bit overprotective. I want these changes made in a peaceful manner but your Empire is not making it easy for us.
Don't stop me! I'm leaving the Army to become an image designer! I always wanted to be an image designer.
I guess I'll go with you quietly. You better pray that I won't get out of prison though, or I will find you one day when I'm better prepared.
Where is he?  How come I don't see him?
So where is the scum I told you to arrest?
Don't tell me you blew it and wound up killing him!
I take it you didn't have any trouble?
Yes, I'll stop him for you.
Absolutely, sir!
I'll see to it that he's brought into custody safely.
I'll get this spy and return!
No, that's your kind of job, not mine.
But aliens should have equal rights!  I'm not going to help with something like this!
Are you crazy?  I'm not going to apprehend a Stormtrooper!
I'm not authorized to arrest spies.  Sounds like an Imperial job to me.
Who is the gangster?
Who is this alien agitator?
What happened to the unorthodox Stormtrooper?
On what charge could I arrest this spy?
It's because I'm just not cut out for the life of an officer of the law.  Sorry, I can't do this for you.
I've come to realize that aliens are people too!  I can't take part of this.
I'm not going to get in trouble with the Imperials by arresting a stormtrooper.  Have someone else do it.
I've had something come up.  You're going to have to call in Imperial support for this one instead.
Because he's too wily for me.  Don't worry, I'll catch him!
I don't have him yet.
Okay, I won't tell you that then.  I'll tell you that he asked me to stop by later to arrest him.
No, I haven't found the spy yet.  Don't worry, I'll get right on it.
You have another employer at the moment. But if you're serious about hunting, see me when you have some free time.
If I find any more work I think you can handle, I'll let you know.
If you're interested in becoming a hunter, I might have a little job for you -- just to show your aptitude, you understand. Up for it?

I have another job for you. An offworlder wants to take a hunting trophy back home with him. It's the sort of thing that I wouldn't trouble myself with, but as your mentor, I encourage you to do all the fieldwork you can. What do you say?
I was offered another commission recently, one well beneath the abilities of myself, to whom even the biggest krayt is a simple afternoon's diversion. You might find it a tad interesting, though.
You've done a bang-up job so far, but now you'll have to grow up a little. I'm not sure you're up to this job, but I thought you might enjoy a challenge. Interested?
That's the spirit. Head into the desert and find a squill for the Jawas. They wanted the meat, as I recall, so be sure to bring back the carcass.
Good show! Bring back the hide from a variegated womp rat, and we'll make a professional hunter of you yet.
You certainly have gumption. I admire that, really. Track down a matriarch bantha and bring back the horns for our client. Foul beast, the bantha. Honestly, I wonder about people's taste in décor.
Think you've got what it takes? All right then, track down a grizzled dewback and bring back the hide. Try not to scorch it. A museum wants to stuff it for a display of dangerous wildlife.
Don't feel up to it? I guess you don't have what it takes to be a real hunter.
Are you sure you're serious about this line of work? You don't seem to have the dedication of a hunter.
Probably a wise decision. I expect that last creature was about the limit of your skills.
Not everybody has what it takes to make it in this business. Some just choke under the pressure.
Some Jawas recently approached me about killing a desert squill. Far beneath my abilities, of course, but a good test of your basic skills.
Apparently he wants the hide of a variegated womp rat. Why anybody would want one of those filthy biters is beyond me, but there you are. Your decision?
I've been asked to get another trophy item -- a matriarch bantha. It's the sort of trivial job I like to pass down to younger hunters who really need the work.
You're a cheeky one, you are! I was hunting krayts when you were still learning not to drool on yourself. Bah! "Do I ever hunt," indeed!
Whatever.  I'll be surprised if you can get this done at all.
Yeah, they can be little buggers.  Keep looking!
Hmmm... you know, that's a pretty good idea.  I'll have to remember that.  I mean - yeah - I'm glad to see you're learning.
Really?  Wow.  Um... I mean... yeah, I'll expect this done.
You've got to be kidding me.  Well, before you trying hunting squill, you may need to track down a spine.  I'm sure that will help.
I thought you were a little too dim to do this.  When you've learned how to read, look me up, okay?
Probably a wise decision. I expect that last creature was about the limit of your skills.
Not everybody has what it takes to make it in this business. Some just choke under the pressure.
I say! You do seem to have passable basic skills. I might consider taking you on as a pupil. I'll let those Jawas know their meat is ready for them.
Bagged the beastie, did you? Smashing good job there, old desert rat. Why, one day your name may be known with the same reverence as mine!
That's just the ticket!
You've done far better than I ever thought you would. It's a pity the League isn't accepting new applicants just now.
So, are those little beasties feasting on the that squill yet?
Have you skinned that little sucker yet?
So, have you killed that big monster?
So have you shown that dewback who the master is?
Yeah, I'm up for it.
I'll kill whatever you want me to!
Ha!  I'll kill it blindfolded!!!  With one hand tied behind my back, too!  No, both hands!!!!!
Only as long as it's a challenge.  If I don't barely make it out there alive, it's not worth it!
No thanks.  I'm scared.
If this is anywhere as dangerous as the last one, count me out!
Okay, you just said 'krayt'.  I'm outta here.
I've been doing this the whole time and haven't learned a thing from you!  I'm done with this!
What sort of job?
What are we after this time?
What is the prey this time?
Do you ever actually hunt anything yourself?
I saw that squill, and it's HUGE!!!  You're crazy to send me out against something like that!
Look, if I can't even pronounce the name of the thing I'm supposed to kill, I shouldn't be hunting it.  I'm out.
I can't do it, Mat!  I'm scared to death of banthas!  And a bantha this big?  Nightmares, I tell you.
You lazy sack of bones!  It just dawned on me that I'm doing all your work!  I'm through with you.
No, that squill has so far managed to elude my tracking skills.  I'll get one for the Jawas, don't worry.
No, I've only found normal womprats.  I'm still looking for one of those variegated types.
No, I was waiting for her to leave the pack.  I didn't want to spook the rest.
Not yet.  I will shortly, though!
I'm afraid my assignments would require your full attention, citizen. Medical issues should be top priority, after all. Please come back when you're free.
Thank you, but help is already on the way.
I hope that vaccine gets here soon.  I've been waiting here all day.
If I have any more medical emergencies I need help with, I'll be sure and ask for you.
No, this is not an infected womprat hide.

I could use your help with this emergency, actually. A womp rat bit a local moisture farmer and the wound has become infected. The young woman waited too long to contact me, unfortunately, and I now I fear her condition may prevent her from making the journey safely. Could you make sure she does?

I could use your help in investigating the possible spread of this deadly disease. I need to perform an analysis of an infected womp rat. This will allow me to determine if the plague has mutated and requires a new vaccine. Do you think you can bring me an infected specimen's hide?

I was hoping you'd ask, citizen. I need to make sure this vaccine gets out to all the moisture farmers who may not have access to the cities. Could you deliver this supply to a representative of the Affiliated Moisture Farmers?
You are most gracious, citizen. She's transmitted her coordinates. She was attempting the trip on her own, but realized she might not make it. She's brave, but also a bit on the reckless side.

You are noble and good, citizen. I've taken the liberty of inoculating you against common Gray Rot with a modified bacta spray. This will keep you safe. If I determine that this is a new strain, I'll provide you the vaccine as soon as I develop it.
You are nothing if not reliable, citizen. Here you go. Make sure this gets to its destination as quickly as possible. Gray Rot can devastate a settlement in mere days.
It is regrettable that you choose not to help this young woman. If you'll excuse me, I need to find someone who will. Good day.

I would inoculate you against the common strain of Gray Rot, so I assure you you'd be safe. If after I've studied the specimen, I determine a new vaccine is needed, I'd provide you that as well. Please, these citizens need your help.

I must assume you're very busy. You do not seem to be the type of being that would stand idly by and watch dozens of innocents suffer a terrible fate. I'll find someone else to deliver the vaccine. Good day.
Her name is Maikeen Storn. She's only been on Tatooine for about a year. She's originally from Agamar, I believe. She's a brave young woman whose spirit I have come to admire. I hope you can help her
Gray Rot makes a victim's skin go scabrous and gray until it eventually cracks and ulcerates. Death follows a few agonizing days later. If caught in its early stages, it is treatable with bacta.
The man's name is Aroy Sekun, friend of the Darklighters, I believe. He's a responsible sort and will make sure that vaccine gets properly distributed.
You will need to hurry.  If her infection is allowed to grow, I fear my skills will not be able to heal her.
Well, I wish you good luck.  As soon as I have that hide, I can begin working on a cure.
Well, make sure they get it.  Their representative is still waiting for you.
Are you here to help me back to Doctor Melios?
Oh, good!  You must be the one who has the vaccine.
I'm so disappointed...
Now I don't know if we'll ever be able to stop the disease.
I fear for our moisture farmers.  I wish you'd managed to get them the vaccine...
It is regrettable that you choose not to help this young woman. If you'll excuse me, I need to find someone who will. Good day.

I would inoculate you against the common strain of Gray Rot, so I assure you you'd be safe. If after I've studied the specimen, I determine a new vaccine is needed, I'd provide you that as well. Please, these citizens need your help.

I must assume you're very busy. You do not seem to be the type of being that would stand idly by and watch dozens of innocents suffer a terrible fate. I'll find someone else to deliver the vaccine. Good day.
You have my thanks, citizen. You doubtless saved this woman's life. Now if you'll excuse me, I have work to do.
Good work, citizen. I'll get right on this analysis. You may have just saved this city from a terrible epidemic. Check back with me to get a report of my findings.

You've helped avert a catastrophe, friend. You have my thanks and the gratitude of the citizens of Tatooine. We have a new stimpack we've been working on. I don't have any pre-made packs at the moment, but here's the blueprint to make some if you're interested.
Thanks, friend. I'll make sure this gets to everyone who needs it. Dr. Purl has spoken highly of you. It was an honor and a pleasure to meet you. Take care.
Dr. Purl sent you, didn't he? Oh, all this fuss over me. Well, I appreciate your help. If I pass out, just slap me till I wake up.
Have you brought the farmer back yet?
How goes your search for one of those pestilent womp rats?
Has that vaccine been given to the Moisture Farmers yet?
Absolutely!
If this will help cure others, I'll do it.  Yes.
I'll make sure it gets to the right hands.
It's not my fault she waited too long.  I'm too busy to help right now.
No, that's not my field of work.  Sorry.
You're better off hiring a courier.  I'm not interested.
Who is this moisture farmer?
What exactly is Gray Rot Plague?
Who is this representative?
I've had something come up. I cannot escort her back here any more. Sorry.
I have second thoughts about this.  I don't want to get infected myself, so I have to decline.
I don't feel I should be the one to deliver this.  You might want to get someone else to do it.  Sorry.
No, I haven't yet.
I have yet to find one, but I continue to search for one.
No, not yet.  I'm in the process of taking it out to them.
Hey there, friend. Watch yourself out in the desert. It's too easy to get lost. Made trouble for me, but I see you're busy. Come on back later.
I think I'm in the clear thanks to you. If I get in any more trouble I'll let you know.
Mikos Dinari is the name, and I do have a problem I could use a bit of help with. There's Tusken Raiders out in the desert that want my hide. You think you could do something about it?
I'm still having trouble with those blasted Sand People. You did such a bang-up job last time -- maybe you're willing to help me out again?

I like you young folks. You got good hearts. One of those Tuskens is hot on my trail. I'm safe here in town, but every time I try to leave, he's there waiting. See to it he doesn't bother me anymore, if you can. I surely would be grateful.
Good hearted! It's what I've always said about you, and I stand by it. Maybe if you were to kill that Tusken Raider chief, they'd decide that I wasn't worth all this trouble.
Well, danger ain't for everybody, is it? Don't you worry. I'll get by somehow.
I guess you had your fill of Sand People in that last encounter. Well, don't let an old man waste any more of your time.

I was out in the desert surveying, and I kind of lost my way. My supplies were running out when I stumbled on to that oasis. Turns out the Sand People are a mite protective of their water sources. I ran. Stumbled across a sandcrawler, and for a small fee, plus the things they managed to steal, the Jawas brought me here.

I guess they're still angry about my drinking their water. Now their chief is hunting me. Every time I head out into the desert, he and some of his guards track me down, so I have to hightail it back to town.
Thank you for doing this.  This means a lot to me.
Well, when you're victorious, come back and let me know!
Well, danger ain't for everybody, is it? Don't you worry. I'll get by somehow.
I guess you had your fill of Sand People in that last encounter. Well, don't let an old man waste any more of your time.
I can't thank you enough for helping me out of that mess. You be careful out in that desert now, y'hear?
Thanks to you, I can get back to my surveying and finally earn some credits again. I won't forget this.
Have you dispatched the Tusken Raiders?
Are those evil things going to bother me any more?
Sure.  I can't stand Sand People!
I still hate Sand People.  I'll definitely help.
Sorry, but I don't mess with Sand People.
I'm not sure I want to do any more of this 'killing' thing.  Sorry.
Why are the Sand People angry with you?
What sort of trouble are you having now?
I'm sorry, but something came up.  I can't do this anymore.
I'm sorry, but I can't do this anymore.
Not yet.  Once I find them, they'll be dealt with.
I don't know.  I know that I haven't taken care of them yet for now.
Sorry, can't talk now. I'm busy.
Unless of course you're an Imperial.  If so, that was just one big joke.  Umm.. bye!
Nevermind.  I thought you with with someone else.
I don't have anything you can help me with right now. Try me again later.
What do you want? You're not part of my organization, I have nothing to say to you.
An Imperial Army non-com is defecting to the Alliance. I need someone to escort him here before the Empire gets him.

Friend of mine, Vil Sembian -- ever hear of his dad, Daw Sembian, the famous weaponsmith? Doesn't matter, Daw's dead now. He left Vil the schematic for a new kind of blaster. Vil is bringing us the plans, but the Empire's on his tail. I need you to bring him here safely.
Great! His name's Drenn Biktor. A tiny nothing of a man, but don't tell him I said that. Bring him here safely.
Good. Get going. I've got more crises to deal with here.
Fine. I'll get someone else to keep this sleemo alive. Enjoy your day.
Right. I'll just hope someone else decides to help change the course of the war. Nice outfit. Bye now.
He knows more about Imperial Outer Rim supply routes than anyone could and stay sane. We can use that data to interdict their shipments. C'mon, I'm aging rapidly here. Decision?
I don't know why the blaster is so special. My commander says it could tip the scales in our favor. Good enough for me.
It's just that you can never tell about these kinds of things.  I'm hoping he really means to defect.
Well, you should hurry.  I don't know how much time he has left.
Help! The Empire will kill me when they learn I'm gone. I have to be taken to a place of safety!
Identify yourself before you get any closer!
What? Dead? How could that happen. This is not good.
Fine. I'll get someone else to keep this sleemo alive. Enjoy your day.
Right. I'll just hope someone else decides to help change the course of the war. Nice outfit. Bye now.
Good work, another victory for the Alliance. Now I have to get this guy offworld. Gaah, one more crisis.

Great. I'll have these schematics sent to High Command. Hopefully they are what we need. If we just had more soldiers of your skill and determination, the Alliance would already have freed the galaxy.
Thank you. I don't know what will happen to me now. But I couldn't go on serving the Empire. I had friends on Alderaan!
You're taking me to Captain Vendallan? Thank goodness. I thought the next place I was heading for was a Imperial prison camp.
Did it turn out to be a trap after all?
Were you able to find him?
Yes, I'm interested.
Sure, I'll do it.
Not interested.
Sorry, I don't want to get involved.
Why is an Imperial Army non-com important?
What's so special about this blaster?
I don't know, and I really don't care.  I've changed my mind about this.
I've changed my mind.  I could get hurt doing this, and don't like that idea.
I don't know, but I don't like the sound of that.  I haven't picked him up yet.
Not yet.  I'm on my way to save him right now.
Well, hello! I am Om Aynat, creator of Bestine's most famous Talusian Flatbread! Unfortunately I am out of bread right now. Please return later!
Hello, stranger. I can't talk now -- I'm waiting for someone else.

Maybe I'll find more work for you later. Right now I need to make more flatbread.

Well, hello! Can you help me? I'm expecting a rep from the Sand Dragon Fresher company to bring some supplies -- but the rep has gotten lost on the way to Bestine. If you find him and bring him to my humble stand, I can give you a fine bottle of Corellian Ale. I have surplus!

I hope you enjoyed the Corellian ale! Urgh, I could use a drink myself. I'm embroiled in a legal battle with a failing cafe owner in Mos Taike. She claims she owns the recipe for my special creation, Talusian Flatbread. She lies! My legal advocate just sent a distress message from outside town. Can you escort him here?

I'm preparing a banquet for my longtime friend and benefactor, Moff Aryon. As a surprise, I've recruited the illustrious chef from the Fallen Star hotel. Yes! Unfortunately, the chef is notorious for lateness. So if you're willing, I'd like you to escort the chef to me. Yes? No?

The Planetary Museum curator runs a matchmaking business on the side called "Dune-Hearts." But the museum's antique messenger droid accidentally gave all the clients bad locations in their datapads. Now they're wandering the desert, searching vainly for their true loves. Can you escort one back here so I can set him straight?
Great! I'm in desperate need of new supplies. Be careful, now!
Excellent! I look forward to your return, and an end to this frivolous lawsuit!
Good. I can't extend an invitation to the banquet -- very high-tone, you know. But I can certainly provide a worthwhile reward.
Wonderful! I'm sure that the message droid problems will be fixed by the time you return. Be careful!
I understand. Perhaps some other time? Take care.
Wellll -- as you will. I'm not sure what I'll do about this lawsuit, but -- as you will!
I understand. If I could extend an invitation to the banquet, it might be more attactive, no? Maybe later.
Yes, well -- I suppose people should solve their own problems. Thank you for your time.

My name is Om Aynat. Long ago I trained as a chef on Talus, but -- well -- bad things happened. After bouncing unhappily from system to system, I wound up starting this food stand, financed by my friend Tour Aryon. Now, what about my task?

Under the master chef in Restuss, I was once assigned to make Talusian bread for a cruiser-load of students. I didn't like them, so as a prank I left out the fermenters. The flattened bread was a towering sensation! But when the Corellia HoloNet service wanted to do a story about it, the master expelled me. Suspicious, no? I got no credit, and ever since, I have faced countless liars who claim to have created my bread. Will you help me?

It's just a nice thing to do! Right after I was exiled from the culinary conservatory in Restuss, a friend in the Imperial Navy introduced us. She embodies the greatness of the Empire: fair-handed, even-tempered and, well, just a fantastic person! So of course you'll take the assignment, no?

I'm not sure. Perhaps being a curator of antiquities makes one unnecessarily fond of old, broken things. It certainly seemed to make him an old, broken thing. But if he keeps hanging onto that droid, we'll have many more people stranded out in the desert, looking for love. Symbolic, no? Well, what's your answer?
Be sure to let me know when you have.
Be sure to let me know when you have.

Careful with this thing. It's put together well, but if you crush it, it won't be worth a scurrier's ear.
Here's your official proclamation. It won't be valid unless and until I get elected. But just in case, hang onto it.
Here you go. This is a picture I took during liftoff from an Outer Rim planet. That picture is the only one of its kind in this system. Beautiful, no?
Here's a recording rod that I paid far too much for. It's valuable but fragile. Be careful with it.
Whew! I thought I'd be stuck here forever. Can you lead me to Om, please?
Ah yes. Could you take me to Om Aynat, if you please?
Aynat sent you? Nonsense. Plenty of time, plenty of t-- gad! Look at the time! And I have so much still to prepare! Quick, take me to Aynat!
You're not my date! But hey, after all this time wandering out here, even you look good. Wait, I didn't mean how that sounded!
Have you found the Sand Dragon 'Fresher rep yet?
Have you found my advocate yet?
Have you found the chef yet?
Have you found the star-crossed lover yet?
Yes. I will find and bring the representative.
Yes. I will escort the advocate to you.
Yes. I will retrieve the chef for you.
Yes. I will bring a client here to you.
No. I have no time for this.
No. I can't do this for you.
No. I can't.
No. Sorry.
Who are you?
Did you invent Talusian Flatbread?
Why are you hosting a banquet for Tour Aryon?
Why doesn't he get a new messenger droid?
I will not be able to escort him back any longer.  Sorry.

Visitor? Ihhh, no idea why. Not much of interest way up here. But go ahead, look around. Watch out for vermin. Don't mess up the place.
I don't have the funds to hire you any more. Come see me later.
Who are you? Only loyal soldiers of the Empire should be in here!

I'm Custodial Officer here. Ihh, fallen a long way from my good days -- never mind. Got problems with womp rats, and I want 'em dead. All of 'em. Got a budget for pest removal, so I can pay. Interested?

Got more problems with animals -- mynocks, now. Not space mynocks, but the ground-bound Tatooine kind. Not the kind of problem I used to worry about as an Imperial officer, but anyway -- You interested?

Know those big dragonets? They're prowling around the trash compactors here, growling at the troops. I need 'em dead. That's my life now, lining up pest control. One trip to the forest moon, and poof! Disaster.

Dune lizards. Hate 'em. They think this is their territory. One Imperial officer gets eaten, and suddenly it's my problem. Now it's yours. Kill 'em -- the lizards, not the troops. Don't have any credits left in the budget, but maybe I can work out some other payoff.
Right. I've found where they sleep. Destroy them, then check back here.
Good. Those mynocks are eating the silica right out of my walls. Blow up their hive, or whatever it is, and check back here for payment.
Good. Folks say those dragonets are young krayt dragons. Don't know about that, but be careful anyway. Kill 'em and report back here.
Good. Check back here after you kill all those lizards.
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.

Oh, they get into the water tanks, and -- ihh, I tell a lie. Truth is, I just hate furry things. Empire sent me to some forest moon in the back end of nowhere. Little furry creatures there made trouble all day, every day. Ever since, I like to see furry things die horribly. What about it?

I was records officer on an Imperial scouting mission to this one forest moon -- place you never heard of. Didn't like the place, and said so. Seems the Emperor himself saw my report. That can end a career fast. Anyway, these mynocks -- will you kill 'em?

Me? After Endor, I got put on lonely duty riding solar focusing mirrors in orbit around Coruscant. Thought that was the worst duty in the galaxy, 'til I got sent here. About those dragonets -- want to kill 'em?
You want to go? Heh. Way back when, Imperial Security sent me a duplicate security clearance for Endor by mistake. Tell you what -- you take out these lizards, I'll give you that clearance.
Ihh.. now you see why I hate them.  Wipe them from the face of this planet, then tell me when you are triumphant.
They're not the ones that haunt me...
Good, good, get it done.
Good, good.  You might be an Imperial officer some day!  Tell me when they're all dead, okay?
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.
Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.

Ihh, well, pardon me for living. I'm getting back to work.
Nice job. I hope those rats screeched loud as they died. Ihh, me, once an officer, fallen to gloating over dead womp rats! Life's funny.
Good. Mynocks -- lousy vermin, worse than Ewoks. Ihh? What's an Ewok? Never mind, you don't want to know.
Good. Dragonets, huh. Let a few of 'em loose on Endor, and the Ewok population would drop pretty dramatically.
Good work! Here, take this. Not sure why I saved a painting of that horrible place, can't stand to look at it anyway.
Ihhh... you done already?
All mynocks dead, yes?
No more Dragonets?
All of the Dune Lizards dead?
Sounds like an easy job.  I'll do it.
I like killing mynocks.  Sure, I'll get it done.
I'll kill them for you, yes.
I'll wipe them from the face of this planet!
I'm not a lowly exterminator.  Get some lowlife to do it!
How could you think of killing those adorable little things.  No, I won't do it.
No, I won't do this.
No, that's a bit too dangerous.
Why do you want the womp rats killed?
If you were an officer, why are you a custodian now?
What did you do after the forest moon mission?
Where is the forest moon you visited?
I can't kill them.  They're too cute.  I can't believe you would dare to have me kill those little furry things.
No, I've changed my mind.  They deserve to live just as you and I.  Well... more the "I" part.
No, I'm not doing your duty work for you.
No, no more killing these animals!  I'm through with this, you crazy old man!
No, not yet.  They're wily little things.  I'll let you know when they're all gone.
Not yet, but soon.  Soon they will no longer haunt your waking days.
I am still killing them all.
Yes, they're all dead. But... more showed up, so I'll kill them as well.
