Boy do I have problems. I'd share them with you but you seem kinda busy. If you get some time off, check back with me.
Wraaaarrrhhhhh!!!
Get out of my face.  I don't know you.
I'm all set for now, ace. Check back with me later.

You offering me some help? I could sure use it, friend. Remember how I said that sabacc was bad for you? Well, somehow I got some dangerous characters mad at me. They insist I cheated and owe them money (something about an extra ace). Long story short, I ain't got it so a brute is on his way to break my shapely legs. Help?

You are one sweet individual. You know that? I'll gladly accept your help again, ace. I know you took care of the Wookiee, but he was just hired muscle. His boss is still after me. Think you can get rid of him for me?

See? I told myself you had a kind face. I'm rarely wrong about these things. The thug's a Wookiee with absolutely no sense of humor. Goes by the name of Chalurrekk, although you can call him Chumpy. He likes that.

Is it any wonder you're so popular, ace? This creep's name is Korrkoressk. He's a Trandoshan, in case you couldn't tell from the name. Don't let this killer get the drop on you - he's one deadly lizard. Shoot first, save the questions for a cutie at the bar. I'm rooting for ya.
Oh, right. Not your problem. I gotcha. Well, nice talking to you. I gotta find someplace to hide.
I understand. This guy's a serious gangster. I believe he's connected to the main slug himself, Jabba. I suppose if I were you I wouldn't wanna get involved either. Wish me luck, at least.

Cheat? Me? Do I look like the kind of gambler that would be caught cheating? Please, I'm way too clever for that. No, these slugs just thought it was me. The extra ace belonged to the Rodian who slipped out as soon as the trouble started.

Now I don't want this to worry you, but this guy's a serious gangster. I think he has ties with the big slug himself, Jabba. Not that I think you couldn't take him. Besides, how will Jabba ever find out it was you who made this loser disappear? I won't tell. Honest.
Good.  I thank you, my good friend.  Let me know when I am fully safe.
I'll stay hidden until then.
Snort! Grrumph! GRRWORRR!
You work for Valarian? You kill me and you're as good as dead.
Oh, right. Not your problem. I gotcha. Well, nice talking to you. I gotta find someplace to hide.
I understand. This guy's a serious gangster. I believe he's connected to the main slug himself, Jabba. I suppose if I were you I wouldn't wanna get involved either. Wish me luck, at least.
You're a pal! I knew you could take old Chumpy! As I said, I don't have any money but I can give you this. It'll bring you good luck. Honest. No, really.
You took that killer out? Really? Wow! You're one tough gundark, ace! I was saving this for a special occasion but this certainly seems to qualify. Enjoy it, ace. You've earned it.
So, is the thug still coming for me?
has that horrible Trandoshan been taken care of?
That;'s not right, them beating on a lady like you.  I'll help.
I won't let anyone harm a lady!  I'll kill the crime boss for you.
I don't see why I should get involved with this.  No thanks.
Now you're taking it a bit far.  No, I won't get that for into this.
Did you cheat?
Who's the Wookiee's boss?
Probably, but I don't want anything to do with this anymore.  Sorry.
You know what?  Nevermind.  I'm not interested in helping you out.
Yes, he still is, but I'm setting a trap for him.  You needn't worry.
Not yet.  His guards are a bit difficult.  I'll let you know when he's gone.
You have a lot to do already. Come see me when you've got a little more free time.
Nevermind, I don't know you.  Sorry about that.
Oh, I'm sorry.  I thought you were here to - well - nevermind.
Hnnaarrgh.  Hngh.
Oooh.  I thought you is someone who you is not.
Oh, sorry, I thought you were someone else.  Carry on.
You don't work for the Prefect?  Oh, okay.  I'm sorry about that misunderstanding.
That's all I have for you right now. Perhaps later I'll have more for you.
You are not strong enough in your Imperial conviction, or maybe you forgot to talk to Wilhalm Skrim?

Well then. This is not to go beyond this office. A certain Imperial official has assiduously fabricated false evidence to implicate this office in a bribery scandal. Lies, I assure you. A henchman is even now heading toward Bestine to deliver this evidence. In the name of truth and fairness, you are to assassinate this henchman.

The Stormtroopers in my Guardian Squadron recently found and destroyed an advanced assassin droid. A similar droid killed my predecessor, Orun Depp. Evidence on the droid implicates Gohn Bimmin, a droid engineer in my own service. Will you find and kill this traitor?
The droid engineer you recently terminated for me was hired by members of the Hutt gang. I have identified the intermediary who bribed the engineer. Will you execute my righteous revenge?

The planetary governor, Tour Aryon, has enlisted an ISB officer in a foolish quest to complicate my life. Of course I respect the ISB, but the informant who lied to that officer must die. This task falls to you, if you will.

Discretion is mandatory. The Moff has embarked on another silly scheme to discredit me. She has inveigled an Imperial Intelligence officer to slander my office. I may have ways of dealing with the officer, but I am hampered by his formidable Zabrak bodyguard. I require you to dispose of the guard, so that I can work my will.

The madwoman Tour Aryon has lured an Imperial Inquisitor to Tatooine! Insanity! The Inquisitor is even now tort-- interrogating informants at the Pit of Carkoon. Heed me: There is one man, not yet caught, who absolutely must not fall into the Inquisitor's grasp. You must terminate that individual at once.

Very well. You seek a minor gangster called Akkar Plint. He belongs to the notorious Swang's Swoopers gang. I doubt he'll be heavily armed, but then, I have no idea of your own capacities. Therefore, expect the worst.
I thought so. One of my operatives planted a tracking beacon on Bimmin, and I have waited to take my vengeance until he is likely to be isolated and alone. That time has arrived. Go.
Splendid. Through you I now carry my war against the Hutt gang straight to their own doorways. Your way lies clear!
You seek a Bothan female named Nwilla Thar-- Thal-- well, "Nwilla" will do. Watch those Bothans. They're crafty. Go!
My spies have placed the Zabrak bodyguard at these coordinates. Move quickly, and expect pronounced resistance from the target. Tell no one!
Here are the coordinates. Move quickly. Leave no one alive.
As you will. Note that if I hear rumors circulating regarding this henchman's sad fate, I will know who spread the rumors, and it will go badly for you. You may go.
It is unimaginable to me that you would allow such treachery to go unpunished. I shall remember that about you.
I am perplexed. Is the hunting and killing of a known criminal beneath you? How nice to have such lofty morals. This meeting is over.
I daresay your unpredictability must serve you in battle. But it is a charmless trait in social life. You may go now.
For once I cannot blame you. This assignment is more challenging than most of your ilk could handle. You may go.
Speak of this to no one. Get out.
I'm sure the official's identity falls within a security classification higher than any you possess. Do you want this assignment?

I suspect the traitorous Bimmin has been bribed by one of the Hutt gangsters. I have spread far and wide, even to Imperial Center, that I am determined to root out their evil. They fear me, as who would not? Will you take the assignment?
Your quarry is an alien, an escaped slave of the Wookiee species. He is one of Jabba's many hirelings. Killing that thug will only benefit this world and this office. What do you say?
The Moff may mean well, in her wayward, slapdash way. But her methods are misguided. Pernicious. I will say no more. What is your decision?

The Intelligence officer's bodyguard is Klaua Jik, a female veteran of the Dathomir prison. She was drummed out for insubordination and has since lived a renegade existence. The Imperial officer hired her, freelance, specifically for this trip.
He was my -- I was -- never mind! I shall only say that if this man falls into the Inquisitor's hands, my career is over. Do you hear? Over! Accept or refuse, now!
You must make haste.  If that false information reaches the hands of Tour Aryon, this will come down on your head.
You must be more efficient than this.  The longer you wait, the better a chance he has to escape.
You have the opportunity to teach Jabba not to interfere with the Empire, yet you tarry.  I highly suggest you expedite this, citizen.
You must not delay.  Take care of this and do not return until unless you have positive news to report.
This is good news.  Return when you have a full report on the events that transpired.
Do NOT tell me what and what not to do.  Until he is dead, I have much to worry about.  Remove him immediately!
You try killin' me, an' the Moff'll be all over you, you creep! That's right! Tour Aryon, an' none other!
Aah! Talmont found out! I knew that gangster would -- Well, I didn't take all that money just to die young and poor!
Hnnaarrgh!
Ick! No! I was guarantee-ee-ed ee-muniteee!
Are you the one who tricked me away from my boss? You lousy scum, I'll kill you!
Wha-- who sent you? The Prefect? He would never do that! Liar!
As you will. Note that if I hear rumors circulating regarding this henchman's sad fate, I will know who spread the rumors, and it will go badly for you. You may go.
It is unimaginable to me that you would allow such treachery to go unpunished. I shall remember that about you.
I am perplexed. Is the hunting and killing of a known criminal beneath you? How nice to have such lofty morals. This meeting is over.
I daresay your unpredictability must serve you in battle. But it is a charmless trait in social life. You may go now.
For once I cannot blame you. This assignment is more challenging than most of your ilk could handle. You may go.
Speak of this to no one. Get out.

You have struck a blow for the integrity of this office! Damage to the Prefecture would have been severe. That would only weaken the social fabric of this great -- er -- of this world. Return to me in the future for more work.
This hopeless betrayer has come to a just end. Never forget that to obstruct the rise of Talmont is to meddle with forces beyond control!
This stern teaching has now been tattooed on this world's dark underbelly: To attack Talmont is to commit folly! Fine work; you may contact me again.
Before long the criminal underworld of Tatooine will understand my mighty purpose. And the lessons that I hone and perfect here. These lessons I will carry on to greater horizons!
This is good news. I remind you to keep these proceedings secret, or you yourself will meet the Zabrak's fate.
Your services has been invaluable to me and the greater good of the Empire. It's a sad time when wearing the Prefect's uniform is to wrap oneself in thorns and razorwire. Go, I am distraught.
Has the messenger been taken care of?
Has Bimmin been taken care of?
I assume you have dealt with the thug, correct?
I am glad to see that you have effectively dealt with the Bothan.
Have you been able to remove the body guard from the picture?
Has Harbo been silenced - er- I mean, taken care of?
I understand and accept this duty.
I will deal with this traitor personally.
I shall do so for the glory of the Empire.

A spy has obtained records from a Mos Eisley repository owned by Jabba the Hutt. Jabba stole the records long ago from a rival Hutt crimelord. Now the Hutts are after my spy. Can you bring her here?
Drik's majordomo, Wizzel, holds my contract. I want you to get that contract back, by force. After I'm free, I'll look for my son, Kitster. What do you say?
Right. I'm told the saboteur is a Twi'lek named Binz. I doubt he'll let himself be quietly arrested. Report back once you've resolved the matter.
All right. You're looking for a Bothan named Silm'an Voueen. She'll have a datadisc for you. Bring it back here.
Good. I've got a lot riding on this. Please hurry.
Good. Wizzel will probably only let you have it over his dead body. That's fine with me.
That's all right. I expect we can handle one saboteur ourselves.
All right. I'd still appreciate it if you didn't let this get back to Drik.
Sorry to hear that. I've got a lot riding on this. But I'll try to make it happen on my own. Thanks anyway.

Some guy who claims there are problems with "working conditions" at the mine. Drik says the guy is actually a mine owner, out to undermine the competition. Can I count on you to stop his saboteur?

I had my own ship. Ran controlled medicines to Outer Rim worlds to bypass Corporate Sector surcharges. Lost my family in a Hutt pirate raid, and since then I've been wanting to get back at the Hutts. But right now, I need your decision.
They're records of Gardulla the Hutt's slave purchases and transfers. I don't know what the records say, but it's probably important, or the Hutts wouldn't be after them so soon.

I'm sending out messengers to the various cities, based on the information you brought me before. I'm glad there are so few cities on this rock -- the search shouldn't take long. I hope. I can't remember the last time I hoped for something so much. Well, will you help me?
What am I paying you for? Get to work and stop him!
Well, I'd appreciate it if you'd pick up the pace. I'm very curious as to know what the truth is.
Hurry, please. I've got a lot riding on this.
Once I have that contract in my hands, I will delight in ripping it up into a thousand pieces!
If you're working for Drik Bandrik, you'll die like his slaves are dying!
Ee-oo! Ee-you are the one I meet?
If you have anything less that noble intentions, know that I'm armed.
You don't leave Drik's service. He fires you. Permanently. Like this!
That's all right. I expect we can handle one saboteur ourselves.
All right. I'd still appreciate it if you didn't let this get back to Drik.
Sorry to hear that. I've got a lot riding on this. But I'll try to make it happen on my own. Thanks anyway.

Binz said Drik is a slaver? That's not the way I understand it. Except -- hmm. I need to look into that. Check back with me later.
"Kitster"? Are you sure he said the troublemaker is named "Kitster"? Oh no. Wait, maybe it's a coincidence. All right, I have to get some questions answered, fast. See me again later.
It's true, then. Drik Bandrik has played me like a dejarik piece, sending me to attack my son. My own son! Friend, check with me again. I have more work for you.

Thank you very much! Someone misordered this shellfish harvester, won't have much use for that here. You can take it in addition to your credit payment, hopefully you can find some use for it. I've sent out messengers to find my son. Take care of yourself!
Ee-yes, this data describes Drik Bandrik's slave operation. I enclose certain extra data about the troublemaker, Kitster. Perhaps ee-your employer will pay a bit more for this.
Jabba stole these records long ago from a rival Hutt crimelord, Gardulla. Rakir will find them very interesting. Please take me to him.
Has the troublemaker come to an end?

So where is she? She's not dead, is she?
Do you have my... grrr... "contract"?
Sure, I'll do it.
I'll do it. I'd like to know, as well.
I'll do it.

Who is the troublemaker, and why is he making trouble?
"Current" boss? What were you before you worked here?

Ah! You're back. Yes. Well -- ah -- nothing for you here, I'm afraid. But good to see you nonetheless.
I know it's possible that the brain was altered, but I don't think it was altered THIS much.
Would you terribly mind going out and destroying a certain gangster who stole one of the Jawas' droid verbobrains? And do bring back the brain, of course.

Recall that droid brain you fetched for me? Well, the Jawas put it into the droid's body, and the thing went absolutely berserk. Quite awful. It seems the Hutts have slicers out in the desert, and they are controlling the droid. Can you be a good soldier and dispose of them?
Well, you may recall our earlier matter of the killer droid? Yes, that's the one. That droid is now out in the desert, all on its own. Nasty thing. Could you, um, blow it up a little?

This criminal fellow works for the Hutts, but he himself, I'm glad to say, is a human. Or perhaps I should be sorry about that. Well, never mind! I suggest you can locate him at these coordinates. Don't forget my brain!
Well then! Look for the slicers at these coordinates. Note well! They are odd and detestable in manner, but not without skills in weaponry. Report back here after treating them mercilessly.
Fine, fine. Now, proceed to the coordinates given by the droid's homing beacon. I recommend extreme caution and heavy firepower.
Ah! Well. No problem, no problem. Enjoy the weather, then!
Ah, well. That's to be understood. This is not a matter to take lightly. Enjoy the weather, then!
Ah, well. I understand. This is a matter for brave hearts. Enjoy the weather, do!

Ah! Right! I am an itinerant buyer for a commodities dealer in Mos Espa. I have learned the Jawa language, and I find myself strangely attracted to Jawa culture. It's quite, quite -- well, enough of that. What about my little task, then?
Possibly those Hutt gangster scoundrels reprogrammed the verbobrain. The droid lashed out on all sides, killing Jawas right and left. Its behavior was utterly unwelcome. What, then, is your decision?
What -- ah -- what kind? Ah! Yes! Interesting question, most interesting. I -- ah -- I don't know. No indeed. Now, your decision?
Take your time, friend.
You might want to pick up the pace a bit.  There's no telling what those slivers plan on doing with that droid.

Ah, welcome back! All went well, I take it. What's that? An assassin droid? Why, how remarkable. Really. Well. Tell you what, you take this reward and we'll say no more about it. To anyone. Enjoy the weather!

Okay, hotshot, ready to play the part of a discreet courier again? I need you to deliver this datadisc to my client's droid, Envoy -- remember him? As usual, don't let anyone see you and don't let this disc fall into anyone else's digits that are not silver and metallic. We got a deal?

You know, I was hoping you'd ask about work. Remember how Envoy said my client would contact me again? What can I say? I need your magic courier skills again. You should know the drill by now. This time around it's a pickup. Interested?

Good. I'll transmit your image to the droid you'll be dealing with, so he recognizes you. Remember, the fewer individuals that see you, the happier my client will be. And under no circumstances should you let that datadisc fall into the wrong hands.

All right. The droid should remember you from last time. I retransmitted your image, just in case. And since we now know that Talmont has taken an interest in this transaction, keep an eye out for Imperial patrols. Good luck.
Great! I'm sure everything will go smoothly. But if by chance you should see someone following you, don't hesitate to open fire. You can't be too careful these days. Hurry back!
Suit yourself. See you around.
Too much excitement for you last time? I gotcha. Have a good one.
Come on, hotshot. This droid knows you and trusts you. I doubt the Imperials will get involved this time. I'm disappointed.
Codes on a datadisc that will help insure a smooth business transaction. They're encrypted, of course - so don't get any funny ideas. You in?
Confirmation codes that prove my client's bet was placed and my fee was deducted. And yes, it's encrypted. We doing business?
You're sharp, hotshot, no doubt about it. Yep, it's a new set of codes. Apparently my client got an "anonymous tip" and now wants to change his bet. So you helping me out or what?
That's good to hear.  Let me know when it's done.
Why?  I thought you understood that Envoy was waiting for you.  Don't botch this, or I might be a bit upset...
Well, get on it then.  A slow courier is an out-of-work courier.
Would you mind stepping forward so that I may analyze your features?
Would you mind stepping forward so that I may analyze your features?

Thank you. My master will review these materials carefully. Tell your employer to expect to hear from us again.
My master wishes to cancel his previous bet and put triple that amount on Lam Bregaani. He refuses to listen to any more of your employer's advice, I'm afraid. I beg your pardon if this sounds rude.
Why are you back?  Did anything go wrong with the transaction?

Welcome, yes, yes. Always the Third Sun cantina, raucous haven of pleasantries, is giving refuge from a busy busy life. You are to be talking to me when not so busy, yes?
What do you want?  I don't want any trouble with you, so just keep moving, okay?
Unless you're Jabba himself, I don't want anything to do with you. Get away from me.

Don't you have something else to do?
Ah yes yes! I, Stella, am to be welcoming you back to this eternal partying refuge from sunny Mos Taike. But just now there is to be no more work for you to be doing. So drink, drink!
Oh, no, no, this is not how much they are owing me. I, Stella, will only take what is being owed to me.
Oh, no, no, this is not the deed for the Third Sun. I, Stella, am being in desperation for that deed.
Oh, no, no, this is not data that will help me. I, Stella, am needing data only the Bothan has.

Ah yes yes. Welcome to the Third Sun, center of rollicking jollity in sunny Mos Taike. I, Stella, am to need sharp eyeballs to find problem customers in the desert. They did run without paying, and for Stella this is the crime of crimes. What is to be your willingness to help me?

I, Stella, for a long time have been owning this cantina. But now a stinking fink who is to be working for Jabba the Hutt did steal the cantina's valuable deed. He is to be taking it to Jabba, and Jabba is to be owning this excitable joint! You are to be stopping him, yes?

I did pay a Bothan spy to be finding information for me. He now has the data, but he is to be sending nothing over the HoloNet. I do now ask you, my friend, to be meeting the Bothan and getting the data. Yes?

Ah, yes yes. I did locate these stinking finks outside town at these coordinates. You are to be going there, getting the credits from them, but not to be killing anyone. Dead folks are not to be paying, yes?
Ah, yes yes. You are to be looking for Ulek Talstin. He is a dangerous stinking fink, so good luck to you, yes.
Ah, yes yes. You are to be going to the coordinates the Bothan did give me. It is secret, yes? He is to be giving you a disk to bring back here.
Ah, okay, ah. This is not to be a problem. I, Stella, welcome you anyway anyhow to sunny Mos Taike. Drink!
Ah, okay, ah. This is not to be a problem. I, Stella, still welcome you to this cantina that I am not to be owning. Drink!
Ah! I am most sorry. Ah well. No, it is not to be a problem. I, Stella, still welcome you to this cantina that Jabba is to be owning. Drink!
Ah, "Stella" yes. "Stella" is the short name of my name, D'Mayna Stallaphalat. I am Bith, as you see. My father did forget me here as a small child. What is to be your choice of my job?
Police? This is sunny Mos Taike, where law is to be coming out of a blaster barrel, yes yes. You are to be deciding now?

Ha! I, Stella, am knowing everyone in Mos Taike! I am on hello-terms with spies, miners, officers, farmers, Rebels, cops! -- Except, you are not to be telling anyone about the "Rebels" part. What is to be your choice, what?
Good, good. I, Stella, will be here serving drinks at this egregiously fun dive when you return.
Good, good. I, Stella, will be serving drinks at maybe Jabba's Third Sun when you return.
Good, good. I, Stella, will be serving drinks as I am waiting for the Bothan's data.  Do not make him be waiting too long, yes?
Hey! Who are you and what do you want with us!?
This little deed will get me into Jabba's gang, and you won't stop me!
I have been waiting for ee-you. Let us get this done before we are seen.
Yes, this is understood by me.  You let me know when you can offer your help, yes?
Yes, this is understood by me. You are to be letting me know later if you can be helping me keep this whoop-it-up hole-in-the-wall as my own, yes?
Yes, this is understood by me.  We are to be arranging a time to meet him later, maybe, yes?
Ah, this is to be thanked! Strange is the Mos Taike cantina business, yes yes. Sometime you are to ask me about it, and I, Stella, am to tell stories to curl your fur.
Yes yes! All is to be well now. I, Stella, am to be rewarding you with these jubilant credits! Go, spend them at the bar, drink!

Ah! It is here on this disc, the promise and threat of Lady Valarian in Mos Eisley: If Jabba is to be muscling in on the Third Sun, her gang will be landing on this esteemed dive and blowing it up to bits! I will be sending this to Jabba. A good permanent solution at last, yes yes. You are to be accepting this happy reward. Celebrate, drink!
Huh? We forgot to pay Stella? Hey, I'm sorry. Here you go. Please apologize to her for us, okay? Thanks.
Eee-yes, I have the data ee-you want. Tell ee-your patron I expect to be well paid at our next meeting. Well paid!
Ah, yes yes. I, Stella, am welcoming you to the Third Sun, this ideally bumptious joint. Have those finks paid up, yes?
Ah, yes yes.  I, Stella, am welcoming you to the Third Sun, boisterous hangout I am not to be owning long. You have found Ulek, maybe, yes?
Ah, yes yes. I, Stella, am welcoming you to the Third Sun, the ambiably pleasant hellhole I now fully own. You have met with the Bothan already yet, yes?
I'd be happy to happy to help you.
Yes, I'll get your deed back for you.
Sure, I'll get the data for you.

No, I'm not able to help at this time.

How did you arrange this meeting?
I'm not able to find these 'patrons' of yours at this time. Could I try to looking for them a little later?
I can't find Ulek at this time. Could I look for him later?
I'm not able to meet with the Bothan. Can you let him know I won't be able to show up?
I'm still tracking them down. When they've paid, I'll be sure to bring it back to you.
I am still planning a way to get the deed back from him. I'll let you know when I do.
No, I wasn't able to meet him yet. I'll make sure to show up soon, though.
Come back when you're not so preoccupied.
If you can, get to my friend, Tekil.  He can help me.
Still hanging around Wayfar? I wish I had something to keep the place interesting, but it's quiet right now. Thanks again for helping me before.
What's this going to do for my pain?

Are you offering to help? Well sure, I can use you. A friend of mine's been performing some research on Tusken Raider migrations for me. A womp rat bit him last night, and word from Bestine is that those vermin might be carrying a new strain of Gray Rot. Could you take this vaccine out to him and make sure he's doing all right?

Remember Digger? I just received word that the Sand People captured him. We need to get him out of their clutches immediately. I can't go myself because I need to get the settlement ready for a possible Tusken raid. Can you help Digger?

It's a good thing I was getting this place ready for a raid. Turns out the Tuskens have sent raiding parties against many of the local moisture farmers. Think you can lend a hand in protecting these citizens?
Great, thanks. Make sure he takes this vaccine as soon as possible. Gray Rot is only treatable within the first few days of infection.
You gotta hurry. I don't know how many Tusken took Digger so I'd bring some friends along if I were you. These beasts are mindless killers so start blasting the minute you see them.
I'd advise you take some friends along again, friend. Those Tuskens can be tough when faced in larger numbers.
Why'd you offer to help then? Excuse me, I'm a busy man.
Thanks for nothing.
Do you know anyone else that would be willing to help? I don't have time for beings that stand by and watch innocents get hurt.
Some kind of plague. Makes your skin turn gray and rot off. Nice, huh?
I'll spare you the gruesome details of what Sand People do to captives. Those creatures delight in torture. It's a sort of initiation ritual for their young warriors.
Must be in retaliation for you rescuing Digger and killing off a couple of their warriors.
This is urgent!  Please hurry!
This is urgent!  Please hurry!
This is urgent!  Please hurry!
Ooooh... the pain...
Help me out!  They're going to get me!
Why'd you offer to help then? Excuse me, I'm a busy man.
Thanks for nothing.
Do you know anyone else that would be willing to help? I don't have time for beings that stand by and watch innocents get hurt.

Good work.  Digger already says that the itching's subsiding.  Take a look at this Gaderiffi staff - it's the Tusken Raiders weapon of choice for close encounters. Maybe you can learn how to better defend against it from examining this one.
You've done well, friend. Please accept this payment for your valuable services.
Job well done, friend. You're welcome in Wayfar anytime. I came across this robe in my travels but I'm not using it so go ahead, take it as a token of my appreciation.
Thanks, friend! That bite is starting to itch something awful. This should take care of that. I hope.
Thanks, friend! I'm beginning to grow quite fond of you.
Did you give him the vial?
Have you helped Digger?
So, have the farmers been saved?
Sure!
I'll go help him!
I'll definitely help!
Sorry, no.
Sorry, I dont really care.
No, I really don't care about them.

Why are the Sand People attacking the moisture farmers?
I can't anymore.  You'll need to find someone else.
I can't anymore.  You'll need to find someone else.
I can't anymore.  You'll need to find someone else.
Not yet.
Not yet.
Not yet.
I hope you find Tatooine an agreeable place, citizen. There is beauty here that the casual observer might miss. Take your time and appreciate it.
I'm sorry, but I don't believe we've met before.  And if we can, let's keep it that way, alright?
What, you see an old man and assume he needs help?  Move along, you little whippersnapper, I don't need anything, mind you.  Shoo!
I mistook you for someone else.  I am awaiting a friend.  If you don't mind, I'd prefer to do it alone, thank you.
I'm sorry.  If Tour didn't send you, I'm not sure if I can trust you.
Oh, I am sorry.  I believed you were someone else.  Please nevermind me.
Ah, I see.  I believed you were a rescue team.  I apologize.  Have a good day, citizen.
I think maybe you have something else to do right now...
I appreciate your help in those earlier matters, but I'm happy to say we have matters under control here at the moment.

Eager to earn your keep, eh? That's an admirable quality. As it turns out, I do have something that needs attending. A friend of mine, who is visiting from Treylon II, decided to go sightseeing this morning and has not yet returned. Could you make sure he's safe and that he finds his way back here?

You did perform admirably on that last assignment. I think I can trust you with another. The renowned artist Sidoras Bey has just arrived from Brentaal. But I'm afraid he's rather absentminded. He landed at the wrong starport and insisted on finding his own way here. I would appreciate it if you could collect him and escort him back here.

I find you're a reliable and eager worker. I do have something else. An Internal Security Bureau officer, Nilsa Skaller, is investigating some prominent Bestine citizens outside the city. I'd like you to rendezvous with Lieutenant Skaller and make certain she returns to Bestine safely. I have reasons to suspect her life might be in danger.

I've long been trying to guide Jabba the Hutt away from violence to solve his problems. Any conflicts on Tatooine attract undue attention from Coruscant. Recently, I sent my aide, Belutoo Gezmaani, to Jabba's palace for yet another negotiation. The discussion went -- poorly. Jabba transported my aide as far as the Jundland Wastes, then left him there to fend for himself. Be so kind as to provide him a safe escort back here.

This assignment is a delicate one and might embroil you in the politics of Bestine - something you may wish to avoid. It involves the Prefect, a dangerous and vengeful man. Do you wish to help me anyway?

This next assignment will be your most important yet. A very powerful Imperial dignitary may be in great danger. This individual answers directly to the Emperor himself. Do you wish to become involved?
Excellent. My friend's name is Jen Torel. I do hope he hasn't run afoul of any Tuskens. Do hurry.

How helpful of you. Remember, Maestro Bey is a little sensitive about his fading memory. He's a proud man. Do your best to humor him along the way. After all, his coming to Tatooine to be my guest is a great honor.
I know there is an element of risk involved in this mission, but I was hoping the hint of danger would not scare you off. I'm disappointed I was wrong.

Wonderful. I was beginning to fear that I would need to involve Imperial authorities in this matter. That would only damage my relationship with both Jabba and Prefect Talmont. Please hurry and find my aide before he falls victim to one of Tatooine's vicious predators.

I knew I could rely on you. Jormun Shade, an Internal Security officer, just lost his Zabrak bodyguard to an assassin. Fortunately, Shade was undetected by the killer but is now understandably concerned about returning here without an armed escort. Make sure he gets here alive. Imperial Intelligence must hear what he has discovered.

Inquisitor Josard was performing an investigation at the Pit of Carkoon when something attacked him and his escort. We don't know the details yet, but somehow Josard managed to escape. He sent a distress signal from these coordinates. You must race there and offer what aid you can.
Perhaps you're not quite as eager to earn your keep as I had thought. Pity. I can be quite generous when the mood strikes me.
He really is not as bad as all that. But if you don't wish to perform this service for me, so be it. Have a good day.

My instincts told me you would not shirk away from danger. I'm glad they proved correct. Make sure Lieutenant Skaller knows I have sent you. Otherwise she might mistake you for an assassin and you could end up dead.
Well, I certainly understand your reticence. The Jundland Wastes are not to be traveled lightly. If you change your mind, let me know.
I respect your decision to remain neutral in this matter. I will seek another citizen willing to assist me in this matter. Good day.
I do not hold your refusal against you. This mission calls for no small amount of daring and skill. I shall find others to assist me. Thank you for all your help up to this point.
Oh, Jen has always had an explorer's spirit. Unfortunately, this has gotten him into trouble in the past. Life on Tatooine is not at all like life on Treylon II.
Maestro Bey is best known for his amazing sculpture of our beloved Emperor that sits outside the Imperial palace on Coruscant.

The less you know, the better. Suffice to say that some Imperial agents, entrusted with the very security of this planet, should make sure their own records are clean before they begin investigating others.
I sent him to ask Jabba to reconsider an attack on Lady Valarian. Unfortunately, Gezmaani suggested that Jabba's forces could not defeat Lady Valarian, without my help.

I won't go into specific reasons, but I will say that you should be suspicious of anything that man tells you. You should be even more suspicious of assignments from him. Imperial Intelligence's Internal Security division is currently investigating Talmont. That should tell you everything you need to know.

I speak of none other than Inquisitor Kuno Josard, an important figure in the Inquisitorius. You must be especially careful while in his presence. Say as little as possible and clear your mind. It is said he can read your very thoughts.
Well, you mustn't dally.  Jen is not accustomed to the wilderness of Tatooine.  I'm not sure he would know what to be wary of.
Very good.  Please do raise the intensity of your search.  It would be a shame if he were to wander into the desert, being an old man and all.
I am placing my trust in you.  So far you have shown it was well placed, so please continue making me feel that way.
When you are ready, depart with post haste.  He may not be able to fend for himself for too much longer.
That information Jormun has is very important.  You must hurry!
Make haste!  The Emperor will not be happy if he were to find out Josard were to have met his demise due to procrastination.
Well, well, good day to you.
Hmmm... where am I now?  I don't remember Bestine looking like this when I was last here.
Good day, citizen.
Were you sent by Tour?
Stop! You're not one of -- his -- agents, are you?
Did the Empire send a rescue team?
Ah, it's a shame you weren't able to uphold your end of the bargain.  I might forget this slight if you reconsider.  Until then, I don't have any more time for you.  Begone.
I hope this isn't an unfortunate end to such a marvelous mind.  If you find that your will returns, I may still be looking for him.
Well, I understand.  If I cannot find anyone else to do so, I will still need your help.  I shall look for someone else for now.
Well, I certainly understand your reticence. The Jundland Wastes are not to be traveled lightly. If you change your mind, let me know.
I respect your decision to remain neutral in this matter. I will seek another citizen willing to assist me in this matter. Good day.
I do not hold your refusal against you. This mission calls for no small amount of daring and skill. I shall find others to assist me. Thank you for all your help up to this point.
Wonderful. Glad to see Jen is in one piece. Allow me to express my gratitude by presenting you with this small gift. Thank you for your service.
I appreciate your help, citizen. Maestro Bey is dear to me and this service shall not be forgotten.
Again you've proven yourself a most reliable agent. If you keep this up, I may come to depend on you.
I am most grateful, citizen. And judging by his posture so is Gezmaani. Please feel free to come to me again for more assignments. I find I enjoy your company.
Thank you, citizen. I'll take it from here. Please see me later for an additional assignment. You may go.
The Empire is grateful for your timely assistance, citizen. I shall make a note of this in my report to the Emperor. You are dismissed.
Did Tour send you to find me? Will she always try to look after me? I assure you I was quite alright. Well, I suppose she's expecting us. Lead on, noble rescuer.

I certainly hope you don't think I'm lost, because I'm not. I know precisely where I am. I'm not sure why I ever agreed to come to this desolate place. I don't even like sand. Well, are you just going to sit around all day? Take me to Governor Aryon. That's what I came halfway across the galaxy for, isn't it?
You must be my official escort. Governor Aryon's efficiency impresses me. Take me to her. We have much to discuss.
You've saved me. That slug Jabba left me out here to die. I don't know why Governor Aryon insists on trying to make peace with that criminal. It's going to get me killed!
How do I know Governor Aryon sent you? I suppose you don't really look like an assassin. At least -- well, lead on, I'll follow close behind. Be aware that I am armed.

Do not concern yourself, citizen, all is well. The monster did manage to kill my entire escort before I was able to drive it away. Interesting creatures those krayt dragons. They would make a most formidable guard if tamed. I shall have to consider that.
Please don't tell me you have bad news about Jen.
I don't see Maestro Bey with you.  Where is he?
Where is Nilsa?  Is she safe?
Have you escorted Gezmaani back to town yet?
Were you able to make it to Jormun in time?
Was Josard dead by the time you made it there?
Sure, I can help!
Sure, I'll help the old guy.
Yes, I'll get in contact with her and make sure she arrives safely.
I shall do so immediately!
This sounds important!  Yes, I'll definitely do this.
I would do anything for the Emperor. Yes, I will do it.
I'm sorry, but I can't help.
No, I'm sorry, but I cannot help with that.
No, I'm sorry but I cannot help.
No, I am unavailable for such a long travel right now.
No, I do not want to become involved in some politcal game.
No, I do not want to be held responsible if anything were to happen to him.
Why did he go sight-seeing?
What is Sidoras Bey famous for?
Who is Lieutenant Skaller investigating?
What did Gezmaani say to Jabba?
Why is the Prefect so dangerous?
Who is this dignitary?
I can't seem to find him anywhere.  I've given up my search.
It seems someone else might have picked him up.  I can't find him, and I'm tired of looking.
I'm not cut out to escort such a high ranking Imperial.  You should send someone else instead.
I can't do it.  He is way too far away!
I've changed my mind.  I don't want to become involved in all of this.
I've reconsidered, and do not want to be held responsible for this.
No, no bad news.  I'm still on my way to find him, though.
I haven't found him yet.  As soon as I do, though, he'll make it here safe and sound.
I have yet to find her.  Rest assured, she will make it back here safely.
Not yet.  I am still preparing for my journey.
Not yet, but I shall do so immediately.
No, I am still getting directions to the Great Pit.
I wish you weren't so busy with other things. I really need some help right now.
You have nothing important to say.  I must bid you a good day.
You know, now that those Dim-U monks aren't hunting me, my life is getting downright dull. I almost miss the thrill. Almost.
This will not allow us to forgive previous transgressions.

You look like you might know how to handle yourself. Maybe you really can help me. Some crazy Dim-U monks have hired a bounty hunter to capture me. They say I'm to be executed for murdering a sacred beast. Can you help me?
I have a peace offering for the Dim-U monks. I hope it will get them to leave me alone. Interested in helping out again?

Good. I thought I was dead for sure. It's getting so you can't even protect your own property any more. The bounty hunter's name is Rhalia Jinsari. Stop her from bringing me in to those insane zealots, and I'll gladly reward you.
You have a good heart. It's not everybody who will stop to help someone in trouble.
I understand. I wouldn't want to go up against a bounty hunter either. You'd better clear out of here before you get hurt.
I guess a hotshot like you has better things to do. Thanks anyway.
All I did was shoot a rogue bantha that was destroying my vaporators. Those blasted monks worship banthas. I didn't do anything different from anyone else in my position.
I hired a talented artist to sculpt a bantha out of a piece of kiliad marble. I need you to deliver it to Brother Chonar and ask him if they're willing to forgive and forget.
Thank you for your help.  Let me know when I'm safe.
Okay, just let me know what his response is.  I hope this will appease those monks.
Come between me and my mark and you will share their fate!
I hope this will be a worthwhile communication between us.
I understand. I wouldn't want to go up against a bounty hunter either. You'd better clear out of here before you get hurt.
I guess a hotshot like you has better things to do. Thanks anyway.
You stopped her? You've saved my life! Now I just need to figure out how to calm those monks down -- before they hire someone else.

You've come through for me again, and I won't forget it. I used this to harvest resources from the rivers back on Naboo. Won't be doing much of that around here though so please accept this as your reward, maybe you'll find some use for it.
This gift conveys respect for the majesty of these great creatures. You may tell your employer that the Dim-U will pursue him no further.
Have you been able to stop her yet?
Did he accept my apology?
Sure, I'll stop the bounty hunter for you.
Sure!
Sorry, but I don't involve myself with this type of thing.
No thanks.
Did you really kill a sacred beast?
What is this peace offering?
I'll have to pass on this job.
I can't handle someone as skilled as the Bounty Hunter.  I'll have to pass on this.
This is too valuable.  I'm afraid it will be stolen.  You'll have to do this yourself.
I'll get back to work.
Not yet, but you needn't worry.  I'll put a stop to her.
I haven't made contact with him yet.  I'll let you know when I do.
Heyyy, welcome to Watto's Junk Shop! You look busy, eh? You can look around if you got the time.
Oh, I'm sorry.  I thought you were someone else.
Oh, I thought you were a friend of Wald's.  Sorry.
You don't know Wald?  He's one of your friendly junk dealers.  Good guy at heart, I can tell you.
Thank you, but I can make it to the hospital on my own.
Heyyy, friend, you looking for junk? What, work? Sorry, no work for you here today!
Umm... the plans aren't in this.  I was told to expect a droid brain, not this.
No, this won't work!  I need the mouse droid with the -er-... just get me the mouse droid, okay?
This won't help.  I need Wald's -um- junk he's sending.
Ugh... no... this won't help... I need healing... Wald has my special medicine.
Ehh, my repair droid went crazy and dismantled itself. I need someone to take its brain to a droid engineer for analysis. You, maybe?
See this part? You can take it to a poor fellow who really needs to repair his vehicle, eh?
A friend bought this hunk of junk off some Jawas just in town for a day. Soon as their sandcrawler vanished over the horizon, the thing broke. I fixed it, so you can take it back to my friend, eh?
Okay, you understand by now -- I like to help folks who are maybe not on the Empire's party invitation list, eh? One of them, she is wounded and needs a stimpack. You can maybe bring it to her?
Good, good! You look for a Mon Calamari fish-woman, name of Sawoos, okay? Her, she'll want to see this brain's data.
Good, good. His name is Minnro Lax, he says. You just drop this off, and don't worry about what he might say or be wearing, eh?

Good! You look for a Bothan, her name is Trl'apra. She's maybe not feeling so good now, eh? You ignore whatever she might say. I know you had no problem with that last little job for me. This is like that, you know?
Good! Danna Lindro, that's her name. You got to get to her fast, she is trying to carry a certain report to where it will do good, you know?
Heyyy, that's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
That's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
Heyyy, that's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
Heyyy, that's okay. You don't mention this to anyone else though, eh?
This shop, it still belongs to Watto. But he retired a while back to some sunny beach on some nicer world than this. Me, I run the shop for him. Now, about that repair droid, you can help, eh?
I dunno, he just called. Voice only, no picture. You want this job?
It's a sentimental thing, maybe. You want this job or not?
Ehh, she ran into some stormtroopers. Too bad, 'cause she has plans. Important plans, if you understand, eh? What do you say?
Good.  She's waiting to repair it.
He's needing it soon.  Don't make him wait or it might be too late -er- for him to have junk.
Yes, she's impatient like that.  Let me know when you get it to her.
I know you'll get it done.  Thank you, friend.
You wouldn't happen to be the courier, would you?
Are you the one with the droid?
Are you Wald's friend?
Oh... the pain....
Heyyy, that's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
That's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
Heyyy, that's okay. You look around, maybe buy Watto's junk, eh?
Heyyy, that's okay. You don't mention this to anyone else though, eh?
"Battle plans"? She said that? Ehh, just a running joke between us. No, can't say why stormtroopers would want a brain. Heyy, thanks! You take that droid's old head as a reward, eh?
Heyyy? A Rebel, eh? Who knew? Those guards must be after him, the scum. I mean, "the Rebel scum." Let's see, payment -- you want an old mouse droid, maybe?

Stimpack? Heyyy, now that I think, yeah, there was a stimpack inside that junk. Jawas must have left it. I like you, my friend -- you don't ask the wrong questions. Here, want a power core for payment?

Heyyy, you are my new favorite friend! You ever want discounted junk, I'll sell it to you and Watto will never know. Here, take this R4 unit. It wobbles, and maybe it kind of blows up now and then, but it's good!
Good, you're here. The battle plans are encoded in this brain? What do you mean, "what plans?" Oh -- nothing. Not important. Thank you.
At last! Those stormtroopers were about to find me. You've saved my afterburners, friend!
Lights -- too much -- uhh? For me? Oh! Stimpack! Ahh. I feel better. Thank you, I got hit with Imperial drugs and needed that antidote. But I lost the dossiers, sorry.
Oh! Wonderful! I thought my mission was over. But now I can get these battle plans to High Command. Thank you!
It has been given to the Mon Calamari, eh?
So, did he get the part in time, hm?
Is she feeling better now?
Is she feeling all right now?
Yeah, me.
I am very capable of doing so.  You can trust me, Wald!
Sure, I'll get it to him.
Since you're finally honest with me, I'll be happy to help.
No thanks.
No.   I don't want to be know as an Assistant Junk Dealer.
No, I'm tired of doing these for you.
What?  You're a Rebel?  No, I'm not having anything to do with you anymore.
Why do you run this junk shop? Where's Watto?
Who is the "poor fellow"?
A hunk of junk? Why does your friend want it?
How did she get wounded?
I'm sorry, but I can't do this any longer.
I don't trust you, Wald.  I'm no longer aiding you in your junk-giving.
I'm changing my mind.  I'm not doing this anymore.
I've changed my mind.  I don't want any part of this anymore.
I haven't given it to her yet.  I'm about to do so right now,
I don't know.  I haven't given it to him yet.
I didn't know she wanted this junk that bad.  I guess I'll speed this up.
I haven't been able to find her yet.  I'll let you know when I do.
Hello. You are here to see Prefect Talmont? He is unavailable at this time. In any case, you seem rather too busy to see him.
Um...*ahem*... I meant to say, "Nice weather we're having, isn't it"?
Wait.  Why am I talking to you?  You have nothing to do with this?
Oh, you're not?  Ah, good.  Well, then I guess I'm safe.
You've been very helpful. Perhaps you should go speak with Prefect Talmont.
No, this clearly is not the report that has gone missing.  It would be appreciated if you were to be a little more observant, thank you.
Whatever this is, it is not impressive.  Now, when you have the pertinent information, please let me know.  Good day.
I'm sorry, I only deal with Imperials of proven quality.
Rebel spies have stolen one of my reports. I want it returned before they get a chance to decrypt it. Will you go and find it for me?

One of our informants has become -- unreasonable. He claims he has some information of great importance to the Empire but asks an outrageous sum for it, sight unseen. Might you persuade him to relinquish it and let us decide an appropriate reward?
One of my --ahem, the Prefect's clerks has made a serious error in judgment. I need someone to arrest her before she causes this office considerable embarrassment. Will you do it?
Excellent, I'm sure this will go a long way in earning the Prefect's goodwill. Return the datadisc to me, and I'll see what I can do about getting you that appointment.
Very good. The alien in question is a Rutian Twi'lek, one Nethlek'Vaa. Go and bring the datadisc here.
Excellent. Go and arrest Ananda Dwyce. You have my assurance that should you succeed in this, the Prefect will most assuredly make time to see you.
I'll be sure to contact you as soon as Prefect Talmont has some free time on his calendar. Good day.
I had boldly assumed that you were serious about wanting to see Prefect Talmont. I shall remove your name from the waiting list.
The Prefect is far too busy to see the likes of you. You needn't return.

I am sorry; the Prefect is unavailable. He has left standing orders that he will see only those who have proven their commitment to the Empire. This brings us back to the missing datadisc. Your choice?
You can see Prefect Talmont as soon as you've convinced him of your sincerity. Succeeding in this mission might help in that regard.
The clerk has decided to join the Rebels. If she were to succeed, it would be indescribably awkward for the Prefect, to say nothing of the security nightmare.
Very well, then.  Report back if you have future updates.
Very well, then.  I hope you have made better preparations this time.
He may have time available to those who have shown their initiative.  So far, I'm not sure you're one who has.  Perhaps if I see Dwyce in your custody, my opinion may change.
Long live the Alliance!
I can't believe that skinflint wouldn't just pay for the goods.
The Prefect sent one of his men to kill me, please help!
No no no, you were supposed to arrest her, not kill her!
Oh well.  I'll be sure to contact you as soon as Prefect Talmont has some free time on his calendar. Good day.
I had boldly assumed that you were serious about wanting to see Prefect Talmont. I shall remove your name from the waiting list.
The Prefect is far too busy to see the likes of you. You needn't return.
Your service to the Empire is appreciated. Prefect Talmont remains unavailable at this time, but contact me for future assignments.
You serve the Empire well, and Prefect Talmont will note this. However, he is otherwise occupied at present. Contact me for future assignments, and perhaps I'll be able to get you that appointment.
You have performed admirably. Prefect Talmont will see you now.
I should have known I'd never get away. I'll go quietly.
Have you been able to recover the report yet?
What a prompt return.  I take it you haven't left yet, hm?
I do not see Dwyce with you.  Why is that?
I'll stop those Rebels from ever stealing anything again!
I shall have this done immediately.
I shall promptly capture this traitor.
Sorry, but I'm not here to see you, so I have no interest in recovering your report for you.
No, I don't run simple errands.  Do it yourself.
This sounds like a job for sector police, not me.
When can I see Prefect Talmont?
When can I see Prefect Talmont?
What did the clerk do?
I can't find these Rebels.  I'm certain they left the planet with your report.  I give up.
I don't have time for this, after all.
Look, I don't have tine to run around doing this for you.  Do it yourself, and in the meantime let me see the Prefect.
No, those Rebels are sneakier than I was expecting.  I shall find this report soon, I swear!
Yes I did, but I got lost.  I now know which way he is.  I'll get to him right now.
Because I haven't caught her yet.  Am I ever going to be able to see the Prefect?
You seem a bit busy. Why don't you see me when you have more free time?
Get out of my face!
Ever since you took down Blix Lanister, things have been real peaceful around here. Thanks again.
No, this won't do.  Sorry, but I'm going to need more than just this.
Actually, you might be able to help me catch the murderer. We have the murder weapon, but the fellow who owns it seems to have left town. Would you be interested in tracking him down?
I don't suppose you might still be feeling civic-minded? I'm a bit short-handed right now and could really use your tracking skills again. What do you say?
Blix Lanister's crew busted him out and left town. I have people out tracking Blix, but you seem to have a knack for finding him and his cohorts. Do you think you can find him again?
Glad to see you're the public-minded sort. See if you can track down this lowlife, Blix Lanister, and bring him back here to face trial. Be careful, he may have friends with him.
I'm glad to hear it. See if you can't find a Rodian named Gleezwuq and get the evidence back. He's the only one of Blix's gang who we don't know the location of.
Lanister may not let you bring him back alive. Do what you have to do.
I understand. Dangerous work like this isn't for everybody. Stay safe.
I wish you'd reconsider, but if that's how you want it, I understand.
I guess I'm on my own this time. Stay out of trouble.
His name's Blix Lanister. He's the sort of man you don't want to see after a late night at the cantina. He and his swooper pals have been no end of trouble.

Someone has stolen the blaster used on Alita Sweetwater -- the girl Blix Lanister murdered. We suspect the thief was one of Lanister's cronies. Without that evidence, we have a weaker case against him.
Blix Lanister's crew busted him out and left town. I have people out tracking Blix, but you seem to have a knack for finding him and his cohorts. Do you think you can find him again?
Good luck.  And be careful, too.
While you're doing that, I'll be drawing together a case.
We could use your kind of dedication around here, you know?  Let me know when this is all over.
What do you want me for? I didn't do nothing.
You ain't taking nothing back, ever.
I'm not going back there! You can't make me!
I understand. Dangerous work like this isn't for everybody. Stay safe.
I wish you'd reconsider, but if that's how you want it, I understand.
I guess I'm on my own this time. Stay out of trouble.
You did a fine job. You should consider a career as a security officer. By the way, call me Windy.
Great work! Now we can bring that scoundrel to justice.
I'm sorry you had to take him down instead of bringing him back to trial, but you did what was necessary. Good work.
I swear I was nowhere near the girl.  You can't prove it, either!
Do you have him in your custody?
Wre you able to get the evidence?
Were you able to bring him to justice?
I'd be glad to help.
Sure, I'd be happy to help.
I know his pattern.  I'm the best person for this job.
Sorry, not my line of work.
Sorry, not interested.
I'm not the right kind of person for this job.  I'll pass.
Who killed this girl?
What's the problem now?
How did Blix Lanister escape?
No, he gave me the slip.  I can't do this anymore.
I'm pretty certain I'd botch this, then you wouldn't have a case.  You'll need to have someone else do it.
I can't find him, Windom.  I'm sorry I let you down, but I have to give up.
Not yet.  But don't worry, I'm going to pick him up right now.
I'm still working on finding it.  I'll bring it back when I have it.
I haven't found him, but I won't rest until justice has been served.
Talk to me when you're not busy.
Then again, you don't even know what I'm talking about, do you?  Nevermind.
Your interference has been noted.
Don't worry.  I'm not interested in killing you.  Get out of here before I change my mind.
Oh, you're not a slug.  Sorry.  Didn't mean to insult you there.
Work? Forget it.

Sure, I got a job for you. A Bothan came in here a few days ago, bragging about a drink he invented. He waved the recipe in my face, laughed, then took off. No one does that to me. Get me that recipe.

I hate droids. Do you hate 'em? 'Cuz I sure do. One of those blasted RA-7 inspection droids just left. I don't think it was too impressed. Think you can stop that hunk of metal before it makes its report?
There's a Twi'lek named Veenos Thrax that has something I want. It's a small sealed vial. Think you can get it?
I need you to take out a Nikto enforcer. He's carrying an encrypted datadisc. I need you to bring that back to me. Can you handle that?
The slug's name is Baal Vurr'kya. You can find him at these coordinates. Keep it quiet.
Good. And bring me its verbobrain, just in case.
Make sure you don't break the seal on that vial. Get it on your skin and you can kiss yourself goodbye.
Here are the Nikto's coordinates. Don't hesitate when you see him. Just start blasting. And don't forget that datadisc.
Why are you wasting my time? I got customers to serve.
It really annoys me when you ask about a job then refuse it. Just so you know.
I hate when you do that.
Stop doing that! You're driving me crazy with that!
He called it a "Molten Core." Claimed it could shrivel the ears off a gundark.
They just take up space and they notice stupid little details. Like anyone cares.
Some new type of chall poison. Veenos specializes in toxins.
You ask a lot of questions. It's an order from Valarian to take out Jabba's lieutenant. I figure this'll get me in good with the Hutt.
Until you get it, stop wasting my time.
Until you break that thing in two, stop wasting my time.
Unless you have that vial, get out of my cantina.
Understood.  I hope you have some patience as I get around to serving you.  Maybe that datadisc might speed me up, eh?
You can't prove I poisoned those tourists! Die!
This is an Imperial matter. Do not interfere.
I can kill you with a touch!
Back off, slug!
Why are you wasting my time? I got customers to serve.
It really annoys me when you ask about a job then refuse it. Just so you know.
I hate when you do that.
Stop doing that! You're driving me crazy with that!
We'll see if this was worth the price I paid.
Huh, not bad.
I'll analyze this stuff tonight. Might come in handy.
This datadisc looks damaged. If it ain't readable, you owe me some money.
Did you get that recipe for me?
Did you scrap that droid?
Do you have the vial on you?
So, do you have the datadisc?
Sure, I'll do it.
No problem.  I'll do it.
Yeah, I'll get it.
Yeah, I'll handle this for you.
I don't care about this Bothan.  I'm not interested.
No, I don't really care after all.
No thanks.
Are you kidding?  I just wanted to ask about it, not actually do it.
What drink did he invent?
Why do you hate droids?
What's in the vial?

Pelig says he is on to the location of the Mamien's mate. He also told us he's investigated the lair while it was out hunting and does not believe there are others. We need you to finish this once and for all.

Perfect. Look for Sundre near this location on your datapad. Talk to her about the recent problems she has been having. The men think the jungle is haunted, but I think it more likely that the jungle is hungry. Be sure to bring me any evidence you might find at the location.

Very good. This is Pelig. He is an excellent scout, and I know he will find the beasts in no time. I will need you to accompany him through a dangerous section of jungle, then return here for your reward.
I know you can do it. Now Pelig places the creature right around -- here. If you head out that way you're sure to find him. Don't forget to return for your reward after the maneater is dead.

Some other time maybe?

Two nights ago there was a disturbance at a remote labor camp. Wild screaming and savage growling woke everyone up. By the time anyone knew what was happening one of the men was missing. The men think it was a ghost, but I'm sure there is nothing more dangerous than a choku gone maneater.
If the thought of hard working men and women killed in their sleep does nothing to motivate you, there is always the lure of credits.
Yes, stop the Mamien killing our workers and you shall have a great reward.

Well, you're just going to have to try to find the beast again. We can't stop now.

So the scout is safely in the field? We'll find our killer Mamien soon enough. And the sooner we find it, the sooner we kill it, and the sooner we can get back to work. Speaking of work, nice job.

Is there something I can help you with? I mean, I see you walking around IN THE MIDDLE OF A BATTLEFIELD! When you're not so busy, maybe you can do more than just get in the way! GET OUT OF HERE!
Never mind. I thought you were ambushing us.
We're not under attack? Oh, I'm quite sorry.
Oh!! You're giving me a blaster? Joy!
Move along. There's nothing to see here.
You've done good, kid. Now get out of here... there's about to be a whole mess of troopers coming in. I'll hold them off long enough for everyone to get out of here.
What's this? I don't want this! Now get out there!
What's this? I didn't ask you for a present, idiot! I asked you to take out that medic!
What is this? Look, quit fooling around and do what you have to do!
What? Get this out of my face and get back to work.
What are you doing standing around here? I don't have time to answer questions for civilians. Get out of here.

What are you doing there looking slackjawed? We have a situation here that we can't afford to sit around with our thumbs up. Look, I need you to go flank a squad of 'troopers that have my men pinned down. Do you understand, or should I speak slower?
Well now... those Recon units sure know how to scout out an area. We've found a hidden triage camp out in the jungle. You know what we're going to do about it, right?

Come over here. I've got an assignment that's of a... well, a sensitive nature, understand? I need you to fix a problem before it happens. If you're squeamish, you need to let me know now before we go any further, got it?

Damn! The kid had already made enough noise to draw the Empire down on our position! AAARRG! If I hadn't gone soft, I would've done the job myself. Look, you have to help buy us time so the other men can get out of here!

I'm glad I didn't have to repeat myself. Go to this location I put in your datapad and you'll find the troopers. If you get there quiet enough, you might be able to put a blaster through the backs of their skulls before they know what happened.
You're blasted right you'll help. It's not everyday you can get a clear shot at the throat of the Empire. Go out there and take out their medic. Got it?

There's a kid who's seen too much fighting and he's about to snap. If he does at the wrong moment, my whole battalion could be wiped out. Go tell him, "Hey, look over there," and when his back is turned, do what you have to do. Report back only to me when you're done.
That's what I wanted to hear, kid. What you've got to do is take out the preliminary scouts... if I can get my men out of here, I can take over where you left off. Now move out!
What did you just say? Did you tell me that you don't like my tone? What if I shove my face a little closer to yours. Do you think you'll like it then? WELL, DO YOU!??!
A non-combat unit!? You've got a guy out there who's patching up every one of the 'troopers who get away, and you call him a non-combat unit? The battlefield is no place to start getting soft!

Yeah, I thought you were one of those yellow-bellied civilians. You're all talk, but when someone puts a blaster in your hand, that's when you go weak in the knees... yeah, I know your type. Ptui! I eat people like you for breakfast!
So you're going to let a whole battalion lose their lives because you've decided to go coward on me? You disgust me. Get out of here before I break your neck myself.

Were you just born yesterday? Or maybe your momma didn't tell you what a TIE Bomber is? We're in a war here! My Recon team has encountered unexpected numbers and can't take care of themselves right now. Now, are you going to keep jabbering or are you going to go save some men?

In case you weren't looking, we're in the middle of a jungle! The Empire doesn't have time to set up shop and fixing their 'troopers, kid! Out here you throw on some bacta-soaked bandages and get back out into battle.

You know how an infected wound starts to rot and the medic says he's gotta cut it off or everything else will go? Well, that's what we have here... we've got a wound that's about to take out my body of men. I need you to be that medic, understand?

That damned crazed kid was out in the jungle calling out for his mommy! Well, those probe droids sure as all smack heard that and found where we were. Any more questions, or do you want to actually save some lives now?
You're going to go save a group of my men! What part of that didn't you understand?
You're going out there and taking out that medic. With him gone, the troopers will have to patch themselves up.
Look, I'm not gonna chit-chat about this. Take care of the problem and let me know when it's done, got it?
You're going out there and taking care of all the troopers you find! Now go!
What? WE'VE BEEN FLANKED! Behind us, men!
We're under attack!!! Get out there and save me!
Mommy, can I go home now? Please? Mom? What are you doing with that blaster?
Sir, over there. We found the right place. Kill him first!
If you don't have news that makes me breathe a sigh of relief, then I suggest you walk your rear out of here -- double time!
You let him get away? BLAST IT! That was our chance to try to slow them down, fool! Get out of here!
What? What do you mean you went soft at the last minute? You let the kid go? *groan* You have no idea what you just did....
You let them scout out our position? Do you know how many soldiers you've condemned?
Let me go check with the Recon group to find where they can be found. Ask me again in a few minutes.
Let me confirm with the Recon team where that field medic was. Ask me again in a few minutes.
Let me locate a good place to meet up with the kid. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I'll check to see where their troop movements are coming in from. Ask me in a few minutes.
What did you just say? WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY!? Gaaarrraahhhh! Get out of here!
Can't handle it huh?
Fine.  Get out of my sight before I get angry.
Go then.  I don't care.

The Recon team says you got messy with your rescue. You could've gotten yourself killed with that reckless approach. A good blaster in the back works just as well as one in the front. Well, either way, you got the job done. Good work, kid.
With that triage unit gone, we'll be able to hunt down any troopers we've managed to wing. Now maybe they won't be coming at us full force anymore.

It's done? Look -- we've all got blood on our hands, got it? It's one of those things that you keep from your kiddies, but you'll know it needed to be done. Just remember that. It needed to be done to save the rest.

Okay, while you were taking those troopers out, I was able to pull a full evac of our soldiers. Now you get out of here, too. There should be a few hundred of the Empire coming in. I'll take care of them. Nice having you under my command, kid. Now go!
Are you still here?

You haven't let me down yet, and for the sake of my men I hope you don't start now. That surveying team you helped out before is being attacked by a rabid pack of choku. I need you to get out there and rescue as many of them as you can.
That's just fantastic. You run this briefcase out to the jokers standing about near the location I've marked on your datapad, and I'll give you a few credits.

Hey, this isn't a situation you should approach lightly. Those anglers will eat a person just the same as a kaadu. I have faith in you, though. One of my men followed the things back to their den. I'll mark the location on your datapad. Stop by after you're done and I'll see you get your reward.
Good. Hurry, there's no time to waste. You know what to expect: choku are meaner than a sack full of womp rats. Still, I know you've got it in you.
Okay then. If you're not going to help, would you mind not getting in the way?
Hmm. Well, we should be safe for a while. Kaadu meat is very filling from what I hear. I do wish you would reconsider. Soon.
It seems I overestimated you. I just regret that it figured into the loss of my men.
It's just a quick trip to a few surveyors. It's nothing dangerous, but we have plenty of work to do. I'd rather not send one of my men out if I can avoid it. And I'm prepared to pay you well.

I don't blame you for thinking about number one. Anglers can be pretty tricky. Well, I've got a few credits for you. And there's this set of old mining coveralls I found in the storeroom. They look to be about your size.
How could you think of payment when the lives of my men are on the line? Are you really that mercenary? Sad. Yes, I will pay you if you save my men.
I'd say you should.
I ddin't think they were.
Yes, please do.
Hey, are you the courier that Jazeen sent?
Spare me... spare me. My child, my wife... Please help me!
I'm alive... but I'll be needing a visit to the infirmary. Thank you... for all you've done. You're a true hero.
This is what I get for asking a stranger to help me. Well, you know what they say about wanting something done right.
Well, it happens to the best of us. Don't let it get you down. Maybe you should try again?
It seems I overestimated you. I just regret that it figured into the loss of my men.

Hold on a minute, comlink going off... Jazeen here... Ah, Sithspit! All right, you keep an eye on them and let me know when they've stopped. Out. -- Well, hold your horses. Seems those beasties got the idea to up and move. Check back with me a little later and I'll let you know if they've stopped.

I know you did the best you could, and I'm thankful for that. You've done a great thing today. I don't think of too many people this way, but I believe the men are right when they talk about you like a hero.
Look at that. We'll get this scanner up and running in no time. Best you get back to Jazeen and tell him the good news. We'll take care of things here.
You've finally arrived! Thank you!
Is there some problem?
Those spiders dead yet?

Just the problem-solver I was hoping to see. One of my workers recently found an extremely valuable hyperdrive component but got jumped by some scavengers before she could bring it back here. She's recovering in the infirmary, but I'd really like that part back. Will you help me?

I'm always for living in peace with my fellow beings but I've had about enough! Commander Byrne is blaming me for all of this scavenger activity. I need to put a stop to all this thieving quickly or he's going to arrest me on conspiracy charges. Can you help me?

Good. Let me give you the location where that worker was assigned. Be careful out there. We occasionally have people scavenging around for things they can sell. The guards shoot them on sight so they're not likely to wait for you to introduce yourself.

These scavengers are really starting to become a problem. See if you can find the scavengers that ran off with that component and show them the consequences of assaulting my workers. And don't forget to bring back the hyperdrive part.

What would really help would be if you could find their leader and get rid of him -- or her. Once the leader is gone, the others will probably tear each other apart fighting over the division of spoils.
Then I must bid you farewell and attend to this matter.
I'd better find somebody else to look for it then. Good luck to you.
Did Byrne tell you not to help me? Why does he hate me so much?

Commander Byrne only tolerates my presence here because I do the job so well. I was hoping you might be willing to go and track down one of my missing workers before it comes to his attention. It would be a big help. How about it?

Certain pieces of equipment are more expensive to replace than others. This ship had the best equipment that credits could buy. Byrne will be slavering to get his hands on this piece. What do you say?

Ideally by ejecting Commander Byrne into a black hole -- I'm kidding, please don't tell him I said that. If you could find some of these scavengers and eliminate them, it would be a tremendous help. Will you do it?

A higher Flora Surveying skill allows players to obtain samples more efficiently. Resources will start to become extractable at lower percentages, and more resources may be found on a successful sample.  However, this skill mod does not necessarily increase the chances of getting a successful sample. Prospecting has always been something of a hit-or-miss vocation.

The Flora Surveying Range skill determines the range at which surveying is possible. A high Flora Surveying Range skill means that one can either modify the range at which surveying is seen. The result is that it is possible to get more accurate readings by reducing the surveying range one is looking at. This requires a surveying tool that supports range modification.

A higher Flora Surveying Resolution tool gives prospecting players the ability to increase the number of resource marks seen on their survey screen. The result is that players with a higher skill in this will be much more efficient at expediently tracking down high resource deposits, as compared to a novice Artisan.
