Through your help, I will now be able to present Lord Vader a more accurate report of what happened to the shuttle. For now, your orders will be to destroy the rest of these so-called revolutionaries.  Are you prepared to leave?

He is currently in hiding, and wounded as well, therefore this task will not be an easy one. I will give you the coordinates of where he last was when he contacted us. Bring him back here safely, so that we can debrief him to learn why his team failed.

Your eagerness has been noted. You should find it among the debris, but I would not put it past the locals to have already begun scavenging the ship for usable parts. At this time, the ship is not important. If the transponder, which possesses the flight data, is in the hands of a scavenger, you are authorized to liberate it from them. Now go.

I have had your contact, Geg Winthazen, notified.  He is a ballistics expert that has an exemplary career with us, and I appreciate his eye for detail. I am certain he will be able to identify the odd readings and trace them back to their source. This is being kept low profile until all of the proof is in.

I'm glad you are willing to help. I am in need of a jar's worth of Fambaa blood.  I know that it sounds odd, considering the current revelation of the Rebel's base, but I have a good feeling about this.  You should be able to find a sizable herd of these creatures out in the swamps of this planet.

As I have expected from your previous work already. You will meet a woman by the name of Seldair Keeloo who will sell you the weapon.  She doesn't know she is selling to the Empire, therefore she may react in an undesirable manner if she finds out. If this is the case, your objective is to acquire that rocket. You are dismissed.

No, this will be more retaliation than vengeance. Vengeance will ensue at a later point. For now, the destruction of this small band will begin to give all the rebels a lesson in what happens when one attacks the Empire. Report back when you have destroyed the group.

Though I recognize you are a special operative, rather than a fully enlisted member of the Imperial military, I still find your refusal a bit... disturbing. I am not used to having my orders disobeyed, and I find I do not like the feeling. I shall speak with the Emperor's Chamberlain about this matter. If you will excuse me?
I shall assume that these duties are more important than those assigned by a Captain of the Empire. Let us hope the next time we speak you are not so distracted.
Your lack of desire to further the Empire's cause will be noted. I shall personally inform the Emperor of your unwillingness to follow an order by your superior.
I hope you understand that this will cause a great inconvienence to me if I were to have to do this myself.  You wouldn't want that to happen, now would you?
This is not what I was expecting to hear from you. I am quite surprised to say the least, agent. Very well, then, I shall have another operative do this. You need not return.
I'm sorry, agent. I don't believe you understood me. This is not a request, this is an order. Perhaps you need a few sessions with the resident Inquisitor regarding insubordination?

We are still unaware of the full details at this time. All we know is that the transport shuttle was nearing its landing sequence at which point all contact was lost with it. According to the Commander's desperate call for help, we believe the shuttle was shot down by some form of ground based weapon.  This is all we know for now.

This is most likely the case, yes. Alas, not all of the enemies of the Empire are those with political agendas, though. Some wish to wreak their own self-righteous vengeance at the largest target they can find, which would be the Empire, of course. I prefer to explore every avenue before making a full decision, though.

The only thing powerful enough to down the shuttle, without registering any noticable energy readings, would be a hand held weapon. I have noticed some readings that do not correlate with any known weapons that could have caused this, though.  Therefore, it is highly likely that this was a Rebel attack by a previously unknown base. Will you deliver these now?

Yes, an errand.  I understand that this doesn't sound like the most reasonable course of action, but perhaps the results will be as interesting as those provided by these energy readings. Rhyme and reason sometimes take twisted routes that are not easily seen.

One will find that logic is not always a linear path to the end destination.  What appears at time to be convoluted chaos is in truth a disjointed thread in a larger, more ordered pattern. Many cultures throughout the galaxy call those who understand this 'Artists'. Much can be learned from these people, and I believe I will shortly learn more myself.

The paint I used was originally used by a species who have never used metal. By itself, it is quite innocuous, but when placed in contact with metal it will react in such a manner that can be confused for Ion discharge. Using a rocket launcher only sold by this Gun-Runner Hutt, I fired the paint coated rocket, exactly duplicating the same readings found on the shuttle. A clever decoy, but not clever enough.
Finish quickly.  I grow tired of waiting.
Bring him back here unharmed. You are dismissed.
Make sure you have everything you need. That transponder must be recovered.
There is no need to inform me of something that I have already expected to have been done. You are dismissed.
Very good.   Please continue.
Do not tarry. Every moment you waste will increase the likeliness that the gun-dealer will drop out of the deal.
Very well, then.  Make sure it is done.
Identify yourself! Are you one of them, or were you sent by the Captain?
We were here first!  Go find your own scrap!
So, are you the guy the Captain sent?
ROAR!
You're no weapons dealer.  You're that imperial agent everyone's talking about!  I'm outta here...
Imperials!  Protect yourselves!  And don't let them take us!
You were given both a clear and simple assignment, but were unable to accomplish even that. I am very disappointed in your performance.
It is a shame that the transponder was not there among the wreckage. It would have been better to have evidence to back us before we counter-attacked.
I do not wish to hear any excuses from you, agent.  I expected more, especially considering how simple this task was.
I do not wish to hear any excuses from you, agent.  I expected more, especially considering how simple this task was.
Without that rocker I fear my tests will not provide the expected results.  I deeply regret you were not able to perform so simple a task.
Perhaps I overestimated you. I believed you would have been able to handle this by yourself. A shame this did not turn out as expected.
Let me gather the coordinates from the Chamberlain. Check with me in just a few moments.
I need to gather the logistics. Check with me in a few moments.
I will need to contact him before sending you out.  Check back with me in a few minutes.
I need to contact Intelligence to find out where some Fambaas can be located.  Check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me check my reports to find where you are to meet the gun dealer.  Ask me again in a few minutes.
I need to check my reports for where the group can be found.  I'll get back to you.

Though I recognize you are a special operative, rather than a fully enlisted member of the Imperial military, I still find your refusal a bit... disturbing. I am not used to having my orders disobeyed, and I find I do not like the feeling. I shall speak with the Emperor's Chamberlain about this matter. If you will excuse me?
I shall assume that these duties are more important than those assigned by a Captain of the Empire. Let us hope the next time we speak you are not so distracted.
Your lack of desire to further the Empire's cause will be noted. I shall personally inform the Emperor of your unwillingness to follow an order by your superior.
I hope you understand that this will cause a great inconvienence to me if I were to have to do this myself.  You wouldn't want that to happen, now would you?
This is not what I was expecting to hear from you. I am quite surprised to say the least, agent. Very well, then, I shall have another operative do this. You need not return.
I'm sorry, agent. I don't believe you understood me. This is not a request, this is an order. Perhaps you need a few sessions with the resident Inquisitor regarding insubordination?

Excellent news. We will attend to the Commander's wounds, then conduct a debriefing. From what he has just said, it seems this is an attack by the Rebels. If this is the case, then the Empire will need to keep a closer eye on these events. As for compensation I recommend you take this.

You have performed your duty in a timely manner. I shall now have this flight data analyzed by my Chief Lieutenant so that we may discern what caused a Lambda-class shuttle to be so easily felled from the sky. I may have further need of your services shortly, so please stay within the vicinity.

I am glad to hear your mission encountered no complications. I am certain the results will come back shortly. I may have further assignments for you, agent, so please be nearby for the short future.  Oh, and Geg has asked me to give you this compensation.

Wonderful.  I'll be able to take this canister of gasses from the same swamp and combine these two together. I should be able to create a paste very similar to the paint used by the local amphibious natives in their art work. Check back with me shortly, for once I am done, I will have need of you to run another errand.  And take these, as compensation for your assistance.

Spectacular. This is designed exactly as was 'advertised' - extra distance at the cost of a smaller explosion. Now, all I need to do is apply this paint to the surface of a rocket...and...done. Now, if you excuse me, I need to run some ballistics of my own. If this works, I believe we will find where the mysterious 'Ion Cannon' has come from. Report back in a little while, agent.

I take it the rebels have been demolished? Very good.  I have presented the information to Lord Vader, and he is quite upset by the news. I have suggested to him that Colonel Veers will be more than capable of handling this situation.  You should report to him now.  Good work, agent.

Hmmm... yes, these look about right. Looking here, though, I think I see what Captain Thrawn was talking about.  Yes, I'll take these back to my lab and run some tests.  Let Thrawn know that this should take a short bit, but I'll have results for him later.
Excellent. Thrawn assured me that help would be sent immediately, and he was true to his word. Let's leave before these Rebels find us.
Perhaps I didn't make myself clear earlier. You are to escort the Commander immediately.
Why have you not left yet?
Yes?
Have you acquired the blood from those creatures yet?
Do you have the weapon with you?
Have the rebels been done away with?
Sorry, but I think you have the wrong person.  I thought I saw someone else nearby...
I understand, sir.  I will bring him back safely.
Yes, Captain. I'll bring it back immediately.
They will make it there safely, I assure you.
Yes, Captain, I'll do it.
Consider it done, sir.
Yes, sir. Vengeance will be exacted.
I'm sorry, sir, but I will be unable to follow this order.
I have other duties I must attend to. I cannot do this.
I do not wish to take this responsibility.
I am sorry, but I will have to decline.
I will be unable to attend, Captain.
I don't understand this. No, I'm not doing it.
Sir, if I may ask, what happened to the strike team?
This was obviously done by the Rebels, right?
How does this point to the Rebels?
I'm sorry, but did you say an errand?
I don't understand what's going on here. A weapon for a brush?
How did your strange tests pinpoint the smugglers?
Sir, I am not able to perform the task you have commanded.
Something came up and I can no longer perform my duty.
I'm afraid that I cannot do this any longer.
This is too difficult.  I can't do it.
I will not be able to follow this through until the end.
This is too big for me.  I can't do it.
At once, sir!
I was preparing myself for the recovery mission, Captain.
Nothing, sir.  I am about to leave at once.
Not yet.  I am still gathering more.
I have not met with the gun dealer yet.
Not yet, sir.  I was adequately arming myself before doing so.

You seem to be preoccupied.  I cannot rely upon a soldier to perform their duties if they do not have their full mind on the task set before them. Return when you find yourself able to fully accept orders.
Sorry good sir. I mistook you for one of those vile Imperial types. Tata!
Nevermind.  Thought you were someone else.
Ooops. I thought you were busting our illegal shipment. Nevermind then.
I don't know who you are, but if you know what's best for you, you'd get out of here NOW!
Move out of the way!
No, no... this is not it.
You are about to receive a great honor... you have been commanded to present yourself to the Emperor at once.
Where is the item you were requested to bring back?
You should speak with Lord Hethrir first.  I don't have anything for you right now.

At ease, soldier. You have been assigned to me by Captain Thrawn to assist in the retribution for an attack upon a military Imperial vessel. I have been ordered to track down the Hutt crimelord responsible for this heinous act. I am told you are adept at reconnaissance, and I am in need of those functions performed. Do you understand, soldier?

At ease, agent. I have an urgent assignment that I am choosing you for. The stormtroopers I've sent to secure the debris of the starport have come under fire. I have all of my other squadrons assigned elsewhere, therefore I need to send you too. Shall I give you the coordinates of their last known whereabouts?

Our search for the leader of the gun-smugglers has been fruitful. All reports have come back from other Stormtrooper squadrons that have been inspecting the surrounding starports, and it seems there is an unidentified shipment coming in. I'm certain this will lead to that Twi'lek's base, then we can commence the attack.

The ISB has been quite thorough with their analysis, and have been able to triangulate where Borvo's base can be found. I have been authorized to dispatch a team of special forces operatives to take him by surprise. I need you to be the one who will be responsible for the actual elimination of Borvo. Do you understand?

I have been given rather... disturbing... news. It seems the person that was killed was not actually Borvo the Hutt, but a decoy instead. In a... er... display of anger, Lord Vader has put the messenger on the casuality list. I have been authorized by Lord Vader to destroy the only known supply line, in which I have been assigned your help.

The rebels you recently eliminated have destroyed their own base.  Presumably some kind of self destruction.  Some people are out there trying to salvage whatever they can.  I suspect that most of them work for the Hutt, therefore I need you to eliminate everyone at that site. It is likely that some of their possessions will lead us to this Hutt. Depart at once, solider.

You should be able to find the squadron at these coordinates. Since the squadron leader was taken out, you are given full authority to lead them during the interim. Direct them to destroy all the surrounding opposition, then bring them back here. If the squadron has been decimated, then destroy the aggressors yourself.

The shipment has already landed and unloaded.  You will need to track down the caravan, which has opted to travel by land. Try to gauge what direction they are heading if possible and trail them. If not, destroy the gang that is transporting the shipment, and gather the manifest from the cargo. This may help the ISB.

Since the other operatives will be able to clear the way for you, all you have to do is identify Borvo - a Twi'lek -, and kill him. If there any guards nearby, do not allow Borvo to escape in the crossfire. You are dismissed.

I will lead a squadron of AT-ATs to destroy the buildings surrounding the supply line. Your job will be to take out the remaining rabble so that Borvo cannot be alerted until it is too late. Destroy any of them that you see.
I understand that you are a special agent of the Empire and not a solider, but I believed you would have assisted with this.

It matters not that you hold no rank. I have given you an order to rescue that contigent of stormtroopers, and you are in direct defiance of those orders! I will report this to your superior immediately!
And why is that? This is an important military matter, agent. Your help on this operation will be most beneficial, therefore I expect you to reconsider.

If this is a jest, I do not find the humor in it. Now, I have given you a clear order, and I expect you to follow through with it. Any other answer will be insubordination, and I will have to report this to Lord Vader. Now... do we understand each other?

I do not appreciate your insinuation, agent. I have followed my orders to the letter, and completed my assigned duty. The ISB on the other hand will have much to answer to the Emperor for providing false information. That is none of my concern now, though.

Captain Thrawn believes it has to do with a recent civilian law enforcement raid that was being looked into by our Empire. I believe there may be more to it. To risk such a bold move as attacking a clearly marked Imperial shuttle, I believe they were attempting to steal the identification codes assigned to the shuttle. Are you available to help?

They appear to have been ambushed on their way out to the target location. Those responsible for the ambush knew exactly where to strike first - the squadron leader. From the last report in, the stormtroopers were firing wildly everywhere. Well, more wildly than they already do, that is.

Our spies on Nal Hutta have failed to turn up any information on Borvo the Hutt. I have received information from the ISB referring to a Twi'lek that goes by that name, and has 14 charges of smuggling against him. I am certain he is the one using the Hutt pseudonym to inspire fear, but it will not work against the Empire.

No, there will be several more operatives such as yourself out at the target's location. Their job will be to pull away most of the guards surrounding this crime lord, whereas yours will be the actual elimination of the target - Borvo in this case. The Empire would never send you out alone against small numbers, agent.

Unfortunately not. Lord Vader didn't get much information out of him before he expired. We were able to find out that there is a major supply line that he was in charge of, in which we will have to capitalize. Aside from that, our leads have gone cold, and Lord Vader doesn't wish to expend any more efforts upon this Borvo.
There is no time for discussion.  Finish this task at once.
Make it so.
Carry on, then.
Make haste. You do not want your quarry eluding you.
Your cocky attitude may jeapordize this operation, agent. I suggest that you drop the attitude before it gets you killed in the field. Back to work, now!
You must stop the refugees from fleeing, agent. This is very important.
Heads up, guys! The Imperials have shown up early! Kill them!
Look guys!  There was still one left! Get him too!
Watch out! The Imperials found us! Take care of 'em, boys!
You led the Imperials straight here! Guards, get him! Guards? Guards?
Get out of our way! Borvo will hear of this one way or another!
Not one of them had any indication of where their employer was?  I find that quite preposterous!
I am disappointed in your lack of aptitude. Leave my presence immediately.
How did you let the shipment get away from you? I expected more from somebody of your caliber!
You let Borvo escape?! You were clearly instructed to destroy him! I do not believe Lord Vader will be pleased when I inform him of your failure.
You let Borvo's filth get back to him. This has caused the assault to no go according to plan. I expect Lord Vader will speak with you shortly... and shortly at that.
I must consult my charts to locate the debris of the starport. Report back in a few minutes.
Let me trace where the distress signal came from.  I'll let you know in a few minutes.
Let me triangulate where this team may be located at this time. Check back shortly.
I must consult the ISB's information so that I may direct you to Borvo. Check with me in a few minutes.
Once we have triangulated the location of the supplyline, we will be able to launch the assualt.  Report back to me in a few minutes.
I understand that you are a special agent of the Empire and not a solider, but I believed you would have assisted with this.

It matters not that you hold no rank. I have given you an order to rescue that contigent of stormtroopers, and you are in direct defiance of those orders! I will report this to your superior immediately!
And why is that? This is an important military matter, agent. Your help on this operation will be most beneficial, therefore I expect you to reconsider.

If this is a jest, I do not find the humor in it. Now, I have given you a clear order, and I expect you to follow through with it. Any other answer will be insubordination, and I will have to report this to Lord Vader. Now... do we understand each other?

I do not appreciate your insinuation, agent. I have followed my orders to the letter, and completed my assigned duty. The ISB on the other hand will have much to answer to the Emperor for providing false information. That is none of my concern now, though.

You have returned. I take it all went well with the elimination? I see you were able to find some information leading back to the Hutt. Well, we now have a name at least. I'll have Intelligence check with their spies on Nal Hutta to track down who this 'Borvo the Hutt' is. In the meantime, take this as compensation for your assistance.

It is a shame that we lost that squadron. Though numerous, Stormtroopers are still valuable. Nonetheless, those bandits won't be bothering any other Imperial soldiers in the future. You have done well, and I will make sure that is noted to Lord Vader at the end of this campaign. You should take this as compensation for your assistance.

Very good. I will have this manifest inspected by the ISB.  With hope, this may help lead us to where Borvo can be located. Once we finally have that information, I can launch a full scale assault upon his base of operations. Scum like that do not deserve to prosper freely.
Well, well... Borvo the Twi'lek's days of Imperial defiance are over with. As for you, agent, I offer you my congratulations for a job expertly done.

You have performed admirably, agent. The supply line has been destroyed, and Borvo wasn't able to make it in time. I will have to write up an analysis on usage of these AT-ATs for full scale attacks, based on their performance in the field. Who knows... perhaps I might gain a promotion due to it. Again, agent, I commend your skills.
So, you got me... I knew that the pay was too good to do this job. Why wasn't I greedy and asked the boss for more?... sigh....
I see you have not left yet. Why is this?
Why have you not dispatched yourself by now?
Whay are you not intercepting the shipment?
The operation has begun! Why are you still here?
Why have you not stopped Borvo's messengers from leaving?
Nope, I'm not the person you're looking for.  Try looking nearby.
Loud and clear, Colonel! I'll lend a hand.
Yes, sir! Where can I find them?
I understand. I shall intercept that shipment.
Yes, sir.  It will be done.
I understand. I am at your disposal.
I understand, but I am unavailable right now.
Sir, I am an agent, not an Officer. I can't do this.
I am unable to do this for you, Colonel.
That is not something I can do.
I will not engage in another failed venture, Colonel.
Do we know why the shuttle was downed?
What happened to the stormtroopers?
Twi'lek? I thought Borvo was a Hutt?
Will I be the only one on this operation?
Didn't we get any information as to where the real Borvo is?
I will no longer be able to perform this duty.
I can no longer perform the functions of an officer.
I will not be able to follow this order, Colonel.
I cannot do my part in this operation, Colonel.
I don't want to follow this cockamamie plan, Colonel.
I will be leaving immediately.
I needed to re-equip myself first. I depart now.
I am leaving to do so right now.
I was waiting for it to start to give the others time.
I am about to leave shortly.
You do not yet have permission to access this area.
You can not enter the main hall without permission from Kaja Or'Zee.
You can not enter the library until Loam Redge gives you permission.
You may not enter the secure area until Lord Hethrir has deemed you worthy.
Sorry, only Imperial employees are allowed to work for us.
Only Lord Vaderand his personal charges have access to this area.
You can not enter the Throne Room until Veers gives you permission.
Sorry, too busy to talk.
You better head to the throne room and see Bib.  He's expecting ya.
What's this?  Where's the item I asked for?
You shouldn't be down here.  Why don't you head back upstairs and see if anyone needs some work done.  Try Porcellus.

Hey you!  I heard you been doing favors for Jabba's cronies.  Maybe you can help me, huh?  I got a plan to earn my freedom from Jabba. But first I need to grab a special code cylinder from one of Valarian's thugs. You think you can get that cylinder for me?
This is the cylinder I wanted, but I can't crack the code. I need someone to take the cylinder to a scientist I know.  He can decode it.  Want the job?
Good work. The cylinder had a self-destruct code for one of Lady Valarian's storehouses. I'll give you the coordinates to the warehouse, but you'll need to punch in the code. Then run.

Good, good. Here's where you can find the roughneck. Once you've settled your business, bring me that code cylinder.  Meanwhile, I've got to get back to working on Jabba's collection of repulsorlifts, or he might decide he doesn't need me anymore, if you know what I'm sayin'...
Good. Take the cylinder to my friend. Check back with me after you've delivered it.
Good. You're earnin' my trust.  When you're done, come back here and tell me all about the blast. And don't forget to run.
Hey, I can understand that. I'm just one of Jabba's slaves, right?  I'll be sure to let Bib know just how helpful you were to Jabba's personal mechanic.
You're missing out on a payin' job.  But I'll get this done with or without your help!
Hnh. Suit yourself. I can find someone else to take this job, if you don't want it.
Don't ask so many questions. I'll tell you what you need to know, when you need to know it.
I need this cylinder scanned for security measures. I don't want to be walking into any traps. And I'll need copies made. It's all part of my plan. But quit asking questions and just get to work.
There's a terminal there that has a self destruct sequence on it.  Just set it and get out of there.
Get back to work, I ain't got time to chat.
Jabba's thugs eh?  You'll be no match for us.
Hey, are you Barada's buddy?
ALARM!
They said you could do anything, but I guess I heard wrong about you.
What, are you a bolthead? All I asked you was to deliver an object for me, and you couldn't even do that? I guess I've got to get back to work.
You ruined everything that I was working for! Now how am I gonna get out of being a slave to Jabba? Thanks alot...
Yeah, fine, whenever you're ready.

Good work gettin' that cylinder. I knew you were looking for the trouble.  Let me make sure this thing isn't wired, and then we'll talk about the next part of my plan.  And here, I had these laying around, I figured you've earned a little bonus.

My friend contacted me. The cylinder is clean and copies have been made. I'm thinkin' you can be trusted to handle the next phase of my plan.  Oh, and one of the Gamorrean's stumbled across this.  He wouldn't say where he got em, but I suspect there's a visitor missing.  Heh, I'll give it to you.

Good work! Tell me everything. Was it loud? How hot was it? Was the explosion a ball of flame, or a column of fire? I wish I could have been there! Anyway, Jabba thinks my plan was a good one. He's promised me my freedom, but I still got a debt to work off... Oh, but I do have this for you.
That's the code Barada's looking for.  Let me know what happens.
Hey, did you get my cylinder?
Did you deliver my cylinder?
Did it blow up?  Or have you not gone yet?
Sure.  I've already dealt with her thugs in the past.  This shouldn't be a problem.
This is beginning to sound interesting.  Count me in!
I've come this far, haven't I?  I'll see this to the end!
I'm tired of dealing with Valarian's thugs. They're not much of a challenge.
If you can't get away from working on those repulsorlifts, what makes you think you can pull this off?  Count me out.
I have a bad feeling about this.  I'm going to have to say no from hereon.
What are you planning?  Something I shouldn't know about?
The suspense is killing me.  What's your scientist friend going to do with the code cylinder?
What do these codes do?
I need to take a breather and try this again later.
Oh, yeah, I'll get back to work.
Speak to G-5PO.   Jabba has some things for you to do.
You are not allowed in the throneroom yet.  Go back and see Barada.

His Excellency has requested your assistance, and I know you will be happy to please Jabba.  An associate of His Excellency is expected here soon, but we don't want him leading any unwanted miscreants to the palace. Find Romo Vax and bring him here safely, and you will fulfill Jabba's wishes.

YOU FOOL! Romo was being pursued by a bounty hunter, and you've led the mercenary here!  My informants tell me that the bounty hunter is nearing the Palace even as we speak. You have but one chance to save yourself from Jabba's Rancor. Kill the bounty hunter before he reaches Romo Vax!

Jabba and Romo Vax have been engaged in conversation for a while now. Since I am his majordomo, I must run Jabba's operation for him while he is unavailable.  You will need to get in touch with one of my contacts and bring me a schematic he claims will make my job much easier.  You wish to do this for me and Jabba, correct?

My *now* FORMER contact has been paid for a faulty product.  Since he was unable to produce what he promised, he will NOT be paid for his failure.  He has been allowed to run a small time slaving operation here on Tatooine, but his 'charter' will now be revoked.  Go out there and remove him and his band from Tatooine... permanently.

Jabba will be pleased to hear that you have so graciously offered your time. But if Romo Vax is harmed in any way, Jabba will not be so pleased.  And take care that no one follows you back to the palace! I'm sure Romo has a great many enemies...

It will be in your best interests to make certain that bounty hunter is dealt with before he can reach the Palace. I will distract Jabba long enough for you to clean up your mess.  Let me know when you have attended to the matter.

If what my contact says is true, then yes... yes, the pay off will be well worth it.  Now, go track him down, for he is in hiding after getting ahold of his plan. You will find him nearby, so you should depart as soon as possible.  I know you will bring me back this schematic safe and sound.

Very good.  You will find them out in the desert, quite unaware that their real payment will be coming. This will serve doubly to let everyone know that all slaves on Tatooine are property of Jabba, and no one else. Return here to let me know when it is done.
Hmm.. I will be sure to let His Excellency know that you have turned down his request. You are truly wasting your potential.
It's a pity that you are not more responsible. You should hope that no one informs Jabba about the mess you have made, hmm?  His Excellency will be most... displeased.

You work for Jabba now, my friend, but what if something bad were to happen to Jabba, hmm?  Someone would have to take over for him, of course. Preferably someone with a... long memory, perhaps?  I will let you think on that, my friend.

Mistakes, is it?  Very well, my friend.  I will be giving Jabba an update later today on his current profits.  I sure do hope I am able to get all the names straight of who has caused problems around here recently. For your sake, you may want to return to me before I give Jabba the report, if you follow what I am saying.
You have attracted Jabba's attention. He favors those who exhibit great boldness. I have advised Jabba that only you can perform this task. Are you truly prepared to disappoint Jabba?
Surely you are not frightened by a mere bounty hunter, are you? Hmmm... perhaps I was wrong about you? Should I let Jabba know that you are not qualified for any jobs that require violence?

This schematic may help create a means for me to solve my day's annoyances.  If this schematic does what my contact says it does, then Jabba will never again have to fret his bloated - I mean - beautiful head over people trying to betray him... ever again.  If you do this for me, I have a good feeling you will go far within my - er - his Palace.

You ask a lot of questions, my friend.  Questions get people killed around here.  All you need to know is what I've told you, and nothing more.  If you'd like, though, I can tell Jabba that you are curious about how he does things around here.  I'm sure he would be happy to know how much of an interest you've taken to daily operations.
You'd better be finished with that task soon.
Hello.  I'm Romo Vax!
Where is Romo Vax?  You can't hide him forever!
Are you Bib Fortuna's courier?
One of Bib's new thugs, huh?   Hahaha, you won't last...
I will not be the one to inform Jabba that you let Romo get killed. I will give you the pleasure of doing so yourself.
I think you would like to be the first person to know that Romo Vax was found dead in his chambers about an hour ago. And now... I will be letting Jabba know the same.
Where is that schematic? Don't think that I will believe for a moment that you have 'lost' it... WHO DID YOU SELL IT TO!?
A group of sand-ridden worrts such as those salvers were too much for your skills!? Get out of here, for you disgust me.
Don't make me wait too long.
Excellent.  Jabba will be pleased to learn that his associate has arrived unharmed. You have performed your duty well, which will be reported to His Excellency.  I will inform him now.

The bounty hunter has been eliminated?  Good.  If you do not wish to become Jabba's dinner entertainment, you will learn from your carelessness.  His Excellency does not enjoy hearing bad news. If I am caused distress such as this again, I will blast you myself. But we may still gain from this. Let me devise a new scheme. Return to me later.  Also, Ephant Mon wanted you to have this.

Now...let me look at this schematic.  Mmmhm.  Yes, I see.  Mmmhm. Hmm? What? No!  This is nothing as he had said.  Blast it!  This will never work!  Aaargh!  Wonderful... another of my day's annoyances.  Very well, then. You have done what we agreed, therefore you will be compensated.  I will speak with you later.  What?  Your reward?  Ah, here, take this.

No one survived, correct?  Good.  I will now inform Jabba that the band of slavers that were trying to move into his territory have been dealt with.  Jabba will be most pleased to hear this.  I shall also let him know that you were personally the one who took care of the problem.  You are welcome, as well to take this. Good work.
That's that.  You can head on back now.
Ok, I'm ready to go to the palace.
Where is Romo Vax?  Don't tell me you haven't gone to find him!
Has the bounty hunter been eliminated?
Where is my schematic?
Have those slavers been re-educated?
Sorry, I can't chat right now.
I will bring Jabba's contact here safely.
Don't worry, Romo will be safe. I can handle a bounty hunter.
Yeah, I'll do it as long as it pays well.
Point me at them and they'll be taken care of.
My services don't come free.  Either Jabba pays me, or you do the dirty work yourself.
You never said anything about a bounty hunter!  I'm not risking my hide for scum like Romo!
I work for Jabba, not for you, Bib.  Get someone else to do it.
I'm not fixing your mistakes, Bib. Go do it yourself.
Why has Jabba chosen me?
Why didn't you tell me about the bounty hunter before?
How will this schematic make your job easier?
Does Jabba know about this?
I need to start over.  Can I do that?
I'm getting back to work right now.
System detects lifeforms inside building, shutting down self destruct
Sorry, I can't talk now.
Sorry, I can't talk now.  I have things to do...
If you're looking for something to do, try the kitchen.  Porcellus always needs a hand.
So, uh, where's that thing I asked for?
You shouldn't be up here.  Go see Ree-Yees if you need a job.

Hngh. You want a job, eh? You want to serve Jabba? Valarian's thugs are makin' loud threats 'bout hurtin' some of Jabba's "customers".  They need to learn to be quiet.. Go silence them. For good. Do you understand?
Ngh. You back? Good. Jabba wants revenge against Valarian. You're gonna find and punish one of her couriers. You wanna do this small favor for Jabba?

Hurn. We have a problem with the stolen ledger. Bib Fortuna can't make snout nor stump of the ledger's code....again. But Jabba has a code-slicer in his pocket. Jabba wants you to take the ledger to this slicer, Sirad Far. You gonna take this assignment?
Once you shut 'em up, return here to let me know.

Good. That courier is carryin' a special package. Bring the package back to me. An' make sure the courier is dead. We're sendin' a loud message to Valarian. She better learn to keep her snout outta Jabba's business, or it's gonna get chopped off.

Good choice, friend. Take this ledger to Sirad Far, who is waitin' for you. I hear Sirad wants to thank you personally for helpin' with some of his former...associates. Leave the ledger with him, then come back to the palace.
I'm gonna think that you turned down this job 'cause you're spineless, not because you have a soft spot for Valarians' thugs...
Hmmmm.... So, you're too good for one of Jabba's simple jobs now, eh? Maybe you don't value your life or reputation?
Guess I was wrong about you. I thought you wanted to get close to Jabba. If you're smart, you'll reconsider.

Jabba protects anyone willin' to pay for it. I'm not gonna let Lady Valarian's thugs try to make Jabba look weak. So, you're gonna show everyone on this planet that payin' Jabba protection fee is worth every credit. You're up for the job, right?

The courier is nobody. Just another mercenary who needed a job. But Jabba wants what the courier is carryin'. The package has financial information from Valarian's compound. We can use that information to ruin her.

Jabba's spies are morons. None of 'em knew that the ledger was written in code. Valarian is using an obscure form of Old Drall in that book, an' nobody here can read it. Fortunately, Jabba has a big brain named Sirad Far on the payroll. Jabba's been helpin' Far with a few of his problems, and now Sirad's more than happy to read the ledger for the Hutt..
You better get that task done quick.
One of the green guy's slugs eh?  We'll take care of ya...
Who are you?  What has Valarian gotten me into now?!?
Hey, did you come to drop something off?
Ngh. You couldn't even handle a group of thugs like that? Get outta of my face! And don't even think of wanting to work for Jabba in the future, got it?
You have a lot of courage coming back here without that package in your hands.
Let's go over this again. You said a Krayt Dragon rose of the sand and ate the ledger? And you also thing that I'm a monkey-lizard, right?
Yeah, ok.  Come back when you're ready.
I hear you took care of our little problem.  Jabba's clients will be glad to hear it.  Good job. Perhaps, you come back to me for future assignments, hmm?
Ah, you have the ledger.  Good.  Jabba's spies say that Valarian is foaming after losing it.  Take this reward for all your help.
Jabba has heard your name. Keep showin' your loyalty and I'm sure you'll be invited to join his court. Maybe you can find more to do to keep on his good side.  Try Porcellus, he may have some work.
That's the ledger?  That was a snap.
Did you take care of those loud mouths?
That courier get taken care of yet?
Did you deliver that ledger to our friend yet?
Yes, I think I understand.  I'll be happy to take care of them.
If Jabba needs this done, then I'm the one for the job.
I don't want to see Jabba angry. I'll do it.
If you're saying you want them killed, then I don't want the job.
No, I'm not interested in doing courier "work".
I am sick of delivering ledgers.  Find someone else to do it.
Why can't Jabba's customers protect themselves?
What is so special about this courier?
What's so hard about reading a simple bank ledger?
I'm not ready for this mission, I'd like to back out.
I'll get right to it sir.
Don't you have something you should be doing?
Currently Jabba has nothing left for you to do.  Feel free to relax here within the palace.  Perhaps some more work will become available in the future.
Jabba wonders what became of the item he asked you to acquire?
Jabba wishes to know why a worm such as you, who doesn't even have the approval of Bib Fortuna, would even attempt to talk to him.   Perhaps you'd like to see our Rancor?

The Illustrious Jabba the Hutt bids you welcome to his court.  He wishes you to perform a favor of great importance.  Lady Valarian has mistreated one of her accountants, one who understands the greatness of Jabba's power.  You are instructed to locate Scrib Leras and bring him to Jabba's court so that he may offer Jabba his information.

While you were out, Jabba the Hutt, Prince of Tatooine, has learned that Lady Valarian did not wish to execute Scrib Leras.  Instead she wished to interrogate him, engaging the services of a most skilled interrogater.  Jabba wishes you to extinguish the life of this interrogater to repay Lady Valarian for past transgressions.

Jabba explains that his associate, Romo Vox, has uncovered yet another traitor within Jabba's Court.   His Highness has been told that this traitor has sent a message to Lady Valarian via the services of a courier.  Jabba the Hutt demands that you find the messenger and recover that missive.

Jabba is quite furious over the contents of the recovered message. It included a schedule of guard changes, which Lady Valarian's thugs plan to use to infiltrate the palace. The Resplendent Jabba wishes you to locate Valarian's incoming strike team and deal with them accordingly.

The Splendid Jabba the Hutt has requested your services again. You have served him well in the past and he believes you can be entrusted with another sensitive assignment. You are to intercept a smuggler who has business with the Lady Valarian. You are authorized to pay this smuggler more credits than Lady Valarian can offer, and bring whatever 'merchandise' he is carrying to Jabba.

The Great Jabba the Hutt requires your previous assignment to be completed.  The smuggler, Belshu Dadar, has made contact with Jabba himself following your business deal.  It seems Dadar has a price on his head. Jabba wants you to terminate the bounty hunters pursuing Dadar.

You have been contracted to do another job for Jabba the Hutt. You are instructed to take this case of credits to an associate of Jabba's, one Sliv Jurek. Jurek will then give you an electronic key, which you will bring to Jabba. You have proven yourself to Jabba in the past. Do not fail him now...

His Exhaltedness, Jabba the Hutt, has given you the honor of recovering the Rantok Sword for him.  Enter the predesignated warehouse using the provided passcode, and recover the sword.  You should be quite capable of dealing with any opposition. Shall I tell him you accept this mission?

His Highness says that you are to meet Scrib Leras and provide suitable protection as you escort him to the palace. Jabba will be most displeased if he has misplaced his trust in you. You are to return in a timely manner, for Jabba the Hutt is not to be left waiting.

Lady Valarian's torturer will be waiting for Scrib Leras. You will meet with him instead, and deal with the man using your special talents. Jabba will want a full report on how many times the torturer screamed before he died.
Jabba is pleased by your willingness to serve him. Return with the message in hand, and you will be rewarded well.
Excellent!  Now perhaps Jabba will stop blaming everything on me! As usual, the Glorious Jabba will expect this task to be completed quickly.
That is so good to hear! Of course, what I mean to say is that Jabba is satisfied with your initiative and will expect this mission to be completed shortly.
The Glorious Jabba the Hutt says that if you are able to eliminate these bounty hunters, you will prove yourself to him. That endorsement will take you far within his court, I must say.

His Grandness says that he will expect you to follow through with this. If you think of taking the money for yourself... oh dear.. he says that he will watch you eaten by his pet brachno-jags for the next week. Please return with his key.
Jabba is eagerly awaiting his sword. He will enjoy displaying it to everyone. It will become a symbol of his swift justice. Please do return quickly.
Jabba feels that his offer of employment was most generous, and he is angered by your rejection. I would suggest that you reconsider his offer.
His Grandness is most disappointed in your response. He knows that you will reconsider his offer... um... and if you were smart, you would reconsider quickly, I must add.
Jabba is angered by your lack of initiative. He expected more from you, but now understands that you are not worthy of his employment.

The Merciless Jabba does not care which of your appendages is malfunctioning. This mission must be completed. Jabba informs me that he will not take 'No' for an answer. Were Jabba not so preoccupied with other matters, he would feed you to the rancor immediately. You may dwell on this threat...

Oh no!  Please do reconsider. If he does not get what he wants, Jabba may direct his anger towards me! The Vengeful Jabba says that you have a few moments to agree to this mission. If you do not... you will be fed to the Sarlaac next time... oh dear!

Oh dear... Jabba the Hutt tells you that if he has to pay Boba's price for this mission, he will be most displeased.  He is upset that you do not wish to do business with him, and he is getting quite angry indeed.
The Pungent - er, I mean to say - Perfectious Jabba the Hutt says he does not have time to wait. Another mercenary will be assigned this task.

His Magnificentness explains to you that position is easily changed.  He has also told me that he doesn't want to hear a 'No' or he will be very angry with me and ... oh dear, oh dear ... send me to the droid pit to be deconstructed.  I beg you, please tell him 'Yes'.

The Lady Valarian is to execute said accountant for a miscalculation amounting to a total of 4 credits.  Jabba the Hutt, in his generosity, understands that mistakes are made, and wishes to help him.  Jabba knows the accountant will be willing to offer any information to his Highness in return for this favor.

Jabba the Hutt says that Lady Valarian uses crude means of keeping her cronies in line.  She has hired a most competent interrogater to extract information from the less loyal members of her cadre. Jabba the Hutt says he would never resort to simple torture to ensure loyalty.

The Majestic Jabba says that any job he offers to someone is of the utmost importance, simply because it was GIVEN by the Illustrious Jabba.  But, if you must know, the message contains something about the bookkeeper you escorted here recently. Jabba is curious to know why Lady Valarian values this bookkeeper so.

Jabba explains that the strike team's membership is still a guarded secret. It could include some of Lady Valarian's lowly thugs, or perhaps trained Commandos. Jabba the Hutt, in his sagacity, places his full faith in your ability to handle this mild annoyance.

The Wise Jabba says that you ask too many questions.  He has graciously allowed you this information: The smuggler supposedly works for Black Sun, which has chosen to do business with Lady Valarian. Jabba does not know what Valarian is buying, and this displeases him.

Belshu Dadar is now Jabba's loyal associate. His Greatness says that this is a favor he is doing for Belshu.  He has chosen to give you the contract because you have proven yourself talented, but expendable. In other words, he says to mind your own business and take the job.

Jabba the Hutt has been told by Belshu, the smuggler now working for him, that there is a valuable Rantok Sword being held in a warehouse here on Tatooine. Jabba wants this sword to display on his wall. Jabba needs an electronic key to enter the warehouse, and his associate, Sliv Jurek, can provide that tool.
Jabba would prefer to offer this job to Boba Fett, but your fee is much more reasonable. Jabba has placed his trust in you. Do not take this honor lightly.
The illustrious Jabba wishes you to continue with your mission.
Are you from the Palace?
Jabba sends cronies to deal with us?  He should have sent someone competent.  Hah!
No!  I didn't want to turn against Jabba!  You won't take me back alive!
We've been ratted out!  Get that guy!  Don't let him live!
Psst!  Hey, are you the guy?
What do you think you're doing?  I think you're dying!
Hey, pal, how's it going?
ALARM!

The Vengeful Jabba says that he is most displeased with the outcome of your assignment. -Oh my!- He has asked you to stay for dinner and take part in the entertainment. I am afraid he has said this in such a way that it was not a suggestion, but rather and order. I am so sorry, friend.

The Sagacious Jabba says that if you could not handle one person, then you are not of the caliber he is looking for. Oh dear... Jabba the Hutt says you can go get lost in the Jundland Wastes for all he cares.
Oh dear oh dear... the Wrathful Jabba says that he is most displeased by the turn of these events and that the -oh- the "normal" will be happening tonight.
The Irate Jabba says that since you failed in what he wanted that perhaps a job cleaning the Kowakian Monkey-lizard at his tail would be more fitting for your aptitudes.
The Curious Jabba the Hutt, Khan of the Outer Rim, asks you what happened to the money he entrusted to you?

I will tell Jabba that you said you are still working on this. If he hears that you failed, he will do something most awful to... OH! Yes, your Highness? You could understand what I was saying? Oh my.
Oh dear... run, friend! Jabba has called for the brachno-jags! RUN!!

The Vengeful Jabba says that he is most displeased with the outcome of your assignment. -Oh my!- He has asked you to stay for dinner and take part in the entertainment. I am afraid he has said this in such a way that it was not a suggestion, but rather and order. I am so sorry, friend.
His immenseness is most displeased with your lack of progress.  Do return when you've become powerful enough to work for Jabba.

Jabba wishes to tell you that he is pleased with your escort services. Jabba will speak with the accountant later, but currently, eating his seventh meal of the day is more pressing. For now, Jabba wishes to extend to you his personal appreciation for an errand well done.  As a token he bequeaths you this reward.

The Grand Jabba the Hutt expresses his appreciation. He is most overjoyed to hear the man died in a terrible fashion. Jabba the Hutt says you show great promise and he may have use of your services in the future.  He also bequeaths to you this reward.

His Worshipfulness tells you that he is impressed with the speed in which you dealt with the traitor's messenger.  Bib Fortuna will now decode the message and tell Jabba what it contains. Jabba is pleased... thank goodness.  As a result he has decided that you should take a short break, and as a means, he has provided this reward.

Jabba the Hutt says that his next imbibed drink will be dedicated to you, for your brashness and skill. That is quite an honor, indeed.  You should be most grateful for that, and for this reward he has offered you.

His Imperiousness, Jabba the Hutt, wishes to commend you for a job well done. Please inquire later about any further jobs Jabba may have for you.  Oh, and yet another reward has been granted to you, Jabba's most favored employee.

The Great Jabba the Hutt has been informed of your victory over the bounty hunters. He wishes me to tell you that you are exactly the kind of scum he likes. He will be most happy to do business with you in the future.  He has given you this reward.
Jabba the Hutt is impressed by your success. He says that you remind him of a daring smuggler he once employed. You should go far. This reward is for you.

The resplendent Jabba the Hutt expresses his deepest thanks. He wishes to tell you that if you need a place to hide from authorities, he offers you his home, for he considers you to be a close associate.  Oh, I do thank you as well. If this had gone bad, he probably would have replaced me.  I am indebted to you!  As such I'm making sure that you get a good reward.
As dangerous as this is Jabba sure pays well, heh.
Well, that'll do it.
Ok, get me back to the Palace.
The distinguished Jabba wishes to know where his new "friend" Scrib Leras is.
The renowned Jabba the Hutt asks whether Valarian's Interrogators have been dealt with...
The exalted Hutt, Jabba, wants to know if the traitor has been dealt with.
Glorious Jabba wishes to know what has happened to the strike team.
Jabba the Hutt, celebrated leader, is curious about the merchandise you were to retrieve.  Do you have it?
The Remarkable Jabba the Hutt wants to know if the bounty hunters are still breathing.  You realize of course the answer to this question should be no...
Magnificent Jabba wants to know where the key is.  Have you spoken to Sliv Jurek yet?  I do hope you have...
Esteemed Jabba wants his Rantok Sword.  I do hope, for everyone's sake, that you have acquired it.
I will do as Jabba asks.
No problem.  This will be child's play.  How fast does Jabba want it done?
Tell Jabba he can count on me to get it done!
Now that sounds like some good action!  I'll do this one for free!
Hmm... sounds important.  Yeah, I'll do it for Jabba.
Bounty Hunters?  No problem. Point me to them.
Tell Jabba he'll get his key.
I would be honored to help the great Jabba recover that trophy.
Jabba should know that I'm above simple errands.  Tell him I want a real job.
I'm not interested right now in assassinating anyone.
I'm still recovering from a recent fight. I don't want any courier work.
Strike team?  Oh.  Umm... sorry, my trick knee is acting up. I can't do it.
If this is anything like that Strike team job, I'll pass.  No thanks, Jabba.
Bounty Hunters are too dangerous for me. Get Boba Fett to do it.
Let Jabba know that I'm too busy for work at the moment.
I'm too talented for this.  Get someone else to do it.
Why does Jabba care about a lowly accountant?
Lady Valarian has a personal interrogater?
Is this an important job, or will I be running a simple errand for Jabba?
What type of strike team are we talking about here, Jabba?
What will I be buying from this smuggler?
What kind of smuggler leads bounty hunters here?
All this money for a key?  Is it worth all of these credits?
Why is Jabba asking me to do this?
Tell Jabba I can't do this yet.  I'll have to come back later.
Tell Jabba I'm on my way to finish my work now.
Whew.  I was getting worried out here.  Well, I guess our business is done.
Why don't you head down to the garage and see what Barada's up to.  I hear he's cooking something up...
Where is it?  Why haven't you brought me what I asked for?
You shouldn't be back here.  This kitchen is for me and trusted staff only.

Hm, hm, hmmm... yes, yes, you just might be the person I'm looking for.  I'm Porcellus, cook extraordinaire, chef to Senators and Royals alike, and now... *sigh*... slave to Jabba.  Jabba has requested a meal more exotic than his usual fare, and I have just the idea.  Would you gather some special meat for me?

Since Jabba loved his Kaadu Krunchies, he now wants to feast upon a rare beastie here on Tatooine.  He has sent scouts to find that oh so elusive Meat Beast.  Word came back one of the scouts spotted the Meat Beast, but it's being studied by some official looking "veterinarian", whatever that is.  Take down that vet and see if he has the location of the creature.

What exciting news!  They had actually tracked down the Meat Beast to its lair!  Aren't you brimming with excitement?!  All you need to do now is go track down the Meat Beast at these coordinates, kill it, and bring back its fabled meat!  Does that sound good to you?

I am quite overjoyed to hear you can help!  Prefect Talmont has paid a lot of credits to have a kaadu transported here to Tatooine.  After it's unloaded and is being escorted to Prefect Talmont's mansion, all you need to do is intercept Talmont's toadies, kill the beastie, and bring me back a good slice from its haunches.  I'll wait, friend.

Good, good, good.  Now, from what the scout said, the "vet" shouldn't be too far.  Then again, that's information from one of Bib Fortuna's men so, you know...  Remember you don't need to bring back the "veterinarian"'s body,  just bring back his datapad.  If the guy was smart, he probably recorded where he spotted the Meat Beast!

Ohhh, excellent, excellent, excellent!  Go track down that beastie and bring me back a good chunk from its haunches or ribs or wherever!  Now.... what shall I make?  A pate, perhaps?  No, no, too gauche for his tastes.  Ah!  A fine Meat Beast pudding!  Yes!  Hmm?  Are you still here?  Go, go!  Get me that Meat Beast, friend!
All of you scum here are ungrateful bantha-fodder!  You eat my food, but you don't care a whit if I get tossed into the rancor pit, do you?  Whatever will I do?

You charge too much, but you sure will eat the food I make, right?  Very well, then.  I will ask Jabba to send out a scout because you refused to do this for him.  I'm sure that little bite of information will settle well with him.
No!  You don't understand!  If I don't make this meal soon for Jabba, he'll throw me to the Rancor!  I don't even belong here!  Please, you must help me!

For Jabba's dinner tonight, I am preparing him a succulent plate of charbroiled sand-maggot kidneys, served with a chilled carafe of fermented worrt milk.  Is this elegant meal enough for him? NO!  Jabba wants kaduu meat, which he heard Prefect Talmont is importing for a regal Imperial party he's hosting.  Bah!  He's so finicky!

Well, I'm not too sure what the Meat Beast is.  Rumor has it, though, that whoever eats a bite of it will never get indigestion ever again!  Supposedly it's got big horns, two tails, eight eyes, nine legs, and fangs the size of a Jawa.  Then again, maybe not.  Who knows?  What I do know is that when I'm done with it, it'll be quite tasty, indeed.

What?  Can you not see?  I have won the Golden Spatula award 3 years in a row when I was a Master Chef on Coruscant! If I whip up a scrumptious pate made from the Meat Beast, maybe the story will spread to other worlds.  This may be my one chance for my colleagues to know I'm trapped here in this Palace!!!
Well, if you don't get this done quick we're both gonna be in trouble.
Hey, who are you?!?
Very well... I shall remember this when you ask me for a tasty, tasty little treat.
What do you mean you didn't gather that location! Ah! This is a travesty!
Oh, how much you have ruined my day.... I shall be thrown to the Sarlaac for this.
Yeah, fine, I'll find somebody else to do the real work around here.

*Sniiiiiiiffff*  Mmmm... Kaadu meat exudes such a wonderful aroma, wouldn't you say.  Now, all this needs is a little spice coating, some... hrm... oil, yes oil would be good, hmm.... more spices, yes... and a little...ahhh, yesss... Eopie cheese... and voila - Kaadu Krunchies!  I'll let you know if Jabba enjoyed his 'exotic' meal!  Thank you!  Here, take this as a reward.

You brought the datapad back!  Did you see any sign of the Meat Beast anywhere when you were out there?  Nah, I guess that was too much to expect.  Well, either way, I'll have Bib decode this pad to see if the veterinarian left any information as to where its lair is.  Thank you, friend!  As a gift I'm giving you this out of my own pocket.

Oh, how wonderful!  Good, good!  The meat is still in wonderful condition!  I will be known galaxy-wide for my Meat Beast Pudding!  And then, and then... maybe my fellow chefs might mount a rescue team to save me from wasting my talents on this horrid slug!  Thank you once again, friend!  Here, you can have this for all your help.
Where's my Kaadu meat?
Did you get the location of the meat beast?
Where's my meat beast...erm...meat?
A full belly keeps Jabba happy, I hear.  Sure, I'll do it.
No problem!  I'll go get it for you.
Sure!  I can't wait to see this 'Meat Beast'!
No, you got the wrong person.  You must have mistaken me for a lowly kitchenhand.
Get another scout to go find the body.  I charge too much for body recoveries.
Too bad.  I'm not going on a wild Cu-Pa chase to find this imaginary Meat Beast.
What kind of meat are we talking about here?
What in the heck is a 'Meat Beast'?
Why are you so excited about making this 'Meat Beast' into a meal?
I think I'd like to get out of here for a while, maybe finish this later?
Sorry, I'll get back to work.
REELO BARUK needs you to find the TUSKEN RAIDER LEADER who has been harrassing Jabba's friends and KILL him.
Find and DESTROY the KAADU that is being delivered to Prefect Talmont.  Return to PORCELLUS with meat from the beast.
RETRIEVE the location of the "meatbeast" from the VETERINARIAN.  Be careful as you may have to KILL the "vet" and the "vet's" bodyguards.
KILL the MEATBEAST and return with some of it's meat so that PORCELLUS can finish Jabba's Lunch.
KILL VALARIAN'S THUG.  He has a special CODE CYLINDER that BARADA wants you to bring back to him.
DELIVER the CODE CYLINDER to the slicer.  When this is done return to BARADA.
Go to LADY VALARIAN'S WAREHOUSE.  Get past the GUARDS however you can.  Use the SELF-DESTRUCT terminal to destroy the warehouse.  Return to BARADA.
ESCORT ROMO VAX safely to the Palace.  Return to BIB FORTUNA when you are finished.
DESTROY the BOUNTY HUNTER who has come to the Palace looking for Romo Vax.  Return to BIB FORTUNA when you are finished.
RETRIEVE the SCHEMATIC that BIB FORTUNA has asked for.
Find and KILL the SLAVERS who are moving in on BIB FORTUNA'S territory.
REELO BARUK wants you to find VALARIAN'S THUGS who have been hanging out near the palace.  They are to be DESTROYED.
ESCORT SCRIB LERAS to the Palace.  As usual, he is not to be harmed.  JABBA will be most pleased.
Find and KILL the INTERROGATOR that LADY VALARIAN hired to torture Scrib Leras.
DESTROY the STRIKE TEAM that VALARIAN has sent to the palace.
Find and KILL the TRAITOR.  JABBA will not have this in his home.
RETRIEVE the merchandise from JABBA'S friend the SMUGGLER.
DESTROY the Bounty Hunters who are seeking our new friend.  ELIMINATE them without delay.
DELIVER the BRIEFCASE to SLIV JUREK and in return bring back the ELECTRONIC KEY he will sell you.
STEAL the RANTOK SWORD from LADY VALARIAN'S warehouse.  ELIMINATE any resistance you encounter and bring the sword back to JABBA.
JABBA'S VISITOR is lost somewhere near the palace. REELO BARUK wants you to ESCORT him to the Palace.
JABBA wants a slicer in his pocket, and in order to get him you need to KILL the slicers rival THUGS.  When you are done return to REE-YEES.
REE-YEES wants you to find the transponder from a crashed starship and return it.  If the filthy JAWAS have stolen it you should KILL them and take it.
REE-YEES wants you to DELIVER the transponder to SIRAD FAR.  When you have done so return to the palace.
EPHANT MON wants you to DESTROY some more of LADY VALARIAN'S thugs.  They're harrassing Jabba's loyal customers.  This must end immediately.
KILL the COURIER who's making a delivery for LADY VALARIAN.  RETRIEVE anything important he might be carrying.
DELIVER the ledger to SIRAD FAR.  Bib Fortuna will view this as a personal favor.  Return to EPHANT MON when you are done.  Allow no harm to come to our friend, the slicer.
Return to Jabba's Palace.
I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone.
Go see Ree-Yees over there.  He may have some things he needs done.
Could you repeat that?

New here eh?  Well, I've got a problem you can help me with. Some of those nasty Tuskens are starting to get brazen, hanging out too close to the palace.  Jabba hates that.  If you can go take care of them, I'll see what else I can find for you.  Deal?

Oh, it's you. Good timing. I got something you can do for me. There's some thugs that work for Lady Valarian hanging out around the palace.  I don't know what they're up to, but Jabba wants them, you know, taken care of.  Can I count on you again?

Good to see you again. Jabba's has a friend wandering out in the desert, trying to find the palace with a busted datapad and no sense of direction.  I need you to go out there and find this guy and bring him back.  Or maybe it's a girl... I can't remember.  Can you go get him?  Or her?
Good. Just take care of the leader and I'll take care of ya.
Great.  I'll give you their last known location and you can take care of it.  When you get back I'll see what else we have that needs to be done.
Thanks. You've saved my hide. If Jabba's friend doesn't get here, somebody's going to be breakfast for the Sarlacc, and it could easily end up bein' me!
Fine.  You don't look like Jabba's kinda scum anyway, but I thought I'd give you a shot. Come back after you buy some courage.
Well, don't be too long or I'll have to find someone else to take this job.
Well, I'll try to find someone else to do it, but get back here as quick as you can 'cause I think everyone's busy.
You know, the Sand People?  They wear those dirty robes and carry spiked clubs? Heads wrapped in bandages? But just take care of the leader and we'll call it done.  Deal?

She's a lowlife, small-time gangster that operates out of the Lucky Despot in Mos Eisley.  She's a constant thorn in Jabba's side, so whenever we get the chance, we do some damage to her operations.  So, can you help?

I don't know... somebody delivering something to Jabba, or bringing Jabba some info, or maybe credits, or something. Everything's a big secret around here usually, so this lack of information is pretty standard.  I just need to know if you can go get them back here...
Well get back to it then.
It's one of Jabba's thugs, get him!
Hey, I'm over here!
You let me down. No... I don't think this business relationship is going to work out.
I thought you said I could count on you? What happened between the time you said that and now?

Now, let's talk about this. I distinctly remember saying that I needed you to save my friend, right? Now you must have heard 'Go out and let my friend die in a horrible manner'. Now, it's not that I'm above that... BUT I DIDN"T SAY THAT!!!
Fine, come back when you think you can handle this.
Good work.  I'm impressed.  Come back later and I'll find some more work for you.  Oh, but here, take this for your help.
Excellent work.  I hear people talking about you in the halls now.  You're going to move up in this operation, I can feel it.
You do good work.  I'll let Ree-Yees know that I'm putting you on our available roster of employees and you can see what he has for you to do.  You know, I had reward for you.. ah here it is.
Finally.  You're the one Reelo sent to take me back to the Palace, right?  Well, let's not waste any time chatting.  Just take me back there.
You didn't take care of the tuskens did you?
You didn't take care of the thugs did you?
Where's Jabba's friend?
Deal.  I'll get to it.
Of course.  I'll get right to it.
Sure.  I'll be back soon.
No way.  Too dangerous.
Can't do it now.  I'll come back later.
I'm kinda busy at the moment.
Tuskens?  I don't understand.
Who's Lady Valarian?
Who is this friend?
I think I need to start over with this one.
Sorry, I'll get right back to it.
Can't talk now.  Busy.
Sorry, I've got a lot to do, maybe you have something you should be doing?
You've got access to the upstairs now, worrt, go see if Ephant Mon needs anything done.
Where's that item I asked you to get?
Hey, talk to Reelo.  I don't deal with just everybody that comes in out of the desert.  That's his job.

Are you looking at me!? You want a job, is that it? Okay, look, Jabba is missing a slicer since his last one had a little bit of an accident with the rancor.  Well, Jabba wants this one slicer, Sirad Far, in his pocket and he knows the best way to do it would be to help take out Sirad's rivals.  You wanna help out with this?

Hey, worrt! I gotta 'nother job for you. Bib just got word of some vessel that crashed out in the dunes nearby the Palace.  Jabba says he wants the transponder from that craft.  You wanna run out there and grab it for him?

Good news, worrt.  Jabba says that transponder is exactly what he was looking for.  Now Jabba is going to see if this Sirad Far guy was worth all the effort.  Take the transponder to Sirad Far so he can slice into the codes on this thing, okay?
Good move, worrt.  Here's where you can find Sirad's competition.  Finish them off, and maybe I'll tell Bib you have a spine.

From what Bib said, it shouldn't be too far off from here.  If anyone else got to it before you do, let them know that Jabba owns all the space debris on this planet.  If they don't give it up on their own, take it from them, if you know what I mean.
Yeah, I knew you'd want to do it.  Sirad's been told he's got a package showing up, so he's waiting.  Get this over to him, and get it to him fast, you hear?
You think so? You keep talking like that, you're gonna be buried beneath the palace. Now get outta here!
You know, when Jabba hears that you turned him down, I'm sure he'll let ME do a good job on you.
I told Jabba you would do it.  If you don't get this done, and done soon, Jabba's gonna get real angry.  You don't want to see Jabba when he's angry.

Why do you care, huh? All you need to know is that Jabba wants Sirad in his pockets - er- folds. Between you and me, though, Bib says that this Sirad guy is supposed to be one of the best here on Tatooine.  If Jabba does Sirad a favor, Sirad's gonna need to do Jabba some too. So, you wanna prove yourself around here or not?
I don't know why he wants it.  Do I look like Jabba to you?  Maybe once you get it, he'll tell you.  Then again, maybe not.  Just get it, okay?

I heard Jabba say that the type of ship that crashed meets the same specifications as Jabba's own personal starship.  I think what Jabba's trying to do is have this transponder hooked up on his ship so that Jabba can transmit a false identity whenever he wants.  That Hutt is sly, I must admit.
Get on it then!
Thugs, eh?  Sirad Far will be sorry...
Ootini!
Hey, are you the guy old Reesy-Yeesy sent?
Oh, this is gonna be good. When he hears what happens, your face is gonna be smashed in real good-like!
You couldn't even do this one? You stupid little worrt! After Jabba hears about this, I'm gonna get to pay you a little visit. Heh...
What happened to the package, you poodoo-soaked Monkey-lizard?? You'd best have that package in your hands by the time I count to three!!!!
Ok, come back when you get some courage.
Huh, you actually did it... I'll let Bib know you're tougher than you look. And maybe I'll give you another job in the future, worrt.

Good work, worrt.  Jabba's gonna be real happy to see that the transponder wasn't damaged in the crash.  I don't know what he wants with it, but he'll be real happy, I'm sure.  Oh, and by the way, we decided you needed a reward.

You know what, worrt? Word has been going around that Jabba and Bib are real happy over this Sirad Fal deal.  Just don't go thinking that you can have my job.  Worrt or no worrt, I'll still smash yer face if you play games with me.  But you've done good, so next time we're in a cantina, I'll buy us a round of bantha blasters!
That transponder should be just fine for Jabba's purposes.
Hey, worrt, did you deal with those thugs?
Where's the transponder, wort?
Did you deliver our transponder?
I got things to do.  Can't talk.
Tell Jabba I'll deal with Sirad's rivals personally.
Sure, I'll get that transponder for him.
Sounds easy enough.  Yeah, I'll get the job done.
That seems beneath me. Have someone else do it.
Don't waste my time. Tell Jabba to give me a real job.
What does Jabba take me for, some errand runner?  I'm not doing it.
What does this slicer do that Jabba wants him?
Why does he only want the transponder?
What is Jabba planning on doing with the transponder once Sirad's done with it?
I think I need to take a break and start over.
Yeah, I'll get right on that.
