What a pleasure to meet you. I have been informed that you support the Alliance's cause,which I find to be quite noble, indeed. If you have any time to spare, perhaps you may wish to help with some tasks that could use an extra hand?
You are not the bringer of comestibles. Time cannot be wasted for other conversations.
Which, of course, you're not. Look, I'm busy, alright?
Well, I guess I'll mull over the fate of technology by myself, if you don't mind.
This heat is sure oppressive, would'nt you say? Well, have a good day.
I think you have things to do, yes?
Please see our friend Qual'do Herm.  He may have some tasks for you as well.
Mrmmm... no this is not the comestibles that we were told of. Is this Alliance's joking?
What's this? It's message said that you'd be bringing some bacta, but this doesn't look like any bacta I've ever seen before.
I don't know what this is, but it sure doesn't look like my contact information. Maybe you gave me the wrong thing?
My circuits must need cleaning.  What did you say?

Hello. I am C-3P0, Human-Cyborg Relations. My companion is R2-D2, and he has been informed from High Command that you are interested in assisting with the Alliance's cause. According to R2, it seems there is a need for someone to deliver a shipment of food to sympathizers of our cause. Would you be interested in doing this?

Good day to you again. Are you interested in offering further assistance? I'm certain that R2 can find something in the databanks, can't you R2? I said find something in the databanks right now, R2! Okay... yes... okay, R2 says that medicine needs to be urgently delivered to an attack squad that has been wounded. Will you do this?

Oh, R2 says that you are needed to help provide an escort for a person needing to reach this hidden base. See, R2, I told you this one could be trusted. Now, as I was saying, the Alliance requests your aid in acting as a bodyguard. Would you be available for this endeavor?

No, if it wasn't for you, we would never have been in this mess. No. No, I still don't like you. *ahem* Oh, excuse me, I was speaking with R2. You have been requested to take on this duty by *hmph* R2 of all people. The Alliance needs to have this delivered to the new leader of the cell.  Would you be so kind as to deliver it?

Oh, very good. R2 says to take this shipment to a Selonian spokeswoman who will be waiting for it's arrival. R2 has provided the coordinates as to where you will meet her. Good luck to you in your journey!

Oh, they will be pleasantly surprised that you have offered to help. What was that, R2? What do you mean you're surprised, too? Oh, whatever. As I was saying, R2 will alert one of their scouts to meet you so that the Imperials do not track you back to them. Please bring them this bacta.

What glorious news! R2 has given you the last known coordinates of where the leader can be found.  He is waiting for you to pick him up, using this set of designated codewords. What do you mean you don't have the codewords, you obsolete droid, you? Deleted? *ahem* I'm sorry, but there are no codewords. You'll have to make do, I guess.
Wonderful! Now, take this information to these coordinates. Your contact will be waiting for you there. Be safe in your travels!
Oh, I do so understand. If you feel you wish to offer your assistance in the future, please stop by. I am sure R2-D2 will be able to find something in the computers.

Oh, please do reconsider. Without that medicine, any number of ghastly things could happen to their numbers. ....No, no R2, I'm sure this is the person the Princess said to give the mission to...    ...oh, what do you know, you rust-bucket!...
Oh, I understand. You cannot be asked to do something that you cannot help with. Perhaps someone else can help with this, then.
Oh dear. I would've hoped that you were willing to perform this duty. Since you have proven yourself to R2 and I, I was so certain. Well, good day.   ....you stop your laughing, R2....

What do you mean this person doesn't have the proper clearance for that, R2? Well, I don't think that's polite to ask someone to do this without telling them why. *ahem* R2 says that some Selonian food stores have been attacked by the Imperials and the Alliance wishes to help them with this. Unfortunately, this is all he will say.

According to R2, there was an independent strike force that attempted to attack a Imperial Repair facility, but encountered greater resistance than expected. R2 is still being obstinate, and refuses to elaborate any further. Hmph, I swear I should have left you back on Tatooine, you pint-sized excuse for a Jawa. Oh, I'm sorry. Where were we?

If you know what's good for you, you'll tell this kind person the whole story, R2! Ohhhh, I see. *ahem* R2 says that the leader of cell of covert Alliance members has come under questioning by the Empire, and High Command will be helping him escape off planet before he's arrested. You are needed to escort him back here.

It's a list of contact information. You will be bringing it to the person who is taking over Taergle's place as organizer of a small cell of eyes and ears for the Alliance. R2 says to guard this with your life, for many lives will be at stake if it gets into the wrong hands.
I understand you must be quite busy. The Alliance appreciates anything you can do.
I understand you must be quite busy. The Alliance appreciates anything you can do.
I understand you must be quite busy. The Alliance appreciates anything you can do.
I understand you must be quite busy. The Alliance appreciates anything you can do.
You are who the Princess sends with the comestibles, yes?
I hope you're the one that Protocol Droid said was coming...
They don't make hyper-drives they way they used to, wouldn't you say?
How are you doing today? I find it to be quite oppressive *wink*, don't you think?
Oh, that isn't good news. What's that R2? Oh dear. R2 says that without that food, the Selonians may not think of joining the Alliance. The Princess will be most disturbed.
Oh, that isn't good news. What's that R2? Oh dear. R2 says that without that medicine, some of their wounded will die. The Princess will be most disturbed by this news.
Oh, that isn't good news. What's that R2? Oh dear. R2 says that the Princess will have to deliver the bad news to the rest of his family. I'm sure you tried your best, though.
Oh, that isn't good news. What's that R2? Oh dear. R2 says that information was quite important and shouldn't get into the wrong hands. I'm sure you tried your best, though.
Oh, what's this? R2 says the information that is in the computer isn't correct. He will try to recover it again. Please do ask again in a few minutes.
Oh, what's this? R2 says the information that is in the computer isn't correct. He will try to recover it again. Please do ask again in a few minutes.

Ok, please return when you feel more comfortable working for the alliance.

Oh, please do reconsider. Without that medicine, any number of ghastly things could happen to their numbers. ....No, no R2, I'm sure this is the person the Princess said to give the mission to...    ...oh, what do you know, you rust-bucket!...
Oh, I understand. You cannot be asked to do something that you cannot help with. Perhaps someone else can help with this, then.
Oh dear. I would've hoped that you were willing to perform this duty. Since you have proven yourself to R2 and I, I was so certain. Well, good day.   ....you stop your laughing, R2....

Yes, that is a message that the Alliance will be most pleased to hear. On behalf of the Alliance, I am instructed to offer you our sincerest thanks.  R2 suggests that we might give you this reward for your assistance.

What an excellent outcome, I would say. With that bacta in their hands, they should be able to heal most of their injuries. Thank you very much. ............Yes, I just kicked you, you overgrown Mouse Droid! You said this kind person couldn't do the job. Well, I think you now see you're wrong, don't you? Well, I still think you're wrong..........Anyway, we don't have much to offer ourselves, but you may have this reward for your assistance.

How exquisite this turned out. R2-D2 has sent a report to High Command that Taergle was able to make it here safely. According to R2, he will be smuggled off-planet, with his family to follow.  Both his dedication and yours to our cause is quite commendable.  Please accept this reward for your assistance.

Thank the Maker! You delivered it without the Empire finding out! This is wonderful news indeed. What's that, R2? Yes, I think it's about time you said that. R2 wishes to apologize for his exceptionally rude and crude, if I might add, behavior towards you. He wishes to thank you as well. He now believes you are smarter than he thought, and he wishes for you to take this reward for your assistance.  Really R2!
Ahhh... yes... nutritious comestibles for many. The Princess should be told that this will be held within our memories.
Well, that droid wasn't kidding. Tell the base that we'll be able to make it back when the coast is clear. Thanks again, friend... you just saved a lot of lives!

Let me see... yes, these are my contacts. What? Well, I'll be. Garello is a Rebel too? I would never have pegged him for a Rebel. Well, friend, I thank you for bringing this by. I can now start getting us organized again.
What do you mean the codewords were dropped? Well, either way, I'll trust you. Please, lead on before the Empire knows I've left.
My, my, you are efficient. Have you already delivered the food supplies?
My, my, you are efficient. Have you already delivered the medicine?
My, my, you are efficient. Have you brought back the leader yet?
My, my, you are efficient. Have you delivered the information yet?
No, I think you have the wrong guy.  Maybe there is someone around here that looks just like me?
Yes, I'll help.
Sure, I'll deliver the medicine.
Yeah, I'll do it.
No problem.  I'll take it.
No thank you.
I'm sorry, but someone else should do it.
Sorry, I'm not a bodyguard. Find someone else.
Sorry, I have something else I need to do.
Who are these sympathizers?
What happened to the squad?
Who will I be escorting?
Well, first what is it?
I don't think I can handle this right now.
I had something come up. I can't do this right now.
I had something come up. I can't do this right now.
I had something come up. I can't do this right now.
I had something come up. I can't do this right now.
Sorry, I'll get back to work.
No, not yet. I shall do so immediately.
No, not yet. I shall do so immediately.
No, not yet. I shall do so immediately.
No, not yet. I shall do so immediately.
Ah, I see you are a bit preoccupied with your time right now. When you have time for rather important matters, I would like to discuss them with you.
Wait! You're not a Rebel. Get out of here before we arrest you.
Aren't you going to try to run so that I can chase you down?
That's something my mother used to always say. I don't know what she meant by that, though.
You don't work for the Captain? I'm sorry, I thought you were someone else.
Never mind. Move along.
Hmmm... I thank you for this, but I don't think I'll find a use for it. You should keep it yourself.
Mon Mothma is prepared to see you now.
Ummm... I though Ackbar said he had a datapad of information he needed me to confirm.
What's this? This isn't the Empire's military information!
I need someone to find and talk to our friend Han Solo.  Can you do that?

Come in, don't be shy. So, you're the one I've heard so much about.  I am Captain Ackbar, responsible for much of our scattered fleet. Well, now that the introductions are over, on to matters of business. I have need of your skills in an operation that will help to hide some of our starships. Are you available?

There have been some beneficial repercussions of your distraction assault. It seems there are some locals who have voiced their sympathy to our cause. One person in particular has offered to sell us some Imperial information at a reasonable price. Could I bother you to go represent us in this deal?

I have some surprising information. It seems the bounty hunter who attacked you was... well... quite incompetant. He actually brought with him real information regarding guard schedules. I am going with my instincts this time and having this analyzed before walking into a potential trap. Could you deliver this to one of our operatives?

I have just received the most exciting news since word of the Death Star's destruction. Teria has relayed to me that all of this information is the real thing. What we have here is a comprehensive list of flight paths and guard changes. This needs to get to Admiral Bel Iblis immediately!

A new Imperial General has been assigned to oversee Dantooine, replacing the one we captured. It looks as if his task is to destroy any remaining 'Rebels'. He is being escorted by a large number of unarmed, rookie Stormtroopers. Therefore, we will want to launch a quick hit-and-fade on the smaller group of armed ones. Will you help?

The fact that you'll be on this mission with us puts my mind at ease. I will need you to act as a special operative on this mission. In order to bring in a few damaged Corellian Corvettes, we need a distraction, which will be your part. You will need to go to this location and cause enough damage to draw the attention of the Empire. That's when we can safely land the starships.

I know this is not an exciting attack on the Empire, but this is still important nonetheless. Thank you for offering to help. Here's where you'll meet him to buy what he's selling. Let me know when you've returned.

You'll be meeting with Teria Alessie out at a secret location. She'll say the phrase, "The brighest stars burn out the fastest, wouldn't you say?" in which you'll respond with, "Every death makes room for new life". At that point, give her this datapad so that she can confirm if it's real or not.

Thank you very much. I have contacted Bel Iblis and he has let me know that he'll be sending his aide, Jeremes Kelton, to pick it up. Make sure it gets into his hands, for once the Admirial receives it, this may likely change the tides of this war into our favor.

Now, you need to listen to your orders very clearly. You will be the only one going out there to do this, for we want to make sure the Empire believes you're acting alone. Attack the squadron and destroy them, then get out of there. We will be leaving a decoy body in the area to make it look like you didn't survive.
I understand. From what has been said of you, I feel this mission will go much more smoothly with your help. If you change your mind, please let me know as fast as possible.
Well, I understand that this is not glamorous, but not everything is flash and bang in our struggle. Sometimes the smallest thing such as buying information can push the war in our favor.
Well, I understand that this is not glamorous, but not everything is flash and bang in our struggle. Sometimes the smallest thing such as transporting information can push the war in our favor.
Very well, then. I thought you would have wanted to help the Alliance a little more than you express right now. A shame, a shame.
It's not a foolish plan, it's a desperate plan. Sometimes a person isn't given too many options and just has to make the best of it. I hope you can see that.

It's a well known fact that after the destruction of the Death Star, our base on Yavin IV has been under siege. We have re-established this emergency base after the Empire located our decoy base on the other side of Dantooine. Unfortunately, this planet is still under Imperial rule, therefore we have no permanent base for our small fleet of starships.

He claims to have been a contractor working on the Death Star before it was destroyed and was able to steal codes relating to military guard movement schedules. I'm not sure how relevant it may be, but he is not asking too much for the information. We might be able to glean some information from it.

Her name is Teria Alessie, and she's acting as a spy for us here on Dantooine. She has access to some information, and will be able to run these schedules through their databanks to confirm if it's correct or not.  Once she has found out, she'll be able to contact us with a positive or a negative.

What I am holding in my hands is a comprehensive list of ship flight paths, Star Destroyer patrols around this planet, guard schedule movements, names of officers in command, etcetera. In other words, this information will allow us to know what the Empire is doing even before they do it.
Because it's a trap! The information regarding guard schedules has been compromised.  I have a team who is ready to deal with the general, but I need you to take out those troopers beforehand.
We need you to attack a squad of stormtroopers on the other side of the planet. Whilst you do so, we can engage our other team to direct the landing of a group Corvettes.
All you have to do is pay our friend for the information he has. Once you have it, bring it back so that I can have one of our slicers pick through it.
Her name is Teria, and she'll meet you at the specified coordinates. All you need to do is give her the datapad.
You'll head out to a secret meeting location. I have provided your description so you will be recognized immediately. Give him the datapad and then come on back here.
You will find it at the location listed in your datapad. We have another team there already to deposit the decoys after you're done.
What's this? A Rebel! Don't let them get away!
I can't believe you fools fell for it! The Empire's going to pay a lot for your corpse!
The brighest stars burn out the fastest, wouldn't you say?
Let's do this fast. I need to get back to the Admiral with the information.
What's that over there? Rebels! Get them!
This is not good news. Without a adequate distraction, we will be unable to land these damaged ships without notice by the Empire.
You mean this was just a hoax? He didn't have any information? Ah, what a shame.

I don't understand why she wasn't there. I can't seem to contact her right now, so it's possible she might have had to go into hiding if the Empire found out about her. We will be unable to use this information until we can confirm if it's true, though.
He never showed up? Let me contact Admiral Bel Iblis and find out what went wrong!
You weren't able to kill them all? This will not go good to hiding us even further.
Le me consult our battle plans so that I can choose the best place to cause a distraction. Please speak with me in a few minutes.
I'll ask Lance where this sympathizer can be found right now. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I will have to contact her so that we can arrange a meeting place. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I have to designate where the meeting location will be. Once I find out, I'll be able to tell you. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I do not know where this area is. Let me consult the guard schedules to find out. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I understand. From what has been said of you, I feel this mission will go much more smoothly with your help. If you change your mind, please let me know as fast as possible.
Well, I understand that this is not glamorous, but not everything is flash and bang in our struggle. Sometimes the smallest thing such as buying information can push the war in our favor.
Well, I understand that this is not glamorous, but not everything is flash and bang in our struggle. Sometimes the smallest thing such as transporting information can push the war in our favor.
You can quit a job, but you cannot quit a cause. This is something that is in your heart, not mind. I am sorry to hear that you have lost your will to fight the Empire.
It's not a foolish plan, it's a desperate plan. Sometimes a person isn't given too many options and just has to make the best of it. I hope you can see that.

Wonderful, you're back. The operation was a full success. While you enaged the Imperials, they sent several squads in your direction, diverting their sensors. We now have the Corvettes cleverly camoflaged while they undergo secret repairs. Your reputation is well deserved.

What? Why didn't I trust my feelings and recognize this as a trap? Well, I am sorry to have put you through that, friend. Let's count ourselves lucky that Bounty Hunter wasn't that skilled at his trade. I'll still go through this information to see if it has any real information. Please, relax while we are looking through it, considering your close call.
I'm glad you were able to make it there safely and back. Now all we have to do is wait for her report, then we can act. I thank you for your assistance.

I have already been contacted by Admiral Bel Iblis and he tells me the information is in his hands. He is already beginning to move various splinters of the fleet to other areas. We have found some places on Dantooine alone that are never patrolled. Our war against the Empire looks like it has taken a turn for the good again. Thank you.

Very good. According to the manner in which the Empire is responding to that, and by consulting the schedules, it would seem that they have fallen for the trick. If this new General is as pompous as the last one, then he will gloat over his success. That, in turn will hide our base all the more. Thank you for your help, friend. Now... I have been asked to direct you to Mon Mothma. She is awaiting you in the next room.
Okay, let Ackbar know that I'll check this information when I get back to the offices. Once I find out, I'll send him the confirmation the ususal way. Good luck!

This information will be essential to the future of the Alliance. With this, we can hide much of our fleet in safer locations until we can find a more permanant base. Ha! No more having to cause distractions.  I'll get this to the Admiral immediately.
Are you prepared for your mission?
Are you ready to go meet him?
Do you have a question about your assignment?
Have you contacted Jeremes yet?
Are you ready to depart?
Ummm... I think you have the wrong guy. Maybe that other person nearby was who you were looking for?
Always. How can I help?
Sure. I'll make sure the information is purchased.
I'll do it. Where do you want me to take it?
I'll do it for you.
I'll help with your plan.
Sorry Captain, but I'm a bit busy right now.
That's outside of my skills. No thanks.
Sorry, I'm not a courier. Get someone else.
I'm not taking any more documents anywhere.
I'm not interested in commiting suicide. No.
What do you mean by "scattered fleet"?
What information are we buying?
Who is the operative?
Why is this information so important?
Why in blazes are we not attacking the General!?!?!
Sorry, Captain, but I can't be part of this right now.
Sorry, but this isn't my style. I can't do this anymore.
I can't do this anymore.
I'm done with sending datapads around. I quit!
I've changed my mind. I can't do foolish plan anymore.
Yes I am. What am I to do again?
Yes I am. What exactly are my orders again?
Who am I supposed to give this to again?
Where am I to meet him again?
Yes, I am. Where am I to do this?
Hey kid, why don't you come back when you are a little less busy, okay?
I don't know you, right? How about we keep it that way?
Nevermind. I thought you were working for Nym.
Sorry, I thought you worked for Nym. Never mind.
Oh, you're not Han's friend after all. Well, thanks for the help, bub.
I think it would be in your best interests if you left. Immediately.
I don't need this. Keep it for yourself.
You should go to Dantooine.  Ackbar is looking for some help I hear.  He could use somebody like you.
Let me see if I can remember where he used to hang out. This was a long time ago, so give me a few minutes, okay?
Let me go start up the Falcon, then I'll let you know where their hideout is. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me see where Nym said this guy can be found. Check back with nme in a few minutes.
Let me check the map to see where those coordinates are. Check with me in a few minutes.
Let me find out where you're supposed to meet his money guy. Check back with me in a few minutes.
No, Nym said that he wanted a 'Holonomocron', or something like that. From how he described it, this doesn't look like it.
What's this!? This ain't the money! Is Solo trying to pull another one past us again? Why I oughta...
Talk to Nien.  I'm too busy right now.

How are you doing, kid? Both Leia and Nien told me you can be counted on, which is what I need right now. If they haven't already told you, I'm here to try to hook up a deal for the Alliance with one of the biggest smuggler pirates this side of the Outer Rim. I need you to go let an old associate know I need to get in contact with Nym. Can you do that?

I can't believe that Nym! Who does he think he is?! He's doing this just to get back at me! *sigh* Well, I guess I'm going to have to play by his rules. I'm going to need your help for this one if you don't mind. I need you to help recover a stolen item of Nym's before he'll talk to me about any deals. Can you help?

I've just had E'Dycu tell Nym that I'm not going to be playing this game of his anymore. Nym has agreed to talk trade as long as I take care of the rest of that pirate band that has been bothering him lately. Again, I'm gonna need your help with this.

Why that lowdown, rotten, fink! Nym refused to involve himself with the Rebellion! When I get my hands on him, I'm goi- ...hold on a sec, kid, my commlink's acting up... What do you want now? Huh? Okay, try to hold them off - I'll send some help right now! Kid... a friend of mine's been ambushed by Imperials. You've got to go save him!

Okay, things have turned out for the best after all that. Nym has agreed to sell his current surplus to the Alliance. While I'm contacting Leia to let her know how this has turned out, I'm gonna need you to deliver the downpayment to his money guy. Will you do that one last thing for me?

That's what I wanted to hear. Now look, the guy you're looking for is E'Dycu, an old smuggler I used to work with. Let him know I'm here, and bring him back so I can talk with him face to face. I know E'Dycu will still be able to get in touch with Nym so I can try to broker a deal for the Alliance. Good luck, kid.

Okay, I'm going to go make a lot of noise with the Falcon next to the bandits' hideout. This should scare them out of their den, which is where you come in. You tell the guy who has it that you're not leaving without something called a 'Holocron'. Watch out, because this guy sounds like he prefers action over words.

This is what we'll have to do. Nym has let me know where the bandit's leader can be found. You need to go out there and put a stop to him. The rest of his crew will then scatter to different parts of the Rim, Nym will then sell the spoils of his raids to Leia, and we'll all be happy.

Okay, he said he was holed up out at these coordinates. Since we are closer than any of Nym's guys, he contacted me for help, which means he's really desperate. He may not be the best of guys, but we go way back and I owe him a couple. If he's been wounded, bring him back here so I can try to patch him up.
Okay, kid, you're going to need to meet up with his bruiser, Nateba Kerr. Nateba will then take the money back to Nym, then we can get out of here.
Come on, kid. It's nothing more than a simple message delivery, and maybe bring him back here. So what if you have to keep an eye out for the worst pirates not under Jabba's employ?
Look, I don't want to do this either, but Leia and Luke have managed to keep convincing me help out. The sooner we can do this, the faster we can leave. Do it for me, kid.

You think I like doing this too? I'm only doing this because Luke and Leia are convinced I can get Nym to sell us some of his spoils for use by the Alliance. Look, if you help, maybe I can hook you up with a reward from the Alliance. Think about it...

Look, he's not as bad as you think he is. I've worked with a bunch of bad people, and he's a lot better than most. I need you to bring him back while I take out the rest of the Imperials. Just take my word for it, kid.

*sigh* Kid, here's the truth. I needed you to do this for me because when I last left here, Nym let me know that if I ever stepped foot on Lok ever again, he'd kill me himself. I've already got Jabba after me, I don't want to risk finding out if Nym was telling the truth or not.

Yeah... I guess you could say that. Look, before I was part of the whole destruction of the Death Star thing, well, let's just say I didn't have the most respectable of jobs. This Nym guy used to hire me before I started working for Jabba, but let's just say I made a bunch of people angry around here when I left. Let's just leave it at that, okay?
Of course I can get it myself! I've made the Kessel Run in under 12 parsecs and was there at the Death Star run.  Someone has to cause the commotion, and I don't see you with a starship nearby.

Well, Nym ain't that great of a guy.  Matter of fact, when me and Chewie went to go work for Jabba - the worst decision I ever made, I might add - Nym and I had a few, well, not-so-nice words to say to each other. These pirates we're taking care of are a step worse, though. They're taking slaves and selling them to the Empire, which Nym is actually against, go figure.

Well, while we were talking, he said a little bit ago the Empire tried forcing Nym to either work for them or they'll put him out of business. I guess this is intended to be a message to Nym they were serious. Who knows... if this turns out good, this might actually be our lucky day.

Nym makes a living plying the space-lanes and hitting cargo ships. A while back, he hit an Imperial convoy of freighters carrying shipments of bacta. Nym has a lot left over and is willing to sell his supply to the Rebellion now. Other than that, he's not picking sides... and knowing him, I don't think anyone will ever be able to convince him otherwise.
Well, good luck kid. When a person doesn't want to be found, it makes the job all the more difficult.
Well get back out there. I can't pull off my part without you.
Well hurry it up. The faster we can do business, the faster we can get off this planet.
What are you waiting for! Go out there and save him already!
Well hurry it up. The faster we can finish this business, the faster we can get off this planet.
Whatever the problem is, I didn't do it.
I knew that raid would get Nym's attention! Kill him, boys!
Nym isn't going to be the Pirate King for too long. You're going to die now, you hear?
Hey! You're Han's friend! Help me out with these Imperial toadies! I can't do anything, my blaster's jammed!
You'd best have the money, or you'd best get out of here, you know what I'm saying?
What do you mean he's no longer on Lok? Awww... but he has to be! What am I going to tell Leia?
What do you mean he said he sold it!? You believed him?
I was hoping you could have handled this guy. I guess I'll go do this myself now. I've got to go now.
He's dead?! Oh, this is not good....
Okay, let me get this straight... You're saying a Jawa leaped out from behind a boulder and stole the money?... Let's go over this again...
Come on, kid. It's nothing more than a simple message delivery, and maybe bring him back here. So what if you have to keep an eye out for the worst pirates not under Jabba's employment?
Look, I don't want to do this either, but Leia and Luke have managed to keep convincing me help out. The sooner we can do this, the faster we can leave. Do it for me, kid.

You think I like doing this too? I'm only doing this because Luke and Leia are convinced I can get Nym to sell us some of his spoils for use by the Alliance. Look, if you help, maybe I can hook you up with a reward from the Alliance. Think about it...

Look, he's not as bad as you think he is. I've worked with a bunch of bad people, and he's a lot better than most. I need you to bring him back while I take out the rest of the Imperials. Just take my word for it, kid.

*sigh* Kid, here's the truth. I needed you to do this for me because when I last left here, Nym let me know that if I ever stepped foot on Lok ever again, he'd kill me himself. I've already got Jabba after me, I don't want to risk finding out if Nym was telling the truth or not.

Hey-hey...E'Dycu! Long time no see, buddy! Just give me a moment. Hey, kid, let me talk with E'Dycu for a little bit here. Why don't you see if Chewie wants to play a game of holochess with you. ...........Oh yeah... Make sure he wins.

Well, this looks like what he was talking about. According to E'Dycu, Nym said this used to belong to one of his friends before she died, and he's keeping it for sentimental value. That pirate sent me out to pick up a piece of junk! Well, I'll tell him a thing or two. Either way, thanks kid, your help was needed out there.

Good work, kid. I could've used you when I was still smuggling,you know that? Okay, now with that done, Nym had better give us a good deal on these supplies. I'll have E'Dycu contact him again, then we can get out of here.

Thanks for doing that. I made sure the rest of the Imperials weren't able to send for reinforcements. Now, after Chewie makes sure his wounds won't kill him, I'm gonna have a little sit-down talk with my friend. Hopefully I can persuade him to convince Nym that we should start negotiations again.

He's keeping the bacta in 'The Old Place', huh? Yeah, I still know where that is. I'll fly us over there so we can bring it back to the base on Dantooine. Speaking of which, I told Leia how much help you've been. She's asked me to tell you to meet with Captain Ackbar on Dantooine if you wish to keep helping. Thanks for your help, kid... I owe you one.

Let me count it...... Okay, it's all here. Nym says that the bacta is going to be in 'The Old Place'.  I'm also supposed to give Solo a good fist to the face for old time's sake, so you're lucky I don't know you.
You're a friend of Han Solo's you say? Well, it's been a while since I've seen that scoundrel. Take me to where he is.
I've been shot, and shot pretty good, too. Can you help me back to your hideout?
So, were you able to find E'Dycu?
Did you find the thing Nym wants back?
Did you put a stop to that pirate leader?
Huh? What do you need?
Did you pay them yet?
Aaargghh... I think ye be pickin' the wrong person... ye be best to look around nearby.
Sounds easy enough. Sure, I'll do it.
Sure, I can help with this.
Sounds like fun. I'll do it.
You're right I'll help!! Where is he?!
Don't worry, Nym will get his money.
Sorry, but I can't do it right now.
I'm not interested in helping a pirate king, Han. No.
Sorry, Han, but I don't agree with this. No.
That's what he gets! No, I'm not helping!
I think you should give him the money, not me.
I take it you don't want to be seen around here?
Can't you get the item yourself?
What's the difference between Nym and these pirates?
Why was he ambushed by Imperials?
What exactly is the Alliance buying?
I can't find him and I don't want to look any more.
I don't want to involve myself with this anymore.
I'm not enjoying this. I'm going to stop doing this now.
Han, I can't help this pirate out.
Han, I think you should do this, not me.
Not yet. I think I'll go look for him again.
Not yet, but I think I will soon.
Not yet. He'll be stopped soon.
Nothing. Just wanted to say 'Hi'.
Not yet. I'm about to leave now.
I understand you have other things to do, but I deperately need your help. Could you please attend to your business then return as soon as possible?
Move along.
Oh. I thought you were someone else. You'd best be running along now.
You weren't sent by General Dodonna? I see. Look, you might want to get out of here before it gets dangerous, okay?
I'm busy waiting for something right now.
Go find Luke.  I'm worried something might have happened to him.  He's just along the corridor here, deeper in the temple.
Let me get the coordinates of the transports. Ask me again in a few minutes.
Let me get the coordinates of the landing site. Ask me again in a few minutes.
Let me get the coordinates of the repair facility. Ask me again in a few minutes.
I'll contact Nateba and find out where he'll meet you. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Lert me contact Luke and find out where he can meet you. Check back with me in a few minutes.
What's this? This isn't the datapad that the General told me to deliver. Come on, we don't have much time.
Umm... I'm not too sure what this is. Are you sure this is what General Dodonna wanted you to bring me?
I can't speak with you unless Mon Mothma has given you clearance.

Welcome, welcome. Please come in. You have been highly recommended by both Leia and Mon Mothma. As you can tell, our base in under heavy siege, and won't last too much longer. Right now, I am in need of your fabled skills to help some transports leave the planet. Can you help with this?

I am once again in need of you. One of our deep Intelligence teams has uncovered some very important military information regarding the Empire, but were unaware that that our base was under siege. They have landed far away from here to be safe, but they need to be escorted back here safely. Can you help?

Watch your head! Feel that shaking? It's the Empire ramping up their bombing efforts... they know we're weakening.  At this rate, I'm not sure we'll be able to get everyone out to safety. I need you for an operation that will hopefully slow them down. Can you help?

I have made an important discovery among the information the infiltration team has brought back. This information may help us to create a permanent base once again, one far away from Imperial probes. I dare not transmit this information where it can be intercepted, therefore I need you to deliver this to a pilot who will fly it to Mon Mothma.

This is horrible!  Nateba was shot down by a turbolaser battery before he was able to make it out of the atmosphere. Other than Luke, who's helping escort others off the planet, I don't have anyone else to deliver the information. Wait... I'll have to get another pilot.  I'll need you to deliver this.

At this location, you will find a group of camouflaged transports that are to be leaving the planet. Every one of them is full of refugees from our bases, and they are being attacked by a band of stormtroopers. Eliminate the stormtrooper threat before they prevent the ships from ever leaving the planet.
Here is where their last communication came from. You should find their team out there waiting for your arrival. Once you find them, return back here immediately with them.
Okay, I will need you to take out a group of stormtroopers that's causing us trouble. If you can do this, you will buy us a lot more time.
Take the information encoded on the datapad to Nateba Kurr, one of the last X-Wing pilots I have available on the planet. Once he has it, he'll depart to Dantooine and deliver it promptly.

Since Nateba Kurr's X-Wing was completely obliterated, there's no wreckage to recover the datapad from. Fortunately, I made another copy of this info for myself. Look... this is the last copy we have. It's vital that it makes it to safety... I'm sure he'll be able to avoid the turbolaser on his way off planet.
I'm sorry, I don't think I heard you correctly. Did you just say that you are willing to let the Empire destroy many innocent lives?
Please reconsider. There aren't too many able bodied people left here, and I trust you can get the job done.
I understand, but you must understand as well : you are our only hope.
Look, we need to get this information to our current base, and you're the only one I trust that can get it there. Please reconsider.
What? This is very important! This could save the lives of thousands of the Rebellion! Ask yourself if you'll be able to live with yourself if you refuse this.

This has been our base for some time now, but with the Death Star being destroyed we have revealed our presence to the the Empire. Most of the base's personnel have been evacuated off the planet, but many still need to leave. With a host of X-Wings still left to cause distractions, we can safely see the rest of them off planet.

They have been infilitrating the Empire for a few years now, only recently coming out from their disguise. They claim to have information regarding the exact fleet size of the Empire, and also the sectors they patrol regularly. This information has the potential to be the most important information we have seen in a long time.

The Empire is using a number of T.I.E. Bombers to keep up a steady attack.  Vader has a group of stormtroopers on the planet that are giving him coordinates to bomb.  I'm not sure why he's steering clear of these temples, but whatever the case may be, his bombing campaign is beginning to work.

As I said earlier, I was one of the first Star Destroyer captains when they were comissioned by the Old Republic, before the Emperor took over. With that experience, I can tell by looking at this information that the flight paths of the Empire's Star Destroyers seem to overlook a few systems in thier patrols. The one that interests me the most is a small system called Hoth.
It's the only chance!  You've got to deliver that information!
You need to get to those transports now before they are blown sky high! Eliminate the Stormtroopers causing the problem.
You will need to locate the infiltration team and escort them back here.
You need to locate the stormtroopers sending coordinates and take them out.
You need to deliver the locations of potential base sites to Nateba Kurr. Once you have done so, Nateba will then be able to deliver the information to Mon Mothma himself.
You need to get this vital data to Luke Skywalker immediately!
There's a Rebel! Kill him!
Help!  I'm the only one left from our team and I think I'm heavily wounded.....
Don't let them stop us! Keep broadcasting!
Hurry! I need to get that information to High Command before I'm spotted by any T.I.E.s.
Hello. You must be the person General Dodonna told me to expect.
We have received word that four of our transports have been destroyed whilst still on the ground. On board those transports were 200 men and women. I hope you remember this day for a long time.
The information that they held was quite important. It very well could have changed the face of this Civil War. The fact that you let them die will be remembered by me for a long, long time.
With the Empire still being able to rearm as fast as they can bomb, I'm not sure how much time is left with this temple.
Without that information getting to Mon Mothma in time, we may not be able to begin relocation to Hoth without being seen.
That was the last copy of the information we had. We may never be able to move our way out to that system any longer.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.
I'll find someone else to help that has more to offer, I guess.

With those Stormtroopers taken care of, the transports were able to leave the planet safely. We have lost many X-Wings, but fortunately there aren't too many more needed to leave the planet. You did good work. I will have need of you again shortly.

This information will be a great help indeed. From the quick look I had of it, it seems that the Empire hasn't changed their protocols since I was a Captain. You didn't know that? Yes... I was one of the first Captains of the Imperial Class Star Destroyers. That, though, was a long time ago. When we are all done, I'll see to it that everyone of them are scuttled and turned into plowshares.

With the bombing out of the way, it will take the Empire's forces quite a bit longer to rearm from their Star Destroyers. This should give us much more time to get the remaining people off of this base. Thank you for your help.
Nateba has let me know that he is already inputting the navigation codes to Dantooine and should be off-planet within a few minutes. Thank you for getting that information there safely.

Okay, I feel much better knowing that Mon Mothma has this information. If there's anyone who can manuever his way around turbolasers, it will be him. In order to speed up the evacuation of a group of archaelogists, would you mind going out to help Luke?  He should be just along this passage, deeper in the ruins.

Okay, great! I'll get back to my X-Wing and have my R2 unit plot a course to Dantooine. Good luck out here, and make sure you make it out of here alive, you got that? We can't afford to lose good people like you.

I don't know. He said he had just a few moments to see what it looked like. From his description, it looks like some jeweled box in the shape of a pyramid. Hmmm... you know something? This place is actually rather calming... I may have to come back here someday when the war is over. I kinda like it. Take care, friend.

Welcome. I have a very important assignment that I feel I can only entrust to you, considering all you have done for the Alliance already. I need you to deliver this holovid of the attack on the Death Star to one of our spies. Can you do that?

From our information, it would appear that there is a strike team being sent to investigate recent activity. We need that team prevented from acheiving their task.

The Alliance has enacted a plan that should buy us even more secrecy than before. The plan has gone according to plan, and what I need now from you is to take part of the recovery team. I will need you to find the escape pod of the Captain of a Corvette and escort her back here. Can you do this?

We have need of your assistance once again. One of our medical transports has returned from Yavin, bearing a full load of the wounded soldiers that are defending that base. The transport is being readied for return to Yavin, but it looks like a Stormtrooper squadron is about to come through the area. Are you available?

Our efforts to secure secrecy of this base has had an unexpected outcome - the deployment schedules have been changed. The last information we were able to discern was that a Senior Engineer of a secret military project was to be landing on the planet. We must take this final opportunity to apprehend him for questioning.

It seems this project the Empire has been working on has been to create a very large Shield Generator, even larger than that used by Vader's Super Star Destroyer. The Engineer was to retrieve schematics for it from the General on the planet. Though this may blow our cover, we need to get those blueprints. Can you help?

Here is the holovid that needs to be broadcasted. I have arranged a site for you to meet our Bothan friend. I will provide your description to her so that she recognizes you and only you. Please go with this now, for we don't have too much time.

Judging by the standard operation procedures of the Empire, the strike team will likely land far away. We have triangulated where they should be, therefore we have the element of surprise assisting us. I am certain that you can do this.

Thank you. Her name is Captain Altapi T'mman, and I will notify her that you are on the way to pick her up. Be aware that she will likely have been injured in the landing, so you will need to fend off any resistance you encounter.

I will give you the coordinates of the wherabouts of the transport. You will need to eliminate the Stormtroopers in the surrounding area before the transport can leave the planet. Once done, we will give the signal for the ship to depart.

The location in your datapad is the last known location of where he was to land. We do not know what type of forces are guarding him, so be aware. He is quite important to us finding out what this project is, so do not let any harm come to him.
The Engineer said that he was to meet the General at the location in your datapad. There is still time to go out there and intercept him if you hurry. Once last thing : May the Force be with you.

I'm not sure I understand your reluctance. With this information spread to the masses, the lies of the Empire will be weakened. You don't want to see an opportunity to strike the Empire go to waste, do you?
I understand. I will look for someone that is more able-bodied to accomplish this.
Hmmm... I do not understand the lack of concern on your part. Perhaps if you thought on it, you would change your mind.
I will see who else we have available, then.
I see. It's a shame that you could not find it within yourself to help.
This is quite important, yet you turn your back on us. I am very disappointed in you.

A few hours ago High Command was contacted by our representatives with the Bothan SpyNet. They have managed to slice into a major HoloNet broadcast center on Coruscant. We must sieze this opportunity to show the Imperial citizens what happened at Yavin IV. It may convince many more to express sympathy towards our cause.

The hidden nature of this base is a very tenuous one. Unfortunately, we have not been able to find a more secure place. I authorized this base to be re-initialized after General Dodonna informed us that the siege on Yavin would end in our destruction. Until we find a more secure base, we must protect the secrecy of this one at all costs.

The operation involved us sacrificing three of our Corellian Corvettes. We staged the Corvettes to look like an expeditionary force trying to return to Dantooine, then engaged them with a TIE Fighter squad. The Corvettes were only running a skeleton crew, and all the Captains have been accounted for save for one.

The deployment schedules of this planet have keyed us into much of the troop movement on Dantooine. This has allowed us to determine where Stormtrooper, Star Destroyer, and TIE Fighter movements are to take place. This information has been quite invaluable.

The operation in which we sacrificed the Corvettes has paid off very well. The local General has declared this world free of 'Rebel Infestation', which means our base should remain hidden for a time to come. Unfortunately, with a change in security levels, our guard schedules are useless to us now.

We do not see a need for a Shield Generator so large. It does explain why all of the generators were being taken from the old base and other locations, though. We will need the blueprints for this design in case the Generator were to ever be operational. If it is ever used by the Empire, it would be best if we knew it's weaknesses.
You are to deliver this holovid containing the events of the Death Star assault to our agent with the Bothan SpyNet.
You will need to locate the strike team that was sent by the Empire. Once found, you must make it a point that they do not report back to their commanders.
You are to locate Captain Altapi T'mman and escort her back here to the base.
You are to locate the squadron of stormtroopers that will be in the area and then eliminate them. Once done, the transport can then depart.
You will need to locate and apprehend the Senior Engineer if this secret project. Once done, bring him back to me.
You are to intercept the General of this planet...and kill him. Recover the blueprints on his person.
Heyho... You have the look of someone who wants to broadcast, eh?
There's one! Set blasters for stun!
If you're an Imperial, watch out! I'll blast you sky-high, bum leg or not!

let me get the coordinates of where the Stormtroopers can be found. Ask me in a few minutes.

I am expecting much attention to be diverted to all of the rebellious citizens that should be springing up soon. Thank you.

Wonderful. Whilst you destroyed the troops, I had another team hijack their shuttle for future use. The Empire will likely write this off as operater malfunction and leave it alone for now. At least we were able to buy more time. Thank you for your help.

Wonderful work. I see you have been able to bring the Captain back safely. Now all of the crew have been accounted for, we can only hope that the sacrifice of those precious Corvettes will convince the Planetary General that we don't exist here anymore.

The transport has left the planet safely and will be able to pick up more of the evacuees on Yavin. General Dodonna has informed us that the base is still holding up after all this time, but it can't do so for much longer. You have done the Alliance a great service today.

Thank you for bringing him safely to us. We will now be able to discuss what he was working on in private. Hopefully he was high ranking enough to be able to provide enough information as to the nature fo the project. I may need you in a little while, so please check back with me in a few hours.

Yes, this is quite large indeed. Well, we shall keep this in our Intelligence for future reference. Fortunately, with this information, it shows that a small strike team can disable whatever it is shielding. We'll have to keep an eye out for that once we have a more permanent base. General Dodonna has requested your help with the evacuation on Yavin. Thank you for your help.
Yes, this feels nice and smooth. I'll get this back to my compatriots, then we'll screen this for the viewers everywhere. I'm gone.
You're the one sent by Mon Mothma, I take it. Well, I've hurt my leg, so I'll need a little help getting back to base. Lead on.
So, am I under arrest by you Rebels? I'll talk as long as you don't hurt me. I just make shield generators, nothing more!
Yes?
Do you have a question?
How can I help?
Yes?
How may I help?
Did you have a question?
I'm not the person you're looking for. Maybe that other guy that was nearby.
I'll deliver it.
They will be prevented from finding us.
I'll go rescue her.
Yes, I can help.
I'll get him.
I'll take care of him.
Sorry, but I can't do this.
I am not capable of doing this mission.
I'm not interested.
Not at this time, no.

I can't just kill someone in cold blood.
Why the urgency?
Why all the effort to keep the base secret?

Assistance has been offered, but a denial will ensue with gracious attachment. A thought comes to my mind that entails the visitation of Corellia.
Well, if you think of something you want, come look for me sometime.
You're not the person I'm looking for. Get out of here!
Didn't you hear me the first time? I said my favorite line I like to say: Get out of here or get dead!!! That means go!
What? You're not the guy who wants to buy the Hyperdrive from me? Well, what are you wasting my time for?
Dunno what this is. Here, you can have it back.
Talk to Han.  See what he has to say.
Chewbacca cannot fix the hyderdrive without that part.  I really need you to pick it up for me.
I can't talk.  I'm too busy working for Princess Leia.  Well, I could talk to you if she said it was ok.  You know where she's at right?  Somewhere on Cor....oh.  I shouldn't say.

Hello to your person. The Regal One has messaged your expectation of arrival. Problems are had by myself concerning a made to be shifted linguistic decoder that was transacted by a regional purveyor of droids fittings. A request is made for your help. Locate the seller and transport him to my person. Are you understanding?

Thanks again for the previous help. When I was landing the Falcon in a safer, more secret hiding place, I noticed a small craft landing nearby our location. You weren't expecting anybody were you? Nah... I didn't think you were. Well, I hate to say, but you have someone following you, and you might want to take care of it before they find us.

Uh-oh. What am I gonna do? If Han finds out about this, he'll... hey! I... uh... need your help. I guess when I was tracking the bounty hunter's ship, I never bothered to complete my own scans of the area. Yeah... um... well, it seems that our basecamp is in proximity to a nearby Pirate camp. Uh... could you help stop the Pirates stealing the Falcon?

Okay..... I've spoken to Chewbacca... the hyperdrive is heavily damaged, but he says he can get it fixed if he had the right parts. I've managed to get in touch with a few shady pirates on this planet, and one guy said he has the part. Could you run out there and grab it for me? I would greatly appreciate it...

Relief is greatly filling me. The location of the said trafficker is expected to be an inverse of a great distance. Appreciation will be granted upon the finality of your agenda. Hastened movement will increase the feelings of gratitude. Take your fears and dispatch them, for the dealer should comprehend the condition.

I'm glad to hear that I won't have to scrape you out of a mess. Now, from what I gather, I'm pretty certain the craft has fully landed, and this person is on their way to track you down. If they're friendly, that's fine... but I've seen that type of flying before, and I'll wager 1000 credits that's a bounty hunter. Stop by when the coast is clear.

Thank you, thank you, thank you! Okay, here's where I landed the Falcon. You should find the pirates somewhere about here... I've highlighted it on your datapad for you. If you scare a number of them off, the rest should leave as well. If they won't listen to reason... well, they're pirates, if you understand what I'm saying.

Thank you so much! Okay, I've told him I'm sending you out there. You might want to keep an eye open. I don't really trust this guy... well, I don't really trust any of the people here on the planet, to be honest. Just make sure he doesn't try to rob you, okay?

The emotion of anger is projected at the malfunctioning device in question. With a viewing of the past, knowledge provides information to the effect that currency should not have parted my appendages for said object. Blessings be unto you regardless of the outcome.

I'm not too sure about that, friend. By the looks of the ship - and I got a pretty close look without being spotted, I'd say that's a bounty hunter after you. Then again, we are on Lok... I'd still rather be safe than sorry.
Ooooh.... please! You have to help! If Solo finds out that I parked his baby next to some Pirates, he'll kill me! Seriously! I think he might actually kill me!
Ah, I understand. I guess I'll see if Chewbacca can help m out. I really need to get the Falcon fixed before Han notices.

A device created for the intent of the decoding of syllables between both Sullustan and Basic was aquired in exchange for legal tender. The aforementioned splinter of dung has experienced a series of failed functions, resulting in unintended methods of communication. Does the possibility exist of your person performing assistance?

Well, it's still a bit hush-hush, so I can't say much - that's up to Han. I was asked by Solo to navigate us to a safe spot on the planet, so that's why I'm out here. His Wookiee friend went to accompany him with gathering old contacts. From what I gather, I'm not too sure if I really want to ask too many questions about either of their pasts.

You mean the one that goes: there's nothing Han Solo cares more about in this galaxy than the Millennium Falcon? Umm. Yeah. That's why we can't say anything to him about it, okay? He told me if anything happens to the Falcon, he'll tell Chewbacca to get angry. You've heard what they say an angry Wookiee does to your arms, right?

Are you crazy?! I'm never going to tell him. As a matter of fact, unless it's a matter of life or death, I'm never flying that thing again after we get off this planet! Even if we can stop the Empire once and for all, I won't get in his ship again. Well... I guess if we could stop the Empire I would... But that would be the ONLY way I'd fly his ship again!
I do not see problems with this current status. Upon the aquisition of repair, all will be made better.
Well, you'd best hurry before that bounty hunter gets too close to our makeshift base.
Well hurry up! They're pirates, for Sullust's sake! They're not going to wait around all day for someone to show up!
Okay, good. Make sure the part works before you accept it, okay?
Would you care to see my specially modifed droid parts?
So this is where secret Rebel base is, hm? The Empire will pay a lot for this info...
Hey you!  Get out of here or get dead!
You the one picking up this hyperdrive part? Good......
Understanding has eluded my grasp on the same height as yours.
You led the bounty hunter straight here? Oh, I sure do hope it was just some local pirate, rather than someone working for the Empire.
You let them steal the Falcon? YOU LET THEM STEAL THE FALCON?!?!?!? Oh, that's it... I've got to get off this planet before Han finds out!!!
He didn't actually have a Hyperdrive for a YT-1300? Aaarrgg!!!!  What am I going to do now? *sigh* I guess I take my chances with telling him then...
Charts are in need of consulting before a quest is embarked upon.  Please refer back to me later.
Let me check the Falcon for my notes. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me look on this map to see where I hid the Falcon. Check back in a few minutes.
