Ah, I understand. I guess I'll see if Chewbacca can help me out. I really need to get the Falcon fixed before Han notices.

Thank you soooo much! I knew I should have been wary of buying a 'prototype' using a protocol droid brain to translate to other languages. Thanks again! Princess Leia told us to expect you. Look, I have to go move the Millennium Falcon to a safer location, so I can't talk right now. Check back with me in a bit, because I might have need of you.

Well, from what you say, it sounds like you had a bounty hunter on your tail when you left Corellia and had been stalking you all over Lok. You sure are lucky this guy wasn't a professional, or you wouldn't be here to tell me about it. I'll go see if Han is still busy... hmmm? What's that? Hm. Let me check on this warning beacon, then we'll talk some more.

You saved the Falcon?! Oh, thank you so very much. Now, before Han finds out what happened, I'll need to check the damage on this Falcon. If it's damaged, it will be extremely hard to find parts. That's an old YT-1300, not to mentioned heavily modified at that. If you would, could you please check back with me a little later?

Friend, you've helped me so much today, I greatly appreciate it. I can't begin to thank you for your help. You're the type of person who reminds me why we fight against the Empire. Oh yeah... I forgot you were here to speak with Han. I'll let him know you're here, and I'll also let him know you're completely dependable, too.
Bah... can't believe I let that go so cheaply. Get out of here before I change my mind.
Blast it! I told that Sullustan not to get that droid brain wet! Arrrgh.... sure, I'll fix it for him. Take me to him.
Has the position of the merchandiser of rubbish been aquired?
Have you taken care of the tag-a-long?
Were you able to stop the Pirates?
So were you able to get the Hyperdrive?
Whaaah? I don't know you! What do you want with me? Oh.... you must be looking for the other person standing around nearby.
If you mean escort a guy here, sure I'll help.
Yeah, I'll clean up after myself.
They're stealing the Falcon!!? I'll help you!
You're a nice guy... sure.
Sorry, I can't understand anything you're saying. I can't help.
No thanks. I know nobody followed me.
Whoa! This is none of my business, Nien. No.
Sorry, Nien, but I don't have time right now.
Why are you talking so weird?
Why are you and Han Solo here on Lok?
Is it true what they say about Han's ship?
Are you going to tell Han what happened?
Okay, I've had enough of this. I'm not doing this anymore.
I don't think anyone was following me. I'm not doing this.
I won't be able to stop them, Nein!
Sorry, Nien, but I don't have time to help you right now. I can't do this.
Umm... I think the answer is no, but I'm still looking?
Not yet, but I'll have it taken care of.
No, I haven't left yet.
Not yet. I'm about to meet him right now.

Hello. You must be the person both Qualdo and Wedge have told me about. I wish to thank you for all you've done for our cause. With everyone's help, such as yours, we may actually have a chance to put an end to the Empire.
Thank you for stopping them. I'll be going back home now.
What? You're not the one who was described to me. I bid you good day.
Thank you for your assistance. I will be forever in debt to you.
Hey now. You're not running the same system as us, are you? Sorry... no business for you.
If you do not have official business here, move along!
Thank you for your kind offer, but this is not something I am in need of. You should offer it to someone less fortunate.
You should go to Lok and see my friend Nien Nunb.  He's there with Han Solo.  Perhaps they could use some assistance?
Let me check the message to see where she last was before being arrested. Please speak with me again in a few minutes.
Let me look up where you are to meet him. Please check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me check with Tennelt again as to the whereabouts of her extradition path. Please ask me again in a few minutes.
I need to contact the Bothan SpyNet to let them know I'll be sending them a courier. Check back with me in a few minutes, please.
Let me check with the Bothan's information. Ask me again in a few minutes.
What? This has no codes on it! What game are'ya playing here?
You shouldn't be here.  Perhaps Wedge could use your help?

Welcome! It's a pleasure to meet you. I've been told what you've done, and on behalf of the Alliance, I wish to extend my thanks to you. I have a further request for you, though. I am overseeing the off-planet evacuation of a family that has helped us in the past, but one of them has been arrested. I need you to go rescue her, please.

Ah, it's you. I have a request of you, if you are available. We have made contact with an Officer that works for the ISB, the Imperial Security Bureau. He wishes to come over to the Alliance, but requires my assurance he will come to no harm. He requested you to be his bodyguard, as well. Will you do this for us?

Good, you have arrived just in time. Tennelt has informed us that right before he defected, he provided information regarding a prominent Selonian politician that was being abducted and taken to the Inquisitors for interrogation, then execution. We need to save her before it's too late!

We have just received some... well, very interesting news. It seems that Tennelt was actually a spy this entire time, until he revealed to us that he now truly wishes to defect. Since his revelation he has provided us every single code he was privy to, which we have encoded on a datapad. I need your help, for this needs to be delivered to our contacts immediately!

Well, the Bothans sure did a good job. They managed to grab everything they could from Imperial Intelligence. In addition to a number of Star Destroyer flightpaths, they uncovered what appears to be a construction project being built near an out of the way system. We would appreciate it if you intercepted one of these shipments, please.

I thank you in advance for your help. We have her last known location before she was apprehended, but I'm not sure if she'll be there. Once you have rescued her from the Stormtroopers, bring her back here so that we can reunite her with her family. Please hurry, for you are her only hope.

I thank you very much. The ISB agent has designated a meeting place out within the wilds.  I don't think I need to say that you should be prepared for a fight in case this is a trap. Please take caution in case he is not as sincere as he claims.

The information that Tennelt has given us suggests that she will be taken along the route I have entered into your datapad. Accordingly, there is a small group acting as escort, which you will likely have to take care of. Once she has been rescued, bring her back here to the base so that we can help her to safety.

I knew I could trust you to do this. You need to deliver this to our contact with the Bothan SpyNet, and very soon. Tennelt was supposed to check back in tomorrow. When the ISB realizes that he really defected, they'll change every one of these codes. We need to give the Bothan slicers as much time as possible!
We have targeted an outgoing shipment from this planet. What we need you to do is to identify the commander of the transport units, then capture him. He will be able to give us more information.
Umm.. I don't understand. You don't wish to help this person? Am I understanding that you would prefer for her to go off to the Empire's prisons after all she's done for us?

I hate to burst your bubble, but if you look around, half of the people you see in the Alliance were once Imperials. Heck, General Dodonna was one of the first to Captain a Star Destroyer when the Emperor took over. That attitude does nothing to help our cause, friend.

After all you've done for us, I would have assumed you were the best person for the job. Very well, I'll see if I can get Wedge to do it. I must attend to this now, so I no longer have any time to talk.
I understand this is quite important, but I wouldn't have asked you unless I thought you were the person for the job. I have faith in you, so please reconsider.
Yes, I know I've asked you for so much so far, but you are desperately needed! Please, please reconsider.

Her name is Deasie A'Fresel, and she's the wife of the cell leader you helped to escape off planet a little while back. She opted to be the last one to leave the planet, making sure the rest of her family went before she did. Unfortunately, the Imperials have found her and are transporting her to the nearest Inquisitor.

Actually, it was the woman you rescued earlier, Deasie A'Fresel. It seems her brother is an ISB agent, and the fact that she was going to be taken to the Inquisitors was the last straw for him. He has seen what you have done for his sister and brother-in-law, and wishes you to be his escort so that he may speak with me.

According to the information Tennelt has given us, it seems this Selonian is one of the Advocates on the Corellian Tribunal. It seems she has been rather vocal against the Empire as of late, and the plan was to remove her from the picture and replace her with someone a little more Pro-Imperial. We need to stop this from happening.

Yes, it's true. When he came here, he was actually intending on sneaking out and revealing where our base was. In the time that he has spent here and seen what the Empire is actually doing, rather than the propaganda he was fed by the Emperor, he has decided to really join our cause. I somehow knew inside that he was a good person, and fortunately I was right.

We're not sure at this time. Ever since we destroyed the Death Star, the Empire has been hurting for credits. It's possible they may be building a new repair facility, or worse yet, another one of those monstrous Super Star Destroyers. We need to find out what this is before they can continue building it.
You must understand that time is of the essence. You are her only hope!
Please make haste. If the Imperials find out he's defecting, they might kill him outright!
You must hurry! You need to save her before she makes it to the Inquisitor!
You must hurry! Those codes will be changed very soon, and we need to make the most of them.
Well, you don't want to miss it. You might want to set up an ambush for them.
Please, help me! They're going to send me to the Kessel mines!
Hold there. You wouldn't happen to be the royal one's emissary, would you?
Please! You must stop them before they kill me!
Whoaaaa... you have a flashy look in your eye. What code are you sending me, huh?
A bandit ambush! Put a stop to this, men!
She died in the scuffle? *sigh* Let me take care of this. I have to find some way to explain this to her husband...
Did I just hear you say you let him get killed? What kind of bodyguard are you!?
She died in the scuffle? *sigh* Let me take care of this, then. I have to find some way to explain this to the rest of her clan...
The Bothan contact wasn't there? But they're always reliable... well, this could have been a great advantage, but we will persevere.
The commander died in the crossfire, you say? Aarrgh! Without his information, the Empire might be able to get their project completed before we can stop it.
Umm.. I don't understand. You don't wish to help this person? Am I understanding that you would prefer for her to go off to the Empire's prisons after all she's done for us?

I hate to burst your bubble, but if you look around, half of the people you see in the Alliance were once Imperials. Heck, General Dodonna was one of the first to Captain a Star Destroyer when the Emperor took over. That attitude does nothing to help our cause, friend.

After all you've done for us, I would have assumed you were the best person for the job. Very well, I'll see if I can get Wedge to do it. I must attend to this now, so I no longer have any time to talk.
I understand this is quite important, but I wouldn't have asked you unless I thought you were the person for the job. I have faith in you, so please reconsider.
Yes, I know I've asked you for so much so far, but you are desperately needed! Please, please reconsider.

Oh, thank you so much. We'll be able to set them up with a nice home on Rori where they'll be safe, after all they have contributed. As for you, I'm certain they will be forever grateful for what you have done. Thank you once again.

Officer Tennelt has asked me to thank you for providing a safe trip here. I too offer you my thanks, for this will be a great boon to the Alliance if he truly is defecting. I'll need to have a number of talks with him before I'm convinced, though. Thank you very much for you assistance.

As an Advocate on the Tribunal, she will be able to relate her story through her clan. I will send someone out to inform them of what transpired so that she can be smuggled back into their caves safely. Thank you very much for your help.

From how you described your conversation with the Bothan, I'm sure you gave it to the right guy. They're a bit odd, but they're the best slicers in the Galaxy. Now all we have to do is wait and see what information they are able to steal. Thank you for your help.

Thank you. Once the questioning has been completed, we can inform Mon Mothma of the important news so that she can set up a battle plan. You know... I know a guy who could use your help with something he's working on right now. If you'd like to travel to Lok, you might want to look up Han Solo. I'll let him and Nien know you're coming.  And take this reward for your assistance.  It's the least we can do.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. These are some tasty codes. We'll get them sliced and diced in no time. When we're done, we let the Princess know what secrets Old Papa is hiding, okay?
Oh, thank you so much! Once I've made it back to my family, I'll make it a point to send you one of my famous garrenberry pies! Now, let's go!
Very well. I understand the need for secrecy, but I do so hope you pay attention so that I don't fall into a gully. Let us depart.
Oh, thank you! What? You were sent by Princess Leia? I knew I put my faith in the right side of this struggle. Please, lead on.
Very well, then. I surrender.
Have you saved Deasie?
Where is the ISB agent?
Have you rescued the Selonian yet?
What did the Bothan say when you delivered the codes?
Do you have the Commander in your custody?
No, I'm not in need of being escorted by anyone. Maybe you're looking for someone else?
By all means! I'll save her!
Sure, I'll bring him here safely.
I'll definitely help!
I'll get it to them!
No problem. I'll do it.
I'm sorry, Princess, but I cannot help with this.
Sorry, I can't stand looking at an Imperial.
This doesn't sound like a job for my skills. Sorry.
Sorry, but this is too much responsibility for me.
I can't handle something like that.
Who am I to rescue?
When did all of this happen?
Why are the Imperials interested in a Selonian?
I don't understand. Tennelt told you he was a spy?
What's this Imperial construction project?
I'm sorry, Princess, but I can't do this.
I've changed my mind. I'm not helping any Imperials!
I'm no longer capable of handling this job.
I can't handle this responsibility anymore!
I give up. I can't do this.
No, not yet.
I haven't made contact with him yet.
No, not yet.
Um... I haven't yet delivered them yet.
The shipment hasn't arrived yet.
Hello there! I'm Qualdo Herm and a member of the Alliance like you. The Princess's droids have spoken highly of you, and I think I can use your help when you've got some time.
Oh, I see. Well, if you ever meet him, say 'Hi' for me, okay?
Oh, you're not taking the shipment? Sorry about that.
You're not a Rebel? Sorry, I mistook you for someone else.
Please... send for help.... don't know how... much longer.....
Seems like you should be getting back to work.
I'm dealing with some new recruits and some paperwork, but we appreciate your efforts for the Alliance.  Perhaps Wedge has some work that he needs done?
Hmmm... I thought Qualdo said he'd be giving me a modified commlink.  This doesn't look like one.
The droids are the ones you should talk to.  I believe they need some assistance.   C-3PO and R2?  You've met them, yes?

Hello there! I'm Qualdo Herm and a member of the Alliance like you. The Princess's droids have spoken highly of you, and I think I can use your help. I have a friend that has recently decided to help the Alliance by providing some information. What I need, though, is for you to deliver this special comm-link to him. Sound good?

Hi there! I need your help again, friend. I'klee'trao has let me know that a special compound is being transported to his research facility. It seems that this compound is being used for the project he's working on. My plan is to intercept that compound so that it will slow down their research. Can you do that for the Alliance?

Well, hello there! My Ithorian friend has given us good news! It seems that without the compound, which is apparently quite expensive in it's prototype form, the Empire is considering putting an end to the project. With a little help from I'klee'trao, we have devised a plan that might stop the project altogether. Can you help us with this?

Oh, this is bad news! The Imperials found 'Klee's commlink and have had him arrested and sentenced to execution! We sent a team to rescue him, but they were all killed, save for I'klee'trao. Look, this is a matter of life and death! I need you to go out there and rescue him, then bring him back to me immediately! Will you do it?

Great!  It seems my friend, I'klee'trao, is working for a company making dampening devices. Well, he just found out the company's secret project is actually being funded by the Empire. Being an Ithorian, he has no love for the Empire.  Bring him this special two-way commlink so that he can relay any special info to us.

Okay, I'll give you the coordinates of where the shipment should be coming from. What we need is the compound that will be used to make a prototype for the project. Once we have that, we'll be able to put a stop, or at least slow down, the research on this project. Good luck, friend!

Great! You'll need to run over to the research facility and meet with the Imperial Officer that is overseeing this project. He is delivering the design documents, regarding the project that is, to a courier for transport back to a R&D facility. However you do it, you need to get those blueprints from him.

Okay, okay! Okay... let's see.  Okay, 'Klee's last transmission to us was from these coordinates. You need to get out there fast, then bring him back here. Be careful, for he's been severely wounded and has probably lost a lot of blood. Okay, I'll let you do your job and get out of your way now.
Well, I can understand that. I'd do it myself, but I need to oversee the evacuation of one of our guy's family. Well, thanks anyway.
Hrmm... well, I can understand. I was just hoping you would be willing to help. Well, thank you anyways.
Well, I'm not sure I understand, but you've already been a big help to begin with, I guess I can't complain. Thanks anyways.
What? Oh... okay... let me think here. I can't have another person killed, too... okay, I'll have to ask the Princess what to do!!!!!

He's an old friend I went to the Scientarium Academia with.  He specialized in acoustic technology, whereas I focused on alien surgery. As a matter of fact, I used to be the best medic for 10 parsecs around - that was before I just couldn't take the nerves anymore. Just recently he got ahold of me again, and through some talking, offered to give the Alliance special information.

From what he says he made a breakthrough in sound dampening technology a little bit back. Apparently the Empire has now shown themselves to be the ones running the company, and are planning on using this for their Probe Droids.  Their plan is to make these droids far more quiet so they aren't as easily detectable due to their loud whine and chatter.

I'klee'trao suggested that since the project was under consideration due to security breaches, the best way to have it cancelled completely would be to destroy the design documents. He's sent a false message to the Imperial Officer that has taken control of the facility. The message told him to deliver the documents to a courier, but you'll intercept them.

Look, I'm a medic, not a commander. I couldn't take doing the surgeries anymore, so I was transferred to a command position. Only an Ithorian would know how to operate on another Ithorian, due to their physiology. Or a Xeno-Surgeon... such as myself. I'm the only one who can save him from dying, but I vowed never to do an operation again. Now do you see?
Okay, I was just checkin'.
Well, hello to you too.  You really do need to get out there and grab that compound before it's too late, though.
Oh, I can't complain. Sure beats being out in the field patching up blaster wounds.
Well, hurry. He doesn't have much longer before he dies!
Hello. You wouldn't happen to be Qualdo's friend, would you?
Bandits!  Protect the compound at all costs!
Wait one moment! You don't look like a courier! You're a Rebel!!!
*moans*..can't... see too well.... are you here to kill me?
Well, that's horrible!  Imperials got him, you say? I think I'm going to be depressed!
They were able to get the shipment to the facility? Oh well. I guess we'll have to step up our security a bit more in the future.
You weren't able to get the documents? Well, at least you tried to do your part.
What? He's dead? After everything he did for us, you let him die? What are you, a monster?
Hmmm... let me check where he said he would meet me.  Ask me again in a few minutes.
I'll gather where the shipment is coming in from. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me contact 'Klee to find out where exactly the meeting point was supposed to be. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Let me find out where I'klee'trao's last location was. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Well, I can understand that. I'd do it myself, but I need to oversee the evacuation of one of our guy's family. Well, thanks anyway.
Hrmm... well, I can understand. I was just hoping you would be willing to help. Well, thank you anyways.
Well, I'm not sure I understand, but you've already been a big help to begin with, I guess I can't complain. Thanks anyways.
What? Oh... okay... let me think here. I can't have another person killed, too... okay, I'll have to ask the Princess what to do!!!!!

Great, you're back! I'klee'trao has made contact with me through the commlink. If anything comes up, he'll keep us posted. Thanks for your help, friend.  I don't have much to offer, but take this reward for your assistance.

I see you found this compound! This is good news, indeed. With them not able to use this in their experiments, they'll be slowed down long enough for us to work out a better plan.  Thanks, friend!  Oh, and here's another reward for your assistance.

Yes, these are the documents! I'll have to give these and the compound to High Command. I'm sure that the project will be cancelled now that we have everything needed to actually research this. With them unable to make Probots silent, we'll still be able to hear them a parsec away!  Oh, and take this reward for your assistance. You've earned it.

You brought him back just in time! Yes...yes... I can do this. Thank you for your help, friend - you may have just saved a man's life... er... Ithorian's life. I told Wedge about you, and he said he might need your help as well. Not to be rude, but out of my way... I've got a life to save!
Thank you. Tell Qualdo that I'll keep him posted on whatever the Empire is planning to do with the project I'm working on. Good luck with your Alliance.
Qualdo sent you.... *moans*.... please.... help me.... I think I'm dying.....
Have you given I'klee'trao the commlink yet?
Do you have a question?
How are you doing today?
Have you found him yet? Where is he?
Sorry, friend, but I think you've got the wrong guy.  Check nearby, okay?
No problem.  I'll do it.
Sounds important. Yes, I'll do it.
Sure I'll help!
Absolutely!
Sorry, but I'm a bit busy right now.
Sorry, it sounds a bit dangerous. I can't.
Unfortunately, I can't help you right now.
I'm not capable of doing something like that.
Who's this friend of yours?
What's the project he's working on?
What's the plan you've concocted?
What happened to your calm demeanor?
I'm sorry, but something came up.  I can't do this anymore.
Qualdo, I can't do this anymore.
I'm sorry, but I can't do this mission anymore.
You'll need to get someone else to do this. I can't anymore.
Sorry, not yet.
No, I just wanted to say 'Hi'.
Doing fine, and you?
I haven't found him yet.

Hey, you're the one that Qualdo told me about, aren't you? I just want to say thank you for what you've done for us so far. When you've got the time, maybe we can work together, eh?
Oh, you're not? Sorry about that.
Oh, sorry, I thought you were someone else! Nevermind!
Sorry, I was practicing some lines from my favorite play.
You're not here for the keys? Oh, sorry about that.
I think you should be getting to work.
I think Leia would like to speak with you.
I seem to have forgotten where I was supposed to meet him. Let me check my message again, then get back to me, okay?
Let me check with one of the guys to see where she might likely be. Check back with me shortly.
Let me check with Rogue Squadron to find out where he's going to land. Check back with me in a bit.
Let me check his report so that I can point you to the right location. Check back with me in a few minutes.
I'll get you the location of the storehouse in a moment. Check back with me in a few minutes.
Umm... I thought you were supposed to bring me a location where we would meet Wedge.
You should see if Qual'do needs some help.

So, you're the one that Qualdo told me about, eh? I admire your commitment to our cause. While my X-Wing is being repaired from a little scuffle I had with a couple of Interceptors, I figure I'll help out the Princess with recruitment. I'm supposed to meet up with a spokesman from a group coming over. Can you do this for me?

Great... we've got some good news and some bad news. The good news is that they've all decided to come over to the Alliance. The bad news is that one of their number was a bit... well, outspoken about her views on the matter. They've told me that she'll likely try to contact the Empire. I need you to go talk to her if you could?

I'm glad you showed up. My wingmates have keyed us in on some odd Imperial activity. It seems that rather than destroying the remains of the decoy Dantooine base, they're shipping the power generators off planet and bringing them here. This isn't the way the Empire does things, so we need to find out how much they know. Can you help?

It seems this is part of a large construction project the Empire has started.  From what we know already, the Empire is retro-engineering all of the power generators and shipping them offplanet somewhere. We need to take out the man in charge of this endeavor, an Imperial General by the name of Boize.

According to the documents you recovered from General Boize, he was overseeing a storehouse here on Corellia that contains a number of confiscated starcraft and starcraft parts. You need to persuade the Quartermaster in charge of the place to let you in, if you know what I mean.

Thanks a lot, friend. I'd do this myself, but I need to make sure that the repairs go right on my X-Wing. All I need you to do is bring this confirmation letter to a spokesman for a group of people I'm going to meet with. They want to hear from me firsthand about the Death Star. After they hear my story, I'm sure they'll surely help the Alliance.

From what they tell me, she likes to take long walks out in the wilderness. I'm hoping she's not trying to contact the Empire as we speak. Either way, go out there and talk to her to convince her not to reveal too much. I just hope she listens to reason, rather than trying to use a blaster.

Okay, from what the Squadron was able to figure out, the General, I believe his name is 'Graise,' should be arriving via shuttle in a remote location. I'm pretty certain you won't have too much resistance from him, aside from his personal guard. Bring him back alive, if you can, but if he resists use whatever force you deem necessary. If you have to terminate him, make sure you bring back any documents you find.
And that's why I asked you. I know I can rely on you for something like this. All you need to do is take out General Boize. Go ahead and gather together whatever you need, then get rid of him!

I knew I could count on you. Here is where the Quartermaster should be able to be found. He's going to have a unique code-cylinder on him that will open the storehouse. I doubt he's going to just hand it over to you, so you may have to use the business end of a weapon to convince him. You might as well ask him first, though.

I guess I can find someone else to do this, then. I just have to oversee that the Mechanics fix my modifications to my X-Wing correctly.  I don't want another Kessel Run incident if you know what I mean.
Yeah, I'm not one for talking too much, either. I'll see if I can get Leia to talk to her then. Leia can convince anybody of anything!
Oh, okay, I understand. I'll check with Leia to see who we have that can help. Well, good luck with whatever you're doing.
Well, I think you can do it, friend. If you feel you can't, I understand.
Oh, okay, I understand. I'll check with Leia's astromech and protocol droid to see who we have that can help. Well, good luck with whatever you're doing.

Well, I was there, but it wasn't me who blew it up. Luke's the guy you want to talk to about that. Darn good pilot, if you ask me. But, yeah, I was there flying beside him when it went up in smoke. Maybe someday when we stop the Empire I'll tell you about it, eh? So, can you do this for me?

I don't think it will be too much of a problem if I let you know, considering they are working with us now. These were some Union leaders for the Corellian Engineering Company, only the largest maker of starships here on Corellia. They don't like the Empire's "new ideas" regarding labor laws, so some of them chose to help us.

Oh, this will be a lot easier than it sounds. This General was promoted after he destroyed our Dantooine base... the one we abandoned a while back. Therefore, he's not too competent. I expect him to have only a few guards about him, rather than a squad of Stormtroopers like a smart General would have. This is an opportunity we can't pass up.

No, it seems that no one is privy to that information. All we know was that someone was assigned to oversee the transportation of the generators. He got to his position by being a yes-man rather than by asking too many questions. Even still, this is still important information.

He's the person who's in charge of all things being checked in and out of that building. Even though most of the pilots for the Empire are well trained, you still have some that want to hop in an X-Wing to try one out. That's why the Quartermaster is the only one who has the keys to the place.
Not a problem. If you could try getting it to them by today, though, it would be greatly appreciated.
Okay, but try to find her soon. You need to stop her from going to the Empire.
You might want to pick up the pace before he has reinforcements show up. If that happens, you might not be able to get to him anymore.
Okay, let me know when you taken care of the General, then.
Make sure you're well prepared for his guards before you go running out there!
Hello! You must be the person that was sent by a 'friend', right?
You can't stop me! The Empire will pay a lot for this information! Die!
How dare you! I am an Imperial General! Arrest this Rebel!
You won't get away with this!
You'll get this code-cylinder when you pry it from my cold, dead hands!
You say he wasn't there when you showed up? Hrm... they must've gotten cold feet at the last minute, I guess.
You weren't able to find her? I hope she didn't reveal to the Empire what her associates were doing.
He died in the crossfire? How did you let that happen? Oh well... I guess I'll go explain this one to Leia.
You weren't able to take out the general? Hmmm... well, we may need to send a special team out there to do it, then.
He didn't have the key on him? I can't believe that!

I guess I can find someone else to do this, then. I just have to oversee that the Mechanics fix my modifications to my X-Wing correctly.  I don't want another Kessel Run incident, if you know what I mean.
Yeah, I'm not one for talking too much, either. I'll see if I can get Leia to talk to her then. Leia can convince anybody of anything!
Oh, okay, I understand. I'll check with Leia to see who we have that can help. Well, good luck with whatever you're doing.
Well, I think you can do it, friend. If you feel you can't, I understand.
Oh, okay, I understand. I'll check with Leia's astromech and protocol droid to see who we have that can help. Well, good luck with whatever you're doing.

So they were fine with the time and place, then? Okay, that's good. Well, now I've got to brush up on my public speaking skills. Normally, I'd have Leia or Luke do this, but they specifically requested me. Ha! Wait till Luke hears this one. Anyways, thank you for doing that.  Oh, and here's a little something for your assistance.

Well, that's a shame... I'll break the news to her former associates that she was about to sell them out.  Well, there's some people we just can't reach, but at least we only use force as a last resort. Sorry to have to put you through all this, friend. Well, thank you for your help.

Well... it's a shame you weren't able to bring him in. I don't think the Empire will be too happy when they find out about this. Then again, considering how inept he was at his duties, we may have just helped the Empire by removing him. Well, at least you were able to recover these documents, they should give us a great deal of info. Thanks for your help!

So the general is out of commision, then? Good! Now we can start recovering these generators rather than having to purchase more. They can get pretty expensive from what I've been told. I'll contact my wingmates to recover any more of them already in transit. You've done a good job!

Well, I'll be! With this code-cylinder, we'll be able to recover a number of ships to rebuild our fleet. It's a small step, but every bit counts. You've been a great help, friend! I was telling Leia about you, and she's asked me to send you over to her when you got back. Once again, thank you!  And here, a rebel flight suit all for yourself.
One second... let me check this first... Oh, okay, we know where that is. Okay, tell Antilles that we'll meet him there.
I cannot believe you would have the audacity to arrest a person of my rank! I demand you take me to your leader at once! Oh... that's what you already planned on doing? Oh my...
Were you able to deliver the letter yet?
Were you able to find her?
Do you have the General in your custody?
Has the general been eliminated?
So, do you have the cylinder?
I'm not the person you're looking for. Move along.
Not a problem! I'll do it.
Sure, I'll talk to her.
Sure, I can help.
I'll do this job for you, Wedge.
Yeah, I can do this for the Alliance.
Sorry, I can't do this right now.
I'm not the talking type, sorry.
Sorry, Wedge, but I'm a bit preoccupied right now.
Whoa. That's beyond my capabilities.
Sorry, but I'm a bit preoccupied right now.
Are you the same Wedge who blew up the Death Star?
Who are these people that joined our cause?
How do you expect me to get ahold of the General?
Did we find out what the project was?
Who's the Quartermaster?
Sorry, but something came up. I can't do this anymore.
Wedge, I'm scared to talk to people. I can't do this.
Wedge, something came up. I can't do this anymore.
I'm sorry, but this is too much for me.
I can't take him on myself, Wedge.
No, not yet.
No, not yet.
No, not yet.
No, not yet.
No, not yet.
Great, just take the CD to Admiral Cube at the All-Star Cantina.  He will pay handsomely for it.
Is she in love with Han Solo?
I'm a conversationally experienced NPC.  What would you like to talk about?
The Baker is over by the Starport, just around the corner from the Arena.  He should be able to tell you more when you get there.
Not at this point in our timeline.  We find that out in Jedi.

It is inexplicable.  You say, is it just one less than 8' and they scratch their heads.  If you actually have 7 things and try to make them count them, they explode.  Well, I have a meeting now, see you later.
why do they not like basketball?
Well, I can tell you this, they sell scrap robots they find in the desert, they hate basketball, and they do not have a concept for the number 7.
What can you tell me about Jawas?
Is Leia really that hot?
To be honest with you, I have always thought she was kind of uptight.  But man does she look good in that slave outfit.
Is she Lukes sister?
Sounds pretty lucky to me.  You can find her on Naboo hanging around the palace, limping casually from place to place and trying not to fall over.
I think I have that CD.  Who should I give it to?
Oh, sorry, that is in the future.  You see I am psychic.  But trust me, when she is chained to the big slug and Han is blind and Luke starts doing backflips you will see what I mean.
Can you tell me where I can find a quest?
Depends on what kind of quest you are looking for.  The Baker has zombies in his basement, the empire needs an NWAs Greatest Hits CD, and the princess needs her shoe repaired.
Scrap robots are just robots that the Jawas found out in the desert and basically fixed up so they could sell them cheap.  Well my cell phone is ringing so I gotta go.
What is a scrap robot?
Um...number 7?...What?!?
I trained as a shoe repairman!  How lucky is that?
Slave outfit?
Probably because they are short.  Also, they do not really like to play defense and the zone defense rules confuse them.  Well, I am off to get a smoothie.
Yeah, but fear not.  I think he might be, you know, in love with the Wookiee.
Zombies sound cool.  Where can I find the baker?

Buy or Bid on the Selected Item by pressing this button.

Commodities Market Location Filters

Use these filters to narrow or widen your search.  You can browse the Region for Items that can be bought and picked up here.  You can also browse by Planet or even the entire Galaxy.  

If you purchase an item from a distant location you will need to travel to that location to pick up your new item.

Item Type Filter.

Use this filter to choose what type of items for which to browse.

Items for sale or auction are displayed here.

Items for sale in the Commodities Market can be classified by sale type in two ways:

- Auction: Item item up for Auction can be bid on until the time runs out.  When the time runs out, the person with the highest bid gets the item.

- Instant Sale:  Items up for Instant Sale are available for purchase to the first person willing to pay the listed price.
 
Double click on an item to view a detailed description of it.

Available Items

When you purchase an item, cancel a sale, or if one of your sales has expired, the item shows up here.

You can retrieve the item from the Market from here.

Please note that you must be in the same Market Region as the item in order to retrieve it.

Enter your Proxy Bid here.

The Proxy Bid is the limit to which the Auction system will automatically raise your bid.  Your bid is only automatically raised if you are out-bid by another player.

Community Standards information, please review the following guidelines before submitting Community Standards tickets.  Please use the "community standards" categories only for reporting the various types of issues outlined below.  Inappropriate use of community standards categories can result in tickets being closed that must be resubmitted with the appropriate categories and repeated misuse can result in actions being taken against users' accounts.

Harrassment
Harrassment is defined as specifically targeting another player or group of players to harm or inconvenience them.  Harassment can take many forms and often what is seen as harassment by one person or group is perfectly acceptable game play.  An example of this in Star Wars is the way Bounty Hunter players hunt Jedi players (of course there may be cases where a Bounty Hunter player may specifically target a single Jedi player, this would be considered harassment and is not allowed.  Bounty Hunter players should not specifically target the same Jedi over and over).  Additionally, if someone calls you a bad name or offends you in any way, please first attempt to resolve the issue by using the built in features (/addignore, /filter) between the parties involved.  The ignore and language filter features provided in-game will help you to control and avoid most harassment.  Should you be unable to resolve the issue, please submit an in-game harassment ticket as a last course of action and the in-game staff will assist.
Remember, if you feel you are the target of harassment, please make sure that you do a /report <offending player name>.  This will send us the relevent chat data and log it to our servers for secure review.

Language
For all issues of inappropriate language in game, a player report is needed by using the report command; /report <offending player name>.  This will capture and send us the revelent chat data and log it to our servers for secure review.  For cases of mild and sporadic profanity, please make use of the features already in the game to ignore or block profanity.  The profanity filter (/filter) will garble most profanity, and is defaulted to on.  Should you decide to turn this filter off, you are deciding that mild profanity is of no concern to you.  If this is not the case, please turn the filter back on to prevent viewing of most profanity.  Parents allowing children to play the game should always ensure that the profanity filter is on at all times, as the game is rated T (Teen).  The Ignore list (/addignore <player name>) will add any player to your list that will block any spatial messages, private messages, group messages, or emotes.  You will only see the in-game avatar one that player is added.
Please do report severe cases of profane language, sexual/racial abuse, or hate mongering.

Trade Fraud
The /report <player name> command, although primarily used to report issues of harassment and language, is the preferred medium for recording a verbal agreement or "contract" between two players for buffing, items for credits, items to have repairs, slicing, ect. conducted on them.  This will send us the relevent data and log it to our servers for secure review.  These agreements must be logged for Customer Service to take any action should a deal go bad.  Unfortunately, without proof of the agreement, we are unable to assist in these issues.

Kill Stealing
Star Wars Galaxies does not recognize NPC/creature ownership for the point of attaining experience or gaining loot.  Corpse permissions are granted to the player/group that inflicts the most damage to the NPC/creature in question.  Additionally, we do not recognize any camp claims.  Customer Service will not be able to assist with claims of Kill Stealing.  We do however encourage players to play nice together and ask that everyone respect those already engaged in combat and only join in the attack if being asked for help.

Exploitation
All incidents of exploitation should be reported immediately for an in game support to assist.  A CSR must be able to physically witness the exploitation in game.

Inappropriate Player Names
Please report any inappropriate names you see while playing.  We also don't want to see them and will change the more severe names quickly.

In-Game Mail
All issues of verbal abuse and/or harassment experienced through the in-game mail system can be reported by using /report <offending player name> command or /report <system> command.  Please be sure to have the offending mail open prior to submitting the player report.

Evidence
Forum posts, eye witness testimonies, video footage, screenshots, player chat logs, and 3rd party website posts are not allowed as collaborating evidence in any of the above situations.

For further information on any of the above topics, please reference the Game Rules at the official website, or FAQs contained in our knowledge base articles.

Welcome to the Star Wars Galaxies Knowledge Base!  The Knowledge Base is a continuously updated resource for Star Wars Galaxies systems and policies.  You can use the Knowledge Base to search for information on your Profession or use it to solve many problems that you may encounter while playing Star Wars Galaxies.  To submit a ticket, you must first search the knowledge base and you will find the button to submit a ticket at the end of the article.

Thank you for contacting us regarding your issue.  If you have experienced a Bug and would like to report it or provide additional information for one of our Top Known Issues then please click on the Report A Bug button below or click on the Tab above.  Bugs will go directly to the Quality Assurance department and be investigated.  Please note that Bugs are not, as a rule, responded to.  We do encourage you to place Bug reports when you encounter an issue in Star Wars Galaxies and provide as many details as possible to help us track down the root cause.

If you require the assistance of a Customer Server Representative (CSR) then please click on the New Ticket button below or click on the tab above.  Tickets are answered in the order received so please do not delete and resubmit your ticket if your issue has not been resolved.  Take a moment before submitting to review our Ticket Categories to pick the one that best fits your issue.  Using the proper category will help us locate your problem and resolve it as quickly as possible.

If you are not online when a CSR attempts to contact you then a comment will be left in your ticket.  Simply respond to the ticket with any additional information the CSR requested and a CSR will be with you as quickly as possible.

A Modified Jedi weapon which has a second emitter matrix on the opposite end of the handgrip creating a double-blade. It consists of a cylindrical handle in which sophisticated circuits channel a beam of light through a series of crystals.  These crystals modulate the blade's size and amplitude. When activated, internal power cells create photoelectric energy which is focused through the series of crystals.  The energy is formed into a tight, parallel beam of coherent packets. These packets are emitted through a positively-charged continuous energy lens which projects the packets away from the lightsaber. The packets are almost immediately attracted back to the lightsaber by a negatively-charged high-energy flux aperture, and then continually recycled to create the glowing blade. The packets are recycled by a superconductor back into the power cell for re-energizing. The entire process is completely contained. No heat is generated and no energy is lost, since the light in the blade is recaptured. The only energy loss occurs when the blade strikes an object causing crystal decay.

A Traditional Jedi weapon, it consists of a cylindrical handle in which sophisticated circuits channel a beam of light through a series of crystals.  These crystals modulate the blade's size and amplitude. When activated, internal power cells create photoelectric energy which is focused through the crystals.  The energy is formed into a tight, parallel beam of coherent packets. These packets are emitted through a positively-charged continuous energy lens which projects the packets away from the lightsaber. The packets are almost immediately attracted back to the lightsaber by a negatively-charged high-energy flux aperture, and then continually recycled to create the glowing blade. The packets are recycled by a superconductor back into the power cell for re-energizing. The entire process is completely contained. No heat is generated and no energy is lost, since the light in the blade is recaptured.  The only energy loss occurs when the blade strikes an object causing crystal decay.

Life Day is a holiday celebrated on Kashyyyk, the Wookiee homeworld, in order to recognize the renewal of life and remember those who have passed on. Because Life Day is important for reconnecting with family and friends, Wookiees will brave arduous treks to be reunited with loved ones on the holiday. Although originally celebrated only on Kashyyyk, and usually at the Tree of Life, the concept of Life Day has slowly spread across the galaxy. The Life Day Orb, a Wookiee artifact, is a traditional symbol carried by Wookiees during the Life Day celebrations. 

"We celebrate a day of peace, a day of harmony. A day of joy we all can share together..." - Traditional Life Day song lyric (translated from Shyriiwook)
